description: Delicious, healthy, Asian inspired food, freshly made everyday in 70 beautifully designed shops

records.title: Big up to my guy Moses who works in the…
records.text: Big up to my guy Moses who works in the itsu in Gatwick airport kind,gentle and welcoming and made my journey even better when him putting on a smile Thanks Moses continue to shine light on others 🤞

records.title: Great experience at itsu thanks to…
records.text: Great experience at itsu thanks to hospitality of Moses at Gatwick Airport south terminal

records.title: As Itsu virgins we enjoyed a lovely…
records.text: As Itsu virgins we enjoyed a lovely first time experience at the Itsu Liverpool Street. The staff were exceptionally good at helping us navigate our way through the ordering process, the food was hot, tasty and efficiently produced. We’ll certainly try Itsu again!

records.title: ITSU at Brunswick Centre: three cheers for the lovely staff!!!
records.text: ITSU at Brunswick Centre, Camden is an extremely nice Sushi place. The staff are very helpful especially Ornella and Wojciech who have taught me how to operate the technology. Now I can scan with my app and claim my butterflies with ease. I have also been taught how to access my NHS discount. Thank goodness for lovely staff who enjoy their jobs and make customers feel special.

records.title: Itsu Reading Gate is Great
records.text: At Itsu Reading Gate and clean restaurant and friendly staff. Food was quick and great too!

records.title: Tasty food!!
records.text: My 13 year old son loves this restaurant chain. He ordered a rice box and absolutely loved it. He normally complains about eating vegetables but the way its cooked and presented meant he was happy to eat the veg. The decor is beautiful.

records.title: I ate at the itsu restaurant in…Brunswick Centre
records.text: I ate at the itsu restaurant in Brunswick Centre. Naast de excellent food the service was extra special. All smiles and genuine interest in us as tourists visiting for the first time. Quick, efficient and friendly!

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent service, lovely food,I can highly recommend it.

records.title: Phenomenal Food 🥢🩵
records.text: Itsu has such a great menu with really fair prices. The sushi is phenomenal and always so fresh! I also love that it is a healthier option than most fast-food chains/restaurants. The atmosphere inside to dine in is always great too. ✨ The only criticism I have is including the mini soy sauce bottle with every sushi pack - it’s quite wasteful as it may not be used. I think instead there should be an option to take a mini bottle of it if wanted. Other than this the packaging is great :)Apart from this small criticism, everything else is perfect and I absolutely love the app with the loyalty scheme! Would definitely recommend this amazing restaurant to everyone 🫶 🍣 🦋

records.title: I have been visiting the Brixton branch…
records.text: I have been visiting the Brixton branch since it's opening just over a year ago and enjoy the convenience of grabbing a hot meal less than 5mins away from my office. I especially love the poached egg add-on and each dish I order tends to have that top up. I would highly recommend if you fancy some Asian-inspired eat-in or takeaway fast food. Only thing to bear in mind is that it's cashless eatery so old schoolers like myself have to whip out the card...

records.title: very good service and very nice people…
records.text: very good service and very nice people highly recommend

records.title: Early adopter
records.text: Early adopter. I've been using itsu since it started and I'm still a fan.  The salmon went through a very iffy phase for about 6 months ( crunchy texture,really not good ) but that was a couple of years ago , all good since. There is a difference between outlets, whether that's good or bad is subjective.*** itsu social media person ***Please don't comment, I have no issue to be addressed and I don't need my ego stroked .No disrespect intended.

records.title: Disappointing trip turned into great service
records.text: I was disappointed when I bought sushi and realised it already had wasabi on it. Unfortunately I do not like this so it was a waste of my money. I simply enquired online whether it was possible in the future to get this removed. Sandra then went above and beyond and very kindly sent me some vouchers! I am impressed with their customer service and look forward to ordering sushi without wasabi in the future :)

records.title: Off menu - but still good!!
records.text: I buy my lunch from Itsu fairly regularly. It's healthy and nutritious and minimal fuss. The shop near Chancery Lane, London is small, friendly and it's never busy because everyone else appears to go to Wasabi!!The only reason this review doesn't have five stars is because they've recently stopped selling the rice and veggie dumplings! It was something that I would eat with a Miso...I've had to explore other options which may have meant I've tried more food that they sell - but nothing really beats the ease and taste of the rice and dumplings...BRING IT BACK!!!!

records.title: Thank you
records.text: I previously gave itsu a low rating, but after visiting a couple of times after, i can say that it has improved vastly. The prices are still on the expensive side but the customer service is so much better. Thank you

records.title: Great sushi at good price. The best choice if you are on the go or have little time  for office breaks.
records.text: itsu is a great sushi for its price. One can eat well for a budget price if sushi is on your lunch break. It’s quick, fresh, variety is good and  eating facility is good. I have had better sushi at a high end restaurant. But then the cost includes expensive drinks, personal servers and top end sushi chefs. For a quick sushi on the go, itsu is very decent and good value.

records.title: Regular lunch of the chicken teryaki…
records.text: Regular lunch of the chicken teryaki bowl at the Soho branch. Always good, tasty and quick, pleasant service

records.title: Good
records.text: Good service, good food, nice to see more tasty healthy food options. Maybe get rid of some of the sugary drinks on the shelves or make them smaller?! Fish is v.g.

records.title: great customer service
records.text: Average sushi but great customer experience. Good if you are in a hurry!

records.title: It was really good
records.text: It was really good. No queue friendly staff and food to the ready.

records.title: Music too loud
records.text: I like some of the food dishes and the jasmine tea and consider it good value for money.I have been put off at a couple of locations by the excessively loud music being played. Turn the volume down, please.

records.title: I have used the just opened Exeter…
records.text: I have used the just opened Exeter branch of Itsu 3 times in the last 10 or so days. Ive done bullet points to simplify my thoughts.•Fitted out the premises beautifully•The food is beautiful (if not sometimes exactly what's described in the menu,put down to maybe more training or lack of experience.•Does not accept CASH.!!! This is legal tender & no company should take it on themselves to ban it. This particular one urks me.• No display of opening times on shop front.•funny closing times,8pm Mon to Thursday 9pm friday onwards, seems like your missing customers as the city has very little in the way of takeaway,least of all healthy alternatives.My review will be adjusted as & when things I am sure will improve. But the cash ban leaves me not recommending at this times as I am a strong advocate for the use of cash.

records.title: Where's the ginger?
records.text: Great sushi, good service, always consistent, but really fed-up with their ridiculous attitude when requesting some ginger.  Every other boxed sushi vendor places some ginger in their offerings but Itsu stopped doing this a while back.  So I ask for a little ginger at the counter.  Having been assured - in writing - by Itsu that their policy is to provide one packet of ginger free-of-charge per boxed item when requested at the till this is never realised and every time we have to go through a merry dance to not add a ridiculously trivial 5p for a sachet.  This is not about the money: it is the inconsistency and childishness that is the frustration.

records.title: Not the worst place to work
records.text: Not the worst place to work, job security is there although bad hours of work and not much reliability there, could have 15 hours a week, could have 45, depends. Staff and management usually are god awful and people are promoted on nepotism basis while HR is quite alright and CEO isn't abandoning care for his employees, noone got left behind during COVID while Pret a manger fired like 40% of their staff

records.title: Too much plastic, Itsu!
records.text: I bought Itsu crispy seaweed thins from a supermarket. My husband and I absolutely love them BUT I don't want to buy them again because the amount of plastic packaging used is horrendous! The individual packets contain plastic holders, wrapped in plastic, which are wrapped again in the outer layer of plastic keeping them together. Each individual packet also contains a small plastic packet of a substance which stops the product from spoiling. I appreciate that the product is very delicate but, seriously, there HAS to be a more environmentally friendly way of delivering this product to customers. I just can't bear to throw packet after packet into the bin. Please address this issue.

records.title: I got myself the Lloyds Bank World…
records.text: I got myself the Lloyds Bank World Elite Card and it invited me to sign up to Itsu as part of its rewards partners. I decided that i would give Itsu a go and so i went into Baths store to get some Gyoza. Firstly i couldn't use the app and it kept saying it wouldn't scan. I then couldn't get it to work. I ordered and went to the counter and said "Are you able to add my butterflies onto my account" (felt weird to say that!) - only to be told that they couldn't because i needed to spend over a fiver... i explained that i had as it was £5.95 and i was told to go onto the website and there will be help on there. NOPE... no help whatsoever. Not even an option to be able to ask for general question help. I decided to message marketing and upload the photo of the food and my receipt... nope. Crashed and said there was an issue! Not great service!

records.title: Didn't look like picture on menu.
records.text: I looked up the menu online and it looked delicious. Well presented in a bowl. Even on the day of ordering it showed the dish in a bowl. Then after ordering they gave it me in a cardboard tub. I thought the watery slop with flavoured water was overpriced for over £8.00.

records.title: Tea but no milk of any kind - in the capital of England!
records.text: The food was okay, nothing special. But what annoyed me was that I ordered an English breakfast tea - in London - only to find they provided no milk of any sort. That is simply sloppy. I tried to drink it black, but it was so disgusting I could not do that.

records.title: Nothing special to be honest. There’s better out there
records.text: Nothing special to be honest. I don’t support companies that charge 20% to sit down to eat so customers pay their tax. That’s just not on. I know a lot of companies so it. The rule apparently does not apply to hot food is what I was told. Such I and other items apply he sushi is pretty good and fresh. I’m not sure about ingredients. Particularly on their sauces because most companies that sell this sort of food use MSG which is a particularly nasty ingredient. When I asked staff they told me they did not know about MSG and to look at web site. yo sushi is as more informed and checked and told me some products like their soup contain it. I’m surprised of the lack of training at Itsu. Particularly because of the ordeal at Pret and people with allergies. As a consequence, customers are always asked about whether they have an allergy. Also, sulfites is another thing I don’t like whether you have an allergy or not. Wagamama put it in their sauces as a preservative. To summarise, do your research on what they use, particularly soups and sauces. You might just be surprised that a place you eat regularly is causing you problems long term and using ingredients that are not good for you. Don’t be mislead by the fact things like sushi are considered good for you. That might be the case but look out for what they add to all dishes I am going to update my review soon with an update concerning msg and sulfites

records.title: My question is how can you have two…
records.text: My question is how can you have two different price for the vegetable dumplings! If it is hot it is priced at £3.49. If you have it cold it is £4.19.it makes no sense.

records.title: Thier always dirty
records.text: Thier always dirty , they don’t clean or sanitise most of thier counter tops and the trays that we use to eat food on. They’re always a fly hovering around and some of the staff are rude and overbearing, the suchi is always falling apart and can’t be picked up by the chop sticks , the dumplings in the miso soup is always falling apart and makes the soup look uninviting. 👎🏾 it puts me off eating there to be honest . Thier toilets aren’t always clean and both men and women have to share the same toilet 😮‍💨 it’s odd putting to say the least . 👎🏾

records.title: Warning ! Chicken teriyaki rice bowl
records.text: I have gotten the chicken and teriyaki rice bowl from here before and other foods as-well, but the most recent time I have gotten the chicken teriyaki rice bowl it gave me food poisoning! I remember looking at the chicken and thinking it looked funny but just ignored it as I had eaten it before. The worst food poisoning I have ever had. Hot hot fever with the chills

records.title: I Went itsu (Eat Beautiful) At Fosse…
records.text: I Went itsu (Eat Beautiful) At Fosse Park Leicester Last Week For The First Time Customer Service Here Not Welcoming Enough For Me To Return No Smile & Not At All Welcoming So I Very Begrudgingly Wanted To Spend My Money There.... Anyway I Did.... And So I Opted For The Salmon Salad Box (Promotional Offer) Which Looked Good Similar To The Photo But Unfortunately it Seemed Stingy For £6.99! Very Small Piece Of Salmon Cheap Brown Rice And Some Beans And Other Stuff In There it Just Tasted Bland No Flavour Even With The Dip That Comes With It And it Was Just Boring And Definitely Lacked Flavour I Wouldn't Come Back Again As A Greggs Sandwich Next Door Has More Flavour!

records.title: It lost its appeal.
records.text: I feel like the menu just got more boring, cheaper in terms of quality and less tasty. Also a lot of the ingredients are really hard to digest. Like why combine uncooked cabbages, kale, onions, etc all in one dish. Why? Who designs these menus? I feel bloated every time i go to ITSU… It also got a lot more expensive as well and the whole menu feels tired and same, same. The app finally got a bit better but it’s still often buggy and the interface and how to get your freebies is not intuitive. I need a member of staff every time to trouble shoot… it used to be my favourite lunch spot but now I only go there if I forgot to bring in my lunch. And only because it’s the closest to the office.

records.title: Won't bother again
records.text: Just tried Itsu products from a supermarket for the first time. The teriyaki chicken bao buns had about 3mm of filling. All I could taste was bun. The pork gyoza had filling but not much flavour. The only reason I gave this review a 2 and not a 1 was the stuffed green and chile pancakes were reasonable enough filling and flavour.My daughter mentioned she generally liked Itsu products so I gave her the rest out the freezer. Next day she told me the bao buns had a ridiculously small amount of filling which was unusual. Is this a factory error or just another company cutting their ingredients to rip off the customer?

records.title: Okay food, high prices, bad app
records.text: Food was okay (pretty good rather than very good, and rather overpriced) but once again the app didn’t work. Told the restaurant manager - nothing he could do and no way to add “credits” later. If you’re going to launch a loyalty scheme then you really should do it right or else it becomes an anti-loyalty scheme.

records.title: Wasabi tucked under sushi roll- Unpleasant
records.text: I used to love going to Itsu to the point where I would go there for most of my work lunch breaks. However, recently, when ordering my go-to avocado & sushi salmon set, I noticed a pea-sized dot of wasabi tucked underneath the sushi salmon, which tastes extremely unpleasant. There should be an option, like in most sushi restaurants to have wasabi 'on the side', rather than inside the sushi. There doesn't seem to be an option of avocado & salmon sushi without wasabi inside of the roll, so I'm very disappointed.

records.title: Undercooked rice
records.text: For the price of their sushi, I am getting tired of the endless, undercooked, slightly crunchy and wet sushi rice (not normal mirin moisture, just over-wet and soggy). If they want to keep their customers they need to get this most basic ingredient correctly prepared. It makes me feel ill.Also, they need to find a way of using less disposable plastic. All in all I'm losing my will to eat there anymore.(Hanover Square Branch)

records.title: Itsu at Stansted Airport.
records.text: Itsu at Stansted Airport.I tried to pay in cash and found out that Itsu is ‘cashless’. That’s a mild annoyance but I can live with it. What wasn’t okay is that the cash register display said ‘Card Preferred’ so when I pointed this out, the somewhat obnoxious Itsu employee pointed out to a tiny little label which said ‘card only’ on the card machine. If you are going to go cashless, at least make it clear so that customers have a choice BEFORE being asked to pay. Nobody likes to be told their cash is worthless. Oh, and your sushi rice was undercooked on two occasions.

records.title: Overpriced and under cooked
records.text: Poor experience at the new Reading Gate location. Some of the food was under cooked and the dumplings were rubbery and cold in the centre. As for the service, glum faces and for the second visit in a row, the staff were slamming the self surface bin doors as they emptied them.It’s a shame as we had high hopes, but all three of us at our table agreed the food was under prepared and over priced. Not sure we will be going back. At least not until we hear it’s improved. Let’s hope these are the teething problems of a new branch. But after reading other reviews here, I wonder whether ITSU has wider issues across its network.

records.title: I have been buying from the hellenic…
records.text: I have been buying from the hellenic deli for e few times.The product is excellent every time.But this time my parcel was delivered to my neighbour, a matter that should looked into.Otherwise very happy.

records.title: The best I've ever tasted...
records.text: The best olive oil, olives and honey l have ever tasted. I always buy them from the Hellenic deli as other brands simply don't compare.The only reason l don't give 5 stars is that the delivery system is very  inconvenient. I was notified that it would be on Tuesday but having stayed in all day, was notified that it would not be delivered till the following day. I have learned from previous deliveries that if you're not in when they deliver, it is not possible to arrange redelivery or specify a safe place - you have to go to collect it from a Mail shop near Euston. This has happened to me twice and in each case l had the expense of a taxi to bring the box home as it was too heavy to carry.I really think they should use another courier who would specify a time slot and provide the option for redelivery/ safe place.
