description: wethwerspoons.co.uk - wet her spoons!

records.title: Superb service
records.text: Ordered a small breakfast, impressed with friendly service, timing, freshness and temperature of food. Went down well with a coffee. Paignton Devon.

records.title: Great staff, particularly Dylan.
records.text: I went to Wetherspoons in Tamworth and I hadn't been for a while. I was pleasantly surprised with how great the new extension looked. All the staff were great and I loved the app service so we didn't have to queue at the bar. One man in particular was outstanding with his customer service. He constantly smiled and was kind and polite to all he comes across including our group and I have recently been told his name is Dylan. We had a great visit. Dylan made what was already a great day to a fantastic day. Thank you.

records.title: Breakfasts in Weatherspoons are superb
records.text: Breakfasts in Weatherspoons are superb, good food, good service and the staff in Lichfield are professional and friendly. If you have never been for breakfast- try it .

records.title: The Acorn Inn, Lichfield.
records.text: The Acorn Inn, Lichfield. A quick thank you to Dani and her two colleagues who cleared Table 66 in record time, whilst smiling. Good on ya, girls!

records.title: A shining example for pubs and restaurants.
records.text: The Acorn in Lichfield. Made very welcome by all staff who were extremely polite and efficient even though the pub was full and very busy.  Steak was cooked as requested and offered excellent value. Tables were regularly cleared and cleaned. Toilets were clean and tidy. Good atmosphere, Excellent value. Good meal.Manager enquired as to how I enjoyed my food.

records.title: Half term in Blackpool at the Velvet…
records.text: Half term in Blackpool at the Velvet coaster, lovely ambience, nicely priced food and drink. Superb bar staff who were efficient. Enjoyable food.

records.title: Went to Wetherspoons in March
records.text: Went to Wetherspoons in March, Cambridgeshire last night with my 90 year old dad and other family members and we could not have been treated better than we were at the Savoy in London.The food was so reasonably priced and drinks also and the on duty manager, Sophie, went out of her way to ensure that our party was comfortable and well served.Thank you so much for an extremely attentive service.Sophie needs to be promoted to customer experience manager.

records.title: Whether spoons heswall outstanding…
records.text: Whether spoons heswall outstanding service sooper competitive prices sooper clean loos . excellent foodFirst time for some years in a weather spoons well and truly impressed

records.title: Lost bag in Wetherspoon
records.text: I visited Wetherspoons, Liberty Bounds, at Tower Hill, London, after a boat party in the Thames last Saturday around 6pm.   We had a lovely pint, with all the other party goers, great atmosphere,  and then set on our way home to the Midlands. Realized I had left my handbag somewhere, I called the pub the following day, and it had been handed in. The kind worker, Darren, I spoke to told me he would post it to me and I received the parcel today, by special delivery, all contents intact. I'm so grateful, fabulous customer service.

records.title: The staff are always happy and helpful…
records.text: The staff are always happy and helpful at the mexborough pub Breakfast is lovely we go twice a month for it

records.title: fantastic food and drink although…
records.text: fantastic food and drink although desert was poor gorgeous curry and pizza, great quick service with the drinks however though the only thing that let it down was the horribly crunchy desert that was overcooked.

records.title: the app works a treat
records.text: Personally the app works a treat, if you want something fancy and delicious then you're deluded to think Wether spoons is the place to be. But if you want a no fuss pub then they usually brilliant, service is fine, they might not smile or be a bit blunt but it's still massively cheaper than most pubs.The Bromley branch is excellent, albeit a bit bland compared to other branches but is spacious, lots of seating, not had any harassment or threatening behaviour and lots of areas to have a nice private chat. Brings a lot of different kinds of people so overall has a chill atmosphere

records.title: Great staff
records.text: Great food, great price, great staff. My wife and I have just eaten at Brighton marina wetherspoons and really enjoyed it. Cam was really lovely. He was very attentive and very respectful. He had to deal with all sorts of situations (drinks machine packing up and strange people coming in and out) yet he still kept cheerful and upbeat. The manager (Young girl, not very tall) is also lovely. She remembered us and gave us her time despite being very busy. Just a suggestion: warmer plates and provide cleaner cutlery and we will give it 5 stars next time.

records.title: Always pretty good service and value…
records.text: Always pretty good service and value value for money.They provide an environment for people to come socialise old and young, but equally I’ve seen many beaches offering free coffee to homeless people.I also note these pubs opening earlier provide a good social platform for oaps to come meet each other.I think they are more than a pub chain, but actually offer a community service that many people miss coming here to eat or drink in many of these places all around the country.Well done to all the hard working staff and owner for providing these places for local communities.

records.title: Ale prices
records.text: 8 July 24One and a half pints of 6% American Pale Ale guest ale.  See Wetherspoon guest ales leaflet in pubs, or on the Web, change every 3 months. Cost £2.99! £1.99 pint. Why can’t other national pub chains match these prices? They too have 100s of pubs, so should be able to negotiate big discounts, and often sell beers from their own breweries anyway. In a cost of living crisis, why pay twice or three times more? Especially in micro pubs, which are often just small converted shops. Unfortunately, my recent experience of the food was not so good, so I just drink the ales.I also approve the ban on vaping, as I object to having to breathe the smoke, containing who knows what chemicals.

records.title: Ignorance
records.text: Well we have used The Waggon and Horses for years 2/3 times a week and the staff normally acknowledge us ! However the manager is very strange sometimes he will chat but yesterday we passed him and he totally ignored us he does this quite frequently and we really don’t understand ! We have been in the pub trade and thought especially with the regular customers you learn their names and chat with them this guy needs some help

records.title: Their food and drinks are very good…
records.text: Their food and drinks are very good value for money Every meal I have had there has been good. The only bug bear I have is their anti dog policy at one pub they’d roped off a bit of the pavement and put chairs out there and had a go at me for having my dog inside the roped off bit. Do they own the pavement? The dog was sitting quietly not disturbing anyone in fact many were asking if they could stroke her. Families and children often like dogs if one is disruptive then they should be asked to leave but well behaved ones should be welcome, especially outside

records.title: Bole Bridge in Tamworth
records.text: I've been using the Bole Bridge in Tamworth regularly for a couple of years now. I breakfast there twice a week and go for the odd evening meal and a couple of pints. The food's always good. Service is excellent. Staff are doing a grand job but they're always rushed off their feet as there never seems to be enough to cater for the sheer volume of clientele. I've knocked a mark off because I get confronted with sticky tables at breakfast time now and again.

records.title: 2 issues
records.text: I've been to various Wetherspoons pubs across the south of England and London, and overall, I've had a fantastic service. The only real issues I've really had was the extras you get on curry nights and the slow service of some branches. Otherwise, an excellent experience of visiting these pubs.

records.title: Wetherspoons largs.
records.text: Wetherspoons largs.Nice drinks and decent food  and lovely views of largs harbour.Some wetherspoons chips are a bit raw but here they were properly cooked.

records.title: Had a road trip in Scotland and have…
records.text: Had a road trip in Scotland and have had dinner in Inverness then tonight in Aberdeen! I have to say I have been impressed on both visits as recently I have had a disappointing experience from where I live in the south.Tonight I tried the haggis and cheese and it came as a panini and tasted amazing!! Also ordered a veggie pizza and this too looked and tasted great! All food we have had over the last two nights has arrived hot and within 10 minutes of ordering.Food has been freshly cooked and the staff have been great! What is the south missing??

records.title: I find all the pubs to be decent
records.text: I find all the pubs to be decent, sometimes a little messy with tables not being cleared but oh well move it yourself you’re paying less than £3 a pint. Food is always decent in my experience too. Pre-match routine in spoons.

records.title: The Old Gaol House at…
records.text: The Old Gaol House at Winchester.Reasonable setting.Had the mixed grill.Very nice,but meat could have done with a little bit warmer.But good service for the food,in under ten minutes.Beer at a very reasonable price.waitress with the food very pleasant.Plenty of places to sit

records.title: Breakfast!
records.text: Honestly, the best place to get a breakfast in the morning, if you’re in a city you’re not familiar with!

records.title: The Dale, Willenhall
records.text: Having failed to order either the Mixed Grill or Caledonian Burger neither of which were available I had the Ultimate Burger and a pint of Stairway to Heaven both of which were lovely.

records.title: Very nice experience
records.text: Wetherspoons Henley on Thames great half chicken and great service. Thanks

records.title: V Shed, Bristol
records.text: Ordered some drinks and they were all really nice. Although the salad was a little limp, the food was generally tasty. Spoons is a staple of a good day/night out.

records.title: I like huntingdon whetherspoons
records.text: I like huntingdon whetherspoons, the staff are all lovely and friendly, the food comes out hot most of the time, and its an interesting historic building  full of interesting pictures of the local area BUT when a meal is ready they have this horrible beeping machine which can be heard all over the pub,  spoils my visits but i am spergic so i notice these things and others do not.

records.title: Always good food
records.text: Always good food, good value and polite staff.

records.title: Sir john moore
records.text: Sir john mooreNice staff and decent food

records.title: Breakfast
records.text: Went this morning for breakfast to the Auld Brig in Irvine...ordered Mushroom Benedict...never been so disappointed in my life...eggs were like bullets...being a cook myself I expect to receive lovely soft poached eggs...I personally would have binned them if I'd cooked them like that...my advice would be to avoid this dish on the menu

records.title: Mmmmm, just don't do it
records.text: Mmmmm, can't believe they've changed San Miguel for tasteless por(sh) etti.Probably to save 5p a pint. I don't go in the spoons anymore.I ve found an alternative supply 😋😁

records.title: Newcastle Quayside Wetherspoons. Very mediocre.
records.text: Newcastle Quayside Wetherspoons.Mediocre.... Service is very slow. Ordered food early but it took ages to arrive and 'pudding' had to be requested three times!Food was okay and beers were nice.WiFi was appalling... Frequently cut out and very slow. Unable to order online due to pathetic service.

records.title: Cold Harry Clasper.
records.text: The Harry Clasper in Whickham, Tyne and Wear, is my local Wetherspoons.Since opening the staff have never been able or unwilling to use the air conditioning/ heating system correctly. Despite numerous requests by customers it constantly blows cold air into the bar area on cold evenings. Privately, staff have told me that they prefer it that way as it is very hot behind the bar. As I write this review I and my friends are being blasted by cold air which is unacceptable.By writing this review I hope management may view it and take steps to remedy the situation. My friends and I and other customers are presently sitting uncomfortably with our outdoor coats on.

records.title: Haverfordwest William Owen
records.text: Haverfordwest William Owen, can't fault the staff food always good and drinks priced very well, on this occasion my daughter's meal was very late coming out after everyone else finishing theirs and it's a child's meal ! The restaurant is filthy today August 1st 2024 dirty plates all over the tables.Very disappointed if I didn't know the place better would not have stayed.

records.title: Expensive for what it is, even though you wouldn’t think so.
records.text: I’m pescatarian and also gluten free, so trying to find something appealing on the current menu is frankly challenging. I decided to have halloumi which was apparently a ‘light bite’.  Now bearing in mind the dish cost just over £5 I was slightly disappointed that there were 5 small thin sticks of halloumi. So this meant that each measly little one cost £1. Judging by the low Trust Pilot score they clearly don’t do well impressing people! They clearly need to up their game!

records.title: (Caenarfon ) keep the locals happy
records.text: (Caenarfon) food was good although curry sauce was cold, staff polite but not friendly unless ur a local. We must have sat in someones seat as soon as we sat down a couple came and sat on next table banged chairs onto our table and gave us dirty looks, we did same back and promptly moved as they looked like they should be in a pig stye not a pub. We moved near the disabled loo which aprared not to be as decided by the pissed up locals who couldn't be bothered to use the correct Toilets. Rowdy locals cheering and swearing at the top of there voices, not the usual higher standard of a wetherspoons.

records.title: Terrible
records.text: Went to East Grinstead Weatherspoon and was disappointed to be told that the kitchen was shut until further notice, We went there a few days later and got told the same thing! Staff are clueless tooUpdate 02/07/24 - Went in earlier and the service was much better than previous visits so amending my original 1 star rating

records.title: Very unusual result in the JD…
records.text: Very unusual result in the JD Wetherspoons we visited today. The Prince of Wales in Cardiff. Absolutely terrible service, probably very short staffed. Waited well over 40mins for food which in a Spoons is pretty surprising to say the least. No one clearing/cleaning tables, zero condiments except at a station at the back of the pub. Only posting as it’s so unusual. Someone did come to apologise.

records.title: Disability Matters
records.text: So. Not wishing to just be negative about everything and everyone, unless it's deserved....Wetherspoons. Toilets upstairs. RADAR key for those of us unfortunate enough to not be able to deal with stairs. Not just this place (Lifeboat, Formby) but others in Southport, Liverpool, for example. Staff compromise the locks, all and sundry using "our facility"I wouldn't wish my condition or that of the three other disabled customers in here right now on anyone else, but laziness and ignorance are not disabilities. Get this policy corrected. Stop abusing those less fortunate and get staff to enforce rather than ignore the behaviour.

records.title: I’ve always loved their Katsu Chicken…
records.text: I’ve always loved their Katsu Chicken Curry until the last couple of times they deliberately left out the Chilli and Coriander, which should’ve been in with the rest of ingredients!Let down by lazy kitchen staff!

records.title: Cold food
records.text: Has breakfast in The Tremenheere, Penzance this morning.  Staff were polite.  However,  the food was lukewarm with my husbands bacon cold. Can't fault the low price. Don't think I'll be back

records.title: The Gin glass rim was covered in…
records.text: The Gin glass rim was covered in lipstick, I returned the drink to the bar and the bar man had to look through a couple of glasses for a clean Gin glass. I didn’t get a fresh drink, the drink was transferred into the clean glass.However the food we had was delicious and hot.This Wetherspoons was at Cardiff Bay, The Mount Stuart.

records.title: Had an all day veggie brunch and a…
records.text: Had an all day veggie brunch and a cappuccino in West Kirby, Wirral. No way can you complain about the price but the so called quorn veggie sausages, we’re not quorn! I ate a couple of pieces before I decided those sausages were more akin to lumps of lard. Just change to as advertised in the menu and I’d gladly pay more.

records.title: Have been going to wetherspoons…
records.text: Have been going to wetherspoons hedgeford lodge for years and we always had fish and chips as it was absolutely delicious! However we went on the 26/6/24 for lunch and we were very disappointed. When my fish came, well can't call it fish as it was just batter, I was very surprised to see that the fish was very small and overcooked. I couldn't even cut into it. I must say that when I brought it to the attention of a member of staff she quickly sorted it for me. After 5minutes she brought me a new meal with fresh chips and peas. Unfortunately I won't be ordering fish again! Also I always order on the app but there is no facility to order a shandy. I will go back here because I really love their breakfast wrap.

records.title: Never eat at Okehampton Fore Street again 4oz Gristle
records.text: I went to Okehampton fore street for my sons birthday meal as I remembered in the past good food there. This was definitely not good food as my son ordered ham n chips n liked his meal BUT I ordered Classic 8oz Sirloin steak which came with chips. I ordered medium rare n the Steak looked like it was burnt to a crisp n the chips were twenty with maybe only 2 or 3 at a reasonable length the rest were tiny n after eating through my Steak 4oz was just gristle. I had been looking forward to a nice meal but it was NOT! I would say as I’ve eaten out at many places over the 15yrs living there & to get that quality of meal at £10 I will not be eating there again!.

records.title: The Francis Newton in Sheffield.
records.text: The Francis Newton in Sheffield.I spent 10 mins trying to order on the app. Couldn’t. The only Barman on duty said they’d switched it off because they are a staff member down!Resulted in a huge queue round his order point right by the only entrance door. Why couldn’t he move to a point further down the bar avoiding the queue issue in the narrowest section of this large pub. Not well managed

records.title: In general our local Spoons…is not too bad, and recommended.
records.text: In general our local Spoons (Witherspoon) in Faversham is pretty good. As a Guinness drinker, in the main, the bar staff all but some being miserable, know how to poor a Guinness. (Up to harp, let it stand, push away) But just lately, keep putting it in an orange squash glass isn’t on. If Guinness haven’t supplied the Guinness glasses, then at least try to poor in a suitable similar glass. Some none Guinness drinkers wouldn’t understand, but those of us that have drank Guinness from the age of 16, and now 65, know it’s a special drink, and needs better than a squash glass. Yes, I don’t mind admitting, I use the spoons as a it’s cheap, but if this keeps on, I’ll willingly pay more for a decent pint elsewhere. (Which I must admit, not many pubs in the town know how to poor it, and there is a lot)

records.title: Nice setting for The Back of Beyond in…
records.text: Nice setting for The Back of Beyond in Reading. Sitting outside in the sunshine overlooking the Kennet canal I ordered  the pasta for lunch. It came fairly quickly but looked like it had been kept warm under a grill. The top layer was crisp and inedible. Wouldn't order again.

records.title: Although food was tasty it came out…
records.text: Although food was tasty it came out cold. This means the staff obviously don't know what they are doing as my wife commented hers was hot or they are underpaid and don't care, or both.They need to seriously improve this, hence the 3 stars.

records.title: Wetherspoons Feltham popped in for a…
records.text: Wetherspoons Feltham popped in for a couple of pints. Tried a couple of the seasonal real ales, sadly left most of the drinks. Both tired, little head and no taste. I have drunk at the William Ellis in Twickenham recently and must say they pour decent pints of real ale. The barmen told me a barrel only last a couple of days so I guess that is probably the difference between the two branches.

records.title: Ordered 12 inch wrap with coffee... 1230hrs SUTTON SURREY MOON UNDER WATER
records.text: Ordered 12 inch wrap with coffee.... 6 inch wrap arrived.... told by staff was large one.... 2 minutes later table next to mine had delivered wraps twice the size of mine?!?!?! Of the two coffee machines available neither working properly most items unavailable and drink i received was tepid.... not happy. AVOID THE PLACE

records.title: Not great wetherspoons
records.text: Not great wetherspoons! No coffee, overcrowded, noisy and not enough staff.

records.title: Winter gards , harrogate
records.text: Went to The winter Gardens, Harrogate with my mum and my grandma. Worse experience was told in the morning they had run out of breakfasts" hense the cold weather. We all got three filter coffees to warm ourselves up. Nice coffee 😁 despite getting told no breakfasts being served, then next to find out maybe they was not gonna be serving normal dinner menu. We came back to Witherspoon's for lunch. One wanted The ultimate burger to order and find out they weren't doing no burgers. My grandma got the BBQ chicken melt well was ok but nothing special. I got the Classic chicken tikka was lovely. Apart from no burgers and saying nothing on menu all unavailable. ? Maybe give wetherspoons here a miss next time. Think it's going down the pan

records.title: We went to the John Wallace in Newport…
records.text: We went to the John Wallace in Newport - found a table straight away, wasn’t too busy as it was half term and Halloween. Ordered on the app, took 35mins for someone to bring over the cups for coffee machine. When eventually got to the machine, no milk so was a wait. No sugar. Took 50mins for the breakfast to come out which was cold. Too hungry to even moan otherwise would have took longer and had kids with us. My daughter had a kids meal and no apple snack arrived. Was really disappointed and we have been to a lot of Wetherspoons in the past.

records.title: Derby Standing Order 🤔
records.text: Derby Standing order, haven't eaten there for years until this morning, tried a traditional breakfast, almost empty but arrived 25 minutes after ordering and cold! Rubbish food and service

records.title: Disgusting way to treat customers
records.text: Edinburgh branch of this chain has stopped all early bird specials before 5pm as the Fringe has started!  The poor staff had to handle all the angry customers who support the chain for the other 48 weeks of the year!    The meal being much more expensive than usual was awful…..smallest piece of fish ever and twice if not three times cooked chips….disappointing and will not be returning!

records.title: Good potential but cold
records.text: Just been to the new yard inn Livingston, the breakfast had potential but was cold when I received it, as I look around and listened it seems like we are not the only ones with the same problem,  luckily the coffee was hot…..

records.title: The rose Saltaire Bideford
records.text: The rose Saltaire BidefordSevice 1/10Food 3/10Cleanliness none existant if fact disgraceful floors covered with food,napkins cutlery etcnot one empty table clean glasses and plates all over themI'm a regular wetherspoons customer my local being the watchmaker in prescot and wherever I go if there's one i use it but never will i go in rose Saltaire again unless it vastly improves

records.title: The Bear Maidenhead not great quality.
records.text: On 19th August I went to The Bear in Maidenhead BERKSHIRE. I ordered a breakfast there were no eggs and toast was not available  I was given a muffin. I over heard another member if staff saying they had run out of items the night before.  My friend later ordered a meal and was told they didn't have anymore steak and kidney pudding when she asked for a beef burger once again they didn't have any. This pub has just been refurbished and apparently has new management.  It's really gone down hill....

description: Our primary cuisine is Texas-style barbecue. Our dishes tend to baseline on four key ingredients: aged wood, quality meat, sea salt and cracked black pepper. Combining this with the low and slow method of cooking makes our food flavoursome and tender. This is paired with classic American sides; such as macaroni cheese and southern potato salad. You can visit us at our store in Buck Street Market, KERB street food markets or hire us for private events

records.title: I went with my brother this was my 2nd…
records.text: I went with my brother this was my 2nd time Absolutely amazing food delicious I have tried everything on the menu and the service you won’t find better anywhere else, the brothers at smoke & bones especially Awaes True legends they go above and beyond with there high level of professional service

records.title: Highly Recommend!!!
records.text: We are truly impressed with Smoke and Bones the food is Amazing and it has been our sixth visit and I will be a regular customer

records.title: The best brisket and ribs around
records.text: Amazing food time and time again. We’ve had private catering supplied by smoke and bones twice now - the service and level of quality is unreal. So easy to order with, great menu recommendations, and very reliable with delivery timings and serving tips. Our guests couldn’t stop raving about your food - keep it up!

records.title: London to Preston
records.text: Heard a lot about smoking meats lately and was recommended this place by a friend. Online order was placed, email responses received and text messages throughout until I received my order which was a generous serving. Email with instructions on how to use - so to receive quality food prompt and from a smokehouse in London to me in Preston v impressive. Highly recommend.

records.title: Highly Recommend!
records.text: Originally ordered a one-off brisket & burnt-ends at home and loved it so much that I’ve been a dedicated subscriber to the monthly box for 9 months now. Love what they have coming up for the rest of the year! Great service, great flavours, great portions, great price. Very pleased to see this duo do well through the pandemic by pivoting to a home delivery system and now securing a place at Kerb’s Seven Dials foodhall! Can’t wait to visit them in person! Their burnt ends & Mac n cheese are amazing!

records.title: I’ve ordered a couple of racks of ribs…
records.text: I’ve ordered a couple of racks of ribs for delivery.Delivery running a little behind due to a late delivery of firewood at their end which delayed smoking process by a day.I messaged customer service querying and received an apology and representative immediately offered to waive delivery costs.Impressed by the service so far, can’t wait to try the food!!!

records.title: Great food, Great service!
records.text: Stumbles across their food stall at Londons Westfield during the winter season and the menu had me drooling. So I tried their Brisket Burger and it was amazing! Got speaking and found that they do a vacuum packed delivery service which came in handy during the lockdown! Great service!

records.title: Brisket Heaven
records.text: I stumbled across Smoke and Bones online after searching for a fully halal smokehouse. I was taken aback with the variety of the menu and have seen them develop their food and branding.The Brisket is always cooked perfectly and served with a smile. They have recently started selling pastrami which I received at home during lockdown! Give them a go. You won't be disappointed

records.title: Amazing halal American BBQ style food!
records.text: Amazing and halal! After watching so many YouTube videos online and seeing the amazing bbq food in the US I've always wanted to try it but never found a place in the UK that does halal American bbq. This is finally the place, great quality food cooked with love, care and attention!

records.title: Amazing: food gift box for colleague and they loved it
records.text: Bought a colleague a gift selection box as a thank you from work for a job well done, he was very pleased with it. Ordered early on Thursday morning, delivered promptly on Friday with a great selection and amazing food as always. Can't recommend Smoke&Bones enough!

records.title: We had a lovely complimentary dinner…
records.text: We had a lovely complimentary dinner with Smoke and Bones. Good BBQ ribs, brisket and the Mac and Cheese was scrumptious!Personally the wings were not to my liking but I have high standards being from New York.

records.title: Nice enough but wouldn’t go again
records.text: We had food from smoke and bones when they had a pop up food stand at a local brewery. We had to wait quite a while as they turned up late and then even though you were asked to prebook it was actually queue and be served. The food was nice but somewhat underwhelming especially after the wait. Mac and cheese bites and fries were from out a packet which was a bit disappointing. Not sure American bbq translates well to a food truck style service.

records.title: Good food poor service
records.text: Pre-ordered food, turned up and it was an order and be served situation. Waited 40 minutes and got queue jumped. Good food not necessarily worth the hassle. Wouldn't use again. Bookham, UK

description:
Buzz Catering Supplies are a well established company supplying commercial catering equipment and supplies to the entertainment, restaurant and hospitality industry. With a large distribution centre & central offices located in Bishops Stortford, Hertfordshire, and extensive customer services such as a servicing department, 24 hour support hotline, a cash and carry, massive showroom and more, Buzz Catering Supplies truly is the "one-stop-shop" for everything catering.

Built through years of good service, top quality products and our "Lowest Price Promise", we have been able to grow into one of the largest independent suppliers to the trade, with an impressive list of Pub Groups, Hotels, Clubs and Restaurant chains that have used us for many years. With over 11,000 customers, Buzz Catering Supplies has been in operation for over 30 years consistently providing the best quality catering products at prices you can afford.

records.title: Very pleased with the product and the service.
records.text: I knew to turn to a catering supplier when looking for tempered glass wine glasses for my yacht. Typically five times stronger than regular glass, these also had a reinforced rim - usually where the first chip appears - they "should see me out". Very pleased with the product and the service.

records.title: Jo Elliott
records.text: We were in a pickle just before Christmas and needed a glasswasher asap. There were numerous issues on our side which meant it may not have delivered on time, if at all. Jo Elliott was absolutely fantastic and literally could not have been more helpful or cooperative and made sure of delivery on the 20th Dec. I can not begin to explain what a relief it was to have it delivered on the 20th. Jo, thank you for your help. It's because of you I'd have no problem heartily recommending Buzz to any and everyone and will be my first call should I be needing any catering equipment in the future.

records.title: Great Customer Service
records.text: I've used Buzz Catering a couple of times now and both times their customer service team have been exceptionally helpful. They've answered my queries on the phone, and confirmed details. Ordering online is simple and fast, and the delivery was as expected. I certainly intended to order again in the future from these guys.

records.title: Very helpful and efficient
records.text: Order was missed on the system but they did everything to get it to me before Christmas after I contacted them. Great customer service by Hannah. Really appreciate your effort…..also lovely table wear that I bought too!

records.title: Aruba LED Cordless Lamps in Cocoa (23cm)
records.text: I tracked down and ordered 2 Aruba LED Cordless Lamps in Cocoa (23cm). I had seen them used on tables at a new restaurant local to us and they looked so nice.  I will be using them in the gazebo over summer but until then, I'm moving them around different areas in the house.  They hold their charge well and look lovely.  I may need to buy another 2 to use outside next summer.

records.title: Superb response to an issue
records.text: Great products and great prices and excellent Customer care.  I bought 12 glasses for entertaining over the Christmas period.  One arrived smashed, I contacted Buzz via the Live Chat and got an instant response from a team member in the office, a quick exchange of email and a replacement arrived at my house 24 hours later.  Highly recommend this business!

records.title: Will be back for more products!
records.text: Ordered for the first time and very impressed with the service. My items arrived the following day & were well packaged. Great items and competitive pricing. Will definitely order again. Thank you.

records.title: Very happy with the quality of products…
records.text: Very happy with the quality of products received. It would have been helpful to have more feedback on the progress of the order dispatch - there was just a week of silence after purchase.

records.title: Very impressed
records.text: Very impressed  with our delivery from Buzz and Churchill before Christmas. Thank you

records.title: 2nd order came yesterday - all good.
records.text: 2nd order came yesterday. No flaws, all good, thank you! A bit long delivery from Germany (2 weeks) but prices are much better than in UK shops.

records.title: Easy and quick order/delivery
records.text: Easy order system only down side is they don’t except Mastercard as a payment method, however bank transfer is offered. Order(s) arrived in excellent condition with no breakages. Only feedback I would give is that full sizes to be provided on cutlery as the set I order are bigger than the standard fork & knife. Overall would highly recommend and I will used again.

records.title: Excellent customer service.
records.text: Great range of products. Excellent customer service.

records.title: This is not a reflection on Buzz…
records.text: This is not a reflection on Buzz Supplies Ltd but a product they supply - a Gas Lighter for Hobbs and Ovens usually in Caravans - it is a cheap and nasty product labelled from Sunnex, it does work but it is just awful quality

records.title: Great product, poor delivery
records.text: Bought 12, three prong Oxford cake forks. Excellent value, clean design, good weight and perfect size for cutlery drawer space. Also, a good design for left and right handlers (unlike most pastry forks). Would have given 5 stars had DHL Courier given better service. Delivered almost a week late with misleading and poor communication.

records.title: Wrong item delivered but didn't notice …
records.text: Wrong item delivered but didn't notice till we went to use them yesterday. Phoned and asked if they could send replacements while we sorted out a return and was told I needed the original packaging and delivery note which I had thrown away when I opened them last week. In the end sent a photo of the unopened item and the invoice (which had been emailed separately) and got an email later saying they would arrange an EVRI collection and then a refund. All fine but I needed the right item so have ordered it elsewhere.

records.title: Prices were much better than other…
records.text: Prices were much better than other companies and delivery was quick. They are efficient, deal with breakages straight away, and email a VAT invoice fast. I hope we will do more business together. 💪

records.title: I bought a Master Class Heavy-Duty…
records.text: I bought a Master Class Heavy-Duty Moulin Rotary Food Mill Purée Maker and Square Clip Top Preserving Jars Kilner Style 1L for our Community Farm. I thought the price was reasonable and competitive. I haven't managed to use the Moulin yet, but it will come in very handy with our jam making. We got notifications about delivery by email. Although 10 days delivery seemd a bit longer than expected, everything was fine, including the less plastic packaging.

records.title: Updated
records.text: New product resent a week later, so review has been updated. Many thanks Jo Elliott!Unfortunately I didn’t receive the service I was hoping for. Ordered the wrap master duo pack. The film arrived with smashed up fittings making all 3 unusable. Emailed them on Wednesday with images, still no response. Spent an hour on their online chat with no response. Not even an automated reply to say they’ll look into it

records.title: Decent range and prices........
records.text: Decent range and prices although didn't get next day delivery despite putting the order in at 11:30am.I will use BuzzSupplies again but won't rely on their claim of free next day delivery.

records.title: Items arrived quickly
records.text: Items arrived quickly. Larger than anticipated. Degreaser Seems to work well. One of the hand pumps was broken and unusable but I’ll swop the   Tops over once first bottle is used up so not a big issue on this occasion. The broken one had leaked in transit but fortunately was contained inside a black plastic bag so not much was lost

records.title: A good catering supplier to order from…
records.text: A good catering supplier to order from with honest communication of any short-term supply issues, which were soon resolved. Good product support.

records.title: Very happy with most of my order
records.text: Very happy with most of my order, unfortunately I didn’t see the measurements of the Glass Salt and Pepper pots. On the main page they came in at the same price per pot as the ones I wanted, but one or the other were out of stock. To the amusement of my staff they were tiny! When I called to return them, I was told it wouldn’t be worth it as there was a 25% re stocking charge, plus the cost to return, at that point very disappointed.

records.title: Super quality pot. Poor communication.
records.text: The quality of the massive stock pot I ordered is fantastic. High grade stainless steel and a really solid build. I am very pleased.However there was no communication about the delay and it took 2 months because of manufacturing delays. One part of the saucepan arrived in a squashed box that was inside a huge box that also had the lid. Pleased with what I got. But it took a long time and communication was poor.

records.title: Found what I was after on their website…
records.text: Found what I was after on their website which was a good price and they were in stock whereas a lot of other suppliers were out of stock. Spoke to a very helpful customer service lady on a delivery address issue....goods arrived quickly and no damage in transit.

records.title: Try to place the order over the phone…
records.text: Try to place the order over the phone because the discount voucher which I received from buzz didn't work on the website, but advised that you can only place the order through online and advised that vouchers not applicable for these items. So disappointed.

records.title: Long road
records.text: Had to wait for my order has they sold what they hadn't got then when posted 48 hour postage went to 72 hour postage only wanted 4 of each but had to buy six plates good quality from China

records.title: Personal order
records.text: I am ordering for my personal use, everything was as ordered. Just a few point the wed site didn't update the order so that you could see your status and there was no tracking information coming through until the last moment

records.title: Great Service
records.text: Only complaint is after card details entered nothing happened, leading me to enter again. Always weary about having to enter these details twice. Apart from that, great service and will use again.

records.title: Delivered goods on time
records.text: Delivered glasses on time, exactly what I was looking for.On delivery I found the box had large dent and feared the worst, however the glassware inside was so well packaged there was no damage. Happy with my small purchase.

records.title: Would buy again
records.text: Good product, well packaged and well priced. As I had not received a confirmation of order after two days I had to call. Helpful and sympathetic staff agent who found the order and a confirmation was issued promptly. Perhaps an automatic confirmation of order could be incorporated into the system.

records.title: The items still have not arrived…
records.text: The items still have not arrived despite my order being placed before18thHowever having spoken to Buzz (very helpful lady) gather it is with the courier EVRI  and it is now out for Delivery

records.title: Ordered a pack of 6 slate placemats for…
records.text: Ordered a pack of 6 slate placemats for engraving, the price was competitive. The items arrived around 8 or 9 days later which was longer than expected, so I advised the customer they'd be a couple days late. The packaging was only just adequate, being slate would have expected a little more protection. Luckily none were too damaged.

records.title: Ok, but slow delivery…..!
records.text: Product is excellent, delivery very poor.

records.title: It's a shame it's only a 3 star from…
records.text: It's a shame it's only a 3 star from us! This may be no fault of Buzz supplies, however the crockery delivery we received was a mismatch of colour shades from what we ordered.  Different coloured teapot lids.  Different shades on the saucers from the tea cups.  Enamel white in areas where it clearly missed the colour process.  They actually looked like seconds.  Customer service Jo has been very helpful and currently arranging collection and refund after sending through photos

records.title: Good product - poor courier service
records.text: Very satisfied with the product but disappointed with courier Yodel. Their tracking system did not recognise the parcel number. Driver left parcel on our front doorstep in full view of public footpath and did not ring doorbell. Only found it by chance when we opened door to go out. No idea how long it had been there but outer packing was wet. Fortunately the product was not damaged as a result.

records.title: Order not arrived after 6 days despite being on 24 hour delivery.
records.text: Surprisingly received a email this morning asking for me to review the products purchased. Difficult to rate fully as yet. Order not received despite confirmation it had been dispatched 6 days ago on 24 hour delivery. Will reserve judgement until product arrives. Have asked for a call back from company to discuss.

records.title: I ordered 12 Starlight candles
records.text: I ordered 12 Starlight candles. They were delivered by DPD. The package felt soft and “rattled”!  8 of the 12 candle holders were broken and the inner packing, which I didn’t open, was full of bits of broken glass. Totally inadequate packing!  When I contacted Customer Services, and after sending them photos of the damaged candles, they were very apologetic, and promised to send a repeat order, better packed, which I now await with interest!

records.title: Great products. Terrible delivery
records.text: Great products purchased to increase our glassware.  Unfortunately, they were delivered to a random house, not a neighbour, even though we were in all day.  No card. No message. Nothing.  I recommend outsourcing your deliveries to a more reputable service.Delivery aside.  Would have been a 5 star rating.

records.title: Good price, poor delivery
records.text: Good price, great products, but let down by delivery. Choice was 48hr or 24hr delivery, so I chose 48hr, ordered during the evening, so expected it in 2 days, assuming it would get processed the following morning. Ordered evening of 24th, dispatch email on the 26th, delivered on the 28th. That's not 48 hours!

records.title: Not great
records.text: Ordering very easy - getting a delivery not so.  Ordered placed on 12/07/23 - still not received 24/07/23.  Rang Buzz several times was told out for delivery, and then told the manufacturer had delayed.  Eventually the manufacturer contacted us on Buzz's request.  Not very good customer service on Buzz part - the order was placed with them so they should have dealt with.

records.title: Poor Customer Service
records.text: After making order, with anniversary discount code, I was informed that plates that made up one part of my order had been discounted and was offered link to same style plate, but larger, as alternative. When I agreed to this I was very disappointed to be told that the same discount code would not be applied to the replacement option. Poor decision by Customer Service. Requested refund

records.title: The item ordered was reasonably priced…
records.text: The item ordered was reasonably priced but took 12 days to be delivered after phoning to find out what was happening was told it needs to be re- ordered as don’t know what happened, when arrived I was pleased with the product

records.title: Whilst we are pleased with the quality…
records.text: Whilst we are pleased with the quality of the product, it is not the product we thought we had ordered. The photograph on the website was rather misleading giving the impression that the soup plates were a different shape. Perhaps the photo could be taken from a different angle to clarify the shape.

records.title: Very poor dispatch/shipping.
records.text: Very poor shipping.My order was need urgently and the 2 items were ordered with express 24hr delivery at extra cost.The order was confirmed 12 Sept at 14.30 but wasn't notified to the carrier until 13 Sept at 12.28 and they didn't receive it until 14 Sept at 18.14 to eventually deliver it on 15 Sept at 12.30. This was nearly 3 days from order!  This was not the express delivery I was expecting.

records.title: Excellent service provided by Buzz … however!
records.text: Excellent service provided by Buzz! Why then only 3 stars rather than 5? It’s because of EVRI! 10 days for delivery on this occasion but previously they have lost my parcels altogether. I’m fed up with repeatedly having to chase them following their notification of there having been ‘an issue with delivery’. Regrettably, due to the hassle that invariably ensues, I’m having to boycott suppliers that use this delivery partner.

records.title: Check delivery info carefully.
records.text: The delivery times stated on the website don’t always match with actual. My goods arrived a week late and I didn’t have enough glasses for my event. That said I have ordered before (not needing things quickly) and the products were fine.

records.title: Check on delivery times before purchase
records.text: I think the website is somewhat misleading regarding delivery times. I placed an order and it said 24 hour courier delivery but apparently that is 24 hours from when the order is actually despatched. The items I ordered had to be bought in and the despatched so I received them 6 days after placing the order. As I needed the items three days after ordering I would have bought them elsewhere if the delivery details had been less ambiguous

records.title: Cheap but SLOOOOOOOW
records.text: Buzz are cheap to buy from, but so incredibly slow to get your goods. I understand they dropship, so they don't actually hold stock for most products even though they show as 'in stock'.If you need stuff fast, go elsewhere and pay a little more.

records.title: kitchen equipment
records.text: The items I ordered seem to be ok, reasonably good value and decent quality, so I am happy with what I bought. Despatch and delivery were very slow for today's standards almost 10 days.Overall satisfied.

records.title: First time buyer and was impressed with…
records.text: First time buyer and was impressed with the speed of service. Very disappointed in what arrived as items were missing. Customer service was very quick to apologise and promise to send the missing items…never received them so I lost out on all counts.

records.title: go to nisbets instead
records.text: great company if you require your items when ever they can be bothered to send them.Lesson learned IShould have gone to Nisbits  oh no the use Evri to deliver their wares (Every officially the worst delivery company in uk)

records.title: Delivery lacking expectation
records.text: Placed an order on the evening of 22nd August, so was expecting the start of processing to happen on the 23rd. Even allowing for the bank holiday weekend to interfere, it took far too long for "next day delivery".We sent an email chasing up our order on the 28th Aug. Was told it had just come in from manufacturers & should be dispatched same day.Delivery finally happened on Sept 2nd.Very happy with the products ordered, just feel there needs to be better clarity over what is "in stock", delivery schedules & communication given if a delay is likely rather than the consumer having to chase.

records.title: Shipment and delivery details fictitious
records.text: After placing the order I was emailed stating that it was dispatched on the Friday and would be delivered Monday. Waited in but nothing arrived. Emailed Buzz Monday evening and then phoned them mid afternoon Tuesday when I didn’t receive any response. I was called back and told that the shipment email, that also specified the delivery date, was automatically generated and not necessarily correct. In this case, the £750 item hadn’t even shipped.

records.title: Delivery 1-3 days wasn't achieved
records.text: Delivery 1-3 days wasn't achieved. It would have been ok but I didn't get any information that the goods were going to be late. If my expectations would have been managed I wouldn't have minded.When I chased when the goods would be delivered Bizz Supplies acted quickly.Many thanks

records.title: We put in a substantial order in at the…
records.text: We put in a substantial order in at the beginning of May. The website stated that products would be delivered on 24h next day. So we ordered through your company so it fit in with a kitchen opening date. It took 3.5 weeks for all products to arrive which came in drips & drabs which obviously had an effect on business and letting my customers down because of our launch being put back week by week. Not impressed to be honest and your sales advisors didn’t really care when we brought it to their attention. I estimate we lost around £3000 of sales and bookings yet you made almost £4500 from us for false advertising and misinformation on your website.

records.title: Delivery slower than they promised
records.text: There was nothing wrong with what I ordered but the reason I ordered it from this company was because it said 1-2 days delivery. It took a week to come and when I emailed I was informed very politely that it was being processed. No information on the date I'd receive it I wouldn't order from here again simply because I couldn't trust it to come when it says it would which is a shame as there was nothing wrong with the product.

records.title: Keep getting it wrong!
records.text: For the 4th time my order has been delivered to the wrong address! Even despite placing an order over the phone advising of the previous issues goods still get dispatched to the billing address not the delivery address. Once more wrongly delivered again and packaging had been poorly sealed with one box open.

records.title: Send wrong items
records.text: Send wrong items . When i called customer service , she was so rude. I ask for return and they saying i have ti pay 25% reduction for that . Not happy at all .I Never order again . Please don't buy from this website Thanks

records.title: Misleading Website Description
records.text: Good customer service when I required a replacement item due to damage in transit.  Couldn't get through on the phone or by email though, had to use their website chat facility.  Disappointed that the item I purchased clearly stated 'Made in the UK' on the website but the packaging showed it was manufactured in China.

records.title: Incredibly slow delivery for items…
records.text: Incredibly slow delivery for items advertised in stock. The items were not even dispatched for a week after purchase.  Nisbets might be more expensive but you get the stuff Nextday and as a caterer thats what i need. Sorry Buzz but you need to improve delivery times.

description: Fresh, authentic Thai food to takeaway in Epsom.

records.title: Tasty
records.text: Tasty, fresh food. This week I had satay and green chicken curry which had delicious vegetables added.

records.title: Great Thai meals, can't beat them.
records.text: Another tasty and enjoyable Thai, may be get one more in before they're off to Thailand!  Worth noting, you need now to phone when you arrive to pick up, I hadn't realized that.

records.title: The food was amazing
records.text: The food was amazing! Really great service and easy to collect. Will be recommending to friends and family. I will definitely be ordering again!

records.title: Amazing quality tasty food
records.text: Amazing quality tasty food, generous portions and excellent serviceI can’t recommend this treasure I have find enough

records.title: Excellent food
records.text: Excellent food. Tastes fantastic and is well prepared and well presented. Thanks!

records.title: First time ordering from Mai Thai and…
records.text: First time ordering from Mai Thai and everyone loved it. Fresh tasty food at a competitive price cooked beautifully. I couldn’t fault anything and am looking forward to our next Mai Thai experience!Thank you

records.title: My wife discovered this gem on…
records.text: My wife discovered this gem on Facebook. Having been to Thailand, the food is about as authentic as it gets. Limited menu but always find something tasty.I was a bit daunted when collecting at first, as Mai cooks all food in her flat & have to ring a buzzer but parking close by makes it easy.It's a real treat at a weekend.

records.title: Woudn't have Thai from anywhere else.
records.text: Always such tasty food that is noticable with the high quality ingredients and the care of cooking to order.  We drive 25 miles each way to get a Thai meal from Mai Thai, because it's that good.  Just wish we could pay by card on their website instead of the faff of having to do a bank transfer.

records.title: Great customer communication
records.text: Great customer communication. All the meal choices chosen have been lovely and last Saturday's was definitely the best we'd had.  Can even ask to change the ingredients and have to say the prawns with cashew nuts, delicious.....  Well done, Mae.

records.title: Yet Another Fantastic Meal
records.text: We introduced friends to Mai Thai this weekend, they have been converted!  What a lovely evening sampling various dishes.  My favourite still is Chicken, Veggies with Cashew Nuts, just my preference, though saying  that the Drunken Noodles were very tasty.  It's good to know Mai will happily cook the dishes with less spice if you wish.

records.title: Very authentic and tasty Thai food
records.text: Very authentic and tasty Thai foodLoved it

records.title: Loved the chicken cakes starter
records.text: Great service- pick up from collection point. Disappointed that the Chicken satay was really dry but peanut dipping sauce was delicious! Chicken cakes tasted just like Thai fish cakes which I love! Prawn pad Thai And chicken Cashew nut dish was yummy (but a bit salty).*Not sure how to reply- but in answer to your question:we ate the satay and cakes straight away without heating. We microwaved the mains once the kids went to sleep and they reheated really well!

records.title: We enjoyed ordering all the options and…
records.text: We enjoyed ordering all the options and everything was brilliant as usual except the pork was a bit chewy otherwise it would be5 stars as usual !Thanks Colin

records.title: Our first time of eating from Mai Thai
records.text: Sateh a little dry, therefore a bit tough.Prawn rolls fantastic.Pad Thai great for me as my husband doesn't like noodles and I was desperate for some!!4th takeaway in the past 12 months - great to have a meal off from cooking!!Wil definitely order again.

records.title: the spring rolls were as usual…
records.text: the spring rolls were as usual fantastic, so was the prawn toast.  Pad Thai was good and the sauce for the choo chee curry was excellent - though the sauce is a little thin.  All in all, I love Mai's cooking.

records.title: Lovely food
records.text: Lovely food, especially the green thai curry. Excellent Value tooThe surprise dish with chicken and a sort of gravy was rather HOT!!So next time I will be careful not to eat the chillies :)

records.title: the spring rolls are second to none
records.text: the spring rolls are second to none - this time though the noodles were a little too spicy for us.  I know Mai has told us to say we want them less spicy and I will in future....

records.title: the quality is consistently good
records.text: the quality is consistently good, the service impeccable!  It would be nice to have some different things occasionally

records.title: This was again a wonderfully cooked…
records.text: This was again a wonderfully cooked dinner…fresh and tasty.  The new dish with basil was amazing…..yet I ordered prawns and got chicken

records.title: Beautifully presented and cooked
records.text: Beautifully presented and cooked. The spring rolls are the best I’ve eaten

records.title: First class cook, we'll be back.
records.text: Exceptionally high standard of all meal choices. Perfect if you like hot spicy food. I'm hoping next time the level of heat can be reduced on request!  Collection couldn't be easier, no need to leave your car.  Mai and her husband are extremely helpful.

records.title: great way to eat Thai in Epsom
records.text: We have lived in Thailand so are hard taskmasters.  The spring rolls were fantastic, as was the sticky rice and mango.  The other dishes were good.  All beautifully presented and freshly cooked.  Would love one or two more choices

records.title: Lovely meal
records.text: Lovely meal, they just forgot to put the spring rolls with the order. They apologised and I was refunded straight away, so no problem at all. The meal was so nice, we didn’t miss them anyway!

records.title: Authentic taste
records.text: Authentic taste; generous portion size; good price!

records.title: Great service, great food.
records.text: Great service, delicious tasting food. The rice was a little dry but other than that really lovely. Will be ordering again.

records.title: Enjoyable authentic Thai
records.text: Enjoyed our food it was delicious and the presentation was lovely. Efficient service collection worked well.

records.title: The food was very tasty as usual
records.text: The food was very tasty as usual, Just a bit  too spicy this week

records.title: Great main courses
records.text: Great main courses.  Very tasty with interesting vegetables.

records.title: This was first disappointing meal I’m…
records.text: This was first disappointing meal I’m afraid

records.title: Main course was good but starters were…
records.text: Main course was good but starters were dry and over cooked, did not like the satay sauce.

description: Purple Plum Catering are professional caterers in Norwich, Norfolk. Weddings, Corporate events or intimate dining; we cater for all your requirements.

records.title: We were thrilled to have Chef Julia &…
records.text: We were thrilled to have Chef Julia & her team cater our weekend wellness retreat! Her passion for vegetarian cuisine made every meal a highlight, with vibrant, flavorful dishes that exceeded all expectations. Many guests shared it was the best vegetarian food they’d ever tasted! Each meal was thoughtfully crafted & beautifully presented. Thank you, Julia & team for making this experience unforgettable—we can’t wait to work with you again!

records.title: Excellent catering company!
records.text: Julia catered our retreat at West Lexham and the food was absolutely delicious.  There was so much variety and everything was cooked lovingly from scratch using fresh produce. We ate well and there was plenty for everyone.  We would definitely recommend purple plum catering, they were super helpful and available for video calls and email chats ahead of our event to make sure everything went smoothly.

records.title: We loved working with Julia for our wedding!
records.text: We loved working with Julia for our wedding. Her and her team made the whole experience amazing from start to finish. The food was delicious and she really went above and beyond to give us a smooth experience. Thank you Julia you're a star!

records.title: Wonderful food!
records.text: Julia catered for a friend’s birthday dinner hosted at home and it was wonderful. Julia dropped off all the dishes and there was a perfect balance of vegan, veggie and meat dishes so something for everyone - each one had so much flavour. Big portions with lots of leftover, so well worth the money too. Highly recommended!

records.title: Delicious dinner and cakes - would definitely recommend !
records.text: Lovely Julia catered dinner and make cakes for us at our yoga retreat at West Lexham and it was absolutely delicious ! Everyone LOVED the food especially the aubergine (that had been grown in West Lexham's vegetable garden) and the Persian Love cake which was a big hit with everyone. She was so kind and helpful and made vegan/gluten free options for us. I'm really glad we got to meet and that we got to eat her food and can't wait to come back to West Lexham soon for more ! Thank you so much :-)

records.title: Hire Purple Plums immediately! 🫶🏼
records.text: Just got back from a retreat at West lexham where the warm, kind and talented Julia cooked up a storm for our very hungry group! As a vegan I wasn't left with one solitary plate of food. It came in abundance!! With gorgeous produce she created a real variety, no one night was the same but it was always delicious and filling! You can tell Julia loves what she does and cooks with care and love 💕 being home I'm having to acclimatise to my own cooking again 😅 don't hesitate to use Purple Plums!

records.title: Delicious food and warm welcome
records.text: Julia and her team cooked for us at West Lexham. Nothing was too much trouble and their freshly cooked, freshly sourced food was incredible. We were delayed getting to WL and it looked likely we’d arrive after the cafe was shut for the evening. Julia kept in touch with us en route and had four freshly baked, delicious pizzas ready for us on arrival. The team’s breakfast was also brilliant - our favourite was the new potato hash with spinach, bacon and poached eggs.

records.title: Pettitstree House, Christmas party Weeknder
records.text: Julia and her team, did an amazing job catering our Christmas Party Weekend at Pettitstree house. The lasange and lentil curry went down a storm on the Friday and the 3 course Dinner Saturday ticked all the boxes with some very tough customers!.defo recommend and use Purple plum catering again.

records.title: Fab caterer for team away day
records.text: We worked with Julia on a recent company away day at a private property. She was lovely to deal with and suggested some really wonderful and varied menus for our group that helped create the right vibe for the different parts of the event. Her and her staff completely ran the kitchen at the venue for us, meaning we didn’t need to worry about a thing. Plus all the team thought the food was delicious!

records.title: Fantastic food. Lovely people.
records.text: We wanted something special for a 70th birthday lunch.  Julia from Purple Plum suggested that they do a superb "Lebanese Feast".  They were not wrong.  They cooked great food (I'm am used to eating Lebanese food in London, so have a benchmark).  The flavours were subtle and delicate.  The spices beautifully balanced.Julia presented the food to the party, explaining, what each dish was. Universal acclaim from all at the lunch.  It was a pleasure meeting them and enjoying food they obviously love to cook.

records.title: Rustic wedding catering
records.text: We had Purple Plum cater our wedding in September. Food was tasty - definitely on the rustic side, and would work best as 'family style' rather than served up individually (which we went for). Communication was a bit chaotic, but appreciate that its also been a chaotic time this past 18 months!

records.title: Professional company that offers good…
records.text: Professional company that offers good value for money and keeps their promises

records.title: My wife chose Purple Plum Catering for…
records.text: My wife chose Purple Plum Catering for our wedding celebration in May 2018 and we were disappointed with the outcome. Meetings to discuss arrangements were cancelled at short notice and communication was poor before the event. On the day the proprietor, Julia, didn't even turn up and the whole affair was delegated. In fairness to the guy who was on the spot, he did well, but the service and the food failed to meet expectations and there was absolutely no contact afterwards to see if we were satisfied. In retrospect, I should have seen it coming when she demanded payment in full prior to the event. I've no doubt that they can do a great job when they want to and the reviews on here would back that up, but they don't always and my advice would be to withhold the fee until you've had the service.

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: We used Purple Plum Catering for a wedding at our home last year. After initially being impressed by the food and service that was on offer, we were disappointed with what we received on the day. Prior to the wedding we were aware that Julia had suffered a bereavement, however she assured us that she wanted to be working and that she was looking forward to catering our wedding. On the day Julia did not show up, leaving her assistant to run the event with a team of inexperienced and underprepared agency staff; food was not what we had agreed, a drinks station never materialised, staff helped themselves to (and lost) crockery from our home as they had not brought enough for the food service, guests were left serving themselves drinks and the bride and groom had to help clear tables.We approached Julia a week after the wedding for an explanation as to why things had gone so wrong. Rather than an apology, Julia explained she had not been feeling up to the event, and had decided to shut down her business and stop wedding catering all together. We felt sorry Julia and saw no reason to give a review on what we assumed  was a business no longer trading. However, this appears not to be the case and it is unfortunate that other couples have had the same disappointment on their wedding day as we did. For that reason, although this review should have been written a year ago, I feel it appropriate to write it now.

records.title: DO NOT USE! Terrible service on our wedding day
records.text: So saddened by the service we received by Julia on our wedding day. Throughout the planning process Julia wouldn’t reply/replied late to emails, often not making sense and conflicting previous details. On the day she didn’t show up and left a poor woman to deal with the mess she had created, along with 5 less waiters than she’d promised. She was unable to communicate clearly with the Crockery hire company resulting in us missing 120 plates! The food we received was different to what we asked for, was not served how we wanted in the lovely Moroccan style bowls promised but instead in cheap white plastic bowls and there wasn’t enough food for our evening guests! This left my wife crying on our wedding day and we were embarrassed in front of our guests. Julia has offered little in the way of compensation and does not seem to understand the impact of her unprofessionalism. We hope other couples never have to go through what we did on our day - please do not use Purple Plum catering!!

records.title: I would NEVER recommend Purple Plum…
records.text: I would NEVER recommend Purple Plum Catering after my daughter and son-in-law used them for their wedding in June 2022.  The staff were very inexperienced and didn’t serve the guests appropriately throughout the day and Julia was not there as expected - apparently she had hurt her ankle. The evening buffet was a complete disaster with a shortage of food, so many evening guests were left with nothing to eat and the food was served on plastic and foil disposable plates, rather than wooden and pottery platters as promised - a very embarrassing situation. The communication was appalling and emails and messages were often ignored with my daughter and son-in-law having to constantly chase up Julia for answers to questions. Please do not be led into believing that Purple Plum are amazing because of their flashy website - it is all a cover up for a poorly organised business that certainly didn’t live up to our expectations and we would never recommend. The last thing that I wanted to see was my daughter in tears at her wedding when she was so upset by the catering arrangements and she realised that there was not enough food for everybody when she went up to get her buffet and there were only a few olives left and she had at least twenty people queuing behind her. The catering staff had driven off without an explanation, making a swift exit before we could speak to them about a lack of food.After reading the response to my initial review, I can confirm that we definitely didn't say that we were happy with the catering for the event at any time during the day, or after the event, Julia wasn't there to talk to anyway!I am offering honest feedback to ensure that others are not highly disappointed as my Daughter and Son-In-Law were on one of the most special days of their lives.

records.title: If I could leave zero stars I would
records.text: If I could leave zero stars I would, but unfortunately it makes me select one. Very bad experience which ended with Julia and team letting us down 15 minutes before booking. Had made a booking back in February for a group birthday dinner, paid deposit and selected menu 2 weeks before event. On the day of the birthday dinner, caterers were supposed to show up at 530 and didn't. Got to 630 and nothing, called but no answer. Eventually got a TEXT at 7pm stating they were sorry but would not make it. Disappointed is an understatement. I had arranged the dinner for my sisters 40th birthday and had 17 people to feed with no notice. Such a  poor, poor service. Definitely be careful if you are looking to book. I wouldn't be surprised if the are no longer operating but do be  careful before you hand over any money!!!!

records.title: I believe this company is going out of Business
records.text: I believe this company is going out of business.  In any event they are not settling debts with creditors.

description: Farmhouse Pizza, The biggest Pizza in Town. Wide selection of Pizza food delivered to your door.

records.title: Best pizza ever
records.text: Best pizza ever, super tasty, always has a lot of toppings, delivery hot. Also hot wings are awesome, and fries as well! Highly recommend pepperoni, Hawaiiana and chicken supreme

records.title: Delicious food
records.text: Delicious food, fast service, staff were incredibly friendly and went out of their way to make us food, not allowing an incorrect order to go to waste, gave us free food with no fuss outside of their open times as we turned up late. Would highly recommend.

records.title: We ordered the Farm House Special…
records.text: We ordered the Farm House Special tonight with cheese stuffed crusts an Jalapeño Cream Cheese.  For a Friday night, the service was swift, the food was warm and very tasty with generous toppings.  I don't usually write reviews, but Farmhouse in Wokingham got 10 out of 10 in our books tonight.  We'll done, keep up the good work!

records.title: The food was very good
records.text: The food was very good, delivered on time and the delivery driver .. Tahir was super nice.  He was courteous and professional but my main reason for the review is the Pizza, better than most of the big brands. will highly recommend

records.title: Amazing tasty pizzas
records.text: Amazing tasty pizzas, quick delivery and the driver knock so quietly to respect the time of night. Perfect when the kids are in bed, also cheaper direct than Deliveroo ect couldn’t be happier

records.title: Fast delivery and lovely food
records.text: Fast delivery and lovely food. Easy to order online and pay. I also found the communication and update info on your order very good.

records.title: Great pizza

records.title: Lovely staff and lovely food x
