records.title: Lovely food and people
records.text: Date of experience: 18 November 2021

records.title: was undercooked..
records.text: was undercooked... i think this is enough said

records.title: Usually ok
records.text: Usually ok. Tonight's pizza was lukewarm.  Delivery guy insisted I pay even though the receipt clearly showed I'd paid over the phone. Don't get duped.

records.title: Regular customer with Farm but last few…
records.text: Regular customer with Farm but last few times it’s been disappointing. Todays order is overdone and dry. We prefer thin crust but it’s almost like paper with very crusty edges. Shame  as they can do so much better.

records.title: Rubbish
records.text: Not using this company again disgusting service 2 hour wait pizza edge all curled up couldnt put anchovies separate pro cause you get a whole 2 for 1.50. Iv used in past no problems. Ordered at 8.40 got delivered 10.30 after I phoned they said didnt get order yet taken money and I had confirmation on email. Somebody obviously isn't watching what's going on. I had to ask for compensation some garlic bread. When arrived no garlic on it and soggy and soft. Never again !!!!

records.title: First time ordering from Farmhouse…
records.text: First time ordering from Farmhouse Pizza, the menu looked appetizing however the pizzas were disappointing, best described as bland at best. Stingy on toppings and was not sure there was any kebab on the kebab pizza. Doubt if we'll order again, there must be better out there.

records.title: This was possibly the worst pizza I…
records.text: This was possibly the worst pizza I have ever had! Really poor quality and overpriced.Cheap as cheap can buy the meat was meatless and the cheese disgusting!First and last time ordering from Farmhouse Pizza.

records.title: Very poor quality pizza i suggest never…
records.text: Very poor quality pizza i suggest never order on Sudbury farm house branch Very upset and disappointed with service

records.title: Rude and unprofessional.
records.text: Rude and unprofessional.Ordered food and the delivery driver made a runner without giving the change.Contacted the shop and apparently the driver is owners brother and the reason no change was given was because my little one didn’t asked for it, well she didn’t said to keep the change either and it’s shopkeepers/delivery driver’s responsibility to give the right change back. When we go shopping we get back our change without asking it back cos it’s the principal. Pathetic customer service and food isn’t nice either. Never going to order again.

records.title: PLEASE do not order from this place
records.text: PLEASE do not order from this place. I am definitely not going to order anything from this place. We have ordered Asian special pizza for delivery and it turned out to be a burnt reheated pizza, it was not fresh at all, dips exploded, also pizza box definitely dropped, because as soon as I opened the box, pizza was folded at one side. Very disappointing service, unbelievable the way manager spoke to us and just hanged up the phone. Very rude. I am definitely not going to recommend FARMHOUSE pizza from Oxford road Reading.

records.title: grease grease and just more grease
records.text: weve ordered from farmhouse wokingham branch loads of times but the last two times  well ! just awful , you couldnt taste the actual pizza you ordered just bit through grease grease and more grease , gave them the benefit of the doubt after first greasy pizza cos they,d been good before ... we ended up throwing it out for our local fox visitor ... i bet even he/she thought mmm never again !

records.title: RUDE
records.text: Absolutely rude staff (claimed he was the manager). Would not listen to my complaint about pizza being too small (I offered to send him a photo with ruler but wouldn't give me a number) then accused me of never having ordered a pizza before. If you own this restaurant this member of staff needs disciplining/firing.

records.title: I used farmhouse Pizza in Reading…
records.text: I used farmhouse Pizza in Reading oxford road earlier today, when received pizza it was over cooked, cold & badly cut. When we complaint manger from shop he was very angry over the phone & was dismissive of our complaint. I went to shop & try to talk to manger/owner but he was still very angry & rood to us also refuse to give us receipt as it was not given to us on delivery. I had to call 999 as I felt this conversation will end off in fight & after speaking to 999 Opreator he gave me receipt, thank good I now at least have proof that I paid these criminals money & may have some rights to go to consumer court for compensation.  Please avoid being cheated & go to reputable place at least you will get good pizza & wont be insulated.

description: Harvester, the home of great tasting, freshly prepared food.

records.title: Lovely food, absoloutely amazing waitress, Angela!
records.text: From the moment we stepped into Harvester Lowestoft, we were made to feel welcome by our waitress Angela. Nothing was too much trouble, and she was extremley pleasant wishing us a happy new year, and engaging in conversation with our 3 and 6 year old. Asset to the Harvester team for sure! Food was amazing too, and a good price!

records.title: Harvester White Hart Hockliffe
records.text: I took my Mum out for a meal at Harvester White Hart in Hockliffe. The waitress was very polite and really attentive, even though it was extremely busy. The meals we had were really well presented and tasty. Thank you for a lovely meal and visit.

records.title: Harvester Hornchurch
records.text: As always, a reminder to put in your reg, a nice welcome, a great Xmas dinner & a great team effort from Olaine, Lisa, Holly,  Terise & the team of chefs. Came back Boxing Day as usual, saw Olaine, Loraine & Terise again. I hope they all have a well deserved few days off as the welcome, service, food & eating areas was above expectation. The modernisation of the restaurant is looking great & has a cosy feel to it. Thanks for making us welcome the Crooks family 👍🏻

records.title: Wow! Fantastic Dinner
records.text: Really lovely family dinner, great service very friendly team, salad bar really well stocked & clean too! Another fantastic meal from our favourite restaurant!!

records.title: Visited Harvester Talbot Green today
records.text: Visited Harvester Talbot Green today.  All the staff are amazing, they all deserve a Christmas bonus.  I would like to mention a special shout to Maddie.  When I arrived I had a special request.  I didn't know if it was possible.  Maddie pulled out all the stops to accomodate me.   Without fuss or hesitation she made some changes to the booking.  I was impressed by her professionalism and kindness.  Everything was perfect from the food to the service.Merry Christmas to you all 🎅🌲

records.title: Meal at Amesbury Archer Harvester
records.text: We booked a table last minute at the Amesbury Archer for two. The booking system on the app is very easy to use. We were greeted by the friendly assistant manager who showed us to our table and informed us who our waitress would be. Lyla our waitress was friendly and helpful, checking our order. The service was efficient. I particularly enjoyed the change from the watery corn on the cob to the corn bread which is a good change. Both myself and my husband enjoyed our experience.

records.title: Just had a great meal from the festive…
records.text: Just had a great meal from the festive menu served up by possibly the most overqualified server that we've ever had the pleasure of meeting. Heather, was an absolute pleasure to speak with. Having just completing her masters in cancer research, she moved to London to follow her dreams of working in the research of finding a cure for cancer. Good luck Heather, and thanks for your wonderful service. Hope you get all of the gratuity.

records.title: Thank you harvester for a lovely…
records.text: Thank you harvester for a lovely Christmas day meal, the food was great well served by a hard working staff, we were well looked after.

records.title: Harvester Shorehouse Southend on sea
records.text: Harvester Shorehouse Southend on sea When I saw the reviews was bit worried as didn’t have great reviewsWe went in there about 7 pm on Wednesday 18th Dec 24 after shopping had groupon voucher .we thought it was lovely and clean lovely atmosphere service was great it wasn’t that busy . The food was excellent I think it is the best harvester we have been to .I had to write a review as think  it a shame it has some bad reviews maybe they have  a new chef or new manager , I just wish it was nearer to us .

records.title: Afternoon Harvester
records.text: We thought we'd have a local treat as our trip to Bletchley was cancelled. We were served by a lovely waitress called Cayleen. She was patient when we took forever to decide on our food and was very attentive throughout our meal. Food tasted great. Fantastic afternoon.

records.title: Staff couldn't have been more helpful
records.text: Staff couldn't have been more helpful, Paul the Manager and Lauren F our waitress. The one with the lovely red hair ♥️ Broccoli was awful, not a good colour and hard. A party of 6. The rest of the food was fine.

records.title: Pavillions Peterborough …
records.text: I like the pavilions Harvester in peterborough Normally I dine at other harvestersThis was a firstGood location, food options, staff, cleanliness Disabled toilet awaiting a plumber overdue, that was an inconvenience The forced tipping when you pay the billBy cardPay by cash then it gives you the optionIf you think worthy to pay 5% 10% 15% etc etc

records.title: Better than last visit but not what it was.
records.text: Visited RochdaleHarvester for first time in many years. Welcome was good.Menu looked much improved and wife's rotisserie chicken meal was good. Salad bar was OK but shadow of its previous incarnation. Very limited range but what was there was fine. I had a dirty burger and that was a mistake! Brioche filled with lettuce, tomato, cheese slice, beef patty, potato waffle, more sauce, onion rings and top brioche. No chance of holding to eat and ended as a soggy pile of components. Tastes OK, but far from well presented.

records.title: Lovely service very friendly staff and…
records.text: Lovely service very friendly staff and lovely meals but manager on duty 13/08/24 at 17.40 was a very manny told us we couldn’t take drinks out but it’s the way she said NA Na yer can’t do that at the top of her voice considering we had a meal and pudding and drinks. Very abrupt and out of order quite unsettling felt like the school teacher for her behaviour not even one star.

records.title: Harvester Amesbury is a lovely place to…
records.text: Harvester Amesbury is a lovely place to dine , such a lovely ambient and staff are very pleasant and nice . Excellent service as usual . Would like to special mention Phillipa who attended and serve us tonight . Amazing food and fast service

records.title: Daughter booked a table for my 60th…
records.text: Daughter booked a table for my 60th birthday meal as we have been to harvester Llandarcy before and it was previously wonderful.. this time the food was not so great I had sirloin steak which was very tough and full of gristle and my husbands chicken was swimming in grease and cold chips. But I must say the server Paula was very efficient and helpful and very sorry about the situation with the food and could not do enough to help.it did spoil my birthday meal a bit but was not the servers fault she was very good. Apparently the manager said they were having a problem with their supplier with the stakes and would be changing the menu the following day. Otherwise everything else ok. Thank you Paula 😁

records.title: Staines
records.text: Staines - HarvesterWent there for Father's day. The staff were very friendly, particularly Rosie who gave me a free Father's day drink to celebrate. She was very warming and pleasant to have as our waitress. Really enjoyable evening with the family. The only reason this isn't 5* is down more to maintenance/cleanliness. The ice machine was broken and the temp was pushing 30 and toilet cleanliness wasn't the best.

records.title: The waitress called Helen went out of…
records.text: The waitress called Helen at aintree business park Harvester went out of her way and we feel she deserves recognition  for being such a lovely staff member.we don't know her and should've told her at the time we appreciated her attitude  but she had finished her shift.

records.title: The Navigation Enfield
records.text: We went to harvester The Navigation in Enfield tonight and was served by ROB He was so attentive and polite and nothing was too much trouble. Excellent server and will definitely go back because of him.

records.title: Harvester Carmarthen good quality food.
records.text: Harvester Carmarthen good quality food the staff where friendly everything was running on time.The venue was clean spent a good two hours there in a very relaxed environment enjoying time with family I would recommend.

records.title: Vegan traveller
records.text: I’ve  always love harvester even before veganism was well known. They now have a decent selection of Vegan choices. Disappointed the coleslaw isn’t vegan however the chef offered to make me vegan coleslaw which was delicious.

records.title: Harvester Plough Chelmsford.
records.text: Harvester Plough Chelmsford.I’ve eaten here a few times over the years and most recently since it was refurbished as our in-laws took us out. The staff and servers are always very nice and friendly enhancing the dining experience. Unfortunately the steaks always look a lot better than they are, being very chewy and tough (seems to be a persistent problem). The small scampi was hidden in a large amount of batter. Can’t usually go wrong with the ribs and whole fish though.The basics are good - particularly the salad bar and the atmosphere. It’s in a very convent location for us and our extended family which is why we’ve been back several times over the years but we’d be back much more often if the mains were better quality.

records.title: Our experience
records.text: Our experience, at Harvester Merthyr Tydfil was very pleasant and enjoyable. It was a memorable experience because of a really lovely, attentive and conscientious waitress, named Lynsey. Food was nice but could have been a little more plentiful on the plate. There were obviously catering issues due to many basic foods being removed from the menu. I find it difficult to understand why these products could not have been sourced locally. These issues were made less frustrating by the exemplary service and attention given to us by waitress Lynsey. She should be highly commended for her customer service skills and general attitude towards the clientele. If had not been for her service and care of customers my rating would have been around 2 to 3 stars, Lynsey bumped it up.

records.title: A superstar waiter in James…
records.text: Visited the Brighton Harvester yesterday on a day out and was so impressed by one of the waiters there. James (despite being rushed off his feet as appeared to be the only waititng staff working!) went above and beyond to ensure that every customer was looked after and happy there. He even went so far as to make me a proper cream soda (after the one on the menu tasted like sharp lemonade and nothing like cream soda). If only every waiting staff were as efficient and happy in their work as he was. A true gem for Harvester. Well done James! Now if you can only sort out your tasteless peas and upgrade them to Birds Eye you'd get 10/10 from me!

records.title: Harvester in Merthyr Tydfil…
records.text: Went to the Harvester in Merthyr Tydfil in April and it was good. Our first time to this chain and the staff were very helpful, pleasant and hard-working. The salad bar was excellent but the toppings had run out and weren't re-filled. My main was OK, a bit soggy, but they were short-staffed in the kitchen.The atmosphere was very pleasant and we were made to feel welcome.

records.title: Harvester in Gowerton
records.text: We went to the Harvester in Gowerton. My husband had his favourite. - Belly pork! And he enjoyed it. I had a child’s portion of fish and chips and the fish had so much batter - there was very little dry fish in the middle. Icecream was fantastic!.Overall we enjoyed - and Cerys was a very helpful waitress.

records.title: Fantastic service and 19 Crimes wine!
records.text: Two of us went to the Harvester at Croxley last week. The service from all three staff ( Patrick, Tanya and Stacey was fantastic. The person I was with is severely glutton intolerant and Patrick spent ages going through the options with us. Maybe Harvester CAN have a separate menu ( like Cassio Lounge in Watford) as this saves time for him when he is mega busy. The 19 Crimes is a wonderful wine, nothing was too much trouble and I will definitely be back. Ambience is very good too and, when the garden at the back is sorted,  I am sure it will be great for the summer. All in all much to celebrate. Well done and thank you you stars!

records.title: Regularly go to harvester Carmarthen…
records.text: Regularly go to harvester Carmarthen and staff are always nice but needed to shout out to Hannah as she was just awesome. she was just lovely. She deserves five stars but harvester no longer do Sunday breakfast so I have hash browns withdrawal!

records.title: Lovely service, friendly staff. Mediterranean tart 👎
records.text: Lovely service, friendly staff. Food always well presented but on one occasion one particular meal wasn't that good. The Mediterranean tart is more like a ladel full of ratatouille in a pastry case. Very slimy and soupy. It's not a tart at all.

records.title: Beaten Track Shrewsbury…
records.text: I went to the Beaten Track Shrewsbury for an evening meal and it was delicious. The servers were not the friendliest, hence, the loss of a star, but the food was simply divine.

records.title: Double check the kids menu charges..not defined
records.text: Visited the Yeoman Harvester in Nuneaton.  Our waitress Jo was quite helpful albeit pretty determined to encourage us to add this and add that however quite welcoming and pleasant Our disappointment lies with the kids menu pricing .  We ordered a bigger bite which displays £7.49 on their web with a choice of main, 2 sides, free dessert and certain drinks all included in the above pricing.  We as 2 adults didn’t have dessert , 1 child did We checked our bill …unfortunately when we arrived home only to see we had been charged £7.99 for a kids meal and £6.99 for a dessert.!!!We challenged this and were refused the obvious discrepancy of the actual kids meal price (it’s on your web.. misdescriptions…we were refunded …after much discruntled discussions on the management side, the cost of the dessert NB. My meal states, our waitress Jo did highlight this also “it comes with garlic bread is that ok”…it was pitta bread or some kind of naan bread! Ensure you check the pricing and the bill

records.title: Dirty surroundings and tables but service was pleasant
records.text: We arrived for a late breakfast at the Harvester on the Eastern road, Portsmouth.  Food was limited but reasonably affordable. The veggie breakfast was ok. Mum had sausage sandwich and she enjoyed that. Nice drinks. Service was lovely. It was mostly empty. But it was dirty, from the steps and door at the entrance to the dusty fabric seats to the sticky tables. The toilets were ok but surfaces were dusty, even the walls dirty and not great. The stairs and everything really needed some care as it was really off putting. Normally I wouldn’t have minded if it was just a bit scruffy here and there but I didn’t expect it to be so bad. I’ve not been in a Harvester like this.However, the service was pleasant and couldn’t fault that.

records.title: Too good to go
records.text: Too good to go, usually good , however they didn't let us know they were out of chicken and didn't cancel the order so when I came to collect (5 minutes early) there was nothing to collect,  manager said they run out at 8 , its 8:40for an 845 pick up , please let us know , manager says we'll you are 5 minutes early,  just 5 minutes early but still no chickens aye mate lol 😂 xx Hopefully I will have better cluck next time .....

records.title: Pricey for average food
records.text: Websites dont show prices....lunch menue and breafast best values....5 of us visited for fathers day treat bill was £150 ....lots of addons and suplements for variouse sauces etc...sirloin . Rack ribs tomato soup nice....parking nightmare! Not what it was in the past! And this review echoed by others....hidden supplyments...

records.title: Ran out of breaded mushrooms
records.text: Had a Groupon voucher for 2 courses, which had a limited starter choice. Unfortunately they had run out of breaded mushrooms which was annoying as is my favourite, the other choices were not much good. The rest of the meal was very nice though. Gravesend harvester

records.title: We have been going to the Harvester for…
records.text: We have been going to the Harvester for 15 years. Always satisfied with food and staff. The last few times we have gone been disappointed with portions. My husband always had large rack of ribs which were big. Now they come out of a packet you can get 3 for £10 in supermarkets. Al the meals are the same.. portions smaller. Chips in a dish. Prices same or more. Reluctant to bother going now.

records.title: visited the harvester at chichester for…breakfast
records.text: visited the harvester at chichester for mothering day breakfast, restaurant,big and  busy,but only one toaster ,very bland and tasteless sausages and only two average size mushrooms.the one toaster caused a never ending cue.staff very nice

records.title: We visited the spyglass in Weymouth for…
records.text: We visited the spyglass in Weymouth for my husbands birthday , the restaurant wasn’t very busy we ordered our mains my husband ordered the mixed grill there were items missing and his steak was over cooked, I also had to wait for my meal as it hadn’t been done. Service was very slow when we had finished our mains nobody came to clear our the tables and when they did they only cleared half . My son in law ordered sundae best with toffee sauce it came with chocolate which he cannot eat .

records.title: Recently visited my local harvester in…
records.text: Recently visited my local harvester in Bolton. Service was fine but food was lacking. Salad bar missing lots of items with no signs of refills. Ordered the half roast chicken and think they must have mixed the chicken up with a sparrow!! Smallest chicken I've ever seen! My mash was going hard as if had been left under the lamp top long and was served with a tiny piece of corn on cob instead of usual vegetables. Cost us just short of £70 for 1 starter, 3 main meals, 1 desert and 3 soft drinks. Just can't justify it specially if the portions are so small. Won't be going back again.

records.title: Harvester Shrewsbury
records.text: Harvester Shrewsbury.  A harvester is our usual go to but unfortunately this is the second time this restaurant has disappointed. Pulled pork appeared to be missing but we were advised by the kitchen it was “under the cheese”…so half a teaspoon then. Good job it’s held on with cheese in case it blows away.   A number of items not available on the menu.  We did enjoy choosing what we would like and then re-thinking once we knew what wasn’t available.  Although a nice 20deg outside the restaurant itself felt stuffy.  Not what we usually experience. We’ll probably still go to our usual restaurants but we’ll avoid this one next time we’re here. Staff were pleasant and eager to help,  just disappointing food quality and availability.

records.title: Mixed emotions on this one
records.text: Mixed emotions on this one, Ordered through Just Eat & then Deliveroo order - see separate reviews for them.  Quantity of food you get as a main compared to if you were in the restaurant is poor value for money. While I had to take my takeaway back the Manager SEB at Harvester Pavilions in Peterborough was Outstanding.  Gives this man a raise as he was extremally helpful, calm, empathetic and accommodating.  Shame there seem to be a scam going on in the background of different menus online for Just Eat to in store and then attempting to rip of consumers.

records.title: The George Morden
records.text: Considering this place had a renovation a couple of years ago you never think it now, it’s falling apart, looks and feels dirty. The staff don’t even look clean and presentable, their uniforms are dirty and looked unwashed. (The plough staff look clean and fresh clothes)The glasses arrives dank. Missing food items as written and shown on the menu. Extremely long delay in getting the bill and then to actually pay. The outside looks dirty and needs a good jet wash and revamp all over and inside.

records.title: Not the best experience you expect from Harvester
records.text: My wife & I went to the Talbot Harvester at North Weald yesterday 23-7-2024 for dinner.The Calamari was excellent, the chicken & ribs that my wife ordered was good but when it came to my meal, the Bird Surf & Turf, the steak, the cajun chicken & the sweet corn was good but the jacket potato was almost cold to the point that the butter would Not melt & Not at all edible as it had been baked much earlier that day & to top it all when I asked for Mustard & Horseradish I was told that they had run out, later I found out that they had run out 3 day's previously & yet there is a shop opposite them that sells both these items, would it have been to difficult for them to go out & purchase these items from this very close by shop?It is like going into the KFC & them telling you they have the chicken but they had run out of the coating for it!       This is bad ordering & does Not make you feel like going back to this establishment!!!

records.title: Timberdine disappointed
records.text: Just taken my two granddaughters who are staying with us for a couple of days to the Timberdine. I have to say we wish we’d never bothered. Items missing off three dishes and the one child’s chicken breast was so overcooked it was largely inedible. My chicken kebab was also overcooked. The bread rolls were very very dry and the garlic bread starter hardly tasted of garlic. We did have two desserts for the children and these were much better so almost saved the meal.

records.title: Overal we had a lovely meal but unable…
records.text: Overal we had a lovely meal but unable to have a meal altogether as such horrible comment made about my child . James was incredible and he sorted it out and was very calm and polite . I am very happy with the customer service from him . Unfortunately one the lady's who said " I wouldn't go out if I had a child like him " he has autism and I'm extremely disappointed in her for this and I was very upset as so all my family . We all feel very upset about this . We have found out the lady who said this was actually the lady sorting cutterly wearing a bun in her hair . . It's a big shame . James made it all much happier and told me to come back with my little boy as we are welcome . It's makes such a horrible experience so much better having people like James , he is a massive asset to the company . High Wycombe .

records.title: Food was cooked perfectly shame about the floor staff
records.text: Food was cooked perfectly, asked to pass onto the chef as best cooked chicken I had. Shame about the floor staff. Standing the the food counter commenting on customers in a bad way including the manager too.Hampton, Peterborough

records.title: Food only average
records.text: Food was average. Rolls a bit stale. Chicken tasted old. Corn on the cob soggy. Service was fine, although cost the consumer extra with incorrect information about a particular deal. Unhappy with this experience.

records.title: What a shame
records.text: The Harvester has always been a favourite of ours. My young son loves the Salad bar pasta. We went to our local restaurant last night and found that they had changed the pasta for some bland pasta with a tasteless looking tomato flavouring. We won’t be rushing back

records.title: Pressure to TIP!
records.text: Re: Harvester Amesbury:Good food and pleasant ambience BUT I was a bit miffed to be pressured into leaving a tip!Two things happened:First, on looking at the screen to make my card payment I noticed a CHANGE, that gave you the option of giving them an extra: '5%, 10%, 20% (yeh right) or 'OTHER.' I was tempted to click on 'other' just to see what that was but the waitress boldly said to me: 'Don't you want to leave a tip today then?' This made me cringe and feel awkward, as it was in hearing distance of other diners - so I meekly clicked on the lowest amount of 5% - which was only a few pounds but I still felt aggrieved about the pressure and lack of choice really in this matter!They have clearly changed the payment screen, which used to have a red or green button but now have other options, which are bad in my opinion.All staff are now paid the minimum wage anyway and tipping is out of date and oppressive; particularly when we are in the middle of a cost of living crisis!How rude of the waitress to address us in this way!Customers don't even know what 'other' might mean and will inevitably click on the % button, whether they want to or not....Come on Harvester, your prices are high enough anyway and your staff are presumably paid the minimum wage, so why pressurise customers like this? It's OUTDATED, RUDE and UNNECESSARY.

records.title: Food was fresh hot and tasty.
records.text: Food was fresh hot and tasty.Our waitress was the best.Very dusty on shelves were we sat in boothAnd constant banging of kitchen doors for the whole hour we were there was very annoying surely someone could sort the soft closure mechanism on them to shut without banging all threw serviceChichester the barn

records.title: Harvester Lincoln
records.text: Harvester Lincoln Christmas day The staff on floor were great but food was unacceptable on the main all vegetables were solid undercooked,turkey was not as expected and advertised. Steak absolutely horrible

records.title: The Arden Oak…Harvester in Birmingham
records.text: My brother and I go to the Arden Oak Harvester almost every Sunday.  29th Dec. when our food arrived my brother said "that's burnt".  The waitress walked away but later came and asked if everything was OK.  When he said no his food was burnt she went and spoke to the manager.  We never heard the conversation nor did the waitress return until the bill was due.  My brother had hardly touched his food as it was burnt and too dry.  Again he complained that the food was burnt so at this point the waitress went back to the manager who came to our table.  She simply said "it's Rotisserie chicken that's how it comes".  We pointed out that as we are there almost every Sunday and my brother always has the same she just repeated "that's how it comes".  It doesn't come like that every other Sunday but this Sunday it was burnt and inedible.  My brother settled up but while the other staff are good the manager not so much.  We were left making full payment for a meal that couldn't be eaten.  Our only option is to stop going there after such a rude interaction and burnt food.  Update I contacted Harvester head office who apologised and emailed an e-voucher for £20 to us that we can use if we decide to go back.  If we do go back I will instruct my brother never to order any chicken although previously it was his first choice on the menu.

records.title: CHRISTMAS DAY, A DISAPPOINTNENT.
records.text: My son and I booked The Harvester, Basingstoke, for Christmas Day at 2 pm, being our third year in a row we were looking forward to it. It was very disappointing. We had our first course and then waited approximately for the main 1hr 40 mins, and then another wait for desserts. At no time did Management come and explain the situation or offer a complimentary drink. Nothing. When the main meal came it was not up to scratch. Veg was either undercooked or cold. Louis, our waiter, was excellent and kept apologising. He needs a bonus for his calmness and politeness.My son and I amused ourselves playing anything from I Spy to noughts and crosses. Maybe, The Harvester needs to put a pack of cards on each table and, at least, management take responsibility for the delays.I wish you a better 2025.

records.title: Taunton Harvester on Boxing…
records.text: Went into Taunton Harvester on Boxing Day at 4pm. Very disappointing visit, first when’s we arrived we booked a table for 7, but they only put the booking down for 4, Which was sorted quick. We were showed to the table which was dirty, food all over the floor. There were loads of tables empty and was still empty when we left. We waited aged to be service, went to the bar to ask for someone to take our order, which after another 10mins approx she took our order she brought our salad bowls but no knife and fork I had to go around other tables to get them. I  like to say the food was good.All the young waitresses want to do is hang around the end of the bar chatting. No ice cream on a Boxing Day so we had no desserts

records.title: Terrible service. Meal took 3 hours
records.text: Went for family Christmas meal at Oakmere Potters Bar. The meal took 3 hours because the service was extremely  slow. 3 of the meals had cold, dry hard chips. Complained and did get £20 discount on meal for 6. Wouldn't  go there again as who can spend 3 hours in a restaurant.  It was lunch time so not even busy evening

records.title: Not great.
records.text: Arrived at Pencoed, old mill harvester at 4.30pm on 14 December. We hadn't booked so we were not shocked when the manager said he didn't have a table for 2, we were happy to sit in the bar. The bar service was shockingly slow but the customer service or lack of from the barmaid was unreal, no acknowledgement at all that you were even waiting. We understand she was busy also service tables alone but just not being acknowledged wasn't great. The manager was quite rude and unhelpful. Said he had no pinot only house wine and i asked if it was dry, blunt answer from him was "i dont know". The salad was almost empty and not at all fresh. No lurpack, no croutons, lettuce leaves had lost their colour. Main meal arrive and the burger was not very well cooked at all, very pink. Sent it back and waited 30 mins for it to come back. Waste of £29.99, wish I had ordered a takeaway and stuck to my guns.

records.title: I really have NO idea how you stay In…
records.text: I really have NO idea how you stay In business? Terrible place. The theme is centred around a pond with a few small fish in it, a down at heel bayou, even the crocs left. Awful over-microwaved food, tired salad bar and the bowls are very small. Honey-drizzled corn bread, horrible. Tasted like yesterday’s fried bread that had been reheated and honey dipped. The toilets smelt and there is no hot water, disgraceful. I didn’t bother complaining and don’t think the poor people working there would have understood. A truly awful dining experience.

records.title: Christmas meal.
records.text: Disapointed with main Christmas main meal from menu, 2 out of 4 were not acceptable, vegetarian mushroom option was overcooked, and side vegetables were undercooked, and not apetising for both meals in the Maidstone restaurant.

records.title: Slow service
records.text: We went to the Haveseter Barn in Chichester West Sussex on the 4th December.  The service was very slow, the food was good and the staff Damon was excellent.  We sat by the window with a outlook onto the road, the grounds round the edge of the Haveseter were overgrown and full of weeds. I know it's winter but surely someone could tidy it up !!

records.title: errrr... Whats that
records.text: I ordered Triple Sausage medley pointing at the picture and asking if this was it which I was assured it was... Thats not what arrived I might as well have gone to a greasy spoon cafe it would have tasted better.. Instead of a plate with chopped up food on a bed of something I had sausages stacked up which were dry and over cooked...

description: Wagamama is a British restaurant chain, serving Asian food based on Japanese cuisine.

records.title: Wagamama Lakeside, Essex
records.text: Great experience at Lakeside Wagamama today. Got a table in minutes, all staff were friendly. Nice lady called Lefki served us who was really lovely and helpful.Food arrived quicky, was very nice and not expensive either.

records.title: Edinburgh has an Amazing Team
records.text: I ordered some food for collection at the St Andrews Square restaurant in Edinburgh, my food was delayed (not by long) but the team gave me a slice of chocolate cake by way of an apology. It was so good I went back the next night and tried to order it for collection but I couldn't, the team swapped by brownie for it and couldn't have been more helpful and kind. This is my favourite Wagamama Restaurant in the UK. Amazing Team!

records.title: Wagamama Reading Berks
records.text: Wagamama Reading Berks. Our first ever visit. We loved it. Everything freshly cooked and beautifully presented. A very helpful young man who guided us on our choices by answering our questions. And Sophia our waitress was charming, friendly and very patient. We live in Spain but pop back quite often., so we will definitely return to Wagamama Reading. A big thank you to all the staff.

records.title: Lovely experience
records.text: Went to wagamama Bromley today and were served by a very friendly waitress called Demi. The food and the service were fabulous. Cocktails were also yummy. Demi is very knowledgeable and helpful . We had a lovely time. 👍🏼

records.title: A wonderful eating out experience
records.text: 26/10/24: Wagamama Longmarket Canterbury.I don’t eat out, because I have multiple allergies and intolerances, and it is just too difficult to get the right food.Visiting my Wonderful niece in Canterbury, I took a chance with Wagamama.They have a specialist staff member, to help you with allergies. Aisha, was so patient, understanding and professional.Aisha, asked me all the right questions, listened and provided clear information on ingredients.Aisha, eased the stress 🙏🏿that usually comes with eating out!Next, Chef Miska cooked me a tailor made dish!  My meal was delicious, fresh, clean, and a generous portion too. Thank you to Aisha, Miska, and all the lovely staff members at Wagamama Canterbury.A very welcoming place, my niece and I, enjoyed a lovely eating out experience.Will certainly eat there again!👌🏿👏🏿👍🏿💛💛💛💛🍜

records.title: Myself and my wife went for a meal to…
records.text: Myself and my wife went for a meal to Wagamama Swindon and Balazs our waiter really made the experience extra special, nothing was to much trouble and the food was fantastic Balazs in a real asset to your company

records.title: I was having bad day
records.text: I was having bad day, I went to wagamama in bluewater to have some comfort food. I forgot to claim my free gyoza when I signed for the app. So server called George at table 1411 said he will have a word with the manager. It was settled and I got what I wanted. I want to say just a small gesture by this guy changed my day. Thanks George.

records.title: Wolverhampton Bentley bridge
records.text: Wolverhampton - Bentley bridge Our server Aid was lovely. Helped us with the menu, gave us great recommendations and provided excellent customer experience. Nice to see someone in customer service role that do such a good job. Very pleasant and friendly.

records.title: The BEST ramen I've had in years
records.text: The BEST ramen I've had in years. Only downside, there was way too much soup and it took me forever to eat. Absolutely lovely food, plenty of choice and tasty as I don't know what. All I can say is mmmmmm. Two seater tables are incredibly cramped because you're almost caged in with the screens and nowwhere to rest handbags or coats but otherwise,  fantastic.  Just be aware that there are roadworks on the bottom middlebrook venu, right underneath the restaurant so a bit confusing when parking up.

records.title: Wagamama, Bentley Bridge, Wolverhampton
records.text: Wagamama, Bentley Bridge, Wolverhampton Fantastic service from all the staff at the restaurant, particularly Lasa.Our first time at Wagamama with two young boys, made to feel really welcome, served quickly, food was first class and service was excellent!Can’t rate more highly and very impressed!

records.title: Great value and good quality food
records.text: Great value and good quality food.  Always a pleasure to drop in for noodles or curry.  Just visited Cardiff and enjoyed as always.

records.title: Very tasty food !
records.text: Went to Wagamamas on Middlebrook near Bolton for the first time . Staff very friendly and helpful with the menu .Lots of choice and three of us who went all chose differently. The  food is served as soon as it is ready at it's freshest which could mean your main arrives before your starter but it still works ok . One of us regretted choosing a main dish with chilli oil as it made the dish too hot to enjoy properly but the remaining two of us really enjoyed the taste experience of the various choices we made. Really enjoyed it - Thank you

records.title: Great food as always
records.text: Great food as always! Portions are a bit smaller than they used to be, but everything else is consistently excellent.

records.title: We've always really enjoy a Wagamama's…
records.text: We've always really enjoy a Wagamama's and certainly cannot wait for them to re-open in the near future. We tried a take-away option from them recently and whilst the food was nice (If perhaps a little overcooked - The sirloin steak was too chewy to eat on my Teriyaki Soba) the portion sizes did seem smaller compared to the ones we get when we dine in. Also, If I can offer any advice whatsoever, Chill your beer glasses - makes such a difference! Hope to see you soon Wagamama!

records.title: Liverpool one January sales shopping and meal
records.text: Wagamma Liverpool one restaurant. Been here must be 20 times now and it never lets you down food is excellent with loads of choice firecracker chicken being my favourite  I've tried most dishes and all delicious, staff spot on friendly with great service. Only reason I didn't give 5 stars is the chairs are either wooden stools or wooden benches made of solid wood with no seat cushions it doesn't take long before they become very uncomfortable please sort this small issue out.

records.title: Ordered from Wagama Edinburgh on 12th…
records.text: Ordered from Wagama Edinburgh on 12th March. Food turned up cold, but Wagamama's couldn't do enough to sort it out. Only incompetence from Deliveroo messed this up- they tried to keep some of the refund from Wagamamas! Ultimaley did get a refund. They did their best to help, including phoning Deliveroo to try to ensure the full refund. Will use Wagamama Edinburgh again, but will be avoiding Deliveroo in future though.

records.title: Superb service and Quality - Newcastle
records.text: Took the family to Waga in Newcastle upon Tyne, the service was good, the food came quickly and was tasty as ever. Chicken RamenFire cracker Chicken Beef donburi Chilli Squid Tama Squid Reading a few of the 1* reviews clearly there is some issues at some restaurants.  Waga definitely have something the other casual dining outlets dont.  Please don't take your eye off the ball!

records.title: Went with my family to your brent cross…
records.text: Went with my family to your brent cross branch, the wait and line was very very long but once we were sat down (at a nice table location) the food was all very tasty and service was fast. Would return at a quieter period perhaps during the week.

records.title: Great service and atmosphere
records.text: Me and my husband visited the Wagamama Telford branch on Thursday evening and the food was divine. We sat right in front of the most hardworking staff at the bar. Not only she was fast and we could tell she was tired but she kept working. If all honesty she looked like a manager. We also had the sweetest server Rachael, so lovely and friendly. Will definitely be coming back. :)

records.title: Been going to Wagamama more than 10…
records.text: Been going to Wagamama more than 10 years. Good and tasty food as always. No bad experiences so far. Will keep going.

records.title: Good food and good service
records.text: Me and my boyfriend visited on a busy evening. We had to wait about 15 mins to be seated but once seated the service was friendly and the staff were attentive. The food came out hot and delicious.

records.title: Fresh and delicious branch
records.text: Went in the Leister Sqr branch. Amazon food, fresh and delicious. Little expensive because of the locaiton

records.title: Okay food but overpriced
records.text: Okay food but overpriced. Service was good and nice atmosphere. Plenty of menu options, altogether nice experience.

records.title: Friday is our treat day at Wagamamas
records.text: Friday is our treat day at Wagamamas, starts the weekend off perfectly!Thanks Wagamama.

records.title: GOOD CHAIN; TOILET MADNESS
records.text: This is currently my favourite chain restaurant. I'm not overly keen on chains because of their tendency to sell mediocre food in small portions at high prices, to cover the astronomical cost of overheads and renting prime city centre "units". (This is why the  "chain" business model is often doomed to fail: many chain eateries go bust before yet ANOTHER faceless "investment firm" picks them up to try again – or ditches them completely to launch something totally different.)However, I like "Wagabubs" (I use their Cardiff City Centre branch) because of their consistency, good quality (for a chain), great tastes, unique dishes and proper, professional packaging by way of their tightly-sealed, recyclable, signature bowls.Because I am mostly house/bedbound due to a neurological illness, I usually order via Deliveroo (although their prices on the app need to be reduced by 15/20%) but on occasion I enjoy the full, buzzing Waga-restaurant experience-Mama.My favourite dishes are the raisukaree curries and the salmon koyo - mmm! Also Wagamama is one of the few places that I can order brown rice: an underrated delicious side that is also great for gut health!As regards the restaurant, the only concern I have is that the toilets are weirdly mixed (they lose a star on this). This means that women and girls have to share the facilities with men and boys and do not have a safe space to comfortably attend to themselves, change their clothes etc, or just simply feel secure in a place that should really be a sanctuary for them - especially unaccompanied young girls - as toilet facilities have been for thousands of years (would you believe). (FOOTNOTE: One major venue in Cardiff was recently investigated by the police because it was reported that men dressed as women may be infiltrating the ladies' toilets for nefarious purposes. The law is now changing, in England, to force (new-build) restaurants to offer SEPARATE toilet facilities to both male and female customers - Wales should put the safety of women and girls FIRST and follow suit. It is now time stop this absurd toilet fad that essentially allows a sleazy bloke - even a sex offender - to pop on a dress, slap on on a bit of makeup and skulk into women's/girls' toilets unchallenged. Permitted madness.)UPDATE: I notice that Wagamama has not replied to the above review. If no courteous response is forthcoming I will assume that the chain agrees with the serious points I have raised above.

records.title: I like wagamama
records.text: I like wagamama, good selection and the dishes are delicious. Staff is nice.

records.title: The food wasnt as nice today
records.text: The food wasnt as nice today, service with a smie as always though!

records.title: Amazing food
records.text: Amazing food, but the service is hit and miss.

records.title: Love the decor/food bleh
records.text: Love the decor, the seating and excellent service. However as it was a birthday celebration we were disappointed that there was a restrictive menu. We were told no chicken or pork or ramen noodles. I was looking forward to the Chilli Chicken ramen, so had to get the beef brisket ramen which was tasteless too much coriander and broth lacked any taste. Also the ramen broth was half normal portions.I left disappointed and feeling a bit cheated, Staff should warn people that Sunday nights might not have a full menu. For the money I spent for 4 people I expect more, I don't think I would use wagamama again as the food was not the usual standard. The ramen did not look appetising but I was hungry and only ate a third.

records.title: Croydon Resturant
records.text: Clean environment, fast service and friendly staff but the food is just not that great. The starters were OK, then I had the Yakisoba noodles and i have had better meals out of the pots you add water to and had belly ache 3 hours later. I won't be going back.

records.title: Disappointed with Payment Process
records.text: Food was fine but very disappointed that overpayment error is yet to be repaid to me having been assured that it it was voided on Saturday 5th  October. I have provided bank details to Whiteley Wagamama again but still not actioned. Will not visit again.

records.title: Freezing. Eat Fast, Leave Fast. Don't Tip?
records.text: Gatwick North. Stopped for a snack, nothing to complain about there. However, it is very sharp practice to turn the air con up so high that you can turn tables quicker. The uninitiated sitting in their coats etc. An intelligence insulting activity, I believe pioneered by another well known fast food restaurant chain...

records.title: Inedible Thai beef Salad
records.text: Firstly, Fantastic service but food was inedible as it was so grisly! Thai beef salad, lovely flavour but couldn't eat it! Manager refused to give a partial refund and offered a desert or a drink. I didn't want a desert or any other drink but was given no option! My advice is to choose carefully, this is not my usual service from Wagamama and was disappointed from a new restaurant!

records.title: Food is good depending on which branch
records.text: Food is good depending on which branch. Kensington branch has much more organisation than other branches ive been to. Had one good experience at paddington branch London, and one not so good, food was not great and the shortage of staff was visible however, the manager was very helpful and seemed to have everything under control. she seemed to be doing everything to make me feel welcomed. Not sure if id go again though! The food was better 6 months ago.

records.title: Good staff. Good was lacking.
records.text: First time at Wagamama today (Birmingham City Centre).  Staff were very friendly and apologetic for the waiting time, but considering it was peak time and cleaning etc due to Covid it wasn’t a problem. Starters were good, but main courses were very average. Lacked flavour and nothing more than a microwave type meal. Very noisy surroundings like a canteen. First and possibly last visit I’m afraid. 🙄

records.title: Sustainability issue - black plastic containers
records.text: Sustainability issue. Nothing wrong with the food or service and we are regular satisfied customers. But why is the takeaway food packaged in black plastic containers? In my area black plastic is not accepted for recycling so the only option is to try and reuse them or throw them away. Supermarkets etc are moving away from black plastic packaging, so I hope Wagamama will follow suit very soon - as I am sure sustainability is very high on the company's agenda.

records.title: The reason I didn't leave a tip........
records.text: Great food and service as always at Brighton branch but didn’t have the white Pinot we wanted so had to pay £6 more for a bottle of Sauvignon Blanc so unfortunately the tip I would normally have left paid for the difference. Surely not difficult to ensure you have everything on the menu or wine list?

records.title: Good food, slow service.
records.text: Four of us, 3 adults and 1 2 year old went for lunch in the one in Bury St Edmunds. Staff were polite and the restaurant was exceptionally clean. My only grumble is the way the food is served. My daughter who got served first had finished her meal about 10 minutes before mine even came to the table. Also don't like the plastic take away containers. I'm sure there must be a more environmentally friendly way of delivering food. The food itself was great, and I can't complain about the quality.

records.title: Mixed feelings
records.text: I have mixed feelings when it comes to wagamama. Depending on my visit, i get a different experience from good and bad. Honestly, it all comes down to the staff i come across that day. Sometimes they are so lovely and attentive and some days they seem like they’re forced to help you, even though it’s their job. Even with the food. Sometimes it’s so tasty and well cooked and then some days the food comes colder than it should be and like no time was taken into making itOne stable thing within wagamama is the seating, its considerably comfortable and even perfect for families because of the good amount of space

records.title: WENT TO REIGATE WAGAMMA
records.text: WENT TO REIGATE WAGAMMA food good, but there was a man with a masssssive beard with no beard net, i started to wonder if I was eating noodles, or his beard hair, it made me feel strange and i almost convinced myself i was eating hair  Now I don't like noodles coz I think of beards Can you give him a face mask

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: We have always been fans of Wagamama and have been to several from The Tower of London to Covent Garden and The Soith Bank. We have been visiting the local St Albans branch since it opened as well as having takeaways.  The last 2 takeaways were very poor. Spilled sauces, cracked bowls, items missing and overcooked noodles. Decided to go into the restaurant tonight as it has usually been good there but it was disappointing.  The food was warm but not hot. There were no Japanese pickles with the Katsu. My eldest daughters plate had lots of water from the salad and my youngest had to check her prawns were cooked as they looked a little anaemic, this was after being served with 2 dirty glasses. It was not busy yet the chilli squid only arrived as we had finished everything else. I also feel that 8pm is a little early to start taking away sauces and cutlery from the tables, especially as we were still eating. I think it will be a while before going again.

records.title: Not worth the hype
records.text: Main dishes were good and reasonably priced. Starters and side dishes were ok; nothing to write home about, and horrendously priced. Juice drinks were flavoured water and pricey.NOT value for money.

records.title: It was alright but I wouldn't come here…
records.text: It was alright but I wouldn't come here again because the food came to us cold. Got replaced but wasn't much better. Won't be going back

records.title: They were was ignoring us
records.text: 1 waitress was ignoring us. We waited for the bill for HALF and hour. Good food but service was bad- they gave us death stares and I waz scared

records.title: Good flavor but overcooked noodles
records.text: Good flavor, but the noodles were so overcooked.. almost to the point of being mushy.

records.title: The service was good and the food was…
records.text: The service was good and the food was very good but my partner and I had to eat off chipped crockery!!

records.title: service was poor
records.text: service was poor, card machine was broken, tried to intimidate innocent 16 yr old girls because they couldn’t work the card system out, didn’t give us our free gyozas and they tried to scam us - Leicester

records.title: We love Waga food but not at cribbs causeway
records.text: As a family we have been great fans of Wagamama for years mostly Exeter London and Edinburgh branches. However my daughter and I visited the cribbs causeway outlet on Thursday and were very disappointed both with the quality of food and service was poor considering it was almost empty during our visit . Both of our meals were more onion than anything else and I had a large piece of onion skin in mine . My second cup of  green tea looked like dishwater and was cloudy and tasteless .it could easily have been dishwater in fact !!  After asking for it to be replaced replacement  cup was worse so I had to leave it . There were several staff on duty ( 3 pm) but service was very slow  and the person making the tea was sullen and unhelpful . I would not advise anyone to use this Waga mama there are far better ones with decent food . Extremely disappointing meal

records.title: Hard to find something not spicy…
records.text: Hard to find something not spicy in the menu.I went with my wife to the wagamama in Fort Kinnard, we ordered a ramen without chilli nor kimchi in the description and was still spicy. It should be in the description.

records.title: Wagamama has the dodgy practice of not…
records.text: Wagamama has the dodgy practice of not including VAT on menu "prices" where it quotes figures without a "£". This means 20% is added onto the bill and service is also not included. The Yaki Udon I had was tasty but expensive for what it was. Service was absent despite the Ealing restaurant being at most 1/4 full. The waiters appeared more interested in chatting amoung themselves near the kitchen than working.

records.title: Staff not bothered
records.text: Food was okay. Most of the staff very uninterested, do not serve unless called for and people are left waiting and being served after others have come in. Seems like they do not want to be there and just chat amongst their selves with no consideration of the customers.

records.title: Went to Wagamama in PUTNEY HIGH ST the…
records.text: Went to Wagamama in PUTNEY HIGH ST the other week had a pad Thai and ordered a cocktail.The chicken in pad Thai was awful it was a dark colour and looked like the cheapest of chicken which I didn’t finish as it was not nice.  I also had a drink which had no alcohol at all it was like squash and £9.50 Very very disappointed

records.title: Poor
records.text: Poor - going downhil since venture  capitalists bought the chain in 2019. Poor sevice in St Albans  (twice now in 3 visits!) . Obvislouy the investors  need the premuim they paid coming out of the profit - hence cutbacks in staff. They will follow Jamie's and Byron etc, if they continue like this. I normally visit once a month, I will start giving it a miss.

records.title: Don't buy the stir-fry sauce
records.text: I wanted to cook a meal at home, for me and some friends. I chose Wagamama Teriyaki stir-fry sauce and wish I hadn't. It tasted really really strongly of salt, to the extent that one of my guests nearly threw up, after just a small taste. My evening was ruined and I was embarrassed. I can't believe that someone is being paid good money, to give the ok to products which aren't just bad, but actually impossible to consume.

records.title: Food was great when they finally…
records.text: Food was great when they finally managed to serve the correct meals. The staff very rude, not helpful, the manager Tracy at Trafford Centre not interested at all, she couldn’t even be bothered to speak or apologise. Charged for drinks that never arrived. Big let down.

records.title: Downhill experience
records.text: Last few times I have been (all different wagamama locations) the food was bland, lacked flavour completely and not worth the cost. Drinks are okay. More expensive food for smaller portions. Haven’t been impressed at all.

description: We’re Drinkstuff, an online retailer of bar, glassware, tableware and catering equipment here to help both home and business customers. With over 20,000 unique and inspiring products from top brands, you can be sure to find exactly what you need.

records.title: Just - WOW! Laundry Dispensers!
records.text: I have have purchased several of these lovely glass drinks dispensers. The ordering process was easy and they were delivered in super quick time. All very carefully packed/wrapped. So.. what did I do with my now 8 drink dispensers? I’ll tell you what!  They are now placed next to each other in my new laundry room. Each dispenser holds a different washing liquid/softener/white vinegar/etc etc. it makes laundry so much fun using my little ‘buckets’ hanging on each one to use .. a bit like ‘pick ‘n mix’ from years ago!!  They look spectacular with the various colours and are proving so economic in letting out just the required amount of laundry liquid/etc. I made little hanging labels for each dispenser with its contents. Stupid me left one of the taps slightly on .. and returned to the laundry room to find a big puddle of pink detergent. I won’t do that again! I would highly recommend these beauties and hope I am able to leave a photo of them. Definitely the wow factor I was after for my laundry room! Word of caution for those with young children to place well out of reach of little fingers etc as the bright colours of the detergent could be construed as something ‘nice’. So do be mindful. Otherwise - enjoy! Oh.. shame I can’t leave a photo .. :-(

records.title: back when I was working as a bartender

records.title: The products delivered were great but I…
records.text: The products delivered were great but I didn’t get the quantity I ordered. When I called to re order I was given a credit for the postage, which when I tried to use was only able to be used in £2 quantities per order. So I ordered the missing items from another retailer with no postage costs. This wasn’t explained by the customer service team

records.title: Good service
records.text: Good service. Unfortunately, the jugs I ordered are smaller than I thought and because they don't cost delivery it's not worth paying the cost to exchange. Probably more suited to those ordering in bulk or spending enough to make the delivery free.

records.title: Cappuccino cup
records.text: Beautifully crafted cup, quick delivery and really well packaged. Only reason I gave 4 stars is that I would have expected a cup sold as cappuccino cup to have been quite abit larger. But it's gorgeous! Thankyou.

records.title: Brandy warmer and glass
records.text: Bought as a gift for my dad for Christmas so don’t know how good it works but looks the part would of 5 star but the glass was cloudy so just bought a separate one to go with it x

records.title: Glasses were perfect for purpose loved…
records.text: Glasses were perfect for purpose loved the products - fast delivery and a really reasonable price.....Good value for money, seem really good quality, and packaged with care.

records.title: Disappointed as item suggested it was a set.
records.text: Order arrived swiftly, but box quite damaged by delivery company, but luckily glasses inside weren’t broken. Glasses weren’t boxed which was disappointing as item suggested it was a set.

records.title: UPDATE to Review: Beware cheap plastic Martini glasses
records.text: UPDATE as of Jan 2023:  Drinkstuff responded quickly and very helpfully to my review below, arranging a free return and full refund. I cannot fault their customer service and would certainly buy from them again.My original review: “Your description of the Strahl Martini glasses I purchased “These stunning cocktail glasses look and feel like real glass thanks to their triple glazed finish” was in no way a faithful representation of what arrived. They feel and look like cheap plastic (you can even see the plastic mould lines on the sides of the bowl) but at £7.99 each were not cheap to buy!” An additional comment regarding a restocking fee proved to be inaccurate on my part as my purchase fell within a Xmas return period so I have deleted it.

records.title: Order not fulfilled
records.text: Only a small part of my order has been delivered. The website gives no indication as to when I will receive my order and doesn't state that the items aren't in stock.Update: I have now been contacted by Customer Services who have been very helpful.

records.title: Nice item but not fit for purpose
records.text: Bought an ice bucket for my son’s birthday party.  Looked really nice but rope handle broke on first use.  Water, bottles and ice went everywhere.  Not even used for wine bottles, just small bottles of fizzy drinks so should really have been able to cope with weight.Drinkstuff refunded me which is very much appreciated.

records.title: Underwhelming
records.text: Drinkstuff has a huge range of products, some very hard to find in the UK, at generally excellent prices. In the past I have been very, very impressed but this time found the experience rather underwhelming.It took them over a week to pick and despatch the 'in stock' elements of my order, which is poor in 2024. Delivery was then quick, but there was a breakage. Drinkstuff use cardboard based protection for glassware, but the outer box had little obvious sign it contained fragile items - no red 'fragile' tape/stickers or anything like that, just their standard black printing. The DPD driver who dropped a box on my driveway did not appear to understand that it contained glass!The items which were shipped direct from the supplier took another week after that. DPD initially said it was out for delivery on 28th November, then sent a series of messages saying there was a problem without saying what the problem was. Tracking showed it sitting in their depot. The remaining stuff wasn't delivered until 2nd December. Not Drinkstuff's fault, but a poor experience nevertheless.My email about the breakage took them 24 hours to respond to; when they did reply I was offered a replacement but that still took a further week to arrive.

records.title: Your product is absolutely perfect
records.text: Your product is absolutely perfect. It's so difficult to find a glass which contains a sensible amount of wine rather than something the size of a fish bowl. I'd have rated drinkstuff 5* if it hadn't been for the courier, who arrived 3 hours early, made no attempt to ring our doorbell and just left the parcel in the lobby, where any body could have picked it up. My husband only noticed it by accident.

records.title: Fast shipping, excessive packaging
records.text: Fast shipping and a great choice of items. Packaging included about half a tonne of extra cardboard inside the box - it's going to take three recycling collections to get rid of it all! I appreciate eco-friendly packing filler, but this heavy cardboard is a nightmare to deal with.

records.title: Delivery and after service great but my cups melted…
records.text: Delivery was great but my cups melted on the drinks table and were unusable. More warnings needed in big red letters as this is obviously a major issue in the summer. (update) Refunded, thanks. I had a freak time with my cups it seems. Drinkstuff researching thoroughly the mystery of the melting cups. Thank you

records.title: Not as advertised
records.text: I am sure the goods I received are seconds as the wood is not as advertised, I bought a bulk lot and they are all made up of different wood so appear as stripes, also there are bits of wood missing on one of the designs. I wanted them to all look the same as per the advert but have received totally different.

records.title: My first delivery didn’t make it only…
records.text: My first delivery didn’t make it only to be told almost a week after it was supposed to be delivered that it was damaged in transit. Offered a refund or to resend the order asked for it to be resent only to be informed that one of the items was out of stock 🤦‍♂️I asked if you used other couriers and I was told you use DPD so I asked if the parcel could be sent through them but you still used EVRI On the plus side the parcel turned up this time albeit 2 items were broken

records.title: Unfortunate delays on glassware
records.text: The range that Drinkstuff supplies is great and the prices reasonable; however the delay on getting some of the lines in can be prohibitive - if we need replacement glassware we can't really be waiting nearly 2 months with multiple estimated arrival changes.

records.title: The packaging was poor
records.text: The products were great as advertised; however, the packaging was squashed when it arrived. Given the products were not damaged all was well but the packaging stated glass, which would have been broken if present.

records.title: Love the glasses but I ordered a box of…
records.text: Love the glasses but I ordered a box of 6 and only received 4

records.title: The recyclable little goblets that I…
records.text: The recyclable little goblets that I ordered were a fantastic price, arrived very quickly but are opaque.

records.title: Item had a few blemishes
records.text: Item had a few blemishes,  are they seconds?? Didn't complain as price very reasonable.  No option to deliver to parcel shop when placing order,  then no option to change to parcel shop when allocated to courier.  Courier (Evri) uncontactable. Only obe hour notice given for delivery meaning I had to rush home from work. Parcel left at front door on busy street, could have been picked up by anyone.

records.title: Review hounds.
records.text: Good prices and good speed but my god this company will hound you for reviews. Really sours the experience. Would be a 5 star if they hadn't followed up more than a single time.

records.title: I wasn't happy that the parcel was…
records.text: I wasn't happy that the parcel was thrown over the fence and the box was soggy, fortunately inside the item had bubble wrap round it so wasn't wet!No harm done and Drink Stuff refunded my postage!Thank you Drink Stuff.

records.title: DPD are not reliable or fit for purpose!…
records.text: The reason I am giving less stars is because of the disaster with getting the package.DPD messed up more than once they are not fit for purpose.I would say if I had known it was delivery by them I would not have ordered from this site.

records.title: Good and bad
records.text: Ordered a soda syphon - part of it was missing when delivered. (How hard can it be?!)Delivery charge cost significantly more than average.Customer Service remedied the issue promptly, without hassle and at no extra charge.

records.title: I placed my order on 29/8 the…
records.text: I placed my order on 29/8 the information said 3-5 day delivery so i was expecting my goods before 4/9 as it was a birthday gift,unfortunately my order arrived one day late on 5/9 ,also one of the goblets i ordered had a firing fault and a section of glaze was missingit was great to be able to choose individual goblets but disappointment with delivery and quality control

records.title: change your courier
records.text: Viking horn glass and stand well received

records.title: Great product but dropped two stars due…
records.text: Great product but dropped two stars due to the length of time dispatching and receiving the glasses... packaging could have been more sturdy as box was crushed on one corner and one of the glasses was chipped on the rim.

records.title: Feel like plastic glasses
records.text: glasses where not heavy, thick and actually feel cheap and plastic. Was after some heavy tumblers and these feel flimsy.

records.title: Ordered and paid for bonzer silver…
records.text: Ordered and paid for bonzer silver plated bar spoon, only to find later that this item would not be delivered This was the main reason why I placed the order. Although I received a refund, I still had to look elsewhere to order from a similar supplier, therefore paying more postage. However the other items I received were well wrapped and I was happy with them.

records.title: Only 5 glasses turned up in a pack of…
records.text: Only 5 glasses turned up in a pack of six. Not able to send one more due to some stock/computer error. The 5 I have are great, but I need 6! would have chosen an alternative model to get a full set. Now I need to buy another six....from somewhere else sadly. A refund for x1 is missing the point.

records.title: Haven't received the items yet so can't…
records.text: Haven't received the items yet so can't possibly review them, you say they were dispatched 10 days ago and Evri are still saying they're waiting to receive the parcel when I try to track it

records.title: Good quality products, poor customer service experience
records.text: Quality of products is generally good.Customer service care is very limited.This isn't my first order with Drinkstuff, but for 2 of 3 orders I've been chasing customer service. Have just been ignored! If you have an issue, you'll spend hours of your time chasing for answers!

records.title: Not advised of out of stock items which according to packing slip were present.
records.text: Order arrived and according to the invoice contained the full order. Instead of 250 plates a full pack of 125 plates was missing!When I contacted the helpline and suggested a photo of the box would prove that the plates were not received Drinkstuff said they knew these were out of stock already and cold send them out later or refund me. When asked why they hadn't advised me earlier of the shortfall they just said they were sorry and would offer a refund. This did not help me with the event I was catering for.

records.title: Shipping + refund issues
records.text: Good products, but terrible customer service team. Passive aggressive team. DHL have delivered our items on a public sidewalk and now DrinkStuff are dragging their heels to rectify the issue. Packaging is not great. Always get broken glassware.Edit:After contacting drinkstuff regarding the stolen delivery we were told that it would take 4 working days to liaise with the courier company. I contacted them after 4 days as I did not have a reply. They then told me it would take 7 working days for the issue to be resolved. Today marks 9 working days and I’ve yet to have a response despite emailing them.

records.title: goods damaged on receipt
records.text: goods damaged on receipt. Linda assured replacement. over a week later have not received replacement. Had to ring again today, Amelia said Linda had not activated replacement and said she would do today? I was wanting to give these as a gift, now because of delay is causing me uncalled for stress.

records.title: Shocking ! Still waiting!
records.text: This is the second order for the same item, first order was told after payment taken that it would be 3 months before we see our order, that was then cancelling and placed a second order - which I was informed would be here within a week, now I await the delivery of the second and we are going on 3 weeks. Rang up to enquire and was told all that can be done is to cancel the order and get a refund.. not happy at all!

records.title: Not the most straightforward order ever...
records.text: Found ordering online was not possible for some complicated reason to do with the system not accepting my apparently already registered email address, refusing to send me a password reset (as it said the email address did not exist on their system) then would not let me create the email address as a new registration as it said it already existed on the system!!!   I ended up booking with Drinkstuff over the phone.I wanted 2 boxes of 12 wine glasses (2 different sizes) but only 1 box of 1 size was in stock. I had to order those and pay for them first before being able to order and pay for the out of stock items. I was told the 3 remaining boxes would be with them the following week and 2 of them were and arrived in time for the event but I am still waiting for the 4th and final box. In all there will have been 3 deliveries for 4 boxes of glasses involving 2 separate payment transactions. Nothing wrong with the glasses themselves just the process.

records.title: Staff training
records.text: Poorly trained staff, a website that wouldn't work properly, and a system where one person knew nothing about what the others had done (despite computers!)

records.title: I received a broken mason jar and a…
records.text: I received a broken mason jar and a broken lid this time. It has never happened before. So I am disappointed.

Plus easy to navigate website and speedy delivery.

records.title: Satisfied Customer. Ordering was easy and the order arrived…
records.text: Ordering was easy and the order arrived in good time.

records.title: True Origin are a great company
records.text: True Origin are a great company , its a pleasure to be a customer

records.title: Can't fault this company
records.text: Can't fault this company. Bought some fair trade tea, coffee etc and selection of products for christmas gifts and they arrived promptly and well packaged. Would buy from them again. Love the bear bread!

records.title: Order fulfilled promptly & efficiently

records.text: Good products promptly sent.Slightly irritated by Royal Mail. They messaged that there would be an evening delivery but it came early afternoon when we were out, and was left on the doorstep (roadside) which their note declared to be my “safe place: enclosed porch” - it would have been better to redeliver it when someone was in.

records.title: Great to have a source of fairly traded products in the absence of Traidcraft.
records.text: I like the products, I like the ethics behind them. I am glad to have a resource for ordering fairtrade since Traidcraft had to cease business.The reason the fifth star is missing relates to delivery, but this lies within the local Royal Mail field of responsibility rather than with Just Trading or True Origin.

records.title: Mostly
records.text: Mostly, it was great, but I couldn't understand why there was so much packaging - 2 boxes of tea in a box, but then that box put into a much bigger box. I'm grateful for the explanation in response to my first review, letting me know that it's to ensure the tea arrived intact, as the smaller box wouldn't have withstood the weight of other packages in the delivery van. Thank you.

records.title: Great food and service
records.text: Great food and service. Love the Kilombero rice!!

records.title: No problems with placing order and delivery!
records.text: Delivery was completed ahead of schedule, complete, well-packaged and undamaged.I'm concerned that items I've bought in the past no longer feature in the JTS catalogue, including Oryx Desert Salt (Gourmet Fine and Smoked), Cote d'Ivoire Black Pepper and Moroccan Harissa Spice Mix. Perhaps they will return?

records.title: Good products, but packaging could be improved
records.text: Order arrived promptly with correct items.The delivery box was far bigger than the product boxes, so a huge amount of paper was used to pack them. The outer box was sealed with plastic, not paper, tape. Several of the spice bottles in the advent box had fallen out of their holes, so the box had to be opened up and rearranged before it was given to the recipient.
