I just got a call at some point during the day to say FedEx was outside, now if I had received comms beforehand, I wouldn't have left the apartment.. But anyway, atleast the delivery driver called and was given instructions on how to access building and deliver parcel. Can't wait to have the sweet aroma fill my home, to remind me of home. Thank you!

records.title: Prompt service

records.text: Even though the price has increased since our last three 5-litre bottles order, this olive oil continues to be the best olive oil we can buy and so still good value!

records.title: Delicious and excellent!

It is ideal for dressing a salad or even just having it for breakfast with a toast.  The nature and quality of this oil are far from other virgin olive oils available.  The secret is an immaculate production, carefully  monitored, from the best source in Cordoba to the final customer. I highly recommend the Koroneiki type whilst I wait for a bottle of Picual to compare!

records.title: Great product and customer service

description:
Located in the heart of Hornchurch, Tandoori Lounge holds a prominent position in the High Street amongst some of the biggest high street names. The very obvious distinction being that Tandoori Lounge is Hornchurch’s one and only authentic Punjabi restaurant, offering the delightful flavours of the Punjab, combined with the very traditional spices of Indian cuisine.

A big statement by a small family-run restaurant, that aims to provide its customers a genuinely authentic cuisine, matched with a professional yet informal customer experience. With a combination of modern lines and very vivacious curves, the restaurant serves up a unique dining experience, only surpassed by it's array of mouth watering dishes.

records.title: The food is always excellent and Sukh…
records.text: The food is always excellent and Sukh and the team are great!

records.title: Great authentic Panjabi food
records.text: Great authentic Panjabi food from Tandoori Lounge. None of this fake Bangladeshi "Indian" curry that litters Essex.Service is good and prices are reasonable given the location.

records.title: A Splendid Establishment
records.text: Right hear me out, an authentic punjabi restaurant, based in the heart of Hornchurch and I had absolutely no idea about it?!We visited here for NYE with some work colleagues and were left amazed by the quality of each dish. Admittedly, our friend who is punjabi, ordered for the table and its safe to say, nothing was left behind.Special comments for the TL special Lamb which was super tender and the Fiery Calamari which was brilliant. The staff were young but knowledgable in regards to the dishes which was refreshing and we also met Honey, the owner who was also lovely and catered for my friend who is celiac which again, was very refreshing. Thanks for a lovely NYE and we'll be sure to be back!

records.title: A Very Pleasant New Year’s Eve!
records.text: Visited this establishment in Hornchurch for New Year’s Eve. I would like to thank Sukh & Honey (the owners) for their great hospitality and amazing food! Our waiters attended to our special requests for each dish as we had a few vegetarians along with a Celiac on our table and they were brilliant. Would definitely recommend this to anyone in the London/Essex Area looking for authentic Punjabi food in a polished atmosphere!

records.title: Visited yesterday with my partner and…
records.text: Visited yesterday with my partner and was a very nice experience with very helpful and nice staff. Felt very comfortable and the food was great with some amazing help from the waitress.

Thank you so much for the lovely evening. I will be visiting your place very soon. Once again thank you so much.

records.title: Wrong Customer Service!
records.text: Went to Tandoori Lounge Hornchurch for a Quiz Night which included a two course meal. We booked a table of two but was put on a table for 6, tried to separate the tables, the male owner wasn't too happy but agreed to do so.  We were then told that we had to remain partnered with the other members on the table for the quiz which hadn't been communicated when purchasing tickets.  I must say here that our partners on the table were great so we were very happy we were partnered with them!  The Quiz, atmosphere and food were great, no complaints, well executed. My complaint is that we had bought a bottle of wine only and when we asked for the bill, it came with a service charge of £2.50 which I disputed.  The waitress taking payment said she couldn't take it off the bill as it has to be paid.  I again said that its supposed to be optional and she went to speak to the lady Owner who came over and said the service charge is payable.  I asked why and explained that we had only bought a bottle of wine and there shouldn't be a charge on it, and she actually said, was it served at your table, shouldn't my staff be paid for that??  Tried to explain it again but she was not having any of it just repeated that its to be paid.  Have never come across a rude front of house owner like this before!! Paid the full bill because it seemed to be getting out of hand and she was not willing to take it off but informed her that I will be putting in a review, she said, go ahead!  Will never be going to this restaurant again.  No customer service at all!!  Nothing on website to say that service charge is payable other than for tables of 6 and over!!

records.title: Avoid this restaurant at all costs
records.text: Avoid this restaurant at all costs. The owner was so rude! Waiting over 2 hours just for our starters which were cold and tasteless. Owner was purely there for the money. When we finally got our food it was awful. Topping our night off when we received the bill more items were added onto it which we never ordered.

description: Turner's award-winning pies. Based in West Sussex since 1933, our award-winning products are baked daily, from scratch using only the finest ingredients. Freshly baked pies, nationwide, directly to your door with Pies by Post.

records.title: Bought as a Christmas gift for family
records.text: Bought as a Christmas gift for family, They were really pleased. They make an great alternative gift. We bought two Starter packs one for Vegetarian family and one for regular meat eaters. As always both the packs were brilliant and appreciated. Never disappoints.

records.title: I ordered the Boxing Day packs for my…
records.text: I ordered the Boxing Day packs for my parents and my sister. The packaging and delivery were good and the products were very well received. The feedback I got was that they were delicious and my mum said the meat was as though she’d prepared it herself ( high praise indeed!). I had queries before ordering and Sam was so helpful. Highly recommended!

records.title: The very best pies
records.text: The very best pies, high quality with great service. Full of quality filling with excellent taste. Wide selection on easy to use website which offers choice of delivery options. We have bought from Turners Pies for several years after first hearing about their win at a farm food/pie competition on TV. Highly recommended and you won’t be disappointed.

records.title: Delicious pies, great service
records.text: Great service, as always, and delicious pies delivered, just before Christmas.  Some guests tried them for the first time and were just as impressed.  We use a few fresh from the box but freeze the others.  After defrosting and heating they are just as tasty.  Highly recommended.

records.title: Best Pie's
records.text: Was told about Turner's pies by my friend who is the actual Queen of pies (true story). Have purchased their Christmas bundle a couple of times now, and can say both times the pies were excellent. The turkey, ham and cranberry pie is particularly tasty and festive. Totally recommend this service

records.title: Excellent pies and service
records.text: Have used Turners pies many times before from their shop and online. I ordered pies a few weeks before Christmas which were delivered on the day I requested. Packed very well for their journey.Turkey & ham pie plus mince pies were very enjoyable went down well!

records.title: Best pastry I’ve tasted in years
records.text: I got the Christmas pack of mince pies, a veggie quiche, Turkey, ham & cranberry pie & apple pie. Yum delicious ! The pastry on the pies is the best I’ve tasted since my mother-in-law’s, who was also a pastry cook. The turkey & ham pie was packed with meat and my only wish was that it was a bit bigger so I could have had some more. But then again I’ll know to buy 2 for a large family next Christmas ! Outstanding.

records.title: Amazing Pies
records.text: The pies were the most amazing pies I’ve ever eaten! I ordered 2 large pies (steak and ale and turkey, gammon and cranberry). I ate one within 4 days of delivery and froze the other to eat a couple of weeks later. I even ate them cold and they were incredible! They also were delivered on time and in appropriate packaging 😋

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: I cannot thank you enough for your excellent pies which arrived exactly on the day I requested. They were for a Christmas present which if they had been delivered later would have caused problems.Your turkey and Cranberry pie and mince pies I ordered for myself were the best.

records.title: Excellent!!
records.text: Excellent delivery service. Pies and sausage rolls were for Boxing Day and went down a treat!! Top quality products… will definitely be reordering!

records.title: Delicious pies by post!
records.text: Sent a pie selection box to my mum for Christmas. Understandably the delivery date was an estimate but I didn't get any updates from the courier or Turners to say they'd been dispatched so was a bit worried that they wouldn't make it in time for xmas (delivery was meant to be 21st). Fortunately they arrived safely 22nd and my mum was thrilled. Delicious pies packed well and nice clear heating and freezing instructions.Just maybe a review of which deliverypartners they're using to ensure complete customer satisfaction.

records.title: Christmas Gift Pack Pies
records.text: I treated the family to a Christmas Gift Pack, which we enjoyed the weekend before Christmas. They were delivered on the date specified and beautifully packaged. The main pies were excellent, 2 x chicken & ham, 2 x beef and Stilton & 2 x chicken & chorizo pasties, all excellent. The 4 x sausage rolls were a bit basic, and with the sweet mince pies the pastry was a bit heavy, definitely better when warmed and served with brandy butter. Overall pretty good and I would definitely buy the main pies again, plus there are several more flavours for us to try!

records.title: my rating would have been a 5 but the…
records.text: my rating would have been a 5 but the boxes must have been dropped or thrown as despite your packing some of the pies pastry was cracked, broke off or mis-shaped.

records.title: The pies arrived well packaged and with…
records.text: The pies arrived well packaged and with ice packs. Delivered on time.  The savoury pies are deep filled and taste amazing, especially like the chicken and ham. Bit disappointed this time with the fruit pies, the apple pie could have had more filling and sweeter pastry.

records.title: An extra Christmas gift
records.text: Ordered as an extra Christmas gift for family. Extremely well received; you probably have another customer

records.title: The delivery was clear and easy
records.text: The delivery was clear and easyPies came well presented and boxed nicely.

records.title: Service and quality
records.text: The quality and service can be taken for granted

records.title: Excellent and timely
records.text: Order delivered on time - well packed and still cool in the box.  The turkey, gammon and cranberry pie was excellent, moist, succulent and full to the brim.  The pasties were also full to the edge of the pastry.

records.title: Best Pies On Line
records.text: Great tasting pies with plenty of fillings Easy to use website Pies came well packed and delivery was as informed. Will definitely be using again. Already recommended people

records.title: Ordered the vegan one
records.text: Ordered the Vegan one - delicious! Watched Phil on The Apprentice and decided to try his pies. Glad I did! Good packaging and kept updated throughout delivery process. Pease consider expanding the vegan range! As a lacto-vegetarian I feel like it would be quite simple to switch the pastry to the vegan option? Phil - great work :)

records.title: Even more pie filling!
records.text: The pies arrived beautifully packaged and looking perfect!We have enjoyed the ones we have eaten so far, although some members of the family have suggested that they could be a tiny bit bigger with possibly even more pie filling!  We like the range of pies on offer but wonder if some leeks could be added to the chicken and ham pies.

records.title: We have tried a variety of ready made pies and always come back to Turners.
records.text: We have tried a variety of ready made pies ranging from M&S, Waitrose, and many of those available online. We keep coming back to Turners Pies because the pastry is  light, the filling is almost to the top and the size is just about right for our appetites. The selection isn't extensive, but the range suits us as occasional pie eaters. They freeze well and are very tasty accompanied with some fresh vegetables and gravy.The only issue we have had is with the delivery agent, who twice now has almost failed to deliver within the allotted delivery window. Its not as we are in a remote location it just seems weekend's cause them issues.Our preferred pie supplier.

records.title: My order was missedplace and therefore…
records.text: My order was missedplace and therefore did not get them until 5 days later then request Being unable to contact anyone after 5.0pm on a Friday or over the weekend is/ was unbelievable and unprofessional so we had no Sunday dinner as the pies were not delivered on the Saturday as requestedHowever the Pies are lovely Will we order by post again I’m not sure

records.title: Got there in the end
records.text: The pies, sausage rolls, and scotch eggs were all delicious when the second attempt order arrived. However, due to the very poor delivery provider Turner's Pies use, the first order had to be thrown away as they were in transit for more than the maximum 48hr chill time. The ice packs had melted and condensation and soaked through to the lukewarm produce. The customer service was prompt, and a fresh delivery date was given just three days later.

records.title: Great quality and service.
records.text: Although we love the quality, tastiness of the pies both savoury and sweet, and the great delivery service we were disappointed in the Cornish pasties which we thought had too much pastry but I’m sure most people will love them, just not for us. However we will be buying more of everything else. Great company too.

records.title: Dessert pies/quiches FABare to…
records.text: Their dessert pies and quiches are to die for, which is why I reorder whenever I can fit them in the freezer Not too keen on the savoury pies; can get equally as nice if not better from my local farm shop and in a greater range of options

records.title: I’ve ordered pies four times now
records.text: I’ve ordered pies four times now, three times for us and once as a gift for my son’s birthday. Communication before delivery and then APC communication has been good. Pies arrive well packed with ice packs still part frozen. We have only tried the individual pies so far and love the steak options the most. Good quality gristle free meat and lovely buttery shortcrust pastry. The only slight problem I’ve had, which is why I’ve given 4 not 5 stars, was the Happy Birthday gift pack for my son didn’t come with the Happy Birthday lettering as shown on the website. This was a little disappointing.

records.title: Well worth the wait
records.text: This is my second order and although the waiting times have reduced from the first order I placed, they're still a little bit longer than the average consumer would be prepared to wait.However, these pies are defintely worth waiting for if you are prepared to wait. They're very tasty, both the contents and pastry are excellent. Cannot fault the quality of the merchandise on offer at all.

records.title: The pies are lovely.
records.text: The pies are lovely.. As an octogenarian, living with one other, most are too large for me. Half of a small pie, when served with vegetables, is sufficient and enjoyable.  The larger pies will be useful for occasional visitors.

records.title: This was our first pie order.The first…
records.text: This was our first pie order.The first pie we tried was steak & Stilton.It was very tasty but maybe just a little dry.

records.title: Good service and delivery
records.text: Good service and delivery. Disappointed with the product. I've tried the steak pie with stilton and lamb pastie flavour. Expected them to be very moreish but not so. Bought after seeing them shown on the Alan Titchmarsh programme. Michael Ball thought they were delicious.

records.title: The packaging was good and you…
records.text: The packaging was good and you delivered on the day you said you would. However, despite staying in all day and having no noisy TV or radio on, you just left the package on my doorstep. Had you knocked, I would have come and collected it. It is fir this reason that I downgraded your service to 3 stars.

records.title: Overall disappointed
records.text: We were attracted like many by seeing Phil on Apprentice. The ordering process wasn't bad but I did find it a little difficult to get a combination of what we really wanted with the various set packs plus limited add ons.The pies are clearly made with good ingredients and the pastry was lovely but they all left us a little disappointed on flavour or lack of. To be absolutely honest we tried some M&S pies recently which were much more enjoyable.Customer service is good with very prompt replies but overall, sadly we won't be buying again. Sorry

records.title: Not as good as expected
records.text: After a very long delivery we were really excited to try the pies, we chose a pack of 8 with 4 different flavours.  The pastry was amazing, the pies were filled to the brim but the flavours let us down.We tried the chicken and leek, which wasn't too bad, mince and onion, no flavour in the gravy and no onion flavour either, beef and cheddar, again no flavour and chicken and mushroom which was bland.  Was a shame as we wanted them to live up to the hype.

records.title: Pies arrived on time and yes they were…
records.text: Pies arrived on time and yes they were very tasty, we also had the pumpkin tart which we didn't like, it was far to sweet. I doubt I will be ordering again as I feel they are too expensive

records.title: Oh dear - not what we expected
records.text: We always look forward to our Turner pies and have been eating them for about 5 years now. If we don't order by post, we ask family members living locally to get them for us. The pie we ate last night (chicken, leek and potato) was disappointing. The chunks of chicken we'd expected weren't there. Instead the filling seemed mushy with no differentiation of the ingredients. We know you like feedback and this is the first disappointment we've had in 5 years.

records.title: Pies were ok
records.text: Pies were ok, had better from local butchers but they were better than most. Scotch eggs were disappointing,  very little blackpudding in the blackpudding ones and the standard ones were no better than what you'd get from any supermarket.  All in all average at best.

records.title: Quiches very small
records.text: Dissapointed by how small the quiches were. They tasted better than what you'd get in a supermarket but still not worth over double the price, not including delivery...

records.title: The pies are the best I’ve tasted but…
records.text: The pies are the best I’ve tasted but their online Website could be improved by allowing you choose and purchase individual pies instead of pre-selected packs.Their sales would increase ten-fold if you could purchase exactly what you wanted.I hope someone at Turners takes up this suggestion.

records.title: Hit and miss experience
records.text: As I was having a major operation and would not be able to cook for a while, I decided to order a selection of individual pies, pasties, quiches and a fruit pie. I have previously purchased family size pies direct from the shops and these have always been nice.When I received my order, the items seemed to be well packaged, unfortunately some of the individual pies were crushed. So far the individual pies have been tasty as was the fruit pie. However the quiches have been a big disappointment. The salmon, cheddar and broccoli quiche had a scrambled egg texture and lacked any salmon. The asparagus, broccoli and tomato quiche was slightly better however it consisted of 1 large slice of tomato, 1 large broccoli floret and 1piece of asparagus. I would purchase the pies and the fruit pies again but the quiches are a definite NO!

records.title: Delivery well organised
records.text: Delivery well organised.  The meat content of our pies was tasty,  would have liked a deeper filling, smaller pie with less pastry

records.title: Ordered a pie pack for home delivery on…
records.text: Ordered a pie pack for home delivery on 13/9/24. Didn't arrive till 16/9/24 @12. Ice packs had melted. Not impressed with delay as this affects quality of product not great for a premium product

records.title: delayed customer service
records.text: I have placed several orders in the past with this company and been more than happy with the service. Unfortunately, my most recent order was delayed by the courier and because of this the pies did not arrive on their due date or in their usual chilled condition - needless to say, I needed to dispose of them. After contacting Turner’s customer service, I received a dismissive reply stating it was out of their hands once the parcel had been received by the courier - i.e. none existent customer service and my money has been wasted!09.01.2023 - Contacted by Turners Pies with an apology and full refund -  thank you

records.title: Steak pasties and a plate mince pie…
records.text: Steak pasties and a plate mince pie review. Steak Pasty - Very disappointing, entirely mislabeled as "steak", these are mostly vegetable and pastry (and there is rather a lot of pastry) and certainly not worth the price paid. Very heavily seasoned, closer to a cornish pasty than steak. Avoid. Plate Mince Pie - this was much better. Filled to the brim with a tasty mince. Shortcrust pastry was very decent too. All round a good plate mince. Overall score is 3 stars however I could've easily knocked an extra star off as their customer service when contacting the company was poor but instead I'll just shop elsewhere

records.title: Not for us
records.text: The speed of delivery was good as was the communication from the Turners. The courier did, however, leave the package on my doorstep for an hour as we were not home. The pies seemed very fresh and were full of filling which is always welcomed. We unfortunately found them a bit dry and we didn’t like the pastry used. We also found both the meat and fruit pies to be very bland. The gravy wasn’t nice either. Overall we were disappointed.

records.title: Good but worried
records.text: In the past used this service and it was excellent, but this time had it ordered for my brother in law and time they gave it didn’t arrive, so had text to say it would definitely be delivered today so they stayed in . It didn’t arrive and had Text nxt day to hr delivery time that couldn’t be changed and they were going out but fortunately it arrived before they went . It’s silly to say I worried about this but I was in bed poorly and everything seems worse . They kept us informed but felt it was 🤞it arrived in time . It was Christmas time and expect traffic bad and weather frosty .

records.title: Pies are still as good as ever but have…
records.text: Pies are still as good as ever but have just priced themselves out of my budget over £13 for a family pie is just to dear for me now. Sad really as I used to be a regular

records.title: Cannot rely on a date.
records.text: I placed a order for a birthday present with 3 weeks notice. They did not arrive. When I complained there was almost zero empathy....Its in the fine print...no guarantees...well why allow me to choose a date.?They arrived a day late.Well at least give me a reduction on the delivery...nope.First time I have contacted their customer service and the last

records.title: Delivery is a farce - pasties not very good
records.text: Our first order of pies was spot on so we tried again, this time including the pasties which looked great. We were so disappointed. The filling was dry, there was just a lot of potato and nothing else apart from some rather grey meat. So different from the pies which are delicious, especially the steak & stilton and steak & kidney. And then there was a delivery farce. The first order never arrived at all. I contacted the courier's local office and they said they hadn't received anything. Yes, we are in Scotland, but our initial order had arrived without a hitch. I contacted Customer Services at Pies by Post and they agreed to make up another order and send it to an agreed date. Again the package didn't arrive so I chased again and this time it arrived the following day. What is the point of putting stickers on the box saying "perishable, do not delay" when the courier appears to leave the box lying in a corner of the warehouse? It's obvious the package contains perishable food. Fortunately the freezer packaging (which had obviously defrosted) was cool enough to keep the pies, pasties and sausage rolls edible but they wouldn't have lasted another day. We are willing to give the company another chance, because the pies and sausage rolls are the best (certainly better than anything we can buy locally) but if there is another problem with the delivery, then we'll have to give up. A word of praise for Joanna in Customer Services - she went the extra mile to try and ensure our order eventually arrived.

records.title: Beware of Ink on Boxes
records.text: Stained entrance carpet with the ink used on soggy delivery boxes.No reaction from company when reportedOtherwise delivery arrived ok

records.title: Pies didn’t arrive and no way to get in touch with courier or Turners after 5pm on a Friday
records.text: I ordered pies to be delivered on 20 September. The courier didn’t deliver them and is now trying to deliver the same pies on 23 September. Yummy! pies sitting in a van for 3 days. The pies I would give a 5, but trying to get hold of anyone after 5pm on a Friday, either Turners pies or the courier company, forget it. Communication, or lack of is terrible. Very disappointing experience, especially when you’ve booked them for a particular day. Such a shame.

records.title: Mince beef pies were disapointing
records.text: I found the minced beef pies lacked any gravy in them to give them a richer luxury taste.Chicken and mushroom had very little chicken and mostly mushroom.Steak pasties had loads of onion which over-powered everything else, and if i had known there was onion in them, I would of had the sausage rolls instead...but they are sold as steak pasties...not steak and onion pasties....slightly misleading.All in all, not a great experience this time given the cost.

records.title: The pies/quiches arrived in good order…
records.text: The pies/quiches arrived in good order and exactly on the day ordered.  They were all absolutely delicious, the family including two teenage boys all enjoyed them and we will order again in the future.

records.title: Disappointing ☹️
records.text: Bought these after wanting to try them after all the hype on hearing about them in The Apprentice, but thought they were expensive, a deal came through in an email so I bought the deal of 3 quiches, a small box of small sausage rolls and a pasty. They arrived, quiches small, nothing to look at, topping decoration only on one side of quiches, not appealing to look at and all pretty tasteless. My very first bite which was the ham one had a big bit of gristle in it, yuk! The asparagus one wasn't nice either, the best of a bad bunch was the salmon & broccoli, but still poor, they all had a very sloppy texture too. Morrisons deli, do a big quiche that is amazing for £5 I'll be sticking to those. The small sausage rolls are mediocre, as was the pasty. All in all they are very expensive for what they are, really nothing special about any of it, very disappointed. The only good thing was the packaging, all recyclable apart from the ice packs, but they are reusable and when they arrived they were still cold and in one piece.

records.title: I was looking for decent pie's and saw…
records.text: I was looking for decent pie's and saw the reviews were good but then read ingredients for the scotch eggs and read GMO oils or something. Why why would you need GMO in anything 🤔. Yeah nah not my thing anything genetically modified. Shame.

records.title: Cheese & onion pasties poor
records.text: Ordered cheese & onion pasties as part of a pie pack but they were far from the usual high quality I expect from Turner’s pies! The pastry was thick and stodgy and the potatoes in the filling had not been peeled- would not order these again.

records.title: Tried but wouldn't buy again
records.text: Pastry is lovely, meat and potato pie had large piece of gristle in and potatoes were not cooked enough and hard in the centre, so was off-putting. Apple pie was nice but found large, sharp piece of apple core which meant i was carefully checking the pie to make sure there was no more as you could easily choke on the piece i found. Sweet mincemeat pie had too much mincemeat centre and everyone who ate it ended up scraping some of the mincemeat out, sorry didn't enjoy your version of the dutch apple pie :(. Quiche was really nice, Chicken and ham pie my mum said was lovely, my son said the sausage rolls were too porky and gave him bad heartburn. I live in the Northwest and would never normally pay these prices for a pie but i thought i'd give them a go; Done that now but again, sorry, i wouldn't try again as not worth the money. They should have been perfect for the price you pay and quality and quality-checking should have been faultless, but too many problems for me to want to try again.

records.title: You need to simplify your ordering frustrating …
records.text: You need to simplify your ordering tryed to order 4 mince 2 steak kid pies 2 pasty 1Apple pie four times given up Andy s Old bugger

records.title: Not a tasty pie
records.text: I ordered a large steak pie and two pasty’s that came in a nice packaging and on time. It was such a shame that the flavour was lacking. The steak pie was filled really well but the beef was tasteless, unseasoned and bland. The pasty’s Was a touch tastier but definitely not the worth the £38 I paid for the bundle.

description:
Custom printed or plain crockery for every area of the hospitality industry, corporate sector and retail.
No minimum order quantities and huge stock levels.
Bespoke screen-printed logos, all hand-applied and fired in our on-site workshop and kilns.

records.title: Everything was perfect!!
records.text: Everything was perfect!!Lowest price I could find after extensive on line search.  Free delivery. Arrived quickly and was superbly packed.🫖 Teapot is great .A very satisfied customer.

records.title: Great quality and customer service
records.text: Coffee cups offer Churchill products in different colours that even Churchill can't provide

records.title: Great customer service
records.text: Great team behind the website. Having placed and order, (and making a complete mess of it) I contacted them, and to my surprise was instantly speaking to an actual human, and even better than that, they sorted my little problem out over the phone in a matter of seconds. I received my cups and saucers the next day on time and well packaged. I’m definitely going to be placing more orders with them and I’d recommend them to anyone.

records.title: Good Products and Really Lovely People
records.text: Their products are very good but what stood out for us was that they may be the loveliest people we've ever dealt with.  They're extremely friendly and efficient, and made the whole customer experience really enjoyable. And even when one of the plates they sent was incorrect, they sorted the problem out immediately and sent the correct plate the next day, free of charge. If we could give them more than 5 stars for that alone, we would!

records.title: 5 * and some!
records.text: I had a bit of an issue with my order. The customer support was impeccable and they went beyond what I expected. I don't usually comment on these things but it was the best customer service I think I've ever had! Merry Christmas!

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent service, I even received a phone call to see what design I wanted on my dogs bowl, and it arrived before Xmas, recommend coffee cups brilliant service 👌

records.title: Attractive & well made
records.text: Keeps liquid warm, holds nearly two mugfuls, no drips when pouring. Ideal for me when enjoying herbal teas in this cold weather!

records.title: A great service
records.text: Bought from them before, always been quick & a good product. This time 1 cup arrived broken but replaced immediately. Great company & service.

records.title: Wanted a tall glass for Christmas…
records.text: Wanted a tall glass for Christmas drinks and came across Coffee cups on the internet. Great glass and delivery was good, would use again.

records.title: Easy to order and quick
records.text: Easy to order and quickDelivery glasses are perfectFor what we needed them for. Thank you

records.title: Good Quality Product
records.text: Good quality product well packaged and fast delivery. Only slight niggle the cups don’t fit the saucers properly otherwise like the product.

records.title: Bought X2 mugs exactly as described
records.text: Bought X2 mugs exactly as described. Postage was a little pricey.

records.title: Company fine. Delivery expensive
records.text: Helpful company. Good that you don't have to purchase larger quantities like other catering suppliers. Delivery charge was expensive though, and product is not as robust as I'd have liked.

records.title: Perhaps slightly over packaged for my order
records.text: Perhaps slightly over packaged for my order, but at least with stuff that can be put in recycling, and meant absolutely zero damage in transit. But, then, I only ordered couple different cups and saucers to see how they were, and pretty happy with the quality, although, hasn't helped decide which I want to get more of as like them both, for different reasons. While maybe over packaged for this order... for a reasonable set, packaging would be fine, and would trust that they'd arrive intact.I'd certainly purchase again from here, when I can decide the cups I like most. Wasn't fastest delivery, but nothing is at the moment.

records.title: Great little espresso cups snd saucers…
records.text: Great little espresso cups snd saucers with speedy delivery but have not given 5 stars as one of the cups has a slight red mark within the yellow  and won't wash off so doesn't look as good 😐

records.title: Just what I wanted .
records.text: Found just the cups & saucers I was looking for here . Excellent service & order delivered quickly . Would give 5 * but one saucer ( which was to be a gift ) arrived with  a small glazing flaw . However  within an hour of contacting company a replacement was on the way & arrived in time for gifting . 5* for customer service!

records.title: Coffee mugs
records.text: Sold the coffee mugs  I wanted individually which was what I needed (not is sets of 6 which I didn't need)Price was a little higher that I expected but product was delivered on time and quickly, well packaged.

records.title: The cups that I bought are up to my…
records.text: The cups that I bought are up to my expectations and love them. I gave 4 stars only, because other companies include the vat into the price and it’s much more more convenient

records.title: Nice quality cups of good size
records.text: Nice quality cups, thought the saucers were included - no obvious statement to the contrary near the add to basket. Photos showed cup & saucer

records.title: As usual
records.text: As usual, excellent service, though on this occasion some pieces were broken in transit. But they are being speedily replaced.

records.title: Excellent product good price compared…
records.text: Excellent product good price compared with others  problem with packaging cups could of got broken plenty packaging but cups put to the out side of it 1 handle sticking out luckily no damage

records.title: Great service and very well packaged.
records.text: Great service and very well packaged. Missing 1 star because of the amount of packaging used. It felt slightly excessive and therefore wasteful.

records.title: Pleased with cups

description: Nisbets is Europe's leading supplier of catering equipment, boasting over 40 years’ experience serving the catering industry. With our next-day delivery promise and an extensive product range that includes over 33,000 items ranging from chef clothing, knives, and utensils to cooking machines and refrigeration units, we are the top choice for hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide. At Nisbets we pride ourselves on providing top-quality products at competitive prices, ensuring that businesses can find everything they need to run a successful kitchen. Our knowledgeable customer service team is always on hand to offer advice and support, making the shopping experience seamless and stress-free. Whether you're a small café or a large restaurant chain, we have the expertise and resources to meet your catering equipment needs.

records.title: Consistently excellent service
records.text: Great for all your basic catering needs, with super helpful staff who've always promptly helped me out resolving queries. Great service.

records.title: Great personal service
records.text: I had missed one small item off an online order. Making another order online would have meant a large relative carriage charge. The adviser was flexible and helpful in creating a new order to be shipped at the same time but within the carriage charge. Very good service and exactly what I’d hoped for in speaking to a human!

records.title: Replaced a Faulty burner head
records.text: Replaced a Faulty burner head, delivered the next day by Parcel Force by 9.45am. far better service than Amazon delivery which can be several hours after noon.Well done.John L`Huillier FBII

records.title: First class from order to delivery
records.text: Easy to order, good price, payment via paypal secure, fast delivery and drivers helped to move old fridge out and place new fridge in position.  Would use again and certainly recommend

records.title: Fantastic customer service
records.text: I had a problem with my order (arrived damaged twice caused by the delivery person) and Nisbets customer service was an absolute delight. They solved my problem, were friendly and professional, and were so nice to me. Some of the best customer service I've ever had. Thank you again, Patrick and Caroline!

records.title: Great customer service and delivery…
records.text: Great customer service and delivery execution. Even when one item was delayed pending re-stock you still delivered the one in stock. Also the delivery status updates on the re-stock item were excellent in managing expectations. Couldn’t ask for more.

records.title: Great service
records.text: First time using Nisbets. Easy ordering process and very quick delivery . Product exactly as described and better quality than others we have tried.

records.title: Ordered a black toaster got a red one.…
records.text: Ordered a black toaster at a brilliant price, got sent a red one, short phone call later and the black one came the next day. No hassle no problem, a company is only as good as when things go a little wrong, well done for putting things right.

records.title: Recommend Nisbets for sure
records.text: Recommend Nisbets for sure. Order process online is smooth. Delivery is good. I’m regular and haven’t tested their customer services as yet which I think says a lot.

records.title: 5 stars
records.text: Nisbets is such a great company to use and purchase from. Customer service is outstanding and it's never a issue.Been a customer for many years and will always purchase from them for many years more 5stars

records.title: Good customer service
records.text: We ordered some glasses just before Xmas, the delivery was to be after Xmas and too late so we ordered an alternative set, these arrived quickly. We cancelled the first order which then arrived and we were told we could have a refund and keep the glasses. The communication was positive and efficient and the gesture kind. Only improvement I guess, from their perspective perhaps, would be if the original order was actually cancelled. Would happily use them again.

records.title: Help needed
records.text: The customer service was amazing . However delivery of wine glasses had breakages so replacement sent which also had breakages. Issue solved by a very helpful staff member in Nottingham called Tiff . It would appear that the breakages were most likely caused due to insufficient packaging or courier neglect. This would not stop me using this company again though

records.title: Bulk of order went well, but one part materially delayed. Now resolved.
records.text: Bulk of order went well and delivery smooth. However still missing one box as it is ’awaiting Dispatch’ after more than week. Communication has been good, but no details on when it should be expected and no explanation of why the delay… Updated as box now safely delivered, still only 4 stars as delivery was materially longer than stated.

records.title: Almost excellent service
records.text: I've always had excellent service from Nisbets and this time was *almost* as good.  But it wasn't their fault - that lies with the courier: Parcel Force.  Most of the order was delivered safely and promptly, but one item was delayed.  On checking with Parcel Force, I discovered it had been damaged at their Basinstoke depot and had been returned to Nisbets.  It would have helped if Parcel Force had let me know, rather than my having to chase them!  Anyway I then contacted Nisbets and explained the situation and that I really needed it the next day, Friday.  That wasn't a problem they said - they'd dispatch a replacement straightaway for delivery the next morning.  Unfortunately, it didn't arrive then and I had to go out and purchase a substitute from elsewhere - of inferior quality. 😢  The replacement did arrive the following business day, Monday - and safely this time.

records.title: Great range of things I need
records.text: Great range of things I need, and good price too. Sadly the postage was delayed so I contacted them and they refunded me the postage costs. Would have given 5 stars for prompt delivery.

records.title: We ordered 96 pint glasses and 96 half…
records.text: We ordered 96 pint glasses and 96 half pint glasses were delivered. Nisbets were very efficient at replacing the incorrect glasses, thank you xx

records.title: Really easy ordering
records.text: Really easy ordering, although the online shopping catalogue has too much choice! Most items delivered really promptly. One was delayed a couple of times, but clear email comms kept me informed of the new delivery dates. Good quality table and glassware, at fairly reasonable rates, so hopefully it will stand the test of time!

records.title: It was okay
records.text: The process was smooth, not as smooth as Amazon but smooth. I did upset me paying an extra fee for next delivery before 10 , but the package arrived the day after. But I didn’t receive a refund or acknowledgment of the mistake.

records.title: Happy with quality
records.text: Happy with quality, a bit disappointed that I couldn’t get the pans/steamers in smaller size

records.title: Great service
records.text: The parcel I received was well packaged arrived on time and I am very pleased with our new microwave. However the rest of my order has not been received yet and no advise as to when.

records.title: Fuss free and efficient
records.text: I have always found Nisbets to be helpful and efficient and they didn't let me down this time either.  I had to return an item I purchased for work, they sorted it out straight away and the item was collected within 3 working days.  Fuss free.

records.title: GOOD COMPANY, FRUSTRATING DELIVERY.
records.text: Really happy with Nisbets service and comms on my purchase. Couldn’t fault their side of it. Would be 5 Stars, however, unfortunately, I was left very frustrated at Parcel Force delivery service. 2 attempted deliveries (only got email/text confirmation of the first). Neither delivery driver left a card. Looked on line and it said it was back at Depot for redelivery. As 2nd delivery had apparently been attempted I wasn’t sure. So called the Depot and just  arranged to collect it. Bit of a faff.

records.title: Nice Staff, Good Products
records.text: I've been to the store in London Kingston before they closed. There was 1 or 2 cute and nice girls there, hope they're doing well now.I've been buying kitchenware from them sparsely for over 5 years. All the products are Chinese, there's nothing UK/Europe made which is disappointing.

records.title: I ordered a cheap £6 frying thermometer…
records.text: I ordered a cheap £6 frying thermometer from them and  the billing address did not transfer over the house number so Royal Mail did not deliver it.  Why Royal Mail waited till it got to the posties hands rather than checking before is a good question.So I rang them up and got through fine and they sorted it out. Only to find out Royal Mail are now outsourcing returns to the local Kwicky Mart rather than a post office. They are really cutting corners.Looking at other complaints I suggest Nisbets do DPD rather than Royal Mail.

records.title: Small delivery came in two packets
records.text: Small delivery came in two packets! (Not very environmentally good - two lots of packaging and delivery emissions).

I began giving them directions to my house which can be hard to find but they insisted they knew the way. An hour and a half later they finally arrived having been lost for an hour.

records.title: On time delivery

records.title: Prompt delivery and good prices
records.text: Prompt delivery and good prices.  Customer services were speedy in responding to my enquiry when part of the consignment wasn't delivered (a Parcelforce oversight).  I do find sizing a bit difficult.  Some plates I ordered turned out to be smaller than anticipated even though I had measured plates that we already had and ordered what I thought was the same size.  I've just ordered some glasses which turned out to be on the small size.  Wanting to replace like for like I measured the capacity of glasses that I had which was 200ml.  No glasses on the Nisbets that volume so went for 160ml which was the closest I could find, thinking that the volume quoted was not full to the brim as I had measured.  Some guidance on how to measure volume / diameter or whatever size Nisbets quote would be helpful.

records.title: Delivery was on time and guys were very…
records.text: Delivery was on time and guys were very helpful.unfortunately The right hand panel was slightly dented in 3 places.sales order... 28158747order date... 22/10/24product... HOST1110UR

records.title: Delayed Delivery
records.text: When my purchase did not arrive on the due date I had to chase my order.   It had not been processed.  However, the issue was soon resolved by Nisbets.  Then, without prior notice, Royal Mail Parcelforce attempted delivery while I was out.   I gave Parcelforce and preferred date for re-delivery.  They came the next day without any notice - I was out.  I did get the order delivered today - the day I opted for: but without prior notice.

records.title: Okay experience generally

records.title: slow response to issues
records.text: After placing my order I waited until the delivery date to be told that it was not available and would only become available 10 days later. If I wanted to cancel I could respond to the email. I responded to the email to cancel my order and found an alternative supplier who could delivery sooner. Then the day of the new suppliers delivery I was told by Nisbets that my order would be delifvered the next day - sooner than they had told me and clearly not having read my cancellation email.

records.title: Too long to wait

records.title: Ordered new cutlary on 2nd Dec for our…
records.text: Ordered new cutlary on 2nd Dec for our school Christmas dinner on 11th Dec unfortunately they did not arrive in time.

records.title: Good but an irritation
records.text: Good service. Not always the best prices but the service helps.  However persistent youtube advertising is so irritating we do not do more business. I must have seen 500 nisbets ads on Youtube.... a serious turn off.  Would have been four or five stars otherwise.

records.title: STOP USING PARCELFORCE
records.text: Great company, but really needs to stop using PARCEL FORCE, they are garbage!When you offer a next day delivery service and fail to deliver 9 times out of 10? That's going to lose you some customers. Feel like if this happens again, I will take our business elsewhere.

records.title: Good - apart from the packaging
records.text: Ordering the item online was easy and it was delivered on time. One important fact led me to give a three-star rating, which was the box in which it was delivered. The order was for four pairs of rubber gloves, yet the box was big enough to take five or six laptop computers with room to spare. A simple polythene (or jiffy-type) bag would have been quite adequate. As I have no use for a box of that size, the only thing I could do was break it up and recycle it.

records.title: Polar display fridge
records.text: Took little longer to arrive due to chosen courier Parcelforce but product is as expected.  Hope the interior light doesn’t stop working as did my last one as there does not seem to be any instructions for replacement and sourcing bulbs proved impossible.

records.title: Check product is what you want
records.text: Asked for a dry Bain Marie and purchased a bain Marie. When I came to test it, it was a wet only device so I had to return it and purchase a dry one which was delivery only so had to wait for it to arrive. No issues with the service as a refund was provided straight away but had double the visits to get what I wanted.

records.title: Late delivery
records.text: I ordered an item with next day delivery on Thursday.  It did not arrive until Monday.  I received no information about the delay so wasted a whole day waiting in.  I contacted customer service who were helpful and looked into it.  Apparently the warehouse was busy so it didn't go out.  No deliveries at weekend so h we nice Monday.

records.title: First fridge delivered was unpacked to…
records.text: First fridge delivered was unpacked to reveal excessive damage. This was returned and a new one sent which was perfect and of very good quality. The picture and video indicated there was a wine rack. There isn't and for a bar fridge is a significant omission. Please let me know if they can be purchased separately.

records.title: Paid £10 extra to get the product…
records.text: Paid £10 extra to get the product delivered on Thursday and it didn’t arrive until Friday afternoon. Very disappointing as I needed it urgently. I had to ring and chase on numerous occasions and although the customer service people were very polite and helpful they need to sort out the delivery aspect.

records.title: Bad courier
records.text: The item could do with more sensitive controls as i am making yoghurt at c.100F.  The range is 96-104F.  It seems v wide. Unfortunately. NISBETS used Parcel Force who delivered to the wrong address.

records.title: The order was not delivered as stated…
records.text: The order was not delivered as stated (by 2pm the next day if ordered before 6pm on any working day). Understandable as it was placed on Friday the 6th of December. I paid for a Saturday delivery. But then only 1 of 2 items was delivered on Monday the 9th. After phoning to find out about the second item, I was told it was due to be delivered on Tuesday. On Tuesday, the wrong item (colour and brand were completely different) was delivered. I phoned immediately and was told the correct replacement would be delivered on Wednesday before 12. It was not even delivered on Wednesday.  On Thursday an "attempt" was made and then I recieved an email from Parcelforce saying it was delivered to the Post office and a card with the relevant inforamtion was left at the flat. This wasn't the case. We have received no card. Nisbets Customer service says an attempt will be made on Monday the 16th.

records.title: The item was not as described
records.text: The item was not as described, it was portrayed as a volume dedicated to all the 'sauces' you'll ever need, I was expecting recipes and all I got was a dictionary that tells you whats in a sauce not how to cook it.

records.title: Nancy - Kilner Jars…
records.text: Ordered 4 Kilner Jars on 7/12/24 on line all shown as in stock and delivery date to be 9/12/24. Received only 2 of the jars on 9/12/24. Telephoned Nisbet to report this and spoke to a really nice lady called Liz who said all items were showing as in stock so could not understand why all four jars had not been despatched together. She apologised and said she would get missing items despatched as urgent and I should receive tomorrow (10/12/24). Nothing arrived so telephoned again on 10/12/24 and once more got a really nice lady called Holly. Explained the situation and she said that one of the missing items would be delivered on 11/12/24 (which it was) but other item was showing not in stock again until 15/12/24. I said how come then that all items were shown on line as in stock on 7/12/24 when I ordered she apologised and said she could only think that the stock position had not been updated. I then got an e mail from Nisbets confirming order status was now 15/12/24. A little later I then got another email stating order status was now 16/12/24. The final jar was delivered today 18/12/24. On a positive note I am very pleased with the jars and their quality and the 2 ladies from Nisbets who were very helpful. Also Parcel force who deliverd all items were outstanding. On a negative note I have to say this is the first time I have dealt with Nisbets so am very disappointed as a new customer that my order was not delivered in full on the day promised. In the end Nisbets have had to incure 3 lots of carriage charges because it appears that stock level information is not being properly  maintained.

records.title: So much regret for using these guys
records.text: Items came from random suppliers at random times and so were left outside and in corridors. One of the most expensive fryers arrived faulty and I've waited almost a week with no update or repair/replacement solution. Absolute nightmare first order to be honest, missing parts, deliveries left in random places, no coordinated date of delivery as requested.

records.title: The ordering and delivery were great as…
records.text: The ordering and delivery were great as usual.Queried my inferior oatmeal bowls with Steve from customer services and have been ignored since.Product sold with lifetime chip warranty but these were not the bowls sent.

records.title: Wash powder Order…

records.title: Delayed Delivery

records.title: Website failed with a ghost order
