Great gravy as well , .Also the staff we excellent as well , friendly, polite, reliable ; reliably well informed, could havevbeen a little quicker service at yhe bar, but I just think that was down to it being very busy, .  .But apart from that, everything was quality about the place .And also a good clean and tidy place as well .Price was probably abot the going rate and average these days .Maybe a little expensive, but I think that us just the times we live in, these days .Can't wait to come back .

records.title: Hampton Toby Carvery - Highly recommend
records.text: Visited Toby Carvery a couple of times recently and Hampton is the best in Our area. Staff are welcoming and friendly and the food is great value for money. Lovely lady serving the food (who I assume is the main cook) always has something lovely to say, encourages you to come back for more if you aren’t full enough, can people actually go up twice? Great selection of meats and refillable soft drinks. Really great value for money and a cheap night out in particular with kids. Definitely recommend 🙂

records.title: Good service from Lynn
records.text: We went to Toby Carvery in Bromley today, and we had our breakfast buffet. We were served by the staff named Lynn, who was very friendly and always had a good smile for us. She made sure that everything was taken good care of when it came to our needs. So, while having breakfast, she always checked if everything was okay. We would definitely come back because of the good service. But just a little feedback on Toby Carvery Bromley: in one of their toilet facilities, the toilet room is FREEZING cold. As a loyal customers , we weren’t comfortable using the toilet that is freezing cold. I think a lot of things could have been done to improve this toilet so that customers will be comfortable using it during the winter time.

records.title: overnight stay
records.text: Had the pleasure of dining at Toby Carvery in B73 6SP older place with plenty of space and a well-stocked bar Good Food and it was hot reasonably priced food and breakfast menu,  clean tables and friendly staff would recommend a visit. plenty of parking in a well lit carpark but remember to put your car registration into the machine for free parking on site.

records.title: Sunday roast
records.text: It was super busy, but staff seem to us as quickly as they could, were seated within 10- 15 minutes, good overall tasted lovely and member of staff recommended just the vegetarian carvery for me since I am vegetarian and it’s cheaper. Could have a larger range of vegetables but apart from that a lovely meal

records.title: Miss leading menu
records.text: Myself and my sisters visited on the 18/04/2024 for my mums 87th birthday, we had our meal, and then asked for the mini dessert with coffee X 4, the waitress stated they do not do it anymore, I said it’s in the menu online, she replied its not on our tablet. So we could not have it. PLEASE TOBY UPDATE YOUR MENU ONLINE it is giving false information, to people on a budget it’s so disappointing. Also I had 2 starters, they was stone cold, asked the waitress to microwave the nuggets which she kindly did,( which totally dried out the bbq sauce) the loaded potatoes half was cold the other half was piping hot, am so disappointed the way it has gone down hill ( Buckhurst Hill branch)

records.title: Voucher disappeared from app                                                                                                                        My voucher has disappeared from my phone
records.text: When I set off from home I had a 25% off voucher on my Toby App, when I came to pay, the voucher had disappeared, along with my stamp from my loyalty card. This isn't the first time this has occurred. I would also like to add the voucher re-appeared before we got home. We only went because we had the voucher, spoke to the waiter but he was no help

records.title: Took advantage of the special midweek…
records.text: Took advantage of the special midweek discount on the carvery at Toby in Ormskirk, West Lancashire.Great value, decent quality of food and plenty of it, good service, staff were really nice, will go again.Would recommend a visit, ensure you download the App though to be able to use the offers.

records.title: The food was great due to the variety…
records.text: The food was great due to the variety of options even with some vegetarian options for my sister. I am only giving 4 stars due us having to wait for a table as most of the empty tables were dirty.

records.title: The carvery was quite nice apart from…
records.text: The carvery was quite nice apart from the Yorkshire pudding they were massive and didn’t look fresh, we requested a small Yorkshire pudding but was told the only option was to accept a large one cut in half. Very disappointed in the offer and attitude.

records.title: Great food
records.text: Great food, both carvery and ice cream desert. Our waitress, Leoni, was very efficient and attentive.Only criticism, the carvery chef was very slow considering there was only six people in front.IRaffle ticket number 98.

records.title: First time visiting Peterborough store
records.text: First time visiting Peterborough store, I requested to sit away from everybody else, due to my Daughter having epilepsy, with daily seizures, which being 11 she finds highly embarrassing, but we were put smack bang in the middle of everyone else, after a couple of minutes we managed to calm her down, and tell her she would be ok.I had a groupon voucher but had to pay an extra £6 because the chef gave my eldest Daughter an adult plate, thank god we ordered her a child’s dessert, would we have been charged another £6 if not? The food itself was ok, no chicken though? I think this might be because I hadn’t had a roast for weeks, and really fancied one, other than that it was nothing to shout home about, dessert was nice though, maybe next time I’ll go on a day I haven’t got work, as I felt like a stuffed turkey for the rest of the day and night.

records.title: The Eagle, Snaresbrook.
records.text: Lovely, friendly and helpful staff. We ate in the bar and was helped by the Manager, Lucy with a query we had, and she sorted it out for us immediately. Watching Lucy with the customers was a joy, in particular the way she cared for a couple of elderly gents who were obviously regulars and known to her. Lucy was very professional but was kind and attentive to all customers. The bar tender was also very helpful and friendly, but I am sorry that we did not note his name. This is now our favourite Toby. Would have given it a five star review but unfortunately the meal was not very hot, but still immensely enjoyable never the less. .

records.title: Toby carvery Denby Dale road Wakefield Went for lunch…
records.text: Toby carvery Wakefield Went for lunch today with a friend and was made very welcome.The greeter could see my friend was using a walking stick so found a table near the carvery for us.The meal was very nice and meat portions very generous but we both thought it could have been a bit hotter.Because we were close to the carvery we could see all the food that had been spilt around the serving dishes and it was left for quite a while before being cleaned up.We both had sponge pudding for dessert and it was lovely a huge portion served with custard and very hot.

records.title: Messy food areas
records.text: Maidstone Toby. Waiting Staff excellent and efficiently do their work. I did ask for a window seat but put elsewhere in front of a pillar. Not good when there was a window seat available.  Please note attention to detail.With regard to the Carvery itself, not enough staff.  One member doing meat with no one to take hot covers off new food.  The area was messy and serviettes ran out quickly.  I have mentioned messy area before but no one seems to be cleaning up the area.  It is off putting.  Cleanliness is vital in all things.  Food was good though especially the cabbage and potatoes.It seems lacking in the servery food areas.  All it takes is a team member to clear away debris etc every 20 mins or so.  Please prioritise.

records.title: Had a lovely meal tonight at Buckhurst…
records.text: Had a lovely meal tonight at Buckhurst Hill Our server Caroline was very nice and made our experience better

records.title: HINTON, CHRISTCHURCH DORSET
records.text: My wife and I visited the Hinton Carvery for my birthday meal last night.  The food was good with the exception of cold yorkshire puds.  Our Waiter was Mario (Super Mario). Who was very pleasant and helpful.  He also came to the table to sing me Happy Birthday.  Mario helped make our experience good and I would recommend.

records.title: A  good weekday roast  (Toby Carvery SS1 3AD (Thorpe Bay Essex…
records.text: Toby Carvery SS1 3AD (Thorpe Bay Essex )Went for a roast dinner at midday 01/02/2024( advise to pre book) . 1. Cook  was polite & friendly 2.Food was good but needs to  be much hotter and very little meat ! could do with a couple more slices . 3. Waitress Carol gave excellent service .4. Seating was ok .5. Outside views and seating very good  6.Great parking 7.Fair prices 8.We recommend this pub as good place for a roast and drink.

records.title: First time visiting this establishment…
records.text: First time visiting this establishment and have been welcomed by lovely Alicia at The Watergate Bolton. She was happy to help and explain the rules of breakfast serving!

records.title: The Toby Carvery at Braintree is…
records.text: The Toby Carvery at Braintree is usually fantastic and enjoy going there with family. However, I do have a couple of points that I wanted to make with regards   with continued success for them. We went on a Sunday and paid full price. The carvery had a choice of 4 different meats, which was Beef, Gammon, Turkey and Lamb but can't remember the plates being warm, but had 2 servers carving which got thru the very short queue quickly. There was plenty of veg choice and everything was hot and I used a serviette for the spoon handles, wish they had spoons without metal handles under the lamps as would prevent the heat almost burning your hand. Plenty of hot gravy available including vegetarian clearly marked, but area could have done with a wipe down. However, I was very disappointed with my dessert, it was a Honeycomb Dream, unfortunately I did not find ANY Honeycomb at all, I didn't read description fully & hate chocolate sauce, which was way too much in my opinion, wish they offered Strawberry or Caramel as an alternative, as it would open it up to many others too. But at £4.99 I felt cheated with zero Honeycomb in a Honeycomb Dream, what was I paying for, just lovely whippy icecream and a lot of awful sauce I hate and a half flake in it and a single wafer.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Waited awhile to be seated but once done service was excellent. Seba was very friendly and chatty and the food was lovely .the waiting staff were efficient with making sure we had everything we needed

records.title: Hotter roast at Toby Carvery in Maidstone
records.text: The food was hotter this time. New cutlery was better. Please ensure new dishes added are not poured on top of existing dishes. Excellent waiting staff.

records.title: Wasn't impressed with food luke warm…
records.text: Wasn't impressed with food luke warm carvery not up to standard

records.title: Visited here last weekend with visiting…
records.text: Visited here last weekend with visiting family, and although it was ok, I have had much better. Always quite busy, so usually have to wait to be seated, but once you have a seat you can go up straight away to get your food. Always large variety of vegetables and three meats. Staff seem to stand about a bit incase you want anything but made us feel little uncomfortable as were quite near our table just standing there. Very large carpark so ample spaces.

records.title: They run a special offer in the week…
records.text: They run a special offer in the week for £9.95.  The was a vegetarian option but not much in the way of variety, only cheesy pastries.  A similar thing applied to the veg, the roast potatoes were done in beef dripping so weren't available to me.  My wife's gammon and turkey was nice but the chefs demeanour wasn't.   Altogether it was reasonable but not worth paying anymore.  I can only hope that the weekend choice and service is better as the place seemed generally disorganised at the Trowbridge branch.

records.title: Dear Toby Carvery
records.text: Dear Toby Carvery, Thank you for accepting me through the door on a minimal menu request,  the transactor to your request is next door at travelodge.  Should you send them round for hot breakfasts rather than meals you will find that there will be a surplus in your account.  Speak with travelodge and see if they can inco-operate the vouchers for breakfasts into their room surcharges for the inaccural amount. Marie-Lourdes

records.title: Was very disappointed with the Sunday…
records.text: Was very disappointed with the Sunday Carvery 6/10/24 not up to your usual standard Beef was very tough and fatty food was luke warm but i will give it another go .

records.title: We visit Toby carveries regularly and…
records.text: We visit Toby carveries regularly and know what to expect - but a big let down today. Gravy thin and tasteless, roast potatoes rubbery and full of eyes and cabbage undercooked.

records.title: Not a good meal today at Whitchurch
records.text: Not a good meal today at Whitchurch, Cardiff. We visit Toby carveries regularly and know what to expect - but a big let down today. Gravy thin and tasteless, roast potatoes rubbery and full of eyes and cabbage undercooked.

records.title: Carvery is the best, customer service shocking
records.text: The carvery and staff who serve it to you are absolutely fantastic, friendly and food is fantastic quality. Unfortunately that’s where the good points end. Toby Carvery get everything else wrong, really rude staff who don’t seem like they want to be at work. Shocking atmosphere in their locations, basically just a drinking den which makes the experience unpleasant. Whilst i appreciate they are very busy on certain days, the staff do recommend that you can eat food in the pub section rather than the carvery itself, but it some with an undertone of ‘find a table if you can’ sort of thing.

records.title: The Wilsons Knowle.
records.text: The Wilsons Knowle.The meat slices were wafer thin. Roast Potatoes were cooked but cold. Vegetables were well cooked but again not very warm. Pudding portions at £4,99 were not good and a cold sweet was served warm.( probable frozen and over defrosted in a microwave) We went at 6pm and the restaurant was not very busy so cannot understand why portions were small. At this rate you'll drive your customers away.

records.title: Wot no eggs??
records.text: This actually applies to any Toby right now.  Can they really not find any eggs for their breakfasts? We often stop en-route for an early breakfast when we visit relatives miles away. Past two times there have been just tasteless reconstituted scrambled egg. We look forward to fried. I know there's a shortage but we always manage to find eggs when we go shopping! Plus the bacon was unsmoked therefore tasteless. And - Yorkshire pudding and gravy on a breakfast plate? Really?  Going to McDonald's for breakfast in future till the 'egg crisis' is over! They manage to find eggs for their breakfast muffins.Our chap behind the buffet told us that Toby were thinking of stopping fried eggs altogether. If they do, we won't go again.

records.title: Ate here whist staying at Travelodge…
records.text: Ate here whist staying at Travelodge next door, arrived at 8.30pm, staff were welcoming and helpful, however the veg on the carvery was cold and soggy, nice portion of carved meat.

records.title: Visited newly refurbished Toby in…
records.text: Visited newly refurbished Toby in camberley . Refurbishment very good as was very overdue, however i think “refurb” was just decorating and moving the gravy station. Very disappointed that whilst refurbed and clean the ladies toilets still had the historical nasty sewerage smell which i had been told would be rectified on refurb. This is very off putting and should have been sorted and electric air fresheners  should be installed…. no one wants to visit a smelly toilet, especially in a food establishment. On a positive the staff ( with exception to one lady who sometimes works the carvery and is miserable and rude) are very friendly, and the food has been good for the price you pay .

records.title: Ongoing issues
records.text: 15 of us attended the Whitchurch branch, South Wales. We were asked how comfortable were we just after we arrived at 12.30 as the steamers had gone down and that the engineer wouldn’t be able to fix it for at least 2hrs as he had to come from England. We weren’t told if we could go up and get our food so we just went up but there was plenty of food there. We were situated next to the manager’s office so we could hear them cancelling bookings. After having our food, we were given a choice of either free desserts or 20% off our bills, so went with the 20% as none of the kids wanted desserts. When we left at 2pm there was loads of people queuing to come in so they must have had things working again. The last 3 times that we’ve been to this particular restaurant, they’ve had issues.

records.title: Mean meat portion
records.text: The carver literally gave us two very small slices of meat , not acceptable when the prices have gone up !Surely the amount is standardised across the restaurants and not at the whim of the individual.

records.title: floor waitress very good and helpful
records.text: floor waitress very good and helpful, even though short staffed, bar man let the whole experience down. lovely food, good value for money. toilets could do with some tlc..

records.title: Whitewebbs carvery
records.text: We tried to book an early table at the whitewebbs branch at Toby for 9 people only  to be told the earliest time was 8.30pm. On arrival at 8.30pm the place was empty and did not have a look of a restaurant that had been busy at all.Once we had ordered drinks, we were told the carvery closes at 9pm. We understood this to mean the carvery part and not the whole kitchen, when we tried to order dessert we were told the kitchen is closed.How do Toby expect a table of 9 to order drinks, get your meal, eat, relax and order dessert in 40 minutes.Although the food was lovely and cannot fault that, the communication from staff when booking and whilst there was at a complete low and we left feeling that we had only half a meal, which ruined our family get together and daughter and sons birthday.

records.title: Not worth the wait!
records.text: Visited Toby Carvery Kings Norton, Birmingham on Saturday 16th. Stifling hot, even staff complained about the heat. Spent 20mins queuing for food. Could see beef had ran out 10mins earlier but was told another one wouldn't be ready for another 10mins. Poor lad serving had no help and was painfully slow. Food delicious but cold. Thank God for Debs who saved the day and deserves 5*. She brought a plate of beef over once it was ready enough to feed out table of 4. She was friendly, pleasant, helpful and constantly had a smile. If it wasn't for her would have been 1* Well done Debs.🤩

records.title: A poor lunch
records.text: Having not been to a Toby for a while we were so disappointed with our recent visit . As usual the meats were excellent but the vegetables were poor only lukewarm and the cabbage was far less than el dente actually like eating raw cabbage the other veggies were passable. A small cola  and a medium house wine almost £10 a bit of a shock  won’t be revisiting again in the near future generally very disappointing

records.title: No payment .. No Cutlery
records.text: Recently visited the Toby Carvery at Cannock for Sunday Breakfast. What has always been a lovely breakfast was sadly not this time. The place was packed and the poor chef’s could not get the food out fast enough. The queue was massive and just got longer because the food wasn’t coming out fast enough. Previously, coffee was included in the breakfast price and cutlery either on the table or for you to collect once you had been up and collected your breakfast. Now, you don’t get coffee with the breakfast, that’s an extra cost and you don’t get cutlery until you have paid for your breakfast. This is perfectly okay if you’re an adult and paying for a breakfast you’re going to eat. However, we had two children with us who aren’t big eaters, they will only eat a sausage and perhaps a Yorkshire pudding but the bar man would not give us any cutlery if we didn’t pay the £5.95 for each child! Our argument was they won’t eat £5.95 worth of food. There isn’t a small bowl option like for lunch, it has to be £5.95 if you want a fork for them! Ridiculous! Especially, if you consider the cost of an adult meal at £7.50! The kids had to eat with their fingers or share our cutlery! We don’t begrudge paying the £5.95 once they’re older and will eat a plate of food but for a sausage! - Not happening! The bar man was terribly rude in ‘reiterating’ no payment, no forks! .. Sadly, We won’t hurry back for breakfast.

records.title: Distracted staff.
records.text: Distracted staff.Kept waiting to be seated . Always look forward to going to the Toby at Hopgrove York. But on this occasion the staff seemed to be totally distracted. Several walked past us while we were waiting to be seated without acknowledging we were even there . When we were eventually at the carvery counter no staff appeared till quite queue had built up . He said he couldn't cut a Yorkshire pudding in half because he didn't have a knife and said it would be better if pulled in half myself. When we got back to our table no drinks had been brought to the table so I had to go to the bar and collect the glasses. The place was only about half full. The staff seemed to be very unhappy about something that was distracting them from their work. I would still go back to a Toby Carvery it's excellent value and the food is always pretty good.

records.title: Went here this afternoon and it was…
records.text: Went to Bexleyheath  toby carvery this afternoon and it was packed quesv of 16 or more at one time. The chef cutting the meats was chewing gum continuously ( this is not good as sprays from his mouth goes on food )  The beef was dry/ pork was tasteless/ gammon was good , as also was the Turkey . The chef left the counter area lots of times ( and no not to get new meats ) He was also extremely slow . Most of the veg was bland, under cooked , the area for the veg  had lots of veg waste around it . The 3 gravey  pots were empty , so this created another que to wait for new gravey to come .The staff had food of their own at their desk and was eating it in intervals while serving  the tables .This was the first time in Toby carvery  I was  so disappointed and shocked at the service. P.s the bar staff were very polite and helpful.

records.title: I think it’s a joke the tiny bit of…
records.text: I think it’s a joke the tiny bit of meat you get in Toby Martin rd asked for more as it was a joke was told. We only allowed to give small amount. Now. It’s not worth money because meat n Yorkshire pudding.  R main things that fill you up the veg never cooked through enough  and. Sides always messy the stuffing so stiff u have to get some thing to scrape it off spoon honest such a shame used to be best place in Middlesbrough that had Christmas feel to it. Or hearty homely place. Visited for son bday  on 26 th of Nov for 6 ppl. Not cheap but was really disappointed. Staff Tracy. Knows as I spoken to her she’s known me coming from son being 3 he’s now 27  she’s asset to them such a kind hearted welcoming. Waitress

records.title: Very poor experience, would not go again
records.text: Met some friends at the Norton Canes Toby for breakfast and did not have a good experience.The carpet in the restaurant is well worn and in areas has trodden in dirt and food so much that the carpet is now black. Some of the chairs were thread bare and the whole restaurant could do with redecorating.There was a queue for the food as there were no eggs. After about 5 mins the chef brought out 4 eggs. The first person in the queue had one and the 2nd had 3 so we had the wait another 5 mins for the next batch of eggs to come out.There were about 8 and the chef threw the serving spoon onto the platter that then broke about 3 of the eggs. Another 5 min wait and finally a plate of eggs so I could get my breakfast.They were obviously understaffed but with about 40 customers they are taking between £3,000 to £4,000 !!The coffee in filter jugs was really good as was the sausage. Hence the 2 stars.I’m not normally one to give low marks , this is the first 2 star I have ever given.The overall experience was very poor, I honestly do not know why people go regularly as I honestly do not think it’s work the money.

records.title: Small carvings of meat, disappointing
records.text: went Toby Carvery Romford Brewery today with my daughter, lovely layout and plenty of room, food was cooked nicely and good choice of veg, but small helping of meat, when i asked for another slice of carved meat, she said thats the only portion shes allowed to give, never heard of this before in other Toby restaurants, disappointed 😥

records.title: Very disappointing tonight..
records.text: Very disappointing at Northampton tonight. Ran out of Turkey at 7pm!. Meat  portion very small for all three of us. Potatoes not up to their usual and not even any cauliflower cheese. Gravy watery. Won’t be going again.

records.title: Cocket Hat Aberdeen
records.text: Cocket Hat AberdeenMy sister and I went for the carvery, standard of meat not great. Tiny serving and the beef was inedible, it was almost all fat, some of the veg was extremely dried up. My sister had pork and turkey and was disappointed there was no cranberry or apple to sauce to have with it. Definitely not worth the money. Will not hurry back

records.title: A regular at Toby normally lovely staff…
records.text: A regular at Toby normally lovely staff & good food but today the waiter we had was not only rude but very argumentative actually told us to "hurry because we are busy & time is money" so busy talking he did nt listern then argued when the drink order was wrong. The food was great but this spoilt our visit completely.

records.title: Beckenham branch tried to refuse entry…
records.text: Beckenham branch tried to refuse entry saying they cannot book a table for 7 on a Sunday. Rather than trying to resolve the problem by booking a table of 4 and a 3 in the restaurant the host tried to refuse us entry. Very bad manners!

records.title: Food mostly
records.text: Food, flies. Almost all meat was chewy some fatty, some straight inedible even the potatoes had a tough outer skin which was difficult to chew, bacon was bitty and stringy, left me off put and not hungry anymore. However only the pork was okay though that was dry but with gravy it was fine. (Toby Carvery - Highnam)

records.title: Parson and clerk streetly,the last…
records.text: Parson and clerk streetly,the last twice ive been they seem to be getting very mean with the meat,wafer thin and only 2 slices on a kingsize meal,tiny yorkshires,rest of veg luke warm,place needs a refit,looking old and tired,when we walked in the waitress said "have you booked" it was a monday at 2.00pm she huffed and said well if its just the two of you,the pub was 3/4 empty ! Dont think we will use this place again until they up thier game,which is a shame because it used to be so good

description: Healthy plant-based meal kits, prepared by chefs and delivered to your doorstep.

records.title: So far, so delicious!
records.text: Loving all the meal kits I have received so far from planthood, I have in total had about 4 deliveries (12 meals) to date.  The meals are super tasty, really quick to make and the portion sizes seem just right. If I could make any improvements it would be to increase the range of choice on offer and to have fewer recipes containing soya due to allergies within my family.

records.title: Highly Recommended!
records.text: I'm probably not Planthood's prime demographic, being a 64 year old male, but I was gifted a voucher by my family and have been very impressed by their food. So much so I'm on my third fortnightly order and am now paying for it myself!Their meals are full of flavour, easy to construct and quick to prepare.Ordering is simple, there's a good selection of meals each week and I find the portion size is more than adequate.On the occasion I had to contact Customer Services, their response was very prompt and helpful.So, as I say, overall 'highly recommended'!

records.title: So impressed - give it a go
records.text: So impressed with Planthood. I've tried a lot of meal kits over the past decade and these are definitely the best I've ever had. They're consistently delicious, generously portioned and so quick to prepare. There are enough options each week to always find things that I'm excited to try, without being overwhelmed by multiple options. I'm doing the Zoe diet programme and the meals mean I have no problem hitting my plant and fibre targets each week. I also really appreciate that all the packaging is recyclable or compostable. My only criticism is it would be useful to have an app I can save the recipes in, as the website can take a while to click through to find them each week (there is a QR code on each recipe bag, but it's tricky to open the bag without tearing it). Really happy overall.

records.title: Healthy food that feels like a treat
records.text: Healthy food that feels like a treat. Planthood meals are simple to put together but really tasty. I also enjoy the variety of grains/carbs on offer rather than having rice or pasta with every meal. They have been a hit with the whole family, including my toddler! A great way to get out of a weekday dinner rut.

records.title: I am a busy working Mum of two young…
records.text: I am a busy working Mum of two young children (one with special needs) with a chronic inflammatory immune condition. These meals are delicious and took the hassle out of meal planning and shopping. I now eat well at lunchtimes when I work from home and have noticed a significant improvement in my symptoms. Thank you!

records.title: Pleasantly surprised by the quality
records.text: I have been so pleasantly suprised about how delicious these meals are. Super easy to make and such variety. Im a meat eater but genuinely haven’t missed it in these meals and it gives you great variety for the week.

records.title: Planthood - so good!
records.text: We’ve been receiving 4 meals a week from Planthood for a month and have been very impressed.As someone with a healthy appetite, (my wife calls me a hog!) I was concerned that I’d not find the meals filling, however, this isn’t the case. The portions are generous, really tasty and easy to cook.The Festive Bourguignon Pie was excellent, I hope you do it again!

records.title: Easy and delicious
records.text: Easy to prepare but healthy and delicious meals. As someone who is tight for time during the week but cares about what I am eating I have found planthood such a gift!

records.title: Cannot fault Planthood
records.text: Cannot fault Planthood. After many months of me and my wife being bored of choosing what to eat each week (especially having a toddler and little time!) we tried it out and haven’t looked back. The cooking is enjoyable and the food is even better. Can’t see us going without now!

records.title: 100% recommend
records.text: Lovely to have so many options each week. Everything has been really quick and easy to make and yummy. I love that the sauces are all pre made, not having to plan meals and do big food shops has taken a massive weight off my shoulders and I feel like we are eating a healthy balanced diet now. The garnishes and toppings really complete the meals as I would never bother with them usually so it feels a bit special.

records.title: Delicious, filling and nutritious
records.text: I’ve had 3 orders so far and all meals have been tasty and easy to make. Really great for working weeks when time is limited. Good portion sizes & more than enough food per meal. I hope my positive experience with planthood continues as I continue with my subscription.I also tried the breakfast pots which are nutritious, filling and delicious!

records.title: Great time-saving healthy vegan meals!
records.text: Great meal choices each week to try! It’s given me the confidence to quickly put a meal together that’s both tasty and healthy. Signing up with 5 meals means I don’t have to spend time thinking, planning or shopping for mid-week dinners after a long day at work and instead can have more time relaxing into my evenings.

records.title: Filled to the brim with greatness!
records.text: The meals on offer are always creative and filled to the brim with great veggies I struggle to find in the average UK supermarket. There was only one issue in the past months with a wrong order being sent (not a loss as it was still tasty), but the customer service was so apologetic and quick to fix it for me!

records.title: The meal choices are great recipes
records.text: The meal choices are great recipes, quick and easy to make, which is so helpful when leading a busy life. Recipes easy to access online When items are placed in bag with tins, these have damaged veg, and latest delivery split one of the sauces, which made a mess over other ingredients I have struggled to be in sometimes on delivery. Once taken to a hot shop and not put in cold place which damaged items. But as a whole, the product supplied is very nice and nutritious, very pleased

records.title: I opted to try Planthood as an easy…
records.text: I opted to try Planthood as an easy alternative to aid maintenance in building a healthier lifestyle while going through unpredictable changes. After enjoying my first 4 boxes, I can honestly say that Planthood does just that! My overall well-being has generously improved, as well as my inspiration for new and tasty plant-based meals. For me, it has been more than just having delicious meals but keeping my mental health in check!

records.title: Helpful service for vegans
records.text: The planthood meals are helping me to get through a very busy and challenging time in my life. Thanks to this service I am saving a lot of time by not doing the big grocery shopping and not having to think what I will prepare for dinner for a family of 4. The only downside there is, it is that sometimes it takes me much longer than the stated 15-20 min to prepare the meal. It might be because it’s for 4 people and not for 2.

records.title: Great tasty and healthy food.
records.text: Great tasty and healthy food.Some weeks the choices for my ( very fussy) taste don’t work or aren’t an option, so it’s a bit of a faff to remember to cancel. Be good if there was an option to opt out some weeks instead of having a delivery of dishes I didn’t choose.

records.title: It's so quick and easy and tasty
records.text: It's so quick and easy and tasty. And as a vegetarian it provides a waaaay larger variation in meal options/types week on week compared to Hello Fresh, Gousto, etc. Only thing I wish I had was a bit more detail on a recipe card (virtual or physical) so I could attempt to make some of these meals myself at another time.

records.title: Thoroughly enjoyed by all the family
records.text: We were enticed into trying this by the introductory offers with no intention of continuing our subscription. Now on our fourth box, we are impressed and enjoying the benefits this is bringing to our busy lifestyle. With only one exception, all the meals have been thoroughly enjoyed by the family including the meat eaters! I have also enjoyed discovering some new cooking methods along the way. We were also very impressed by how a missing item complaint was swiftly dealt with and generously resolved - full marks for customer service. We have unanimously voted to continue the subscription on a slightly reduced frequency to keep the costs down. Looking forward to trying the many exciting recipes to come in 2025.

records.title: Healthy meals that are tasty and easy to prepare
records.text: Meals are quick to prepare and most of the ingredients are high quality. Sometimes it's hard to come up with meal ideas, it's tiring to cook at the end of the day, and following recipes can be costly if you have to buy all the specific spices/ingredients. Planthood is good because you can eat a range of meals, getting a range of nutrients but you don't have to spend a fortune buying all the ingredients. I would like to see postage not included as this meal service is on the slightly more expensive side and I think postage should be included in the subscription fee. I'd also like to be able to drop to 2 meals a week sometimes given I have a subscription. But other than that, the meals are tasty and are giving me the energy and inspiration to cook again.

records.title: The first recipe/meal kit service I have used
records.text: The first recipe/meal kit service I have used, and I will definitely be carrying on.  It being a vegan service is great, as I am a lifelong vegetarian. I really hope they don't go down the route of all this 'fake meat' that is appearing on restaurant menus. I have received excellent, tasty and inventive meals, the great majority of which I have really enjoyed. I really like that it is 'part prepared/part cook at home'. The only slight niggle is that I have had a few items (tins and an avocado) arrive damaged/spoilt which they must have been on packing, as the outer box was completely intact. Customer Service gave me a tiny reduction for my next order when I emailed them pictures.

records.title: Life made simple
records.text: Life made simple! Still rather a lot of washing up (sometimes two saucepans and a frying pan) and chopping but the trade off is hopefully healthy (sort of)  eating! I still feel a little hungry after/or quickly after so I add some meat or tofu to up the protein content! Or there can be too much carb (up to 100g) which can induce post prandial sleepiness. However it’s not a bad shout at all.

records.title: Tasty vegetarian and vegan food ( and…
records.text: Tasty vegetarian and vegan food ( and I'm a meat eater!! ). I'm enjoying exploring a different diet, tasty sauces and proteins, with easy to prepare recipes that are quick to make. A bonus is the sustainable packaging. Customer service the one time I had a problem was good, and they were keen to find out more.

records.title: Tasty meals
records.text: Really enjoyed so far. Deliveries are always on time and I’ve never had an issue with getting the wrong meals. I appreciate that the boxes come with recyclable ice packs that keep my food nice and fresh! The sauce packets are delicious but sometimes need a little extra salt or chilli seasonings to taste

records.title: Great if you don't live alone
records.text: Plant hood recipes are easy to follow , massive portions, and really innovative ideas and flavours. Shame they don't offer single person options. As it's all fresh sometimes it's hard to cook up everything before it goes off and not sure how suitable for freezing it is.

records.title: On my third week of meals and really…
records.text: On my third week of meals and really enjoying them.  Some of the meals I would rate 5 stars but giving 4 stars overall as feel they could be improved a bit - more from a health aspect than flavour. Feel there could be a wider range of grains used - there's a reliance on bread / white rice / white noodles when buckwheat, quinoa, amarynth etc would be healthier options.  I am gluten free so this would particularly appreciated.  Also miss sufficent veg/greens (ironically); these are fairly easy to add but a bit annoying given the price.  I am single user so it's a bit of a palaver to split out the meals but do able.  Overall, I would definitely recommend them and very much appreciate having something delicious that I can easily and quickly prepare.

records.title: Healthy & tasty recipes
records.text: I love the variety of recipes and the quality of the ingredients. The taste is excellent and portions are generous. You can skip and select recipes easily enough and you receive emails to remind you to pick. I also love the fact that I can return some of the packaging to them. My only reason for the 4 stars is that the price per portion is a bit steep.

records.title: Really impressed with Planthood as a flexitarian
records.text: We've been using Planthood for the last 3 weeks and have been really impressed with the variety and quality of the meals. It gives us the chance to try new dishes that we'd not thought of making ourselves. They're nice and easy to make, super convenient for those short of time.We're not vegan, mostly vegetarian, so did miss the dairy in some meals, but it's difficult to find a company that caters for this, it seems to be either a choice of meat or vegan. Would be nice if the veggies were more catered for. But that's not Planthood's fault as they're clearly a vegan company! We'd like to keep going once the initial offer finishes, but it does get very expensive. So a difficult decision to be made, but we've been that impressed we're probably going to keep going and just add our own cream/cheese.

records.title: Generally good - worth a try!
records.text: Generally good, would definitely recommend trying. The quality of ingredients and variety of recipes is really good and the delivery is reliable. Customer Support have always been great too.To the business, I'd suggest reviewing the recipe cards as they sometimes don't read too well or miss details. Also the website UI/UX for checking what I've ordered / looking ahead to future weeks can be a little clunky. It's fine, but competitors are stronger currently. e.g. - I know to drain the excess liquid from tofu before prepping, but the cards never state this. Might seem pedantic but just some honest feedback.

records.title: It's all so easy!
records.text: It's all so easy. I love that the sauces are made up! No crushing garlic and squeezing lemons after a hard day at work. The flavours are amazing. I also like that the packaging is nearly all recyclable.

records.title: The food is all delicious, but...
records.text: The food is all delicious. There needs to be more care at the selection/packing stage. In just two orders (three meals for two people) we have had an overripe, brown in parts, avocado, a packet of 6 taco shells all torn down the middle and a packet of powder to make a batter unsealed and spilt over everything else. We have, allegedly, been refunded for these though it's very difficult to work out whether or not the refund is correct because you can't see what you paid for an individual meal once you've ordered, only the total. Was £9.66 really the full cost of the meal involving the tacos and avocado? Who knows. We're expecting another delivery for this weekend and will review our options then. We used another delivery service alternately with Planthood and right now we feel they are so much better.

records.title: Poor quality ingredients and not value for money
records.text: Our first meal was delicious. We've had other recipe boxes from several other companies and this was easier and quicker to prepare. However, the avocado in our box was basically mush on arrival and inedible. The cauliflower had gone off too - parts of it were mushy. It must have been old - I've kept supermarket cauliflowers at home for two weeks and they've been in better condition! Planthood initially offered us a credit against a partial box - I quibbled this as I'd expect a refund if I buy something that isn't useable. (Partial obviously - not expecting a refund for the whole amount). The following three meals were not as good as the first - tasty, but not wow.Despite this, I liked the convenience and thought we'd give it a second chance. I can't say I'm impressed. The veg really isn't the freshest and doesn't last. Again, an avocado that was just edible, but if I hadn't made that meal first, it might not have been. All the tortillas arrived broken so it was difficult to make the Crispy Chipotle Tacos. Given that Planthood say, "We cook all our sauces from scratch in our kitchen, using 100% natural ingredients - vegetables, legumes, spices, nuts and seeds - and zero additives or UPFs", I was also surprised to see that the sauce for the taco contained sulphites.I'm not sure I'd order again. All things considered, it seemed like very poor value for money.

records.title: Great for inspiration but not sustainable
records.text: I’ve had a few really delicious meals (great dal with fritters, nice chana masala) but also some pretty terrible ones (the butternut squash spelt risotto was inedible and the fritters alone were a bit disappointing the following week). Portions are ok generally. And it’s nice to have all the little bits to sprinkle on top. It’s been a good experience to try out and has given me some inspiration for cooking plant based meals I had sort of forgotten about. With 25% off it has been almost do-able but not sustainable longer term once the 25% is over.

records.title: I have liked the recipes but also had issues
records.text: I have liked the recipes and think they are quick and easy to put together. However there has been issues with supply of items. Also the fresh vegetables to add to the recipes are sometimes old and gone off or mouldy. I have received refunds within a couple of weeks whenever I have had problems with the orders. I am not sure I'll stick with it long term if this continues to be a problem.

records.title: Some meals nice; others overly salty
records.text: Some of the meals are great. I like that the sauces come pre-made. However many meals have a been very very salty to the point we’ve been unable to finish them. Website very hard to navigate and difficult to adjust delivery/ billing. A lot of single use plastic which negates why some people are vegan - for the planet. Great meal inspo I’ll be stealing though! Thanks for that.

records.title: I like the meals but…
records.text: I like the meals but 3 negative experiences have led me to give them a 3 star review. The first box didn’t arrive at all, I had conversations both with DHL and Planthood customer service and after being reassured it would arrive a day late, it didn’t actually arrive and so we started again the following week. The second thing that happened last week was that one of the items was completely mouldy. Kale with white mould on it. I didn’t check the food until cooking time and so that was annoying… and now the third thing is that I clicked skip to next weeks box and today had an email saying it is being prepared and the money has left my account. I emailed customer service at 3pm but no reply yet… I’m hoping the box can be cancelled otherwise there will be a load of food rotting on my doorstep on Monday.

records.title: Great tasting food, needs improvements to quality
records.text: Relatively frequent user due to great tasting, vegan food. However, I've found that recently the quality has gone down hill. Vegetables are often past their best and wilted on arrival + quality of some of the ingredients isn't great. Would expect better for the price and quality control is poor as it's not uncommon for items to be missing. Website experience is also frustrating when trying to update orders.

records.title: Missing items, veg past it's best
records.text: Recipes are fine but I was disappointed by the quality of the vegetables. I ordered five meals and in opening the first the spring onions were old and wilted. Had to go through the rest to work out which meals I had to use first based on the longevity of the vegetables provided. Unfortunately not suitable for five meals being delivered at once as the spinach, cauliflower and herbs and spring onions were past their best. Can't comment on the carrots as they didn't arrive. Also takes much longer than the fifteen minutes suggested in the adverts.

records.title: Tasted like jars of sauce
records.text: Disappointed by my planthood box as i had high hopes. The sauces were mediocre and tasted like the jars you get in the supermarket - not fresh and a bit chemically. The recipes created a lot of washing up and weren’t actually that quick. The portions were also a bit small. This was my first box and I won’t be ordering again.

records.title: Small portions of veg
records.text: The pros: great recipes, healthy and tasty, amazing for low-effort busy vegans.The cons: small portion sizes. Specifically tiny amounts of fresh veg. It feels like they bump the calories by just adding more white rice or other inexpensive fillers. On my first delivery I received two pathetic, wilted half-stalks of cavolo nero and, sadly, this was not unrepresentative.

records.title: Expensive and limited variety, but nice for vegans
records.text: I like that the meals are mostly prepared for you, and this was the main selling point for me. As someone with a fatigue based disability, working in an exhausting profession, this really helps with getting nutritious food into me. However, the meals use very similar in ingredients so the flavours don't vary much, and many meals take far longer than the advertised 15 minute limit to put together. In terms of ease of access, the website is a pain to navigate. The company would do well to have an app (like Hello Fresh) so that customers can easily access menus, follow step by step instructions (this is one of the worst parts of the product, it's a nightmare to work out what's needed and what the steps are) and resolve any account issues. I've had to email several times now about damaged/poor quality items and it's a faff.I've used Hello Fresh for years and tried Gousto, both are better priced and have meals which can be as fast and nutritious as Planthood. The only thing Planthood has that puts it in a league of it's own is the vegan based menu. As this was not the selling point for me, it's not the thing that will make me stay either.

records.title: Not very feasible when cooking for one
records.text: The recipes are generally tasty varied and feel nourishing but the scheme is not really feasible when cooking for one. I subscribe to the minimum frequency but end up throwing food away or eating the same thing for two or three meals at a time. I’ve had a couple of spoiled items but customer service has been responsive. It would be helpful if cooking times could be included on the recipes and menus. The size of vegetables provided doesn’t seem to bear any relation to the portion size - I just received a massive sweet potato for one recipe for fritters so there was too much sweet potato for the batter mix.

records.title: OK...worth a try.
records.text: OK.... Absolutely love to whole concept behind Planthood; love their branding, packaging, sourcing, and ease of cooking meals with a busy life.  However, we didn't entirley enjoy the meals. They were delicious, but and found the taste to be very 'samey' after a while of eating, which made up feel we didn't enjoy the full meal.  I found the meals repeated on me for the rest of the evening.

records.title: Needs improvements to service
records.text: The food is really good for people trying veganism but have made a change to another delivery service instead. Only really ever liked 2/3 of gluten free options but you can’t choose less than 3 meals. Website constantly changes your delivery date which is confusing so had a box turn up unexpectedly. Customer service offered no help. When I explained the situation to Green Chef that I’d actually ordered that week they gave 50% off that week’s box. Planthood should definitely take note

records.title: Tastes great but....
records.text: The food tastes great, don't get me wrong. I was just hoping for much less prep effort as advertised. Most of the meals definitely need more than 15 min prep and there is so much cleaning to do afterwards. I was very frustrated while cooking (especially when I had to cut a huge sweet potato or carrot myself).

records.title: Planthood recently swapped to DHL and…
records.text: Planthood recently swapped to DHL and after being a very satisfied customer for a while we recently had a package left in plain sight on the doorstep which was then stolen by someone local before we got home. When we contacted Planthood to try and resolve this they said they'd offer a replacement 'on this occasion' but in the end I cancelled because I can't be sure I'll receive my order in future. It's disappointing that there isn't a guaranteed replacement. Their previous delivery service would always make sure the parcel was hidden.

records.title: The meals vary but overall I enjoyed…poor customer service
records.text: The meals vary but overall I enjoyed most of them. The downstairs is sometimes they miss ingredients in the box, when you contact them to inform they ask for photos, how can you take photos of ingredients you don’t have. Customer service is slow to respond & not great.

records.title: Stone soup
records.text: Stone soup.  Any recipe that involves grating sweet potato is NOT just adding "finishing touches" as advertised.  Furthermore, less than half of our plat is veggies - most will be rice, pasta or a cheap grain. The food does taste good, hence three stars

records.title: Some excellent meals, but inconsistent overall
records.text: We have tried Planthood meals 4 times and are currently awaiting our 5th set of recipe boxes. The meals have been variable, some have been really fantastic, but one or two disasters - a bland Thai Green curry and some ingredients missing from another recipe....never a good look. We are continuing with our subscription at the moment, BUT maintaining consistency of great tasting meals needs to be THE priority ....and for goodness sake SORT OUT THE WEBSITE!!! it is not fit for purpose. Even simple things like checking what has been ordered are stupidly complex...this is not difficult stuff and is very clearly an issue for a lot of customers. Come on Will and Hilary, get it sorted!

records.title: Vegetables look old
records.text: The concept behind having your meals sent and ready to prepare easily is great. The meals are tasty, however the vegetables always appear to arrive in a pretty bad way, the spring onions and carrots have been rotten, soft wilted and soggy. I thought maybe it would be a one off but with spring onions especially its every meal. Its a shame as it would be great to enjoy fresh vegetables with my meals!

records.title: Really disappointed
records.text: Really disappointed. Extremely expensive. £78 for 3 meals. One meal was tomato sauce. Butter beans in tin. Nan bread. I wanted to wowed. I wanted the ingredients to show me how to make the sauces.. The packaging is lovely. The branding is high quality.. but the cost/ experience is way too much to make it affordable. For us it's a no sorry. Spring onions were limp and dry. Only issue with ingredients.

records.title: Not impressed
records.text: We have gotten 3 weeks of Planthood. We had really high hopes but we don’t know if we will continue. What we like - minimal packaging and almost everything recyclable compared to other meal kits. Ingredients are fresh. What we don’t like -Most of the dishes and the high protein dishes have a smoky flavor profile (chipotle etc), and there is a lot of tempeh which is tasteless. A lot of pots, pans and oven trays (often 3) need to be used for only one dish. It does not seem right you have to pay additional for delivery and there is not an option for 2 meals a week. Will try one more week and hoping for less tempeh, less pots and pans to cleans and nothing smoky.

records.title: Great food, appalling customer service
records.text: The food from Planthood is the best I’ve tried.What lets them down is their customer service when things go wrong. I’ve had two problems with planthood, and in both cases their customer support agents were patronising and closed my case down without resolving it, or even taking any effort to understand my problem.I feel like I’m in an abusive relationship with a great chef with no interpersonal skills.

records.title: Food was good and I would have liked to continue but...
records.text: Food was good and I would have liked to continue it but that subscription model, it seems does not suit me. I had thought I would receive an email to confirm my next order and they wouldn't send me the box if I didn't confirm but the email landed in spam which I couldn't see and I directly received the order confirmation email. I tried to contact them and requested them to help me in cancelling it as I was traveling and I wasn't going to be home anytime soon to actually eat it but all their customer care team did was share terms and conditions and FAQs... Not at all interested in retaining a customer. I had to cancel the subscription altogether as I couldn't risk it happening again and losing my hard earned money. I did write a note while cancelling that they could give us another reminder in the form of an sms or a call if we didn't confirm the order - just to be sure as they are so concerned about food wastage... An app with push notifications would also help.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: The food arrived well packaged, it was fresh and well thought out.  I followed the instructions but the meals lacked taste and were not very nice at all.  I’d certainly not recommend and feel I’ve wasted my money and feel utterly disappointed. Taste was bland, no flavour not even the chilli oil which had no punch at all.  I have one meal left to prepare, I was doing this to lose weight which has been achieved as the meals were to disgusting to consume despite trying!  Don’t believe the hype.  Very disappointed indeed.

records.title: Refund ?
records.text: Asked for a refund as the food was inedible (see previous review) they’ve not even bothered to respond and just ignored the request.  Paid for food. All of it ended in the bin, tofu was not solid and in pieces, looked like sick when dished up, sauces were salty and had no taste. Can someone please come back to me regarding a refund for the inedible food you sent !!!!

records.title: First time customer not worth the money
records.text: First time customer, food quality is poor and while the customer services said ‘taste is subjective’ when I complained about the flavour I thought that was a poor comment to make because if something is tasty it’s tasty and if it’s not it’s clear for anyone eating it. There was not enough protein just a few bits of vegetables and sauces. It’s not worth the money at all. I quickly cancelled the weeks subscription which I cannot believe I paid £53 for. I could have rustled up better tasting meals with ingredients from Lidl or Aldi. The food also expired quickly.

records.title: Poor customer service
records.text: The food is good, if pricey.  The customer service is very poor.  I'd expect more from a premium service.  I've been charged in error after asking them to skip a week and they are refusing to refund me.

records.title: Poor quality
records.text: To start I was really pleased with the service but last week the food arrived without any chill packs which after being transported unrefrigerated on a warm day the fresh sauces are not worth the risk and this week one meal contains such mouldy food they must of  scrapped it out of a skip. Last chance next week

records.title: Disappointing Christmas box
records.text: Disappointing Christmas box. Some sauces which were average (gravy bitter). Small portions of unprepared veg. Pies (not ‘wellingtons’) and weird potato things that were bland and unpleasant when fried. Very expensive for what we got. Would not order again or recommend. Cheeses were excellent though. (Latter we’re an extra order). Very good quality and hope we can get these again from vegan cheese shop. Honestly hoped to give a positive review cos we do support vegan businesses but we still ended up having to make a Christmas dinner because this was so meh so an expensive waste for us and we are disappointed.

description: Save up to 40% on our wide range of catering equipment. Reliable equipment at low prices. An apron is a cape on backwards, so power up and be a catering hero. Shop online today. Pay in 3 Available. Backing Britains Best. Commercial Equipment. Recycling Options Offered.

records.title: Powerful blender, large capacity!
records.text: My partner's mother suffers with Motor Neurones Disease. Part of this condition means her food needs to be pureed. She makes a months worth of meals in one day, and then blends them to the consistency required. This is time consuming and stressful.I have been on the look out for a powerful blender with a large capacity to try to make this big batch cooking easier. We found exactly that. In my haste to purchase one, I entered the wrong shipping address. The staff were very quick in rectifying my mistake.We are hoping this product will make our lives a little easier

records.title: I bought a 'Contender' brand commercial…
records.text: I bought a 'Contender' brand commercial microwave oven, 1000W, from ECatering. Other companies sell this same oven but under a different 'brand', and for a lot more money. They are all made by the same manufacturer. ECatering delivered the next day.I thought that there was a fault on one of the functions/programs, but it was the manual not being clear enough for me. ECatering listened to my concern, and within 2 days had it sorted. They had made a video for me to follow, which sorted things out. Really impressed. I recommend this oven, and this company.

records.title: there is help if you ask
records.text: quattro filter extractor hood.had a problem with computer online ordering. phoned in the morning to remedy. miss shasha went that little extra help to see what could be done. and any further technical questions..as also needed to order now. even through we wont able to install yet...surprised it arrived so fast.not opened box yet, but I'm sure i am not going to be disappointed and hope to be able to recommend to everyone that uses professional equipment

records.title: I had a problem with a freezer that…
records.text: I had a problem with a freezer that occurred whilst it was in warranty and got sent a new part free of charge, however the fault happened again after the warranty had ended. Initially it took a long time and a lot of effort to sort the issue, but to E Catering's credit they eventually gave me a full credit for the freezer

records.title: Good quality items and good customer service
records.text: I needed to order two hot plate units for an event urgently so the on-line order was simple and I paid the £80 next day delivery charge. Unfortunately the delivery was missed and was sent out the following day. I sent an email requesting a refund of the £80 next day delivery and this was dealt with very promptly and a refund organised. The goods arrived the following day as expected and the hot plate units are good quality. I will certainly use this company again.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service and I needed a follow up question which was dealt with efficiently and very quickly.  I would definitely use again

records.title: The amazing paula
records.text: Sorry for the delay in this review. I recommend everyone to use this company for there commercial catering equipment. Amazing , I was greated by the wonderful Paula . Who some home managed to for fill everyone of my unreasonable request, from next day delivery to , helping me organise shipping to Sweden so I could complete my contracts. Paula you are amazing and I hope you get the biggest Xmas bonus. Thank you for everything, speak soon as I need more equipment.

records.title: Commercial 1200mm Quattro…
records.text: Ordered a commercial 1200mm Quattro cooker hood after receiving advice and tech support from Kate at eCatering. It was to be used in a large domestic kitchen with a large (1100mm) electric Rangemaster. eCatering sent fitting instructions in advance which helped us decide on this hood. Delivery was prompt and the item arrived safely. Fitting was easy despite the size. The Quattro had nice rounded edges which 'softened' the commercial look of the unit; powerful suction by the way, and not too noisy either! Well pleased! Thank you!

records.title: We are a charity based in Sunderland…
records.text: We are a charity based in Sunderland and have just recently acquired The Victory Pub. Our two glasswashers died on us and we were in desperate need of new ones! After a lot of searching on Good Friday, when most shops were closed, we managed to get E-Catering and the absolutely fabulous Carys to help us. They opened up their shop in Murton especially for us on Easter Saturday and we were able to purchase 2 x 500mm glasswashers. They do not realise how this has helped us but also the 500 fans we have coming into our Pub on Easter Monday!! Buy local and support local businesses! Thank you E-Catering! Anthony and the Team owe you a debt of thanks!

records.title: Ordered a meat slicer last night for a…
records.text: Ordered a meat slicer last night for a big catering event this weekend and this morning realised I had booked standard rather than next day delivery which meant delivery would be too late.I phoned Matthew at ecatering who were so helpful and efficient and they upgraded delivery immediately. Made my day to deal with helpful, friendly people who sorted problem so quickly. Will use these people again as good service means a lot these days and is a rare find.

records.title: Great product
records.text: Great product, good price and shipping was very quick.Set up instructions were a bit vague and I had to call your tech support, who were very helpful.I could not find the screw, that was extremely important in setting up and had to be facilitated with a screw driver…..there wasn’t one!!All in all great service.

records.title: A tale of two sides
records.text: One person made the purchase easy, the others not so much.  I purchased two air conditioning units, one of which developed a fault after minimal use, I asked for help but got told there was no warranty on the product.  I got into a bit of a discussion over email and one person, thankfully helped me out, while others said tough luck this person saw that it was a genuine claim, the unit was practically brand new and was faulty sorted it out pretty sharpish.  I'm not sure whether to purchase from here again.

records.title: We were initially sent the wrong item…
records.text: We were initially sent the wrong item and after a day or two of calls back and forth, Carys (Head of customer service) took our case on and got it resolved by the next working day. Carys kept us up to date throughout the process and got it resolved in a timely manner. it would be 5 stars other than the mishap.

records.title: Quick Friendly Service
records.text: Matthew B at ECatering helped me with my order. Order needed adapting after the purchase and he very quickly helped me change what I needed. He was also able to send me the product specification which has enabled me to complete the prep work and progress the job quickly. 4 stars as I have only just placed the order and can't comment on delivery. wouldn't fault this company.

records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: First delivery. Wrong item arrived. Warehouse fault.Replacement item arrange for with Carys Returns & Warranties. Slow process possibly due to shift hours.Second delivery. Arrived damaged. Due to manufacturers poor packaging. Replacement item arrange for with Kate Customer Service Advisor. Again a slow process possibly due to shift hours.Third delivery. Arrived correct and in good condition.As I had pointed out, the item was required for 4th June, Kate arranged for a Saturday 3rd June delivery.Talking with a set agent was helpful, but time consuming waiting for a response.Both Carys and Kate deserve five stars, but I have awarded four for the overall experience.

records.title: Problem resolved
records.text: It was very unfortunate that it took 3 attempts to get the fridge that I needed.  This took time to achieve.  Better communication from eCatering would have earned them 5 stars for dealing with the problems.  But the final outcome has been good.

records.title: Had a manual fill boiler which leaked
records.text: Had a manual fill boiler which leaked. Karen promptly sent an email explaining what I needed to do. Matthew sent a replacement, for this to leak too! Again promptly this was replaced and am happy with my boiler. Both Karen and Matthew were polite and professional, great response to my difficulties!! Thank you

records.title: Firstly the customer service was…
records.text: Firstly the customer service was excellent, even though their website and ordering software let them down badly, but it got sorted quickly and we got the bottle fridge on the day they promised. Would have given 5 stars but their delivery agent, the pallet network, did not call before delivery which was specified in the delivery notes.We are a night-time venue and it was very lucky that someone was there or we would have missed this delivery. So whilst they are cheaper than others for this item you may not get any notice of delivery.Other than that all good.

records.title: Quattro Salamander grill..avoid updated review
records.text: The Quattro Salamander grill only comes with a year warranty for parts and mine failed after 1 year and 9 months of fairly low use. Get a better quality product with a better warranty deal elsewhere. As ever you get what you pay for.Update: Matthew in the technical support is excellent and alone deserves five stars for his customer service. He arranged a new unit at discount. I would say though that a parts only guarantee for one year is not as good as two years parts and labour as offered by Nisbetts for example. I am assured that it is rare for these units to fail.

records.title: Very good customer service
records.text: We ordered an induction hob. The order was dealt with quickly and it arrived within a few days. Unfortunately it had a fault and needed to be returned for a replacement but the team was extremely helpful, responded quickly and got us up and running within almost no time. Very good customer service and the problem was quickly resolved with no quibble of fuss.

records.title: Fed Ex let them down
records.text: Would've given 5 but Fed Ex let them down very badly. If it was a courier rating it would be 0 as they were useless to be polite

records.title: After my recent review of the 2…
records.text: After my recent review of the 2 glass-washes I purchased from this site I was contracted and now pleased that the washers are now in full working order after dealing with matthew brown who arranged for an engineer to sort the problems out and find the fault with the machines at no charge . It was a stressful 2 weeks but Very happy it’s all sorted. Thank you

records.title: I purchased 2 x Quattro Commercial…
records.text: Update I received a refund from E catering for 2 x Quattro Commercial 9000btu Portable Air Conditioning Unit.I have therefore amended my review to reflect the overall experience due to the much better customer experience provided by Katie to rectify the poor experience provided by paula. I ordered the units at 23:24 hrs on Sunday, 17 July 2022. By the morning of 18 July 2022 the price had dropped. I contacted support via email 18th July asked them to honour the price drop, bearing I had ordered literally a few hours earlier and had not received the units. Paula refused telling me if I return it I have to pay return delivery and 25% restocking charge.

records.title: eCatering resolved our issue and we are happy
records.text: As a new business time can be the difference between success and failure. So as such we were quite unhappy when our oven arrived faulty and it took them 2 weeks of back and forth before it was escalated to a manager.We had to submit an installation certificate for the oven to eCatering before they would collect it which makes sense.They took a couple of weeks but eventually they replaced the oven once it was escalated to a manager. We were also refunded for the removal of the old broken oven and the refitting of the new one although we had to carry them from the front door to the kitchen and back. In the end their service pulled through and we are happy but wasn't without hiccups. If eCatering had a next day professional fitting service then we wouldn't have had the wait and the frustration of being landed with a broken oven for 2 weeks. Something to consider for the future.Nonetheless, the issue was addressed and we are happy now and would consider buying from them again.

records.title: Price was really good and deliver was…
records.text: Price was really good and deliver was in a good time.  Would have given 5 stars only when I followed up the delivery date through the online chat I didn't really get a specific answer.

records.title: Ordered an under counter can/bottle…
records.text: Ordered an under counter can/bottle fridge, delivered, installed, working fine, what more can I say, nothing special.

records.title: The wine glasses I purchased from this…
records.text: The wine glasses I purchased from this store are not only elegant and stylish, but they are also incredibly functional, enhancing the taste and aroma of my favorite wines.

records.title: Wrong items sent, but great customer service
records.text: I ordered a few items from ecatering and unfortunately I didn't receive a couple of items I wanted, but their customer service is reliable and efficient and they solved my problem in no time.

records.title: After sales service for me has been…
records.text: After sales service for me has been terrible. Always very polite but not really helpful on this occasion. I paid £1999.99 for piece of equipment that broke down twice in the first three months. I am still waiting for parts to arrive after almost 4 months. I have actually had 3 months use out of this item in the12 months I have had it. If it ever gets fixed it is now out of warranty so if it breaks down again it’s down to me. They can’t give me a date the parts will arrive, originally was 6 to 8 weeks which has long since passed. Feel like they aren’t willing to help and do the decent thing, they have refused to take it back for a refund. I’m now contacting the Ombudsman in an attempt to get a fair resolution in this matter. I’ll Judge this company by what they do when things go wrong, as they sometimes do so it’s a one star from me. Absolutely terrible after sales.Edit. Issue has now been resolved. After talking to Katie, who was very understanding, professional and generally nice (like the others I have spoken to). Finally she was in a position fix the problems we had. They have agreed to collect the old unit and replace with new. I'm very happy again. Have had lots of equipment with ecatering and this is the first problem. These things happen I understand that. Sometimes it's just getting through to the right person. The one star was for this item only and if I'd taken the trouble to review them previously it would have been 5 stars. In future I will review both good and bad service to even things up a bit. I have now given this 4 stars instead of 1.

records.title: Banisha was very helpful in…
records.text: Banisha was very helpful in communicating with the manufacturer to try to resolve a technical fault. This was resolved in due course.

records.title: Poor service but eventual resolution
records.text: Whilst the boiler has now been replaced I don’t feel the service merits a significant increase in rating however I am willing to now give 3 stars.Initial complaint as below (I’m loathed to give even 1 star for this company who supplied a water boiler to us. This leaked and melted the plug but they are unwilling to replace. They tell me they are waiting for a response from their supplier. I was initially promised an outcome within 10 working hours but we are now in excess of 10 working days with no resolution in sight. During every phone call I’m told no manager is available and someone will call me back. This has yet to happen)

records.title: Slow to respond to queries but sorted quickly when actioned.

Eventually just bought it anyway.  Unfortunately it arrived badly damaged and once someone answered my email (sent twice), Kate sorted out the problem very quickly, indeed within a couple of days I had a replacement which was great.  So very good process to get a new product delivered, just getting a response prior to buying and initial contact about replacement was slow. Would buy again from them.
