records.title: Parts only warranty and no customer service.
records.text: Brought a hand blender. Described as ‘heavy duty’. Failed after just over a month.  ***warning you only get parts warranty***. This is not clear, on ordering in my opinion. It’s in the terms and conditions. I have tried to work with them to resolve, but no reply to repeated emails. Ignore any response from ecatering that they are investigating, as they are not. No information or replies to requests on how I source the parts for the parts warranty. Just no contact at all. Buy elsewhere would be my advice as if you have issues with a product they are useless. Looks like I am one of many unhappy customers, but I am sure ecatering will challenge this review like the ALL the others!

records.title: Won’t be buying from them…
records.text: Won’t be buying from them again.....Even though I paid for next day delivery my high value order it was sent late and then apparently sent to the wrong location.  The lady I spoke to in the phone was unhelpful and rude.

records.title: Wow, these guys have no idea about customer service!
records.text: Ordered a fridge online with free delivery.  Then e-catering ring me to basically tell me that I need to accept liability for parking fines if the truck needs to pull up outside our property or otherwise they can't deliver!  They also tell me that they can't organise deliver after midday when we are open even though that is perfectly logical. And then they go to great pains tell me that the goods must be checked on arrival otherwise any damage or failures are my problem!  So basically: no flexibility, no care and absolutely no responsibility.They really seem to know how to make you feel like you are the problem rather than the customer!  This whole affair just makes me wish I had never ordered from them in the first place.

records.title: STAY AWAY FROM THIS, Unprofessional customer service.
records.text: Extremely disappointed with eCatering's service and warranty program. My business suffered significant losses when our equipment malfunctioned during peak December season. Despite having their extended warranty, the repair process has been unacceptably slow - minimum 2 months waiting time.Their excuse of staff shortage is not acceptable for a business providing essential equipment services. If they can't handle their current workload, they shouldn't take on more customers or sell warranties they can't honor.The extended warranty appears to be misleading - save your money. When equipment breaks down, you're left without support and facing lengthy delays. As a takeaway business owner, this has resulted in complete closure during our busiest period, causing substantial financial loss.Would strongly advise other business owners to look elsewhere for their catering equipment needs. The risk of equipment failure combined with their poor after-sales service is not worth it.

records.title: Less than 0 stars if possible
records.text: Less than 0 stars if possible! We have purchased an oven back in October & within 2 weeks the bulb had blown then within 6 weeks the oven is faulty and trips my building electrics. We have asked for updates over 12 times over the phone & email as it’s an urgent matter but their response is ‘I can’t help, this is a technical issue / we are waiting to hear back from the manufacturer’ . We have requested multiple times for an update to be given regardless & the customer ‘service’ team don’t have the decency to fulfil their promise to personally update us. The technical team or any management don’t seem to work at this company as they are never available. All I want to do is return a faulty item for a refund but they insist of everything they can to ignore me or  suggest fixing it but we all know that isn’t going to happen. We won’t be giving up as this is ridiculous & why have t&c’s if you are blatantly just going to disregard them.

records.title: Perfect food for an intimate wedding feast
records.text: We used The Cotswold Chef in November 2024 to cater for an intimate wedding meal for 18 guests. They were exceptionally flexible with the menu choice, and catered for a guest with a dietary requirement. We enjoyed a scallop and pea puree with bacon and onion dust starter. The steak, stuffed mushroom and potato fondant was exceptional, and I've genuinely never before tasted a jus with that much depth of flavour. We finished it off with a delectable sticky toffee pudding with creme anglaise. The food was absolutely ten out of ten, and the hosting was perfect too, offering a water and wine service. I would absolutely recommend and hope I have an occasion to use them again in the future.

records.title: Outstanding from start to finish
records.text: We booked The Cotswold Chef for my wife's birthday.  Our group consisted of ten adults and four young children.  Jo and Guido arrived in plenty of time.  We left them to prepare the food with four noisy children running around.  Jo and Guido took it in their stride, they were so friendly and extremely professional.  Not only was Jo helping in the kitchen she was constantly backwards and forwards ensuring we had drinks.  She also helped with the photography by taking family pictures.  The food was outstanding, everyone enjoyed it from the wonderful canapés to the deserts.  To top it all off the kitchen was left spotlessly clean and tidy.  We could not recommend The Cotswold Chef highly enough.

records.title: A truly wonderful evening and spectacular food! Thank you Guido!
records.text: Please pass our thanks on to Guido. He was so lovely and wow what an incredibly talented chef! We had the best evening and from the moment he arrived we were able to sit back, relax and enjoy his delicious food! It made my Mum's 60th Birthday evening very special and she loved every second. We would 100% recommend The Cotswolds Chef to anybody. Thank you again and best wishes, Katie

records.title: Exceptional evening delivered by Guido and Jo
records.text: This will be one of those reviews where you wonder if it's real...The Cotswold Chef team came to our Airbnb on Saturday to create a birthday dinner for my wife and I plus 9 other friends.We were blown away by the food, it was truly exceptional, and the service on top, including the table laying, really made the experience feel like we were fine dining in a restaurant. Guido and Jo were very friendly, navigated around a puppy and an enthusiastic amateur chef who weren't keen to leave the kitchen, and made the experience really special. We hope to have a reason to see them and use them again!

records.title: Outstanding!
records.text: What a fantastic evening, Jo & Guido thank you so much, you really made my wife’s 60th birthday. Everyone thought it was tremendous from the canapés through to the cheese. The quality was outstanding and you were so lovely and easy to deal with. Definitely will see you again

records.title: Excellent service and delicious food
records.text: Excellent service and delicious food, we were a party of 15 and everyone thoroughly enjoyed the evening. There’s a huge menu you can initially pick your select dishes from, with something for everyone. Highly recommend.

records.title: A must if staying in the Cotswolds!
records.text: We contacted the Cotswold Chef to cook for a party of 10 for a special birthday and they definitely didn't disappoint! Guido arrived in plenty of time and was super friendly, assuring us to sit back and relax whilst he prepped. The food itself was 10/10! Most of the party had scallops, beef ribs, tiramisu and sticky toffee pudding, all of which were beautifully presented and tasted incredible. Guido also took care of all of the clearing up after- the kitchen was left spotless! The whole process from start to finish was very smooth and professional. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend the Cotswolds chef and would definitely use them again!

records.title: How to make a celebration extra…
records.text: How to make a celebration extra special! Our family get together was made even more special by the delivery of a delicious 3 course meal by Jo on the evening we arrived in the Cotswolds.  Jo sent us the menu in advance so we could choose our preferences and everything was delivered to the door with clear instructions for heating up when we were ready to eat. With a baby and a 4 year old in the party this gave us the flexibility we needed for a relaxed meal. We all enjoyed our meals which included pate or cheese soufflé for starters, lamb or cod for the main course and sticky toffee pudding or chocolate mouse for dessert.

records.title: 5 star food and service
records.text: Guido made us a delicious 3 course meal. He served and explained what each course was, all in a very friendly and relaxed manner.The whole experience was fantastic, he set everything up for our dinner and by the time he left after our desert, the kitchen was spotless and the dishwasher on.We couldn't fault any of it and would definitely use the company again if we find ourselves holidaying in the Cotswolds.

records.title: lovely night lots of choices.food was…

records.title: Thank you so much for cooking for us on…
records.text: Thank you so much for cooking for us on Sunday night. We thoroughly enjoyed the experience. The food was delicious and David was very organised and super tidy. We would highly recommend your services for anyone looking to enjoy a night in without any hassle. The perfect birthday or celebratory treat for someone who usually has to cook. Looking forward to using your services again. Best wishes The Erlam Family from Cheshire

records.title: Was a lovely overall experience and…

Some constructive criticism for me would be that if the plates were hot the food would have stayed hot as was a bit cold for example Carbonara wasn't hot. Also it was all very big portion sizes with not a lot of break between courses. But overall a great experience and would recommend

description:
You’ll choose your favourites from our weekly menu of exciting recipes and decide how many meals you’d like for however many people. Then, we’ll deliver those recipes and fresh ingredients to your door, every week, so you can cook delicious dinners of your choice. We’ve got recipes for everyone from meat eaters to vegetarians, families to couples and from those with low calorie diets to others who want quick, easy recipes. Most importantly, you’re in control of your box, so you can skip a week or two whenever you like in your account area. 

#HelloFreshUK 
#HelloFreshsnaps 
#HelloFreshmoment

records.title: This choice has changed my life
records.text: This choice has changed my life, I was in abit of a cycle of looking in the fridge no motivation or desire to know what to cook and want to cook. It just clicked, the week before Christmas I just decided yes I need to try this and I have cooked almost every night, excited to cook,  it is saving me money aswell as I was spending way too much in the shops and now I have full control of it all. I couldnt be happier! ThankyouSophie

records.title: Enjoy Hello Fresh
records.text: Enjoy Hello Fresh. It is convenient, quick, easy & no waste. Well packaged and always delivered on time.

records.title: Tasty and varied meals that are easy to…
records.text: Tasty and varied meals that are easy to make and would cost much more if purchased as individual ingredients ....because most of the ingredients would be wasted....

records.title: Christmas dinner was given 10/10 by…
records.text: Christmas dinner was given 10/10 by family.  Recipes easy to follow.  Boxing Day dinner also scored highly.

records.title: Absolutely amazing food great choices…
records.text: Absolutely amazing food great choices fantastic prices I did Gousto until a friend said try these no looking back

records.title: This was my first Hello Fresh meal to…
records.text: This was my first Hello Fresh meal to prepare. It was so simple to follow the instructions on the recipe sheet.I chose a salmon pesto and parmasin with dauphinoise potato and veg.Absolutely delicious!

records.title: Delicious and simple to follow.
records.text: I love the fact HF dishes,  introduce me to recipes I would never normally think of.

records.title: I love HelloFresh
records.text: I love HelloFresh.  They make dinners soooo easy.  Excellent ingredients for easy-to-cook meals.  I also love the flexibility of missing some weeks if it’s needed.  Highly recommend giving them a go.

records.title: A meat-free revelation.
records.text: Trying to eat less meat we started Hello Fresh a while ago and we have not been disappointed. The recipes are delicious. Not a single meal has had either of us turning our noses up. The portion sizes aren’t huge, but, I’ll be frank, I would much rather be left wishing for more than eating enough or too much of something that doesn’t taste as good as the Hello Fresh meals do. My wife loves cooking the meals, oft I hear her singing away as she chops and blends the perfectly sized ingredients and she tells me she feels like a “Master Chef”.

records.title: The Christmas meal
records.text: The Christmas meal with the sides were brilliant and the prep instructions were perfect, the cranberry and orange sauce was really nice with the chicken.I always look forward to getting a box a month and cooking from scratch, essentially.

records.title: When the meals turn up it's good
records.text: Hello Fresh is not cheap, but it does allow you to cook high quality meals at home if the sort that most normal people would never think of trying to cook. The results are often as good as you'd find in - say - a gastropub.What is more making them yourself increases your confidence and also allows you to vary things a bit based on other ingredients you may have in the back of the fridge.The only downside is that orders are sometimes cancelled at the last minute with little notice - despite the fact that HelloFresh must know well in advance that they could not deliver. So if you are relying on them for making a meal that evening... just don't.

records.title: Get cooking
records.text: Great meals that offer a decent portion size with simple instructions at an affordable rate. Delivery is always on time and the app makes choosing each week's meals easy. Occasionally I change the recipes by adding or changing ingredients but it's more down to personal preference. Only down side is that I find the odd ingredient is missing from the box.

records.title: So far so good
records.text: This review is based on my first box with hello fresh. The meals were absolutely delicious! My 5 year old didn’t like the truffle mushroom pie but then it was quite an adult tasting dish. The instructions were clear and ingredients were fresh. I’ve knocked a star off as the portion sizes so far seemed a bit small for 2 adults compared to the sizes we got when we used the company years ago. We definitely needed side dishes to make a meal of one of the recipes so far.

records.title: I had to call the Hello Fresh customer…
records.text: I had to call the Hello Fresh customer service and they were there on Saturday between Xmas and New Year and sorted my query immediately - cannot fault the service when other big named companies can’t even bother to reply. Well Done!

records.title: Food is great ….BUT
records.text: Food is great Service , missing items , missing menus Order vegetarian receive meat dishes etc this is getting worse

records.title: Serving/portion sizes are great
records.text: Serving/portion sizes are great. I was half-expecting it to be on the conservative side and that I would still be hungry after a meal but I'm pleasantly surprised this isn't the case. The estimates of how long it takes to prepare and cook the meals are also quite accurate. I am actually thoroughly enjoying this as it expands my palate to so many new dishes and cuisines. I only took one point off for the use of plastic packaging. Although I can see that they are trying hard to be environmentally-friendly, I feel really guilty whenever I see that thick plastic foam insulation in my box. I wish that you can get the delivery drivers to pick-up these insulation pads whenever they drop-off a new box, and just reuse/recycle these pads somehow.

records.title: Good for trying new foods
records.text: Lots of options, good customer service when things go wrong. Takes the effort out of meal planning and stops us getting stuck in a rut of having the same meals over and over again.

records.title: So easy to select nice meals and have…
records.text: So easy to select nice meals and have the items just arrived. Takes the pressure off. Only down side we've noticed as we've been customers for a good while is the meat portions especially chicken are often far too small, the quality is ok but the size often lacking.

records.title: Great recipes, even better if use by dates were added to recipes online
records.text: Great recipes, always something tasty and new to try. Something that would really improve the experience would be to add dates to the app, meat used by dates to know which meals could last until later in the week and which need using first. If this could be something incorporated into the recipe selection, even better to help plan around a week when we have hello fresh 3/7

records.title: The chance to try new things
records.text: My husband and I really enjoy HelloFresh.We typically order 3 meals every 2 weeks. I find I spend a fair bit less at the supermarket those weeks.The selection is varied, and it makes us try new things. The delivery is always well packed, and the ice packs and insulation keep the delivery cold i for quite a while should you forget to change the delivery date!My only criticism is I'd like to be able to increase the protein content.

records.title: Tasty meals easy to make
records.text: The meals are really tasty and easy to make but sometimes the ingredients especially the carrots can be past their best by the time they get to us

records.title: The recipes are really easy to follow…
records.text: The recipes are really easy to follow and make life so much easier.however  I have experienced some ingredient issues (either missing items or fresh items ‘past their best’).when it’s good though it’s really good.

records.title: Menus good, wasteful packaging
records.text: Positives: We really enjoy the recipes and the ability to plan ahead. Delivery timings are usually good.Negative: We find it extremely frustrating that the packaging materials for the chilled food - the padding and the ice blocks are NOT recyclable. Change this!

records.title: Delicious and easy recipes
records.text: The food is absolutely delicious. Not always large portions and sometimes have to add extra veg for example. And you have to remember to skip in time if you don’t want a box every week as if you miss the deadline you are having what they pick anyway

records.title: Everything with the food has been…
records.text: Everything with the food has been fantastic the only problem is the poor delivery option! To only be able to have a delivery on a Saturday is rather pathetic and pretty inconvenient

records.title: Some beautiful recipes
records.text: Some beautiful recipes, good set up in terms of the ability to skip etc. Food comes well packed for freshness. Easy to follow recipes.

records.title: Recipes delicious and instructions…
records.text: Recipes delicious and instructions clear. Only gripe is finding fridge storage stuff in the bags and sometimes I find a use by day- which I’ve passed.

records.title: Customer services are quick to answer…
records.text: Customer services are quick to answer and resolve any issues that arise and it's made very easy to speak to someone.The only thing I'm not so excited about is some ingredients in the packets for example caking agent.Totally unhealthy chemicals. Are they necessary?

records.title: I look forward to receiving my Hello…
records.text: I look forward to receiving my Hello Fresh box and planning my meals for the week. It is convenient and takes away the headache of planning what to make every day.The only downside is the amount of non recyclable packaging that comes with it. I am struggling with my conscience over this and may have to stop my deliveries if the company cannot make changes.

records.title: I like all
records.text: I like all , taste, size of portions,  easy to cook,the only think I am not happy is short date on meats,  my orders comes once a week and need to cook meals in first four days as other way meat will be out of date.

records.title: I recently tried HelloFresh
records.text: I recently tried HelloFresh, and while it has its good points, it’s not perfect. The recipes are really easy to follow, and I did enjoy making meals I wouldn’t usually cook. Most of the ingridients were fresh, but I had one or two items that didn’t look great when they arrived, which was a bit dissapointing. Portion sizes were decent, though I think they could be a bit bigger, especially for the price. It’s a nice idea, and I can see why people like it, but I’m not sure it’s worth it for me every week. Maybe good for busy weeks when I don’t have time to plan meals, but it’s not something I’d use all the time.

records.title: Good okay, service not so much
records.text: Food okay, just a couple of issues with damaged ingredients which could be issue with courier. There was an issue with a vegetarian burger that actually had beef extract in it!The low score is more to do with them not completing actions that they said they would do, did not postpone a delivery that should not have arrived, not completing a refund that they said they would do. And also for their text messaging system doesn’t work

records.title: The meals are extremely delicious and…
records.text: The meals are extremely delicious and easy to make. However, we have had a few items not turn up and instead of the payment for the missing items coming off the next box they sit as a credit for any full price items. You also cannot change your delivery date to suit you without incurring a fee.

records.title: So far one box cost more than expected…
records.text: So far one box cost more than expected due to the increased priced dishes not being clear enough.If choices aren’t made they pick them for you but don’t pick the free dessert so that doesn’t get included.One delivery didn’t arrive and delivery driver lied saying signed for by me.Box after that was a day late! And missing the garlic for every dish in the box! Ingredients are basically on the last legs so if you don’t cook immediately they are off.

records.title: Ordering process and prices not great
records.text: I find the app and ordering process slow and not easy find what I want. I don't like they way the more expensive recipes are presented first and a lot of scrolling is required to find the basic ones included in my plan, and the lack of search function to find dishes quickly. A few weeks in, after several calls to customer services, I'm just getting used to deciding what dishes I might want ages in advance of delivery. Finally, although the portion sizes are just about OK if you're not hungry, the flavours and freshness are good. Probably won't be continuing for very long because of the ordering process and prices.

records.title: Hello fresh is great, poor deliveries
records.text: Hello fresh is great but you've recently started using dpd for deliveries and they're terrible. Packages are always left the wrong way up even with clear instructions on the box. They don't knock, they just leave the package on the door step even if there's someone home. Box looked like it had been thrown around as the contents was all over the place.

records.title: The vegetarian meals are very samey
records.text: The vegetarian meals are very samey. There isn't a vegan option.The meals provide have easy to follow recipes but are required to be adapted to suit a vegan, ie, cream fresh and cheese.

records.title: Use by dates on meats often too short
records.text: Use by dates on meats often too short. The odd ingredient missing. Battered peppers and carrots behave like they’re made from rubber

records.title: Very few vegetarian options
records.text: I gave Hello Fresh a go, but cancelled my membership after a couple of orders.  The vegetarian options are very limited compared to what Gousto offers, for that reason, I have gone back to Gousto.  The meals options on Hello Fresh are also very basic.

records.title: Firstly
records.text: Firstly, I keep saying, your contact telephone number does not work when trying to ring, 2, you do not inform members of price increase, for example I signed on for £20:99 all of a sudden, like 3 months later, I had to pay £29:99 why?? The talk does not completely work, I've asked many times questions of ingredients faults and I did not get a answer to my question, only once I complained that DPD was leaving my box in a completely wrong place and I was given my weeks money back, that was a bonus other then that, I'm not completely happy, if it wasn't for the fact the meals are 100% gorgeous I would have left.

records.title: Must try harder…
records.text: We have had hello fresh for a number of years now. Just recently we have been very disappointed with Hello Fresh! Menus are generally good for us but the quality of the produce is either missing or poor quality.When we report these issues they offer us a small nominal fee as compensation, which doesn’t really help when you are half way through preparing a meal for yourselves. Also they offer no insensitive or discounts for loyalty customers.Seriously thinking of switching to Gusto or one of their other competitors.

records.title: I've been a customer for nearly 10…
records.text: I've been a customer for nearly 10 years and have always been impressed with the quality of food. Deliveries were always on time with the right ingredients. Unfortunately I've noticed a drop in the quality of ingredients over the last year, especially the meat. I found a chicken beak in one meal, which I complained about but unfortunately did not receive a response.I've also noticed, compared to similar services, that their saturated fat and salt content in most meals are relatively high. I've since permanently switched to another service.

records.title: Did not enjoy the fact that three meals…
records.text: Did not enjoy the fact that three meals were picked for us when we joined ,I didn’t even enjoy those meals to the fullest. I haven’t had time this week to even think about changing my meals for the next delivery and can’t seem to skip or cancel my order, Feeling disappointed Could do betterPlease improve Also give more key points and details rather that having to read long paragraphs before being able to use the app as I did not even fully understand Only Allowing people 2 days to change their order is too short and didn’t even get the chance to change it.Please fix your services and improve

records.title: Too samey
records.text: The pescatarian/vegetarian choices are very samey, I get bored of roasting sweet potatoes to put in the recipes. The vegetable content is usually too small for two people, I have to buy more from local shop to bulk it up.

records.title: Most meals were very tasty
records.text: Most meals were very tasty, however, we received off chicken thigh for one of our meals.  The AI customer service said it was down to the way the meat was packaged, and the sulphur smell would disperse given time.  However, this was not just a sulphur smell, the meat was very slimy, and was definitely off.  Basically good value when you get the 50% off offer, but otherwise, not worth it.

records.title: Please increase the amount of recycling…
records.text: Please increase the amount of recycling in the delivery - especially insulation material and plastic with ice in. Range of menus is good. Some weeks the size of the vegetable (eg butternut squash) is tiny and I have to supplement form elsewhere. That is very irritating. The old cardboard boxes did not require ripping to open. That meant they were reusable. Now the boxes are often unusable and all end up in recycling. Reuse comes before recycle.

records.title: Foods good but service terrible
records.text: Foods good but every week they charge the wrong price. Supposed to get free delivery with Amazon prime but they always charge then I have to ring up to get a refund. Every damned week! So frustrating and a waste of everyone’s time. Big promises poor results so far

records.title: It’s just ok.
records.text: It’s just ok.The new selection is not as appetising or as varied as Gusto. A lot of the meals are at an additional cost per portion which leaves really boring options. The portions sizes aren’t the best and several recipes haven’t included things like ketchup, mayo, honey, etc which gusto does. Overall pretty disappointed after swapping from Gusto so will be going back. But I’m sure if I hadn’t have had Gusto first I would have been pleased.

records.title: Recipe was great , but green beans inedible
records.text: Recipe was great , however green beans were so stringy they were inedible .

records.title: Good meals but can be inconsistent….
records.text: I have been receiving Hello Fresh for the past 12 weeks.  The deliveries have been timely and all ingredients contained for each menu.  However, this week has seen ingredients that are not relevant to the menu for example, I should have received Brioche hot dog buns and hickory smoked sausages and I did not receive either but instead received some mince beef instead.I hope this is just a little oversight this week and I’m hoping this is not a regular occurrence.

records.title: Unhelpful, rude customer service agent
records.text: Was quite happy with Hello Fresh, but a couple of times my meal selection wasn’t saved, I got half the meals I was expecting. On the 2nd time  decided to contact them because I was charged more than half the money for only half the meals. Usually their customer service is very good. But the agent I spoke to was so rude and unhelpful that I ended my subscription and have been using Gousto for a couple of weeks now, which is a bit more flexible too.

records.title: Terrible customer service
records.text: I called the customer service team after I was charged but had cancelled the box/subscription and decided not to go ahead with the subscription. The first call was answered and no one spoke so I called back I spoke to someone and she said she would process a refund and put me on hold, she then disconnected the call! I currently use Gousto and expected the same level of service I had from them but have been very disappointed

records.title: Trying to cancel my subscription and…
records.text: Trying to cancel my subscription and it’s not letting me online, tried to call too and nothing, still taking money out Other than that there stuff is great

records.title: Some great meals but some really poor meals
records.text: Some of the standard priced menu options are really good,  whilst others, which in my last deliver was chicken thighs and couscous,  you even had to supply the honey yourself, was tasteless and the ingredients you could buy from Aldi/Lidl for £1 was such poor value,  why is it that sometimes everything is included and then in other often cheaper value option you have to provide a number of ingredients from your pantry!.  HelloFresh need to be consistent,  one of my last delivery’s was a vegetarian type curry but the veg was all rotten,  so essentially there was nothing but rice and sauce,  but yellow fresh only gave me a £2.52 credit,  for a meal I could not use.

records.title: Unwanted deliveries
records.text: I skipped all deliveries over the Christmas and New Year period, but due to HF not having deliveries on Christmas and New Year's Eve, they went ahead and reinstated deliveries for a different day, despite the fact I specifically skipped all deliveries during this time. This has led to unwanted  meal choices, food waste, inconvenience, and extra expense on my part. I'm not impressed at all.

records.title: Average fella review!
records.text: Like many people, we have had many offers sent our way by these meal prep companies so have tried these for the past few months. We don't have boxes regularly but gave them another go this week. The recipes are ok on the whole, the portions are on the small side and we often bulk them out with sides. It's a good way to try things you may not usually and you get the exact amounts, rather than buying big bags or things you'd never use again! The two main problems with Hello Fresh over the other one we use (beginning with G) is 1) quality and life of ingredients and 2) clunky app and customer service. Every box we have had has had some issue, today's was mouldy green beans on arrival, but it's often short dates on the meats (2 days sometimes) or veg that goes off quickly, we usually lean away from salads. (You'll end up buying new) and carrots. Buying more kinda defeats the purpose though. Issue 2 is if you have to complain, they are very quick at automatically refunding you if you say you had problems but you can only use that credit on full price boxes. Now we are 8 boxes into our 10 at 30% off so actually haven't seen benefit yet. I wanted to send a picture of the ingredients in question but the email address vanishes faster than sherry when grannies round. So I went to the chat, went through the bot to a laboured chat with a thoroughly pleasant agent who just totted off the script. I go a link to a Google form which actually doesn't work. They then asked me to do feedback, upon looking it's very much typical feedback on the person on chat and not the company, all asking you for answers structured to what they want to hear...not what you want to say. Much like many nowadays. Am I going to use them again? Who knows, I don't see the point of using a service supposedly to save time and money to actual do neither of those things...Update...after the reply below, what is the point of 3 days life on items in a 5 day meal box?

records.title: Terrible customer care
records.text: This seems like a great idea, until you realise how expensive the meals actually are after that hook of 50% off your first box. Plus delivery.My big issue is that I’ve amassed a big credit ( partly due to their non delivery of one order  - that went into my “credit account” rather than being refunded ) that I can’t use until I’ve taken all the discounted boxes on offer. Problem is - I don’t want to take a pile more of the discounted offers- they aren’t that enticing and  I’ve fallen right out of love with the food offering and the customer service.Such slippery eels to deal with by chat or on the phone, and there’s no contact info for sending an email, which is my preferred method of communication. I’d love one of their customer service staff to resolve my issues, refund my balance or let me just use up my credits and call it a day.Can’t see it happening, just more brush-off.The longer the issue is unresolved; the more unlikely I am to use or recommend the company.Be really careful before you’re drawn in by that first offer - if you have a couple of issues and maybe don’t like the food and don’t like the company’s ethos : You’re stuck with money in credit that is too hard to access.Plus you need to be right on the ball to get your food choices in or skip meals - I’ve found it ALL really difficult with my ADHD issues that make much of my experience with Hello Fresh really triggering and anxiety causing.

records.title: It it could have been excellent
records.text: Excellent idea and I will be looking into other companies to supply me after I've had to cancel. Unfortunately we have cancelled because we were getting rotten food being delivered and in complete recipes quite often.

records.title: Food is great, delivery is poor
records.text: Food is great. Delivery is poor. When you rely on food being delivered and it's not, and then cancelled, it fundamentally takes away any advantage of being organised and committing to the scheme. Being charged for delivery is also an issue when it hasn't been delivered on the day agreed, isn't great.

records.title: Bad start.
records.text: Bad start indeed. Deserts which had been selected did not arrive and the call to the help centre brought an indifferent response. No compensation offered. Attitude was deserts were free anyway but, of course, that is not the case. It is part of the overall package. The meals themselves were certainly tasty but a bit of a nightmare sorting everything out.

records.title: I’m a private customer & I ordered 36…
records.text: I’m a private customer & I ordered 36 Churchill plates yesterday & they arrived today, they’re absolutely stunning,  truly a brilliant service, thank you Benton’s & Churchills Will definitely be ordering again

records.title: Reliable
records.text: Had two brilliant shop experiences with BGBENTON. Mr. Darren Benton was very helpful and the communications were fast and smooth. Will definitely use them again.

records.title: Great levels of service

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: I came across Benton’s late last year as I was searching for someone to supply me with additional cutlary to add to my collection. records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: Bought 24 x Luigi Bormioli Michlangelo Masterpiece glasses. Arrived promptly but sadly one was broken in transit.  A replacement glass was sent out straight away. Great customer service.

records.title: Fast delivery
records.text: Fast delivery, got my glasses the very next day and for £20 less than my usual catering equipment provider !!! Brilliant all round, I never leave reviews but this was one i needed to shout about! Well done Bentons! From the Frontline Club London

records.title: Very pleased
records.text: Very pleased with overall experience. Good website. Good price and prompt delivery. Reasonable shipping though most do free shipping over £100 nowadays. The cutlery is pretty good quality with a nice heft. Overall good VFM and would recommend to friends.

records.title: A top company to deal with!
records.text: Have used this company on a couple of occasions now and have found the service provided to be outstanding. Although I had a small issue with a couple of items on my first order, the issue was quickly resolved by Bentons within just an hour of me raising it!  From start to finish, I found the whole process straightforward and felt very much reassured that the company I was dealing with really cared - would highly recommend.

records.title: Good communication
records.text: Good communication Problem with my order which was efficiently and quickly resolved with good communication

records.title: Came very promptly
records.text: Came very promptly, well packaged, all in perfect condition and looking and smelling gorgeous! No complaints at all, thank u!

records.title: Brilliant products they smell fabulous…
records.text: Brilliant products they smell fabulous I ordered online the company was reliable would re-order again great service...

records.title: Before coming with friends
records.text: Before coming with friends, we read a lot of reviews about local hotels, and unfortunately most of them were not very nice. We had discussions about where to stay because we didn't want to spoil our holiday.

records.title: Ordered 12 coffee cups and got 6, treated poorly
records.text: Ordered 12 coffee cups, received 6 in a box with a paid invoice for 12.  Called to find out what was going on, was told an incorrect code had been used by the company and the price was for 6.  I asked for a full refund with return post (I would also have accepted 6 more cups or half my money back including VAT), but was told by person answering phone that she didn't know what to do.  Was told an e-mail reply would follow, no reply 4 days later so sent company a request for a reply. More than a day later, no reply.  Will escalate to trading standards if no reply with solution soon as I can see no reason for a wrongly coded order for 12 to not be picked up after receipt , processing and before despatch.  Very, very poor customer service thus far.  Very disappointed.Update:Have received a reply from one of the Directors to say that a partial refund has been made for which I am grateful.  Will happily deal with Bentons again.

records.title: Poor communication & Shipping
records.text: Expensive product. Poor communication and very slow shipping.

records.title: Promises unfulfilled
records.text: BG Bentons offer Churchill crockery with a 5 year non chip warranty or replacement if it gets chipped I sent them emails for the plates and bowls  within a few months of bulk purchase last year which got chipped but despite sending reminder emails and numerous calls, they just wouldn't respond and neither replace them and simply said we have replaced them !!!

records.title: A glass arrived broken and I’ve sent 3…
records.text: A glass arrived broken and I’ve sent 3 emails requesting a refund and not had a reply, or the refund.

description: Official site for the Burger King UK chain of fast food restaurants, featuring menu items for breakfast, lunch and dinner!

records.title: Burger King East Kilbride
records.text: It's been a while since I was last in Burger King but would definitely go back. Food was great, quick friendly service and the place was clean!

records.title: Very tasty when hungry
records.text: Very tasty when hungry, certainly welcome on cold nights. Staff very friendly and polite. Nice to know there’s always a Burger 🍔 King near at hand. Wouldn’t go anywhere else!

records.title: Ethan was fantastic help
records.text: Ethan was fantastic help, my app is more up and running thanks to him

records.title: Went to burger king Liverpool
records.text: Went to burger king Liverpool, can not fault them enjoyed every mouth full, not a fast food fan but really nice 👍

records.title: Why don’t you make it more complicated
records.text: Why don’t you make it more complicated, was about to spend £20 but want me to create accounts etc , Make it simple as now cook at home

records.title: Brilliant staff good food and excellent…
records.text: Brilliant staff good food and excellent price and made my daughter smile ,

records.title: Steven
records.text: StevenBurger King Wrexham was really chatty and helpful. Gave my boys Christmas hats and was super lovely

records.title: Plant based Whopper was fantasti...and…
records.text: Plant based Whopper was fantastic...and totally filling ! Very enjoyable and satisfying.Bamber Bridge Burger King venue was nice and clean to sit in and staff helpful .Thank you

records.title: Fantastic....Great brand ambassadors
records.text: Fantastic,I attended at BK Bristol airport and as a diabetic my blood sugars were dangerously low. I was served at the counter by Elitsa and Kokila who prepared my meal as a special dietary order. My meal was promptly delivered.As I walked to the nearest table my shakes became worse and I was unable to carry my tray.Shifas came to my help but was too late to stop me spilling my food. Kokila then helped me by replacing my drink and together with staff did a good job of clearing up.... Shortly after and as I was enjoying my meal , feeling much better by now each of the four members of staff are to check on my welfare and how I was enjoying my meal....Great ambassadors for the brand.... Well Done and many thanks..... Great support when  not every disability is visible

records.title: Burger King Bromley centre where my son…
records.text: Burger King Bromley centre where my son insisted on going there claiming their food was tastier than MacDonalds and I was impressed. I had a very nice tasty cheeseburger and very tasty chips. I returned today looking forward to a repeat tasty meal and loved it. Now it’s my favourite fast food. Staff on both occasions were polite smiling and helpful. Tables were clean too.

records.title: Birchhanger green services
records.text: Birchhanger green services - fast and fabulous but really why give me a receipt asking for feedback only to find the survey doesn’t work. Totally irritating and would be better if it didn’t exist!  If the woman who served me had smiled and your survey had worked you would have got a five

records.title: Milton Keynes Shopping Ventre BK
records.text: Milton Keynes Shopping Ventre BK: Good tasty burgers but the quality of the bread was poor. My bread roll fell apart. Never understood why burger joints don't try freshly baked bread rolls. On the whole we were happy with the meal.

records.title: Went to get BK food at Alicante…
records.text: Well after saying I would not go back, I did! The reason being they were one of two outlets that were supposed to redeem easyJet vouchers. The other one didn't honour this so walked straight up to the BK counter to find out how and they took my order right then. Result. Only 4stars instead of the 2 mind as after the last visit and also the burger wasn't great. Previous 2 star review:Went to get BK food at Alicante airport. No menu, no pre-pricing info. Their software was useless. Could not order easily so gave up and went elsewhere. I'll remember that experience, unlikely to use again.

records.title: Fair play for what you pay for
records.text: Generally overall a decent experience. You'll find longer wait times compared to other fast food chains of a similar level, and slightly higher prices, however the food reflects the quality of that. The only downsides are: lack of new variety of foods ie limited editions, season releases and where we are, they tend to be out of stock of the smaller items, cupholders, etc which ends up being quite an inconvenience when it's a regular thing and you're driving. But they definitely have their recipe right with their whopper.

records.title: Stockton Burger King
records.text: Stockton Burger King. There's always a wait for food but it's always made there and then and nice and hot. The only worrying thing is they always seem to have a chair jamming open the fire escape door for fresh air. Surely this is illegal. Aside that. Food is always great.

records.title: Tattoo
records.text: Food was well cooked and tasty. Only letdown was the fat tattooed young lady who took our orders,  although not rude she had attitude which left us feeling uncomfortable.

records.title: I just left mcdonald's a bad review so…
records.text: I just left mcdonald's a bad review so I think I should leave you a good one as I've not had any issues with the bks I go to. I shouldn't have even tried mcdonald's as it was an awful experience.I've taken a star off because you don't accept cash which is very weird. However , I think the deals on the app are great so I don't have issues with the prices like others here. Mcdonald's deals are non existing

records.title: Wrong meal changed immediately
records.text: I am on an almost red meat free diet but I suddenly had a craving for a burger, so I popped into my local BK (near ASDA, Swansea) when out shopping. It was my first visit in about 5 years...and they got the order wrong. The server thought I wanted a chicken burger. I brought it back and explained to the supervisor it should have been an Angus steakhouse. Without any issue, he changed it straight away and was apologetic. Thumbs up from me.

records.title: I love Burger King
records.text: I love Burger King. Their burgers are full of flavour and make their nearest competitor's offer look like something you'd see in a toilet bowl. You may have to wait a bit longer for your meal to be cooked, but this means it's fairly fresh. It's just a shame there is no longer one near to me now I've moved.

records.title: We are always welcomed.
records.text: We are always welcomed in our Burger King,at Ramsomes Eurro park Ipswich, Carl the manager is cheerful and helpful.

records.title: Great customer service and food…
records.text: Great customer service and food delivered quickly and tastes delicious.Well mannered team👏

records.title: Wigan Branch Robin Park
records.text: Wigan Branch Robin Park. I was served by a lively lady called Dawn. She looked cold to the bone it was -5 outside and wernt much watmer in the building.Get the staff warmer clothes please. Dawn was run off her feet, and was very busy. It appeared she was running the front of house alone. She deserves credit as she really helped me out. I was served around 20.30pm 15.12.2022Food was ok I had the vegan options.

records.title: Good location at Armstrong Way
records.text: Good location at Armstrong Way, Willenhall. They have good food and friendly staff.

records.title: The fast-food pretty much decent…
records.text: The fast-food pretty much decent personally Quality rated 8/10* food along with the service.

records.title: We visited the Macclesfield branch this…
records.text: We visited the Macclesfield branch this evening and was a little disappointed at the appearance from the outside, untidy and unkempt but was extremely pleased with the service provided once in store, Adam, who served us at the till, was extremely, patient, polite, pleasant and helpful, his product knowledge was amazing and he provided a professional and prompt service, he was an excellent example of the model employee and role model for Burger King, thank you and well done Adam and Burger King.

records.title: I like to eat a Whopper Meal
records.text: I like to eat a Whopper Meal. Very reasonable price for this meal.

records.title: Desent food friendly service
records.text: Date of experience: 05 October 2023

records.title: The whopper burger is pretty good
records.text: The whopper burger is pretty good, the pickle type stuff and the mayonnaiisesie go well together. I would recommend I think. also out of all the big fast food chains, burger king have the biggest burgers and the best chips and they give you a free sachet of maryounasise which I put on my chips sometimes.

records.title: MY HUSBAND HAD  WHOPPER BURGER ON …
records.text: MY HUSBAND HAD  WHOPPER BURGER ON 18/5/17when I have tried to get a code so he can have free one tomorrow14.6.17 although  it is still in date I am told I cannot get a code  notfair. It is not as if it is really free because you still have to buy chips and a drink. Last meal was £7. 29 so not cheap.

records.title: Lovely staff in Birmingham bull ring…
records.text: Lovely staff in Birmingham bull ring area. We went at a very busy time so there was a wait but staff handled it well despite the seemingly low staff number. Very polite and fast to take our order :)

records.title: Freezing
records.text: My main complaint was that it was freezing cold. I don't know if it was you, or the service stations responsibility. When we were leaving the one at the KFC was working.When our food came, it was really nice, no complaints there.Bk12062 Charnock Richards

records.title: Restaurant was quiet during our visit…
records.text: Restaurant was quiet during our visit and we were served fairly quickly. Service was okay and staff were helpful. Food was done and provided within 5 minutes. Food was very nice and hot; certainly comparable to other restaurants that we have visited. Disappointing to see some litter on the floor and some of the tables could have been cleaner. However, overall, not bad.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: Last month in Thailand I went for a Burger King meal, something I very rarely do.  It was fantastic, fries were superb and cheese burger juicy and tasty.  Based on this experience we visited a BK in Brighton and ordered the same, what a disappointing experience.  Fries nowhere near as good, nowhere near as crisp or tasty.  Burger dry and tasteless.  Guess I will wait until back in Thailand!

records.title: Good food, poor advertising
records.text: The food was lovely and well made. It arrived promptly after ordering. Service was okay. My biggest gripe is with their current advertised offer of a free child meal with an adult meal. It only lets you apply one offer code per order, so no matter how many adult meals you order (in our case 3) only one child meal is free. A small gripe, but when you have a lot of children it makes a big difference.

records.title: Hickstead Branch
records.text: Hickstead Branch, Sussex.  The food and service is generally good, but they've not had milkshakes available for several weeks, and today, they had no Chicken Nuggets, no Onion Rings and no plain milk drinks.  Somebody who is meant to manage stock needs to get their act together.  Also, to get an XL Bacon Double Cheeseburger like it used to be, you now have to pay for 'extra' bacon and cheese, otherwise it's more or less a plain dry double beef burger.  Rather a cunning way to increase prices?

records.title: As dry as a cream cracker
records.text: I called into burger king at the metro centre after noticing a poster for various chicken melt sandwiches.The posters were very impressive and I chose a barbeque chicken melt. The picture showed a sandwich loaded with cheese and barbeque sauce.What I got didn't resemble the picture at all. There was the tiniest sliver of what appeared to be cheese spread and a miniscule sliver of barbeque sauce.If I hadn't known what I'd ordered I would have thought it was a plain sandwich. It was so dry I felt like I'd eaten 2 dry cream crackers.I'm giving 3 stars because the chips and the coffee were good

records.title: Buck Up in the UK
records.text: Burger King Warrington WA1 never has Fanta Ice Drinks. I ordered a Argentinia Angus Meal and got Steakhouse Meal. WA3 Warrington Burger King is full of grease and never has summer drinks. Great tasting when you get the right order but over the last year Burger King UK have slipped in quality and too many restaurants are not getting the summer drinks and yet KFC are.

records.title: Price inverse proportion to quality
records.text: I note that the cost of the food has gone up recently on an inverse proportion to the quality of the food.  They appear to have either changed their supplier of burger buns or their supplier has also reduced the quality.  BK are still better than McDonalds but we are now talking small margins.

records.title: Should I start too worry about Burger…
records.text: Should I start too worry about Burger King!  Advertising at Stansted airport for USB charging for phones and tablets but the charger points have all been turned off, obviously the cost of living crisis is hitting harder than I thought!!!

records.title: Good but pricey
records.text: I went to my local Burger King around tea time 5-6 and the service was quick and the lady who served me was really nice. Only down side to Burger King is if you don’t have there app to get pretty good deals you can be paying quite high price for a standard meal. Compared to there other competitors it’s an overpriced fast food restaurant.

records.title: cookie dough
records.text: main meal was great. I had chicken nugget meal with a diet coke. I then ordered a small cookie dough through deliveroo expecting a tray with warm/cold cookie dough in that i could microwave or eat normally. However, i received ben and jerrys cookie dough ice cream.

records.title: So so
records.text: So so. Fries and drinks are delicious, but burgers not so good. I once picked up a few burgers somewhere on the road between the Czech Republic and Poland when I was traveling. It tasted like an old sole. It all depends on the particular cafe.

records.title: i was not happy with my milkshake i…
records.text: i was not happy with my milkshake i asked for a strawberry went down and they gave me a vanilla and then i went back in and they had given me another vanilla i asked did they give me strawberry and the replied the machines having bit of trouble ansploytkey fuming !!! chips were good tho !

records.title: Ordered a delivery from New Brighton…
records.text: Ordered a delivery from New Brighton and had stuff missing. Not good! Tried ringing them 10 times and just goes to a message saying that they can't accept messages right now. What a waste.

records.title: Burger King needs to cook the burgers…
records.text: Burger King needs to cook the burgers longer so they would look more appealing and taste a lot better. They look like they're barely cooked with some grill marks on them.

records.title: BK in Newport Retail Park
records.text: BK in Newport Retail ParkService was a bit off-hand and casual.Chips were piping hot and great… but such a tiny portion for the price. :(Whopper by comparison was cold and had too much of the white sauce so it was slippery and the sandwich quickly fell apart.I can cope with the slippery burger.. but it was cold. I would’ve took it back but I’d already eaten half of it, since it was tasty... but cold.Their drink mixer may have been just having a bad day but my Cola was watery and tasted off.. I thought it was Pepsi.Not a great experience…

records.title: My son
records.text: The service at burger King worksop Is really good and the staff are really nice and helpful but the food has gone really downhill over the past couple of years it used to be my sons favourite place to go and now he prefers mcdonald's.

records.title: Place freezing  no heating
records.text: Food very good and the place was extremely cold told heating not working which was the same months ago when we were last year very poor but staff very helpful I apologise about the heating but head office should have sorted this a long time ago

records.title: Went toilets with my wobbly snake on my…
records.text: Went toilets with my wobbly snake on my hand in burger King cheltenham. We sat down trying to figure out what to buy. Still wobbling my snake. We checked out the kiosks. We ordered. Sat down and waited for the order. We both played with my wobbly snake. Wobble Wobble. We got our order. We forgot the extra dip. So we paid for mayo dip pot. But we got given 1 for free. That is crazy. My snake hisses in disagreement and Wobbles even more

records.title: Called at Burger King at Thinford Co. Durham (Spennymoor) ordered a whopper burger as I didn't want a meal, didn't realise till I got home,paid by card, the burger cost 5.99 yet a full meal is 4.99
records.text: A whopper cost me 5.99 burger cost me 5.99 but meals advertised for 4.99 did not see mistake until I got home

records.title: Bk has lost its customer service
records.text: Bk is a occasional treat but I always get the same thing and never have an issue getting water to take 3 tablets with my meal. Apparently the Watford town centre branch is unable to provide something so simple without me actually purchasing a drink - that I don’t want or need more than a few sips of. Customer service at its best. Thanks for a great experience

records.title: Ordered the Angus smoked cheddar and…
records.text: Ordered the Angus smoked cheddar and bacon, very disappointed to find it was served in brioche, this is virtually a cake! I was in the bakery trade for many years, we put jam and cream, sometimes custard in brioche, not meat. Why not proper burger buns? I ate most of the meat and cheese, but threw the bun in the bin. Sadly my last visit.

records.title: Went to Sunderland roker
records.text: Went to Sunderland roker, food tepid as if left 15 min before service daughter had hot choc which which was also tepid, when it came back had brought coffee. Not a patch on Newcastle Station branch

records.title: Customer Service? awful
records.text: Went to Burger King for a Whopper yesterday, and the food was great—but wow, the service was terrible. The guy at the drive-thru was rude, didn’t greet me, and practically threw the bag at me. My order was wrong, and when I asked for it to be fixed, he rolled his eyes like I’d asked for a kidney.Got my corrected order after waiting, but the fries were cold. No apology, no care, nothing. Food’s good, but the attitude? Absolutely not. Anyone else dealt with this?

records.title: Poor food and service
records.text: We went in after a lovely evening wanting something tasty and quick but the service was bad and the food was cold, the whopper I ordered was just a burger and relish no onions or tomatoes and the same for my partner very disappointed especially it being in bath city center…. Even the just eat delivery people were walking out because they got fed up with waiting so long! I’m afraid we won’t be going back!!

records.title: Expensive and poor service.
records.text: A meal at Burger King is about the same price as a main course in a pub, so the only thing Burger King can do to make up for this is decent customer service. Unfortunately good service is not their strong point. Staff are generally not yet old enough to vote, so I won't be too critical of them. The support they have is clearly limited and at the Alfreton, Derbyshire branch the staff seem to wander about and take an age to do anything. Good luck resolving any issues with your order, and don't think you'll be able to claim a 'free' item if you provide a review, as you need a receipt to do that, and the self service order points always have no printer paper, so be quick to note your order number.Not a bad burger when you get it, but customer service is poor for the price

records.title: Overcharging at till…
records.text: Wrote a year ago about tasty burger king but in Ictober this year they tried to charge me over five pounds for a cheeseburger and fries. I told the assistant that wasn’t right and asked how much each item was. £2. 69 for the cheeseburger and £2. 49 for fries. Said again it’s not as much as that but she gave me a cold stare insisting it was. I walked out. This was Bromley town centre. Watch their pricing at the tills.

records.title: Yes been going to burger king years
records.text: Yes been going to burger king years. Had most of the menu. Used to be great flame grilled tasty burgers. Now just reheated burgers with salad. Often cold burgers or overdone. New menu stuff to much money. £12 for 1 meal at one recently. Not good. Only good thing is endless drinks. Also got food poisoning from Preston north one. And send food back 2 or 3 times in Liverpool recently.

records.title: Annoying.
records.text: Took my three young grandchildren today to burger King in Macclesfield   Whilst placing my order in shop another two customers were back during to order missing. I had some of mine missing also. All quickly sorted out. They were quite busy at the time but only had one member of staff taking orders at the till. Where was everyone else? Surely more staff are required taking orders at lunch time? However my young grandson has lost his little blue ladybug. Thinking it maybe left behind I tried several times ringing but no one ever answers. To say he is distraught is an understatement

records.title: Rubbish service
records.text: You’re reliance on using the machine with no other option is ridiculous. There re problems the kids working there can’t resolve. Maybe employ adults with a personality might help also. Hickstead Burger King has one older guy there who is very helpful. Nomatter what the teenagers just look blankly at you. And offer no help. Had an awful experience.came away with NOTHING!

description: The online farm shop established by the Sealey family to market the produce of Fossil Farm, their family run farm located in South Dorset.

records.title: Best meat around!
records.text: We've been shopping from here for a couple of years. Today I cooked 2.3kg King Arthur's Roast. On the advice of Sam, 220 degrees for 10 mins, then 140 degrees for 3.5 hours. My 82 year old dad, said it was the best piece of beef he's had in years. It was tasty, moist and moorish. Accompanied with usual veg and celeriac and parmesan gratin. They also do fabulous cheese you won't find in a supermarket. Highly recommend!

records.title: Just Better!!!
records.text: I just enjoy cooking so much more now that I'm buying from Jurassic Coast.  Everything I buy is fantastic and I daren't waste a single ingredient by not putting the effort in.  Honesty, the food quality is so undeniably better that it has created a huge spark of passion for cooking.

records.title: Support local farmers
records.text: Delivered on time, well packaged, quality meat produce. We won't be going back to supermarket produce again, it's good to know how and where our meat is processed and support local farmers 👍😊

records.title: Excellent produce
records.text: Excellent produce, the lamb mince is tasty, the lamb stew packs were marvelous and I hope the noisettes will be the same.

records.title: Absolutely delicious pork!
records.text: Staying in East Lulworth for the weekend so Iordered, meat and vegetables for Sunday lunch.  It was hard to choose from such a good selection but decided on the large Porchetta.  Left it slow roasting whilst out and returned to the most delicious pork and crackling. Ten people devoured the lot!  I cannot recommend highly enough, excellent quality produce plus friendly, helpful butcher.

records.title: An amazing gem of a butchers, in Dorset
records.text: The produce is second to none, The knowledge and enthusiasm of the butcher/server was brilliant and gave good advice about cooking tips and also able to give advice on specific cuts. He was so helpful we purchased and pre ordered more cuts of meat, It is great to be able to order and have locally sourced meats. 5 Stars alll day long.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service meat for occasions youCan't go wrong I highly recommend them

records.title: We get meat from Jcfs every year
records.text: We get meat from Jcfs every year and it is always beautiful. We tried the king Arthur's roast beef this year and it didn't disappoint. The sausages are great. Loved the sausagemeat and added breadcrumbs to use it for sausage rolls. Great meat and great service. Will definitely keep buying from this amazing farm shop.

records.title: Great value
records.text: Good price, lovely quality, low food miles from producer to consumer, delivered on time. Now that our local butcher is closing and there's not another we can easily get to, we'll be buying here again.

records.title: As usual
records.text: As usual, quality of the meat and fish we bought was excellent, however the Fish Pie Mix arrived frozen which has meant I could not divide in half; a more suitable size for us. I don’t think the advertisement said the mix would be pre-frozen.Otherwise delivery and packaging were up to your normal high standards! Happy Christmas to all.

records.title: Almost 5 stars but
records.text: Almost 5 stars but box needed more cooling packs only  2 when I think 4 was needed. When opening I did not feel contents were quite cool enough and included chicken. In freezer immediately and used in 2 weeks as a bit concerned.Meat was great but really feel more Ice packs needed when using Postal delivery.

records.title: Good value box of high quality meat…
records.text: Good value box of high quality meat products, overall very pleased.  Would have been 5 stars but I asked in the order notes for gluten free sausages and got ordinary.  Also (as coeliac person), I don't understand why sell any gluten containing products (sausages, burgers, sausage meat) when gluten free is possible, no loss of quality and then everyone can eat them.

records.title: Usually all deliveries are good…
records.text: Usually all deliveries are good quality and I enjoy all that is to be offered by Jarassic Coast Farm shop, however I recently I bought some diced venison and almost every other piece was full of gristle, which made a much looked forward too and carefully prepared casserole very disappointing ... hence only 4 stars!

records.title: The King Alfred’s roast was absolutely…
records.text: The King Alfred’s roast was absolutely delicious. Would definitely order again. Maris Pipers not so good but everything else veg wise great.

records.title: Excellent meat
records.text: The meat we have had so far  has been excellent but the haggis was not so good,  so much so that we threw it out in the food waste bin.  Very disappointing as we were looking forward to it.

records.title: I have been associated with Jurassic…
records.text: I have been associated with Jurassic coast meats since covid meant we were in lockdown. It is of great help to place an order, have it delivered on a stated day by kind drivers. The quality of the food is very good and I will continue using the service regardless of covid status.

records.title: SO HAPPY
records.text: Fantastic to have such a great business on my doorstep.  The top rump joint I got as part of a meat box was easily the best I've ever had, comparable to a large joint you would get at a carvery.  Loses 1* because the sausages given were pork and leek not the pork as advertised.  Will shop again as long as it's as advertised.  BRILLIANT

records.title: Beef box
records.text: Beef boxThe beef was lovely. I would have given 5 stars but - The meat packets were not labelled - Use by date was on the day of delivery, so had to freeze all the meat- Roasting joint was under weight by 250 grams

records.title: Very good food
records.text: Very good food.  Everything was just a real pleasure. Would highly recommend a visit.

records.title: Always good produce…
records.text: Always good produce… first time ever the broccoli was rubbish

records.title: Great produce…
records.text: Great produce only the chicken was smaller than expected

records.title: I have been very satisfied with…the vast majority of the fruit veg meat and fish I have received.
records.text: I have been very satisfied with everything that I have purchased from Jurassic Coast farm until today, when I received a Fruit box with a punnet of fresh Strawberries the vast majority of which were visibly mouldy and most of the rest were soft and rotting. Not sure this cold snap is a time for delivering fresh strawberries Guys!

records.title: This is the second delivery I have had
records.text: This is the second delivery I have had, There were a couple of the fruit items last time which were disappointing, so will not order fruit again. The mince was very good, so ordered more.  The beef sirloin was not up to standard,so,again will not re order that. Had some steak which was fine though,so maybe unlucky before. I will use again,but not the fruit.

records.title: As usual the meat and goods I received…
records.text: As usual the meat and goods I received were of the highest standard, I ordered veg for eight people for Christmas dinner, my only gripe was I received two red cabbages one of which was enormous and no carrots which I would have expected. I therefore had to pop out and purchase carrots, which was no big thing but a little disappointed they were not included, the only thing I could think of was perhaps they had run out and therefore an extra cabbage was sent.

records.title: Excellent products
records.text: Excellent products, on time, however notification to confirm delivery would be good.

records.title: High quality meat responsibly produced
records.text: High quality meat responsibly produced. The disadvantage is all about online buying as have to rely on the picture. In a butcher’s shop, you might not choose the joint you get.     However, this negative has to be balanced against very good meat and excellent delivery.

records.title: Our complete experience from order…what’s not to like....
records.text: Our complete experience from order placement to delivery was very good. The quality, taste and value for money of your products is quite exceptional.....and, because the delivery distance is short, you are doing your bit for the carbon wheeltrack, 😉. Well done Jurassic Coast Farm!

records.title: Super efficient delivery and great…
records.text: Super efficient delivery and great quality food. Many thanks! Only constructive feedback would be please tape closed the raspberry punit In future as they arrived as pre made jam inside the box!Will be using the service again and will recommend to friends and family.

records.title: The delivery had everything we needed
records.text: The delivery had everything we needed. Unfortunately the two containers of raspberries had mouldy fruit in them meaning we had to throw half of them away. The rest of the food was fine and I’m grateful to them for a much needed delivery at this difficult time

records.title: Meat looked lovely and was tasty
records.text: Meat looked lovely and was tasty.  A little more information of weight of piece of meat that I had would have been helpful.  More aged meat, and rare breeds, or unusual cuts also would be lovely to be able purchase using this method.

records.title: Excellent meat
records.text: Excellent meat, late delivery with no explanation. If I order again I will collect myself as I need accurate delivery times

records.title: Disappointed at number of items that could not be frozen.
records.text: The quality of the meat is excellent, the fish not so and on this occasion tasted as if it had been frozen for a long time. I purchased a number of meat items with the intention of freezing many of them but was disappointed when a number of products arrived with stickers saying they had previously been frozen and should not be refreezed.  It would be helpful to know this when ordering.

records.title: Room for improvement
records.text: For the most part, the products were good. However, there was a leak from the Chinese pork loin packet which meant the house stunk AND also the freezer and its contents too. We need to defrost the freezer now. Also, when the delivery arrived, it was delayed by several hours, and some items were beginning to not feel particularly cool at all.

records.title: I have to say that we were looking…
records.text: I have to say that we were looking forward to trying some nice locally produced food, but very disappointed with the beef.  It was tough, flavour was ok,but would not buy again.  Milk nice, haven`t tried the lamb chops yet,so hope they are better.  The fruit was not good either.Very disappointed, but you have to try these things I suppose.

records.title: Environmentally unfriendly packaging
records.text: It took a little while to arrive but goods pretty much as expected when they arrived.Was not impressed with the packaging, no consideration for environment,  non degradable silver lined bag. This is such an important matter given the move to online shopping for more and more goods.

records.title: Disappointing delivery
records.text: 3 lots of meat had previously been frozen and therefore being a household of only two we had to eat the same food for 3 days. Two of the items were put at the bottom of the box and were completely flattened and squashed together. Disappointing  delivery

records.title: Good fresh meat but fish that's been frozen and poor communication
records.text: I ordered three lots of fresh fish intending to cook one lot and freeze the others until they were needed. When it arrived it had already been frozen - the use by dates were the previous month. I think that communication would have helped - I'd like to have been told beforehand. Communication is poor in other ways - only an hour's notice before an early morning delivery on a hot day when the food would have suffered if we were out and it had been left in the hot porch. Luckily someone was here.Also the one time I emailed about a delivery, there was never any response.The meat is good quality and the choices are good and I'd have given 5 stars but poor communication and previously frozen fish gets 3 stars.

records.title: My order was not complete on arrival…
records.text: My order was not complete on arrival very disappointing as my order was taken  2/3 weeks before delivery. You stated the mussels were out of stock and would be delivered Thursday or Friday but today is Sunday and still no mussels or even contact made why not? To late now will not be around for the next 2 weeks.As a chef for over 55 years I would expect any suppliers to deliver on time and make sure any short falls arrived when stated. This was my first order with you and if this is the way that your going to run with your customers it’s a very bad start. Have not tried a lot of the meat as yet, the veg was of a very good standard I’m just hoping the meat will be the same.

records.title: I've only given 3 stars because we've…
records.text: I've only given 3 stars because we've had to stop our weekly subscription and make separate orders each week because the weekly subscription didn't come every week or on the preferred day!

records.title: Most of their meat is excellent…
records.text: Most of their meat is excellent although some chops fall short of the standard expected. Moreover, their customer service is not quite on the ball with a lack of response to an ongoing complaint.

records.title: Most of the meat was delicious
records.text: Most of the meat was delicious, and delivery worked well again. But unfortunately the chicken went off within it's use by date which left us without a sunday roast.

records.title: The produce is very good but it doesn't…
records.text: The produce is very good but it doesn't always arrive when expected!

records.title: Hock dressed up as gammon
records.text: My order included a 2kg gammon joint. It was hardly gammon and cut very long down the hock. Even skin was wrapped round the knuckle end. When cooked and sliced, it was clear by the separate muscles that this was not what the average person expects a gammon joint to be.  This was almost misrepresentation and I was palmed off with a poor quality joint. When buying online, you can’t inspect what is being offered and so expect an honest, high standard service.  As this joint, and also the large brisket joint I ordered (which was extremely fatty) were bought to feed visitors, I was very disappointed.

records.title: Would order from the shop but not online…
records.text: Would buy from the shop but not online again. No chill box as described to keep produce fresh, had to ask a stranger to use their fridge, you need to amend your website homepage, therefore!

records.title: Started using JCFS during lockdown but…
records.text: Started using JCFS during lockdown but remained a regular customer due to quality of product and flexible service. I was however  not totally happy with my most recent delivery in that the cod was clearly from a different suppler from previously and was very thin with one pack significantly under weight. Also the fillet steaks were from the thinnest part of the fillet and although to weight were long and thin making them very difficult to cook. I contacted JCFS through their website expressing my disappointment but even more disappointing is that I have had no reply! I

records.title: Poor quality meat and non-responsive to emails
records.text: Delivery was fine and the driver friendly.  However, the quality of the meat was not good at all.  The burgers, meat balls, mince and sausages were just so full of fatty, chewy bits that they were pretty much inedible and many meals ended up having to be thrown away.  When I opened the chicken to cook, the smell was so terrible that it also had to be dumped.  So I effectively wasted a lot of money with this company.  Very disappointing, but what's worse is that they have not responded to my complaint email.  I have given them time to respond before posting this, but they have failed to do so.

records.title: Will not use again I was given a…
