records.text: Will not use again I was given a delivery slot and the driver didn’t arrive until an Hour later after the times given.Then not only that I was not given everything on my order I phoned them to be told that the driver would not be returning back and would try to bring my items the next day we’ll nothing arrived I feel I have been let down as they have my money and I don’t have the goods sorry will never use them againAlso today I was going to cook some pork and leek sausages I bought from them only to find the packet was totally blown up with air which means they were off really disgusted about this as they were not out of date for the next couple of days so had to throw them away more money wasted on this terrible company

records.title: Convenient delivery but worrying meat quality
records.text: Convenient delivery with a good choice, however the meat I ordered went off well before the use by date. Burgers had started to grow mold 2 days before use by.

records.title: Delivery was over  2 hours late
records.text: Delivery was I er 2 hours late, even though I was a new customer,  all the produce was poor quality including vegetables  and fruit, well past sell by date not enough variety,  gave me so much ginger which I dident  order, no carrots , meat was tough chewy and old,  felt this was deliberate to fob of on me as I'm single, don't recommend , some cheese was okay,  generally  poor quality

records.title: Meat was left next door
records.text: Meat was left next door, elderly neighbour awoken at about 8 a.m. to find it left outside her door after answering doorbell and finding  no one there.  She very kindly came across to me as she was worried about it being left in the open.  I saw later a notification left on my computer at 7 ish in the morning telling me it would be delivered.  But as I was asleep then, it made very little difference.  A pity I was not told during the day before that it would be delivered so early, and to a different address.

records.title: Should have had a meat delivery on the…
records.text: Should have had a meat delivery on the 24/7/21, never had any communication from them on the 24/7/21 they just never turned up despite taking my money on the 16/7/21 when the order was placed. I had to go out a purchase meat from elsewhere, so my bbq could go ahead, will never use them again.

records.title: You didn’t provide me with 2 items for…
records.text: You didn’t provide me with 2 items for a meat box they I bought for my mother for mother’s day. You didn’t tell me, didn’t substitute them and took full payment, I phoned, you said you would get back to me and you haven’t and I do not see any credit in my account. You also offered a discount if I subscribed to your mailing list, I expected this to happen at checkout, it didn’t and I just see you have offered £10 off your first on-line order. Talk about kick in the teeth!

description:
THE NO.1 PARTY BOTTOMLESS BRUNCH DESTINATION IN LONDON

We was bored of bottomless mimosas/bloody marys and eggs benedict/pancakes with not much going on.

So.. we created Lovebrunch. An affordable, lively party brunch that offers a wide variety of food, even for the fussy eaters - WE GOT YOU! We ensure our drinks include cocktails, prosecco and beer to include variety. We are for the people.

Between the team, we have experience in Marketing, Graphic Design, Social Media, Event Management and of course.. brunching! This makes the perfect combo for London's BEST brunch experience.

records.title: Super fun evening brunch
records.text: We booked the Rihanna vs Beyoncé brunch and it was so much fun!! Me and my friends had the best time. The staff kept the drinks coming which was great. The food is even really nice! Even with us being a bit late due to train delays, they didn’t mind and still gave us the full 90 minute drinking time.

records.title: high school musical brunch
records.text: Went to the high school musical brunch and had the BEST time. From the moment we sat down they were so attentive with drinks. Food was incredible and so filling! The DJ was really great and was really making sure everyone was having a wonderful time! Would recommend to anyone!!

records.title: Best brunch ✌️
records.text: Best brunch I’ve been to. The staff stayed on top of drinks, there was plenty of waiting staff around to assist with those regular refills 🫢 but also to accommodate any other needs we had. The music and dj were great, venue is beautiful which had really nice lighting which just set a proper party vibe. Absolutely loved it and can’t wait to return.

records.title: Halloween after party
records.text: Went to the Halloween after party on Saturday and it was brilliant. The music, staff, location and atmosphere was 10/10. Billy did a great job making sure everyone had a good experience and will definitely be keeping an eye out for future events.

records.title: Once again, best night out
records.text: I come here 3/4 times a year and have an amazing time every time. food,drinks & service are unreal. Loved the high school music brunch. What a throw back! The Dj spot on and did shout outs for my friend for her birthday. Will defo be returning before the end of the year.

records.title: The best vibes and the staff are…
records.text: The best vibes and the staff are amazing ! Always have the best time here!

records.title: Absolutely loved it!!
records.text: Absolutely loved it!! Will defo be returning and recommending!!

records.title: Booked my first lovebrunch for…
records.text: Booked my first lovebrunch for halloween! We booked the North Pole one and honestly cannot recommend enough. It was really well organised, wasn't a long wait for food or drinks. Everything ran smoothly unlike other brunches I have been too. All staff was dressed up and looked good. Kruger and the Nun was great! I also really liked the wider choice in drinks that you could have with brunch, meaning you wasn't stuck with the same consistantly. Will 100% be booking another!

records.title: Absolutely incredible evening
records.text: Absolutely incredible evening. Very welcoming, great atmosphere, amazing entertainment. Food was on point, drinks flowed. Had the best time for my birthday will definitely be booking again 🤍
Music bangsAtmopshere 10/10 never any troubleDrinks flo Food decentBeen to many brunches (also loads of live brunch)Love brunch by far my favourite The staff put in so much effort x

records.title: So much fun!!
records.text: We attended the RNB brunch in Greenwich which was so much fun! You get lovely food & lots of drinks. Jugs of cocktails & bottles of Prosecco. Definitely get way more than what you pay for. Music & vibes were brilliant. One thing I would say was, we emailed over a week before the event confirming someone in our groups allergies. However, the food was still brought out containing the foods she was allergic to. The birthday girl also didn’t get a drink with a sparkler in it whereas every other table did. Apart from this we had such a great time & would definitely go back.

records.title: Was a good day
records.text: Was a good day, however food wasn’t great, all of our burgers were rock hard, the high school musical songs should’ve gone on the whole time not just half the time

records.title: Brilliant atmosphere & The music was…
records.text: Brilliant atmosphere & The music was unreal all night at the DJ ironik event. However the food wasn’t great, it was a shame to have the Christmas menu as all the food options were quite heavy for a brunch & didn’t taste to good. Would defo go back for the drinks and atmosphere though!

records.title: Love coming to the brunches here
records.text: Love coming to the brunches here, especially ending the evening in the shisha garden. The food is good, but the cocktails are even better. Just a shame with the current pandemic they can’t have DJ’s or the dance floor open.

records.title: Great brunch
records.text: Great brunch, but would be a little better if they stopped skipping songs halfway through and played more popular songs sometimes. I’ve been twice, and the first brunch I went to I only knew about 2 songs! Other than that its a nice experience x

records.title: The evening was wonderful
records.text: The evening was wonderful, I never regretted that I went to this place for dinner with friends)

records.title: I have been twice now and have another…
records.text: I have been twice now and have another booking coming up. My first brunch was for the ‘MAGIC MIKE NIGHT’. The food was really nice and drinks did not disappoint. The atmosphere was very lively, staff were very welcoming and polite. I will defiantly be re booking for the next magic mike night. The dancing crew were very professional and had a laugh. They communicated with the brunch customers well and everyone had a laugh. My 2nd trip was for New Years Eve. The food was again very nice and we carried the new year in downstairs at their after party. The DJ was excellent and created a simple club atmosphere with a twist. The bouncers are also very polite and took care of everyone. I like the fact that they have different areas and we had access to all. The shisha garden was very chilled and prepared us for the crazy night ahead. All of the punters that entered out of the brunch were all very nice and blended in well. It was a great night! I only wish that some of the slots could be a bit longer as we love it upstairs. The organisers are very polite and fast with responding. They defiantly know what we want from a brunch and I can’t not wait to carry on brunching with them x

records.title: Magic Mike 7th August 2021
records.text: I attended the Magic Mike night on the 7th August 2021 with a few friends! This night was defiantly needed after Covid - We have been to this event before in the past and it shows that the love brunch team step it up every time! We will go to this event again in the future. 💃🏼The atmosphere was very lively and everyone was so friendly towards one another - it was like one huge friendship group! Everyone was singing and dancing, taking photos of one another etc. An amazing girls night out! 🥰The dancers and MC were great and ensured that everyone was involved which was nice to see. The routines and music were good. The MC ensured that he “kept the party going” at all times. You could really tell that everyone was enjoying themselves. 💗The staff were lovely like always. They were very fast with their orders and service which was unexpected due to how busy the night was - Well done team! 👀The love brunch owners were there which was nice as they are always so welcoming and chatty! A lot of owners of other establishments are not normally very interactive with their guests but Billy & Kasie always are💗The cocktails were VERY nice! I personally recommend the passion fruit heaven and sunbathing pink lady! I ordered the nachos for my starter and they were lovely. Very cheesy with the perfect amount of side dips. I then had the chicken shish for my main which was nice but I wish they had the chicken burger on the menu along side the beef. I did try one of my friends crispy breaded prawns which were unreal and I will definitely order next time! - I do get nervous ordering fish on a night out😅I would like to thank everyone at love brunch for yet another brilliant night. I’m sure I will see you all soon as this is one of my top three spots to go and favorite brunch!💗

records.title: Fab night
records.text: Always have a fab night here. Tanya is the best waitress so helpful and friendly!

records.title: I went on the Juilbie weekend it was a…
records.text: I went on the Juilbie weekend it was a bit closed off was expecting more decor for that weekend other then that it was ok

records.title: We was told to arrive dead at 5pm which…
records.text: We was told to arrive dead at 5pm which we did as that when the brunch started. we didn't get our first drink till 5:45pm to be told the brunch stopped at 6:30pm and could not have anymore drink. Staff member was called to be told we can have 1 jug for a table of 7 people and that's it. Such a shame as the food and music was good.As response to below :no drinks where made up front and I was even asked to pay the bill up front before iv had anything which I did question. We had eaten and still no drink.

records.title: Good atmosphere but poor service…
records.text: I visited Love Brunch on the first Saturday after lockdown. The atmosphere and food was amazing however, I thought the staff were unprepared. When we arrived none of the staff seemed to know where we were sitting and was asking each other until we eventually sat down. We had to keep getting the attention of the waiters for drinks, they never came over asking if we wanted anymore drinks. This was also the case for the food, we paid for 3 courses but only got 2 as the brunch time was up and we had another booking. If the customer service improved I would go back to love brunch.

records.title: good points and bad…
records.text: This brunch has good points and bad points!! Bad points: food isn’t amazing, I’ve had much better boozy brunches for the same price so do your research before choosing, cocktails come in large jugs full of ice so are really watered down meaning it doesn’t really feel like a “boozy” brunch. We had a party of 20+ people and a waitress accused one of our group of not paying for their brunch (she only had 19 receipts) meaning I had to pay twice to cover the missing person. However I do think this was a mistake from the brunch staff and perhaps they had lost a receipt as everyone in my party were able to prove to me later that they had paid. Booked a table for everyone in the shisha lounge downstairs for afterwards however they gave us a tiny table for max 12 people which was annoying as we had to scramble together some extra tables and chairs by ourselves and service was mega slow which again is annoying as we were on a 2 hour time limit! This shisha part is separate to the brunch I believe so is more the responsibility of the North Pole itself but is still worth noting for anyone looking to visit. Good points: really good communication over email prior to brunch, staff and owners really lovely and music was good! Probably would return but as a smaller group.

records.title: the service was pretty slow
records.text: the service was pretty slow. and was only allowed one hour not even the full 90 mins

records.title: The drinks were very watered down &…
records.text: The drinks were very watered down & wasnt a lot of garage/club anthems getting played at the brunch

records.title: Magic Mike brunch was great for the…
records.text: Magic Mike brunch was great for the first room but the dancers never came into the back room, well they did for 5 mins. I was told that they would be floating between rooms but that was never the case! Most of our back room was in the main room trying to see the dancers or even getting a lap dance from the men. I was very disappointed about the brunch and I didn’t even feel like it was worth the money especially with the group. The food was okay, a little cold but edible to eat however not a great option of food choice from the mains dinners. My group complained to the members of staff and we only got ‘free shots’ for the table because we couldn’t hear the music through the speakers in the back room as no one knew how to work them. I would appreciate if you could take this review in consideration.

records.title: Disappointing…
records.text: We booked this brunch for a hen party of around 20 people. We arrived at the venue 10 minutes before the brunch was due to start to find that out table hadn’t even been set. The staff was still clearing up and putting the tables together. We were able to enter the restaurant and find out seats at 3pm. By the time all of our party was sat down we waited around 15 minutes for our first round of drinks. Before all drinks had arrived to the table the waiter come round requesting payment for the brunch, a member of our party queried the amount we were paying as it was more than we expected to pay. The waiter then said that we were paying almost £10pp for service charge which wasn’t optional as some of the party had already started paying it. The waiter become very rude and left us no option but to make payment. Once payment had been made by everyone it come to light that we was actually being charged for a 3 course brunch rather than the 2 courses we had booked. We then all had to be refunded back to our cards for the over payment, receiving no apology from the waiter demanding the payment. I have to say the manger (I believe) was very helpful and arranged the refund straight away however this took time off our brunch. Starters arrived and everything was fine. We then all received our main course but one (pregnant lady) who received her meal when everyone else had almost finished theirs. There was a couple of people not drinking due to pregnancy however still had to pay the same amount as everyone else drinking alcohol. Meaning the none drinkers had paid £50 for 2 courses and 1 coke. Which is very expensive. By the time all the party had finished eating we were told that our brunch had finished and we now had to pay for drinks. Not taking into consideration that out brunch did not start on time which was no fault of our own. Again the same waiter was very rude when refusing us another drink. Our whole party during the whole brunch managed to only have either 1 bottle of Prosecco or one jug between 3 people which was not what you expect for a bottomless brunch. I’m not one to write bad reviews however the whole experience was very disappointing and extremely over priced especially for those who wasn’t drinking. Food needed to be pre ordered however there was still problems. Due to this experience it unlikely that I will be booking another Love Brunch and will find it hard to recommend to other.

records.title: Wouldn’t recommend
records.text: Attended 14th December for my birthday. This is my 2nd time attending. It was held upstairs, on first impressions looked quite good plenty of photo opportunities. On being seated we picked our drinks etc. the sex on the beach cocktails are watered down with lemonade which made us all feel really sick and bloated after a while? Why put lemonade in sex on the beach it already has 2 mixers in it? Anyway the food was ok, could’ve done with just starter and some chips. The wrap was soggy and not very nice and they took ages to bring it out. As the time went on for a room packed with people there was no air con so it was really hot upstairs. No drinks were allowed downstairs when going for a cigarette which I was not comfortable with leaving in this day & age (spiking etc) so I took ours down with us. It was clearly booked as a BIRTHDAY BOOKING. They brought sparklers on drinks for every single table apart from my table, no shoutouts of my name to say happy birthday etc. I expected nothing less when the same thing happened 2 years ago to my friend for her birthday booking. It’s just embarrassing when your mates are singing happy birthday filming on their phones expecting something to come over like everyone else and nothing does. And then I have to ask for the same treatment as everyone else. They also overcharged us of £175 for 4 people at the table. When it should’ve been £151.80 which I also had to take up with the waiter. The only decent thing was they actually had a DJ this time round rather than playing music off of someone’s phone where you repeatedly heard notifications going through 2 years ago. So at least the dj situation has improved. We left 45 mins early. Would recommend to go elsewhere

records.title: Normally everytime I come we have a…
records.text: Normally everytime I come we have a good time but this time we went to a funky garage and grime one and they played about 3 songs within the genre? Please tell me why you’re playing ABBA ffs… really disappointed.

records.title: Very disappointing night
records.text: Very disappointing night. The music was meant to be garage yet the DJ was playing ABBA lol. Bring back the old Dj. Left early.

records.title: Booked 2 hour ‘bottomless brunch’…
records.text: Booked 2 hour ‘bottomless brunch’ 3:30-5:30 to be told on the day of arriving we can only do until 4:30, staff then corrected herself to say 5pm. I explained this is 2 hours she said from 5pm we cannot order anything else. Staff are very rude & advising wrong information

records.title: If I could rate it no star I would!! Avoid
records.text: If I could rate it no star I would We went to the dinner brunch as advertised 6-9 which was cut short by North Pole bar Greenwich overbooking there venue and stopping the brunch at 8pm after everybody had paid because of the football. The environment became hostile no staff at the venue were being helpful and when me and my 7 other friends and other people at the brunch contacted love brunch they took no responsibility as told us to contact the venue after being directed back to love brunch by the venue. Love brunch sold and advertised a series that was not given to the paying people avoid at all costs!!!

records.title: Would never go again !
records.text: Would never go again !! Undercooked food, burgers were still raw. Inadequate service, meant to be a bottomless brunch but was never asked if we wanted any more drinks. Even though that wouldn’t matter as the cocktail jugs were 5% alcohol and the rest juice. We were made to think we had to pay the added £15 service charge aswell. Do not go !!!

description: Welcome to Fruit4London. We supply premium quality Fruit & Veg to Offices & Homes all around London. Our service is timely and flexible and we’ll bring your fruit or veg directly to your office or home any day* of the week.

records.title: Fresh fruit and veg from farm to table!
records.text: Good quality fruit and vegetables, carefully packaged, delivered by friendly drivers. And sourced from farming communities beyond London, supporting the food growers. What's not to like??

records.title: This was a present for my friend who…
records.text: This was a present for my friend who was ill. Although I never got to see it, my friend was very happy and it arrived nice and early on the day.

records.title: Love it!
records.text: I received my 1st box of organic fruit and veg. Looks and tastes delicious. I'm definitely ordering more as I just noticed I can 'build up my own ' choice of veggies and fruit. :)

records.title: Brilliant service
records.text: Brilliant service, fruit supplied is always fresh and tasty, as well as long lasting.Such lovely helpful people too

records.title: Always deliver on time
records.text: Always deliver on time, good price and good fruit!

records.title: Friendly
records.text: Friendly, helpful delivery people and good quality fruit.

records.title: Great way to get a healthy snack
records.text: I work in a school, it’s so hard to avoid cake and biscuits. The fruit box means I can get a healthy snack whenever I need it. I really enjoy seeing what is in it. There is always a good range of regular‘everyday’ offerings and fancier fruit to keep interest. I really rate the delivery and customer service too. Always so helpful.

records.title: Excellent customer service & beautiful basket
records.text: The recipient was very pleased with the beautiful fruit basket.I sent Fruit 4 London a few questions before I put an order and they were always quick to reply and very helpful. Definitely use again.

records.title: Fantastic quality produce
records.text: Fantastic quality produce. Reliable delivery.Would recommend and will continue to use Fruit4London for the foreseeable.

records.title: Super Fruit & Veg delivery service
records.text: Brilliant ! Great delivery & amazing fruit & veg !. We’ve been using Fruit 4 London since the beginning of the covid lockdown 2020. The quality of the produce is superb, often receives complements when it’s on display in the kitchen, even more when eaten. Delivery has always been on time & delivered with care. Highly recommended this company.

records.title: Happy customer
records.text: Great service- very consistent with timings and the fruit is always fresh :)

description:
Easy and delicious yoghurt made by you!
Our freshly made yoghurt is all natural with two probiotics (A+B) and four active cultures. It is gluten free and a good source of calcium. 
Yoghurt is a healthy and wholesome food for the whole family, and can be freshly made in 3 easy steps with Hansells Yoghurt.​

records.title: the yogurt takes about 10 hours to be…
records.text: the yogurt takes about 10 hours to be ready but it can be left much longer and it never turns acidic.  It is beautifully creamy and can be used  instead of cream on desserts as well as a host of other uses. It would be brilliant if the sachets were recyclable.

records.title: Consistently the Best Yoghurt!
records.text: Absolutely love Hansells Yoghurt! I've been a loyal customer for over three years and always come back for more. My recent online order arrived quickly and was perfectly packed—no issues at all. Honestly, I don’t even consider trying other brands because Hansells has everything I want. Highly recommend!

records.title: Great product fast delivery
records.text: Great product fast delivery

records.title: Quick delivery
records.text: Quick delivery. Nice yogurt although not my favourite flavour as that’s been out of stock for a while. Easy to make.

records.title: Great taste & texture
records.text: Quick delivery. Lovely thick & creamy texture with subtle flavour, and not too sharp. Minimal whey separation. Made it up at night & put it in the 'fridge next morning.

records.title: Excellent product
records.text: Excellent product. Makes the best yogurt.

records.title: Best value for money
records.text: Easy to see what you want and quick to arrive always prompt,also they taste fantastic as well much better than others

records.title: My order was delivered to me in two…
records.text: My order was delivered to me in two days ,very pleased with the service . I always use Hansell yogurt it never fails to please . Well done.

records.title: I was very pleased with what l received…yoghurt maker
records.text: I was very pleased with what l received from the company, the advertisement for this product was spot on, l got exactly what was shown. Making the yoghurt was so easy,done in a couple of minutes, the end result was delicious, will definitely be ordering more sachets, so healthy too,and no milk required, one of the best things that l have purchased, great value,a must have.Well done Hansells!

records.title: Highly recommend Hansells Yoghurt
records.text: Very pleased with the product - have purchased many times for 3+ years . Received online order within a few  and very well packed etc. Highly recommend and not interested in purchasing other than Hansells !

records.title: Excellent taste of product
records.text: Excellent taste of product. Easy to make

records.title: Delicious yoghurt
records.text: Delicious yoghurt, used to do my own years ago.  As I am diabetic I would appreciate more less sugar varieties.  The problem I’ve had was with delivery by Evri.  I was given three different dates and times.  As it happens it was third time lucky.

records.title: Great yoghurt
records.text: Company great to deal with as ever. Yodel less reliable with delivery but that isn’t Hansel’s fault. Though they might be better moving to a diff company that deliver when they say they are going to. Always love their yoghurt & no plastic pots to recycle either.

records.title: You know what you are getting
records.text: This my third lot of Hansells yoghurt, I used to be an Easiyo fan but they don't seem to sell the ordinarily yoghurt, it's all novelty flavours. What I particularly like about Hansells is that they tell you what's in the pack essential for those of us with allergies. I use the plainer flavours as a topping on fruit.

records.title: Natural unsweetened yogurt
records.text: I really only like the plain unsweetened yogurt and I was a bit worried having to buy 12 of them as I’ve had an issue with short shelf life before. But this time it should be okay. I love all the unsweetened natural yogurt and would have liked a mixed case again

records.title: Good products
records.text: Good products, have used these for a while now as cheaper than other yoghurt mixes, and as good if not better. Well packaged items and always arrive safely. Good communication so you know what’s going on with your order.A few more flavours would be lovely please!

records.title: No plain Greek yoghurt
records.text: As usual with Hansells everything about ordering and receiving my parcel was good.  However, substitutions had been made.  No plain Greek yoghurt was included but 2 extra Lemon were substituted.  It would have been good if I had been contacted to let me know about this.  I don't mind the lemon but its not my most favourite flavour and I now have 3 of them.  No plain yoghurt for my baking. I do wish that Hansells did a "pick and mix" pack where you could chose your favourite flavours.  However, the service and the product was excellent and I only dropped to 4 stars because of the unexpected substitution.

records.title: I have acknowledged my disappointment…
records.text: I have acknowledged my disappointment with Hansells, they have stopped selling single packs of the yoghurt mix and now offer 6 packs or 12 packs.So if you want 3 flavours like I did, it will now cost you £52.50 for 18 packs, instead of £17.00 as my last order.Sorry my last purchase done!!Update at 9th May...Thankyou for acknowledging your reviews, I have today made a purchase, small one albeit, but happy customer once more.:)

records.title: Generally happy with products EXCEPT…
records.text: Generally happy with products EXCEPT the Lite Greek natural yoghurt which is grainy, won’t be buying this again.

records.title: They make great yoghurt but the video…
records.text: They make great yoghurt but the video says to put it to set 8 to 10 hours I put it for 15 hours also I  had to send for another one because the maker wasn't setting the yoghurt on the 4th one I ordered that's why I put 4 stars

records.title: A Quality Product
records.text: When I placed my order I knew I was getting a top quality product. It was well packed and delivered quickly.The only problem was with their website which meant I was unable to place my order for a couple of days. I emailed my problem to them. They responded quickly and the problem was resolved.

records.title: Have previously and the yoghurts are…
records.text: Have previously had and the yoghurts are great. Still awaiting on latest delivery,blaming yodel as they have had at local depot for 48 hours.

records.title: Delivered quickly and reasonably…
records.text: Delivered quickly and reasonably priced. Makes lovely, tasty and thick yoghurt. Only slight gripe was that one of the packets was best before 11.24 so I used that one first.

records.title: The process of ordering to delivery was…
records.text: The process of ordering to delivery was efficient and quick. I love the Greek style natural yoghurt and always order this type, unfortunately it had been out of stock for about 4 weeks so there was a serious delay on my being able to order.

records.title: Excellent product
records.text: Excellent product but felt the shipping was overly delayed. Paid on 28th April but didn’t arrive until 5th May would have felt it could have been quicker.

records.title: Yoghurt is delicious.The downside is…
records.text: Yoghurt is delicious.The downside is having to order so much to receive free p+p.If you have a discount code this can cover p+p so isn't so bad

records.title: The delivery man came a day earlier…
records.text: The delivery man came a day earlier than then warning e-mail suggested. It was lucky I was in.I’ve used Hansells yoghurt over many years now, usually from Amazon. So I thought I would give you a go this time.The product is lovely and would deserve 6 stars!

records.title: Was waiting a long while before my …
records.text: Was waiting a long while before my  yoghurts arrived but they were quick sorting out the problem

records.title: Easy ordering for a great product
records.text: Easy ordering for a great product. Pleased with free delivery, and discount. The yoghurt I have known for years and seems the best value for a yoghurt mix.Great offers on the website.Thank you Hansell

records.title: I have always had a good service with…Good service with good yohurt!
records.text: I have always had a good service with Hansells Yoghurt. Its good yoghurt as well as the administration.

records.title: Great products but short dates on packs
records.text: Brilliant yoghurt maker and really good yogurt. Very disappointed though as I bought 2 x 12 packs of yoghurt and all the packs had a very short date, some only a few weeks till out of date! The ones that were reduced on their website because of short dates, had longer dates than the ones I paid full price for! Certainly don’t think this is acceptable. Not sure if I’ll be a returning customer as I’ve never had this problem with the other company’s yogurt I bought it always had more than a years bb date.

records.title: I’m sure it’s just personal choice
records.text: I’m sure it’s just personal choice, but I really didn't like the texture of this yoghurt. Probably others like the rather glutinous mixture….but I prefer a more set yoghurt.

records.title: The order was cancelled by Hansells
records.text: The order was cancelled by Hansells and the money is due to be refunded. I emailed to ask for an explanation but initially I did not receive a reply, however upon submitting the original review I was contacted and advised that unfortunately they had run out of stock of the item ordered. The matter has now been resolved.

records.title: I like the product but I was…
records.text: I like the product but I was disappointed that the classic natural doesn’t have a long shelf life. As I ordered 12 packs it’s going to be difficult to get through them all before the best before date.

records.title: stock control is not very good
records.text: stock control is not very good, lets you order an item but it goes out of stock

records.title: Rubbish delivery company
records.text: Disappointed with delivery company. A week late!! Understand Hansells are changing this.

records.title: Need to be better at recyclable packaging.
records.text: Yoghurts arrived together (2 sets of 6) in a recyclable box, but their individual packaging isn't recyclable and they still haven't a huge range of flavours. Iknow Rhubarb and berries of different kinds are available elsewhere at a good price so now I only buy from Hansells for the flavours not available elsewhere.

records.title: Mixed flavour packs at cheaper rates wanted.r
records.text: Still prefer recyclable packaging!! Use crushed/shredded card instead of plastic pillows for protection.  Would like more flavours, and a mixed pack at cheaper rate, like the all-one- flavour packs are much cheaper than individual packs. Not happy, as I can get a similar type of mix that works with Hansell system but much cheaper and more variety.

records.title: Easy to make
records.text: The making utensil system is neat and compact and the yoghurt is easy to make.  The taste is different from another well known yoghurt mix and it does not set as thick.  This fruit flavoured yoghurt does not taste quite as fruity and the greek and coconut yoghurt is not as nice.  It could be that my taste buds just need to get acquired to this newer yoghurt mix.  It is not unpleasant, just a little different.

records.title: Expiry date should be indicated
records.text: I wrote to enquire the expiry date because only the unsweetened Greek yogurt indicate the expiry date.  Without any reply from you While the autumn sale is ending, I make my purchase.  It is disappointing that they expired within a short time

records.title: Disappointed in expiry dates
records.text: Quick delivery,  but disappointed in the expiry date. This has now been added on the website after an email to them but it wad too late for me and I'd multi ordered. The yoghurt itself is very tasty.

records.title: After signing up for the news letter
records.text: After signing up for the news letter, It gave me a code for 10% off, great I thought,  No, not available, when I placed my order.  Husband tried, same,!!!!! Website not the best,  why offer discounts then withdraw them at the end!!!!!!

records.title: Ordered 12 sachets but only received 6…
records.text: Ordered 12 sachets but only received 6 although still charged for 12.  Remaining 6 sachets arrived following my request.  Would have been 5 star if it hadn't been for the cock up with packing and delivery.

records.title: Ok but expensive for the price of £15.
records.text: Ok but expensive for the price of £15.Easiyo  yogurts which I normally get it from  Is cheaper for 8 sachet and £10.Hansells are expensive and only 6 sachet and £15.

records.title: First time I have used this product
records.text: First time I have used this product, (I have used other makes before .)I find the coconut yogurt( my favourite) quite bitter , not tried the other flavours yet.

records.title: When we order we get a confirmation…
records.text: When we order we get a confirmation email but not any further despatch details letting us know when we might expect delivery. But apart from that it's a good service.

records.title: I was unable to get just a pack of…
records.text: I was unable to get just a pack of light yogurts of the flavors I had before so had to mix with thick and creamy so not really what I wanted but still bought them x

records.title: Yoghurt taste…
records.text: I am very happy with the Yoghurt texture. However most taste rather bland. Is it possible to improve this?

records.title: Ordered 8 packs only 7 were delivered
records.text: Ordered 8 packs only 7 were delivered. Emailed them and they have since sent the missing one.

records.title: Not impressed
records.text: Not impressed, my order hasn’t arrived.  Evri have not delivered TWICE.  I emailed Hansells twice,but no reply.  Shoddy to my mind.

records.title: Stay clear of lite version
records.text: I ordered selection of flavours directly from Hansells own website.  Delivery was swift, I have no problem with the company or their processes.  Unfortunately I find their lite version of yogurts deeply unpalatable slop. I cannot be sure that it was crystal clear when ordering that I was buying lite version.  As a result of this I now have a lot unusable stuff.  The texture of lite yogurt is horrid, slippery, unpleasant.  I will be returning it as it's unfit for human consumption.

records.title: I have used this product before so I…
records.text: I have used this product before so I know what I have to do.However, despite following the instructions ( including using ambient temperature water to mix with the powder), my Thick & Creamy Mango & Passion fruit has NOT 'set'...very dissatisfied.Still deciding whether to drink it or 'toss it' instead.If it happens again in the next few days, when I make my next batch...the rest is going back for a refund and won't be purchased again.

records.title: Rubbish delivery
records.text: Ordering was great packed and sent quickly….. but then your delivery couriers are appalling the parcel was delivered to my front door step in poring  rain driver did not knock on the door we have a ring doorbell so all on camera!! Hence parcel was soaking wet and in full view of a very busy road .Please change your courier this is not the first time it’s happened.They could have delivered to a neighbour but they don’t care . I will be looking for a new company to buy the yogurt.

records.title: Ordered on Nov 19th,Yodell lost parcel, use reliable Royal Mail instead for customer satisfaction
records.text: Ordered on Nov 19th, order got lost with apparently wrong post code, however when I received the goods on Dec 1st the correct post code was on the parcel   . Hansells also  compensated me with replacement goods which also arrived on Dec 1st, these arrived by Royal Mail, so I suggest in future Hansells use Royal Mail & ditch Yodell who obviously can,t deliver goods on time.

records.title: This was my first purchase, but....
records.text: This was my first purchase from Hansells Yoghurt and sadly will be my last.Where do I start???Overall website was easy to navigate and order plus everything was half price as I had a coupon code.What you call your Coconut greek yoghurt is one of the most disgusting things ive ever tried,I personally wouldn't call it greek yoghurt in fact I wouldn't call it yoghurt...it had a very odd texture, unpleasant taste which was artificial and it was more of a very sweet dessert.I don't like wasting food but this ended up in the bin.I think someone needs to go to the drawing board and improve the recipes.However your thick and creamy strawberry yoghurt was edible.I will be ordering elsewhere from now on.

records.title: You need to use a much better delivery…
records.text: You need to use a much better delivery courier- Whistl are awful - so slow!!!!

records.title: Duped by Company closing down
records.text: Bought this as a Christmas present as it was highly recommended.2 days after purchasing the yoghurt maker and 12 sachets of yoghurt mix I received an email to say Hansells were closing down. No more yoghurt sachets in the future.  Feel completely let down as clearly the Company knew they were closing down.

records.title: Disappointed with Expiry Dates and Packaging Quality
records.text: UPDATE: (18/07/24)They have vaguely promised to replace any unused sachets when they expire, but they stopped responding afterwards. It would make more sense to replace the quantity that I cannot consume now instead of waiting for it to expire. I will leave it to you to evaluate their customer service.ORIGINAL REVIEW: (02/07/24)I ordered 36 sachets on July 2, 2024, but the parcel was severely damaged. Fortunately, the sachets inside weren't damaged.The worst part is, all of my 36 sachets were produced on July 10, 2023, which is 12 months ago, and are expiring in January 2025, which is less than 6 months from now. I'm disappointed by the fact that Hansell's Yogurt UK expects me to consume all 36 sachets in less than 6 months.

records.title: Great Yoghurt- Disappointing Delivery
records.text: Hansells yoghurts are just fantastic but sadly the delivery let the side down this time. Yodel left the parcel in the pouring rain outdoors DESPITE my secure place being the indoor front porch which is clearly signposted. When I got home after work the cardboard was soaked inside and out. A real mess😒

description: The Alchemist is a cocktail bar & restaurant that celebrates molecular mixology, alchemy and craftsmanship. Celebrate our weird and wonderful products.

records.title: Superb service from the online order to…
records.text: Superb service from the online order to the delivery within a few days . Trust the items will be well received at Christmas :

records.title: All-Round Amazing!
records.text: Brilliant customer service, super super helpful and polite - Jo was so quick to respond. Beautiful packaging, quick delivery, very helpful aftercare with the questions I had. Would order again 100%.

records.title: Got a birthday horoscope reading…
records.text: Got a birthday horoscope reading from the alchemist which I felt was a nice personalised touch from other birthday emails, and then there was the offer to purchase my horoscope print in its gothic style. It came securely and I purchased my own frame. I really like it even though I have no goth leanings. Nice touch Alchemist.

records.title: James is great!
records.text: James helped me resolve an issue with my order which was a birthday gift that I had ordered incorrectly. James resolved my issue so quickly and with such kindness that we decided to visit the alchemist for lunch as we had such great service from the shop!! I now appreciate the alchemist even more and I’m so grateful for such strong customer service. Thank you James - you made our day! ✌️

records.title: These are gifts for a birthday in…
records.text: These are gifts for a birthday in August. Unopened as yet. Arrived quickly and wellPackaged. Didn’t know you had a shop, needs advertising more. Does it have an instagram/facebook page ?

records.title: Fabulous cocktail recipe book
records.text: Easy ordering and payment.  Arrived really quickly.  Lovely cocktail book just to read even if some recipes are a little complicated.  If too difficult just read the wonderful recipes and then have a trip to your local Alchemist!

Everything from browsing online, to ordering and shipping and receiving was easy! The entire ordering experience was as simple as can be. The descriptions for the products were insightful. I ordered the cocktail kits and they're as simple to make as can be! 5 star experience from start to finish.

records.title: We enjoyed ourselves over a drink
records.text: We enjoyed ourselves over a drink Asked about cocktails on line which to choose as a birthday gift really helpfulGift choose and arrived within 3 days Will know later if my son and wife have enjoyed them He did text me saying they were looking forward to a nice nightThanks to staff Nice to know staff understand and can advise

records.title: Nice little selection to enjoy at home
records.text: We’ve been the brindley place bar and  really enjoyed the evening we even bought two hip flasks to bring home. When I saw I could buy some of the Alchemist cocktails to have a little tipple at home and just add ice bonus! Very well packaged and love how they came in medicine bottles. I Bought the cocktail recipe book too. Easy to order pay and delivered on the specified day.

records.title: Lovely gift
records.text: I purchased the alchemist cocktail book for a gift. I had no idea what it would be like as there wasn't much to go by in the way of pictures on the website but the recipient loved it and it arrived really quickly too so I cannot fault.

records.title: Speedy delivery and smooth transaction
records.text: Love the idea of the cocktails being available for home consumption however the one we bought wasn’t for us. The website was easy to navigate though, transaction went through smoothly and delivery was quick!

records.title: Birthday present
records.text: This was bought as a birthday present for my daughter in law so not opened yet. Wish there had been more variety as she loves other cocktails when visiting Alchemist in Leeds

records.title: Don't sell their merchandise on location
records.text: They don't sell their merchandise on location you have to order through their shop and they only do UK delivery. So you have found this place online and you want to visit it on your holiday and enjoy the experience but no merch available to add to the memory. boo

records.title: Sent wrong size t shirt had to email to…
records.text: Sent wrong size t shirt had to email to get rectified. Didn't have it in stock recieved a refund.

records.title: Ordered during Black Friday period
records.text: Ordered during Black Friday period.  Package was ready for collection from 24 November according to email and tracking number, however it was appears not to have been collected until 4 December.  As one item was purchased for Christmas it meant the packaging had to be opened to check products production date - it would be helpful if this information was on stickers which are placed on the outside of the box so both the present giver and recipient could see this at a glance.

records.title: Quarter full cocktail bottle
records.text: I ordered a box of four cocktails as a gift. One of the bottles was only a quarter full. I sent an email with photos and asking for a replacement but you haven’t yet replied and it’s been a few weeks now.

records.title: The cocktails we liked wasn’t in…
records.text: The cocktails we liked wasn’t in there.I asked the bar tender before we ordered the book if they were there and he said they would be.

records.title: Product was delivered damaged.
records.text: Date of experience: 07 February 2023

records.title: Ordered and paid for 48 hour delivery…
records.text: Ordered and paid for 48 hour delivery but 8 days on still haven’t received it

records.title: No personality
records.text: Date of experience: 18 October 2022

records.title: Print purchase
records.text: Prompt delivery and was as advertised and in good condition.

description:
High-Quality Workplace Catering Powered by Independent Caterers.

Trusted, flexible catering for any occasion. Connect with hundreds of independent caterers offering unique, bespoke solutions for all your needs - great food, every time.

records.title: Perfect and DELICIOUS
records.text: Perfect! I ordered a cake to be delivered to the venue we were having a birthday dinner at. Everything arrived on time, with no issues, and most importantly it was DELICIOUS! (Everyone said it’s the best cake they ever had)

records.title: Thank you!
records.text: Thank you to Theo and all the team at &Dine for always delivering top quality, delicious and unique catering options. It's a breath of fresh air to move away from the usual suspects when it comes to office lunches, and instead experience independent, local catering businesses that don't break the bank.

records.title: Can't recommend highly enough
records.text: The team at &Dine are fantastic to work with when catering events. Felicity has helped me with various orders for events, from small to site wide lunches, listening to the requirements and recommending a selection of makers who could cater the events. All the makers I've used have come through with serving delicious food, beautifully presented and on time.

records.title: Lunch for 300 guests at Salesforce Tower on October 30
records.text: Everything was perfect—right on time and well packaged. I really appreciated how the team organized the food, especially given the size of my order, and separated everything just as we discussed. A special thanks to Felicity and Huw for going the extra mile, helping me bring everything upstairs. It was a big help and truly appreciated! Thank you for the excellent service.Best regards, Anastasia

records.title: Great food and delivery tracking was…
records.text: Great food and delivery tracking was handy to have to anticipate when the food will be delivered.

records.title: Delicious Team Lunch
records.text: Our team lunch catered by &Dine was absolutely amazing. The whole process was made super smooth by Felicity and the rest of the team, who were so helpful and accommodating to our team’s requirements.The food was fresh and delicious, really elevating each of our meals. Everyone raved about the courses, so thank you &Dine and makers!

records.title: Hits the mark every time
records.text: We've tried so many other catering companies before &Dine found us and we are never going back! The communication and tracked delivery makes set up and planning a breeze. The packaging doubles as a serving tray and it's recyclable. All this is a bonus to the fact that the food hits the mark every time. There are frequent requests to have &Dine cater our events and yesterday a team member said "this is the best donut I've ever had." Thank you &Dine for creating an easy platform with delicious options that make the whole office smile.

records.title: Exceptional Service & Seamless Experience!
records.text: I recently ordered from Reemies Cakes via &Dine, and I couldn’t be more impressed! The &Dine team truly went above and beyond to ensure my event was a success. From the smooth ordering process to timely delivery, every detail was handled with care and professionalism. They made everything so effortless, which gave me more time to focus on my guests. If you’re looking for a reliable, high quality service that goes the extra mile, I can’t recommend &Dine enough!

records.title: We ordered from Chrissy's Kitchen for…
records.text: We ordered from Chrissy's Kitchen for our team away day. We got both breakfast and lunch and it was perfect. There was amazing choice on the menu that catered to all dietary needs, there really was something for everyone. Charle's was really helpful in guiding us to order the right thing and gave us exceptional customer service. Everything arrived on time and it was absolutely delicious! 10/10 would order again

records.title: Excellent
records.text: Excellent! We needed to feed 350 people over an evening at short notice. &Dine gave us amazing options, did all of the admin and made sure our guests ate the most delicious food, and at a fair price. Will certainly be using them for our next event.

records.title: Accommodating & Great Food!
records.text: The &Dine team were really helpful by tailoring me a lunch menu that was specific / suitable to our requirements. There are so many different catering options to choose from and is great to be supporting independent food businesses.

records.title: Good product, let down by lack of info
records.text: Good product, but slightly lacking in information. The listing implied they were ‘bake at home’ & I had hoped to freeze them, but when they arrived they felt like they’d just defrosted, so I didn’t dare freeze them & instead had to eat 6 croissants in a few days! Also came with no baking instructions - there was nothing on the listing either & I had to contact both anddines & Libby’s ig pages to eventually get the instructions. (FYI anddine office is closed at the weekends, so if you’re getting something delivered on a Friday & might need help over the weekend then don’t count on them!)Glad to see they’ve now updated the baking instructions on the listing so this doesn’t happen again!

records.title: Can work, but can cancel last minute
records.text: Have had good experiences in the past - but this time they just cancelled the order the day before with no reason given. Offered to redeliver it a week or two later but no use as was planning for a specific event.

records.title: Obtrusive and disingenuous company
records.text: Didn't complete my first and only order because it was too expensive and delivery was too unpredictable, which is absolutely not what I want when ordering food to be delivered. To my surprise, I was then contacted by Max, supposedly the founder, on my personal email address - which I had absolutely not given any permission for - to ask for my feedback on why I not gone through with the order, in exchange for a voucher. I decided to help and completed the survey... and then never received the voucher, even after emailing to remind. Not a good practice for a new business. At least you've got some more feedback out of it, Max.

records.title: No tracking code and the delivery was extremely late
records.text: I didn't receive a tracking code on the day. No updates on the delivery ETA or any other communication. I received the order 12 hours after the initially scheduled delivery time.

records.title: I wasted 3 years of my life working for…
records.text: I wasted 3 years of my life working for this company, they don't value hard work or there employees, very unorganised and all over the place, dont waste your time dealing with people like this, very rude and unprofessional, avoid at all costs!!!

records.title: My delivery was delayed twice during…
records.text: My delivery was delayed twice during the day - originally 12-1pm, then 1-3pm.  It arrived eventually, an hour before my guests, by which time I had managed to cook something else.  No warning was given about the late delivery so I was not able to plan properly.

records.title: Terrible treatment of home-chefs
records.text: Terrible treatment of home-chefs. They make promises they don't keep. They took all my menu/intellectual property and kept delaying signing me up since over a month. They dragged their feet every step of the way without giving any clear responses. Very unprofessional and inconsiderate.

records.title: Poor Customer Service! As a customer who previously ordered…
records.text: As a customer who previously ordered from &Dine, I received an email from Max for a survey in exchange of a voucher. I agreed to it and they scheduled a call, I was waiting for a call and they did not call me, I followed up but did not get a response. That was very rude and disrespectful of my time! Will never order again.

records.title: My limited experience with & Dine so…
records.text: My limited experience with & Dine so far hasn't been great...I have been waiting several months for at least two Chefs to return to the platform, but so far, still unavailable and showing as taking a break, so I have all but given up waiting as they are unlikely to ever return after this long...Also, under food preparation, the majority of dishes show microwave  as the only option to heat when we have a conventional oven, so again, not ideal...I have queried this with & Dine with no resolution offered....There really ought to be a conventional oven heating option....On one occasion, despite making it known we do not have a microwave oven, was sent cottage pies in plastic microwavable only containers...I would like to use & Dine but don't see how I possibly can unless changes are made!!!I see NOT A SINGLE RESPONSE from & Dine to any of the reviews on here which surprises me...UPDATE....I'm pleased to have received a response..I don't believe I have ever made threats as such apart from writing an honest review...You must understand how frustrating it is waiting months for Chefs to return to your platform as only they offer conventional oven heating as a opposed to microwave only....I check on your website frequently and nothing has changed. ..If and when things change and I am able to place orders on &Dine, I will be happy to remove my review....I think that's fair, don't you?UPDATE!!No change. .Chefs that offer conventional oven heating still unavailable after several months, plus pretty well all dishes offered are microwave only...Sadly, I still cannot order.

records.title: Terrible service
records.text: Date of experience: 22 February 2024

description: Explore Albert's Schloss, a Bavarian bier and pleasure palace serving up Europe's finest tankards of beer, delectable Alpine cuisine and showtime entertainment every night of the week.

records.title: The Birmingham branch of this brand is…
records.text: The Birmingham branch of this brand is well run, there was enough security staff for women to feel safe there and a very helpful young man called Keelan who worked hard and knew his job - there is a mix of ages, and everyone gels well and service at the bar is efficient.

records.title: 5* service, first class food
records.text: What an incredible experience. If you are lucky enough to have Reece as your host, you will definitely leave the establishment feeling like royalty. The restaurant itself is quirky, opulent and welcoming. The food is first class and the presentation is a work of art, right down to the green beans !. I had chicken cordon bleu which unfortunately struggled to finish because the portion size was very generous, accompanied by the gruyère croquettes which were sublime and the green beans of course which were fresh and subtle. Not bland like they can be. This restaurant is a must to visit, especially if you like German food of course and just as importantly, if you are lucky enough to have Reece as your host. Thank you so much ! (Next time I'll make room for pudding)

records.title: In A.S Manchester
records.text: In A.S. Manch aester on Christmas eve at 4.30pm with family for celebration. Bar service was poor no enjoyment showed by bar staff and it wasnt busy and no acknowledgment present at all for those waiting to be served. If this was my business I would have peoples who attended these venues and watched for themselves how their staff operated. Suffice to say will not go there again.

records.title: Don’t ever try and work for them
records.text: Replied to an ad looking for tech staff for the new London outlet. Had a phone interview with Kevin the tech manager and was told all good. May 21sr got an email from him saying I’d get an availability schedule the next day so cleared my schedule for the week long soft launch and opening weeks. After that was silence. Ignored phone calls, emails and texts. Very rude, shoddy and unprofessional.

records.title: Crap service
records.text: Crap service, I would never ever recommend or use their event ever again

records.title: Awful bouncer’s falsely accusing people…
records.text: Awful bouncer’s falsely accusing people of wrongdoing with no evidence. Shocking people throughout and especially the staff within the fomplex

records.title: Staff were dismissive of my asthma…
records.text: Staff were dismissive of my asthma symptoms so I had to leave early which ruined my evening. I normally love this venue but was very disappointed with my experience at Albert's Schloss (Bold Street Liverpool) last night. I came to see the live show and was really enjoying it until I noticed something aggravating my asthma symptoms. It turned out they were using dry ice which is a known asthma trigger and which meant I had to leave the bar to get my symptoms to calm down. Meanwhile my partner asked the stage manager to turn off the dry ice but she only said she would turn it down. I was outside for quite a while coughing and suffering and did not feel like I could go back in. While I was outside the stage manager went over to my partner and said it's only water vapour! Whether that's the case or not it triggered my asthma symptoms and the inconsiderate reaction of the staff really upset me. This level of indifference could lead to someone having much more serious symptoms like an asthma attack and I had to leave earlier than planned to avoid further worsening my symptoms which ruined what was supposed to be an evening of celebration. The atmosphere was already great until this point and there was no need for dry ice, but what really disappointed me was the dismissive and defensive reaction of the staff trying to say that I should not be reacting to a known asthma trigger! I used to love going to this venue but will not be returning.

records.title: Terrible bouncer
records.text: Asked them to call police as my friend was SA but was laughed at!

description: Enjoy more of what you love - classic pub food at great value prices. Brewers Fayre, the perfect pub restaurant to visit with family and friends

records.title: My wife and I having been calling at…
records.text: My wife and I having been calling at the Brewers Fayre Sandpiper Llanelli for yrs.We had a meal there today and was absolutely delicious. (Curry/Lasagne)We were met at the front reception by a member of staff  Matthew, he was polite, courteous, professional and led us to our reserved table.We ordered a meal with the member of staff named Caroline, who was also professional and efficient. Lastly, 2 male members of staff (sorry don’t know their names) served us with starters and mains who were also courteous and professional.Whitbread  are fortunate to have members of staff like the above and please pass on our thanks to them.

records.title: Happy New Year
records.text: A busy New Year’s Eve at Sandpiper Brewers Fayre Llanelli It is a shame that there’s not enough staff with queues at the bar and to order foodThe staff cope always with a smile Caroline, Becka, Christina, Matt and all the staffHappy New year to all

records.title: Our favourite restaurant
records.text: Our favourite restaurant - Sandpiper in Llanelli. Food is very reasonable and good value. Staff are always pleasant, including Jake, Christina, Ann, Liam the carver who saw to our every needs. making the afternoon go well and very enjoyable. We shall be back  😉

records.title: Had out first Christmas dinner at…
records.text: Had out first Christmas dinner at Brewers Fare (Hampton Peterborough)Absolutely brilliant! Friendly service and food was delicious! Well done to the whole team!Would definitely go again!

records.title: Festive sunday
records.text: Thoroughly enjoyed meal with family and children Carvery upto normal standard and children very pleased with festive menuStaff helpful as usual and run off their feet.

records.title: A party of 4 went to Chef & Brewers…
records.text: A party of 4 went to Chef & Brewers Bookers Oast today for Christmas lunch & we could not fault it. Charmaine the manager & her team were brilliant. The restaurant are having delivery issue's at the moment so you have to book & order in advance which we did the food was top notch would highly recommend.

records.title: Our favourite restaurant 😋
records.text: Our favourite restaurant 😋Today was no exception.Sunday carvery plus an excellent mixed grill All members of staff were attentive and pleasant; including Aaron, Christina, Gwen, Alison, Liam and Steffan. Thanks as well to the kitchen staff.We shall return 😌

records.title: Sunday Carvery
records.text: Enjoyed Sunday Carvery at Brewers Fayre Llanelli Served by Rebecca and Liam who are always friendlyAll the staff make this our favourite place to eat

records.title: Went to Goole brewers fayre for a…
records.text: Went to Goole brewers fayre for a Christmas meal only one word can describe the meal excellent 10 out of 10 plenty on plate cooked to a high standard staff friendly as always great service great price as well merry Christmas to all at brewers fayre at Goole

records.title: The craftsmanship is outstanding
records.text: The craftsmanship is outstanding; each piece feels balanced and sturdy in my hand. The stainless steel finish not only looks sleek but also resists tarnishing and scratches, ensuring that my cutlery will stay beautiful for years to come. I particularly love the ergonomic handles, which provide a comfortable grip, making slicing and dicing an absolute joy. The knife set glides through vegetables and meats effortlessly, and the precision of the blades is impressive. This set is an investment in quality that I highly recommend to anyone who enjoys cooking!

records.title: A nice place to chill out and enjoy
records.text: Sandpiper Llanelli a great place to chill, an enjoyable meal with attentive staff, not forgetting Liam and all of the kitchen staff. Christina, Jake,Cerys and Anne served us always with a smile

records.title: Happy again
records.text: We use this place quite often and can honestly say never been let down. Quality of food good and the friendliness of staff from Manager down to the Floor staff are exceptional not forgetting the cleanliness of the premises are good

records.title: Very pleasant staff
records.text: Very pleasant staff. To name names well done to Amy who has always gone the extra mile to welcome customers. The manager Codie has our high regard always welcoming and made time for a disabled lady in a wheelchair to ensure her comfort. The menu not so great favourites like macaroni cheese with bacon bits gone. Needs a bit more variety now we think. Good position, nice pub, clean and comfortable. Thank you

records.title: We used  the Brewers Fayre O'bridge in…
records.text: We used  the Brewers Fayre O'bridge in Taunton many times  during our extended stay at the Premier Inn. Phillip, the manager was an excellent host who looked after us very well on all our visits. even though the staff were very busy they did their utmost to serve food and drinks in a timely and pleasant manner food very good and well priced. thanks to all at the brewers fayre for great service Gail & Paul.

records.title: Almost There
records.text: Brewer's Fayre, Queen Victoria, Burnley.On arrival we were advised that there would be a half hour wait, as it turned out our meal arrived within 20 minutes of ordering, so all good.The meal was well cooked, and flavoursome, although if being particularly critical, my steak was marginally overdone for medium.Sadly there was no real ale, or craft beer available, and the beer I had (Tetley Bitter) was a little on the cold side, but again that's being a bit picky.Overall it was a good experience.

records.title: Tables were not sticky at this one at…
records.text: Tables were not sticky at this one at Hampton. This was breakfast and we requested poached eggs which wer provided. Rhys was our guy waiting on table, he did not have a lot to do but was courteous and efficient

records.title: Brilliant customer service.
records.text: We went to the hastings branch and when we had an issue with our order of food the staff (Ryan and Neil) couldn’t have done more to make the situation better. The customer service was second to none. The manager in this branch should be very proud of how their staff went above and beyond to rectify this minor issue.If dealt with in a different way it would have ruined our lunch but it actually enhanced our lunch and we left feeling very satisfied.

records.title: Called into Bideford Brewers Fayre on…
records.text: Called into Bideford Brewers Fayre on way home, nice and quiet (after 2pm) had daytime saver for two, was very nice just enough and good value. Staff were really friendly and helpful too, thankyou.

records.title: We went to the  Drove restaurant in…
records.text: We went to the  Drove restaurant in Newhaven a few times when we stayed in the Premier Inn. We were very impressed with the staff and the service they gave. They were all having to work very hard due to a shortage of staff. We were served by Georgina (Gee) who went above and beyond to assist us and really looked after us in ordering and delivering meals to our room.  She was friendly and helpful and delivered service with a lovely smile 😊

records.title: Turnpike ponteftact
records.text: Turnpike pontefractGreeted with a smile by friendly staff and manager who were only too happy to take us to our reserved table.They asked if we had any special requirements, allergies etc.They were so attentive throughout, we were allowed to eat our meals in peace without being disturbed.The only downside to the evening was the fact my husband has sensory issues which we were catered for by way of a quiet area but some adults allowed their children to run around screaming which made us leave early.The staff and manager were in no way to blame for this as it is a family friendly establishment but it would have been nice if the parents of the children showed a little respect for others dining this evening.The meal was superb, my steak cooked to perfection, my husband said the mini trio of pies was amazing toocompliments to the chef.Mrs Kay illingworth6pm booking 17/02/24

records.title: Good food at reasonable prices
records.text: Plenty of space and tables to choose from. Chose weekday menu 2 for £10.99, like many others. 10 to 15 minutes wait for service which was good. Food quality good and well cooked. Only one comment which l am making in most pub restaurants, the tables feel a bit sticky in places and would benefit from a good wipe down each day, at night.

records.title: I visited brewers fayre Braintree today…
records.text: I visited brewers fayre Braintree today and it was great value. 5 of us eating dinner, 4 having deserts and drinks for everyone for £52.Service was prompt. Waitress friendly. Portions good. Only small criticism were the kids sides were rather small. I asked for my meal well done and they did just that. The pub and restaurant is very clean. We’d had a long day out at Notley country park and we were all starving. Within 30 mins of entering, ordering, we were eating. Would definitely return if ever that way again

records.title: Disappointing and not great value......!
records.text: When we eat out, (not very often), we go to the Gateway Park in Lincoln. We had the mixed grill and the Chicken fajita burger. The mixed grill was great but the chicken burger for £14, without fries, was disappointing. Not a great burger and not value for money. Would not have that again. Also, taking into account the prices of the meals, too expensive. An expensive menu for everyday food.

records.title: Amazing service!!
records.text: We visited the ROYAL FOREST brewers fayre yesterday for my mums birthday. The overall experience was extreme enjoyable and was made better by the staff working there. Oliver who served us was an absolute amazing person doing everything he could to attend to all our needs despite being very busy, nothing felt like too much. He truly is an asset to the company and deserves the recognition.I would have scored it a 5 however small things just weren’t perfect but didn’t ruin our experience. The food was a bit lacking in places like the mixed grill, which most of us chose. There were no tomatoes served on the mixed grill. Eggs were slightly under done in places and had black bits on them. We were asked how we wanted our steak which we got opposite to our request and the onions rings were so greasy. Despite this we’d still return and recommend to friends and family because the actually experience more than makes up for it.

records.title: Linkwood lodge family dinner
records.text: Linkwood Lodge was our regular restaurant for a long time, whenever we went the nearly 30 miles to Elgin,  but we had to change when the ban on dogs was introduced. Yesterday the weather was good for them to stay in the car, so we went in with our daughter and granddaughter who are visiting from Germany. There seemed to be less staff than there used to be but service was still very good and so was the food. We had a variety of foods, including nachos with chilli and sour cream, burgers for 13yo granddaughter and my wife, smothered chicken for me, and a vegitarian Thai curry for our daughter. All meals were very good and servings more than enough for all except granddaughter who also managed half of my wife's burger! Chillis were milder than expected, and part of the Thai curry menu was broccoli and bean sprouts, which were expected whole but must have been included in the general mix, but all flavourings were very good. Over all, very good and we will go back to using the Lodge whenever the weather is suitable.

records.title: Lovely restaurant
records.text: I visited the Abergavenny restaurant last week with my 2 daughters and 4 grandchildren. One of whom is disabled with special needs. I must say it was a very pleasant visit. My grandson is autistic and has behaviour issues so normally people stare and complain wherever we go. Here however no one complained or stared or judged his behaviour or his screams. The staff were polite, Charlotte was extremely understanding and helpful. A real credit to the company. We offered to clear the mess off the floor before we left but she wouldn’t hear of that either. I would love to leave 5 stars but we were rather disappointed how long it took for our food to arrive. However,  they have gained new customers as on the whole we thoroughly enjoyed our meal, the food was very good and our experience there was with out judgement or prejudice. Thank you Brewers Fayre and a big thank you to Charlotte.

records.title: We only went to brewers fayre in…
records.text: We only went to brewers fayre in Bexleyheath because I had a money off voucher and we wanted to meet upnwith a friend who lives nearby. We couldn't put our finger on it but this brewers fayre had a very very strange atmosphere. Mine and my wife's friend said it's like an American diner at the end of the night before closing but it was only 6pm lol. We got a couple of Stellas which were perfect temperature etc but a good price well under a fiver each and ordered our food after myself deliberating for ages which I always do. There was only two staff on the restaurant floor covering a large area and the lady that dealt with me was called Ladonna and wonderful with a real rapport with myself and the other punters.The food was a little slow to come out but when it did it was all fine. The 3 of us had 3 different dishes and all of us were satisfied and good portions.At the end of the day we only went there on the off chance and probably won't go back because the atmosphere was so strange.The highlight of the place was definitely Ladonna and I definitely wouldnt put anyone off eating there 👍

records.title: Very helpful staff
records.text: The staff, especially Charlotte, were understanding and accomodating. Despite a delay in food arrival, the experience was pleasant, with no stares or complaints about the child's behaviour. We thoroughly enjoyed the food and appreciated the lack of judgment or prejudice. The restaurant has gained new customers thanks to the helpful staff. Thak you, Brewers Fayre, and a big thank you to Charlotte.

records.title: As a regular of Monifeith Farm,When I…
records.text: As a regular of Monifeith Farm,When I am their I enjoy a coffee with my lunch.Recently the coffee has changed ,It is weak and tasteless.I complained and was told they were using a different brand.Until it changes I will not be buying coffee.I will stick to a glass of tap water

records.title: New chef new clocktower
records.text: My god you can tell they have a new chef, louisa has brought a whole new element to the clock tower , im so impressed I've been eating breakfast there for years and didn't realise how much I'd been missing out, thankyou Gail and louisa

records.title: Sunday carvery…
records.text: Meat portions for the Sunday carvery were mean and the selection of vegetables very limited.Roast potatoes were nice and crispy but the gravy was thin.Not bad price (cheaper than Toby) but sadly nowhere near the quality and quantity of Toby.

records.title: Food was okay slow service of food
records.text: Food was okay, price for play area is ridiculous as this used to do free the play area is tiny but the lady who served us was lovely her name was michelle she has grey hair and warm smile and amazing with the kids went back the week after but she was not there and the service was not good no conversation or checking that eveything was okay Michelle was very good with the kids she actually spoke to the kids not just the parents like most of the staff The play area is very expensive you pay for a full play area but it's more a miniature size I think this area should be free to use if you are purchasing a kids meal as it used to be freeFood takes a long time to be served

records.title: Big change to potion sizes.
records.text: Went today and have been many times before.  Ordered haddock and chips.  Was a lovely large piece of haddock but could not believe how few chips I got.   My husband ordered a burger and same small chip portion When I commented on this was told they had reduced the portions.

records.title: Noise of a woman
records.text: The food at Brewers Fayre Abergavenny lunch today was good. We had to leave quickly instead of relaxing with a meal because of a large woman called Sophie who was shouting loudly, non-stop. She is a member of staff there?? She was dreadful & spoiled our lunch. A manager  or staff could have warned her of the impact she was having on customers. Sadly because of her, we won't be coming back.

records.title: Staying at Kincardine Brewers Fayre
records.text: Staying at Kincardine Brewers Fayre. The staff do their best but seemingly run off their feet. The ladies toilet leaves a lot to be desired-two cubicles one of which was out of order and the other one had no locks!! Come on Brewers Fayre this is a bare essential in a pub that caters for families with children, very disappointed.

records.title: Disappointing
