records.text: Main food was ok but kids 'fruit' salad pudding left a lot to be desired! The menu states pineapple, apple, grapes and orange. We expected oranges segments but got a strange looking lump of orange ish fruit. No pineapple to be found and ONE tiny black grape! The apple came in two colours but both tasted old and as if it had been refrigerated or frozen beyond its best before date. Disappointing for a child who can't have any other pudding due to dairy allergies. 😕

records.title: Festive Menu Unavailable
records.text: We visited the Weather Vane in Bracknell mid afternoon specifically to order from their Festive Menu. However when it came to the order we were told the Festive menu was not available until after 5.00 pm due to a late delivery. We visit the restaurant on average every two weeks and were hugely disappointed. Rather than leave we ordered meals from their daytime menu which was thankfully tasty. We may now try their Festive Menu at another Brewers Fayre restaurant.

records.title: Staff
records.text: Food was good as always very busy for a Fri but staff were very good even though they were very over workload  a lady called debs was so kind nothing was 2 much trouble making sure all my breakfast was available  and Ann was also amazing making sure we were fully satisfied Amazing service from them both they both need some praise there a credit to your company........

records.title: Bristol for a…weekend
records.text: Having recently stayed in Bristol for a long weekend.  The premier Inn was excellent, very clean.  My only complaint is that the food was rather boring.  It would be nice if you could offer smaller plate portions, perhaps less chicken dishes.  At lunch it would be good if assorted sandwiches or baps were available.

records.title: Member of staff that is bald with beard got a terrible attitude towards customers
records.text: A big group of us went to brewers fayre ebbw vale, which we have been to before, it is good for kids with soft play and outdoor park.Someone in our party went to order food at the bar and come back and said about the bald man with bearded working there is very rude and got a terrible attitude.My wife had to leave a £20 deposit when we booked that we would have back and the lady said when we got there she would do us a tab for drinks and can use it towards that.But when my wife went to see if she owed anymore towards the tab with this worker behind the bar, he started raising his voice and getting very shirty saying we don’t do tabs, and shouting at my wife saying who told you that, I have never come across such behaviour , he should not have anything to do with customers.My wife found the woman who done the tab for us and sorted it with her with no problems.

records.title: Went to hunsworth Cleckheaton today…
records.text: Went to hunsworth Cleckheaton today very disappointed no staff and no fish. Last time no fish lasagne, jacket potato. Use brewers fayre twice a week. The young man serving was lovely very apologetic. We didn't eat just left went to Heathfield Farm. Very disappointed drove from other side of Bradford.

records.title: Fine for a pint
records.text: In general, I usually don’t eat here, I just go in for a pint and sit outside by the Harbour - this is Brewers Fayre Newhaven Quay. As far as the food goes it’s usually not particularly good, middle of the road at best, but the staff is friendly and it’s pleasant enough atmosphere.

records.title: Not good
records.text: We go there often to Royal Forest restaurant and it is usually good, today our food was terrible we ordered fish  one with mash the other chips they both came up with mash the batter was hard and dry one piece was thin with very little fish in it the other was not a lot better. As we left the waiter apologised for the meal.

records.title: The best waitress here today was…
records.text: The best waitress here today was Charlotte. When we arrived she was very pleasent and listened to our requests. We later ordered deserts but waited longer than usual but Charlotte again chased the kitchen to get our order sorted. Excellent service Charlotte

records.title: Main meal was fine ❗️
records.text: Main meal was fine, the only downside was that we waited 40+minutes for a Lasagne, we could have understood if it was busy ,but it wasn’t.As the service was so slow we side stepped the breakfast and ate elsewhere. Shame really as to a certain extent reflected badly on the Gt. Yarmouth Premier inn who were promoting the A47 Brewers Fayre.

records.title: No drinks on 25th to unbooked
records.text: Interesting never realised you were not allowed to be served a drink for example a point unless you were a hotel resident or already pre-booked for a meal no drink served to solo random customer even if I was the only one at the time but eventually the manager at the bar decided he would very kindly serve me a pint so I appreciate that though it did kind of make me feel very unwanted on a day like today!! I didn't expect something like that but faur dues to the manager on the day at the bar .eventually!! 🌟

records.title: Need for improvement
records.text: Food selection was good but not exactly fresh or covered ...awful that some customers were coughing and had sniffles around the food areas  so food was exposed to who knows what. The coffee was excellent self service and tasty .Could do with more staff and cleaner tables floors and loo's.   If food was fresher and covered and they had more helpful staff  it would tick more boxes .

records.title: dissapointed
records.text: Ordered meals for 3 adults hadto wait a hour for food even though the place was half empty when it finely came my order was wrong so I had to wait even longer while the others ate their meal

records.title: Loggans Moor
records.text: (breakfast) Food was cold, soggy and chewy. Definitely not worth the money. Felt uncomfortable when I was getting my food as the management were stood there talking bad about their staff. Loggans Moor branch, wouldn’t go again

records.title: Overcharged for Poor Quality Food!
records.text: We ordered a '2 for £9.99' meal plus a meal of sausage egg & chips, unfortunately, we were actually charged £9.99 for each meal plus £10.19 for the third meal.  Normally, we would have noticed the discrepancy  but we had taken my mother in law who suffers from dementia and needed to take her home asap.  I have complained to BF but to date have not received an answer.  The food was very low quality, the chips were very dry, the sausages and eggs were over cooked possibly kept warm from breakfast. The staff were very friendly and helpful but I don't think we will be returning to Brewers Fayre anytime soon!

records.title: We went for breakfast last Friday
records.text: We went for breakfast last Friday, it was near the end of breakfast servings, I know but the breakfast was cold, it was like they resented us coming half hour before breakfast ended,Can't be bothered attitude For £11 a breakfast expected better service,I get they were near the end of breakfast segment, but the title of the work "hospitality" is self explanatory.Won't be rushing back.

records.title: North sheilds …
records.text: Although the location is great nx to the ferry terminal north sheilds the food was awfull burnt fish dry mushy peas looked 5 days old we asked  for something to take half the fish home as I can't eat much the manager just shrugged his shoulders and said didn't have anything not even a piece of foil !! He had no personality whatsoever  if u are fussy about food stay clear of here

records.title: Christmas get together
records.text: Booked yesterday on line to go for Christmas meal today at Freebridge branch Kings Lynn. On arrival nobody came to assist us and I went to find a member of staff myself. On trying to book we were told that most of actual Christmas meals were unavailable. They pointed out that they had put signs on the door explaining this. This wasn't helpful as there was no mention on their website when I had booked my table yesterday and apparently this had been going on since last Saturday. My friend who had travelled a distance for our Christmas meal together wasn't impressed. Needless to say we left and luckily found somewhere else for our Christmas meal together.

records.title: Limited items on menu, booked but no prior warning.
records.text: Turn up having pre-booked with a group of eight guys for a Christmas get together. What a disappointment. Limited items available on the  menu as  their supplier had had a refrigeratation failure. No  phone call to let us know.

records.title: Just had our first festive meal at the…
records.text: Just had our first festive meal at the Redwood Newcastle under Lyme , it was absolutely tasteless , apparently for a starter we were getting festive nachos with pulled Turkey ( you must be joking ! ) IThere was about 5 small pieces of processed packet chicken ! The main meal arrived which wasnt much better ( absolutely tasteless ) & came with a thimble full of gravy, I did actually get promised more gravy but it never arrived ?? Absolutely terrible meal & terrible service !!!

records.title: Not as advertised in Menu
records.text: On the menu, the description of a ‘mixed grill’ said half a chicken breast although the image depicts what looks like a whole one along side an equally sized piece of gammon, (disappointing if you just go by the picture). However, when my meal arrived I had everything except the chicken and the gammon were both the size of a McD’s nugget! And the sausages are now very tasteless! It was the Alfreton branch by the way! Staff were nice enough!

records.title: Please do not book for Christmas
records.text: Please do not book for Christmas. We went here last year. The food was beyond dreadful. They have increased the cost this year too!We waited for 20 minutes in a queue. Then we were seated eventually, half an hour after our booking.  The starter of pate with soggy toast and no butter was disgusting.Clearly not enough staff.  Queuing at the carvery for 20 minutes. The Chef was shaking hands with mates and not washing his hands. I could go on, but please don’t pay a ridiculous amount to be treated little cattle.

records.title: Brewers Fayre Chafford Hundred
records.text: Brewers Fayre Chafford Hundred. No meat for the Sunday roast, no pies for the three pie combo, microwave mash, no normal size glasses for the refillable apparently they were all dirty which was handy because the refillable soft drink machine was serving flat tasteless drinks. Wires hanging out between the sink, paper hanging off the wall and tiles missing in the gents

records.title: Beware of Spiders ...
records.text: Had lunch at The Marina, Leicestershire. Bar service not great but staff were trying their best. Worse aspect was the huge cobwebs indoors, high up on the windows above the tables alongside the canal. My sister has a phobia with spiders and this completely ruined her lunch as she knew the cobwebs / spiders were lurking there. I submitted a feedback /review form they sent me after the booking, detailing these comments but absolutely no response at all - Very poor! Not sure I would go here again.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: So when 5 of us order a meal, we expect to all eat our meal together. However, one of the steak dishes arrived undercooked even though it was clearly ordered to be well done. It was taken to be remade, over 10 mins later the fresh meal is delivered to the table. The other four people have almost all finished their meal by this point. A brief verbal apology was given but when mentioned to another staff member that it had, frankly, spoiled our evening no attempt was made to apologise further or offer any type of compensation for the error made by staff. Poor customer service all round!

description: Amazing food, live sport, sun-drenched beer gardens and play areas for the kids: just a few things that make our Hungry Horse pubs so EPIC! And with over 200 locations across the country, there's bound to be one of our pubs near you. From sizzling steaks to Sunday roasts, our menu is bursting with amazing meals, and we've got the perfect line-up of drinks to match... plus big TVs to catch all the latest live sport events!

records.title: Ashley Hotel salmon Mix It Up
records.text: Ashley Hotel 23Dec2024 we visited for a Mix It Up salmon on a bed of veg with fries & sweet potato fries large enough to share our Server Jane was friendly helpful & checked that all was ok with our meal & drinks.Another great experience @The Ashley Hotel Worksop.😁

records.title: Great for the whole family
records.text: We have had a lovely visit to the Halcyon for new years days dinner. The staff we lovely, Jules was great, she served us at the bar, made sure everything was ok with our food and made the children feel special with their deserts!! Shout out to the chef, the food was great all cooked lovely, fresh and hot which is wonderful. Will definitely be back and recommending to others.

records.title: Excellent as always
records.text: Ian was great when serving us drinks and food and was very friendly, which was lovely. The food was excellent as it always is as we regularly come here on Fridays for the buy one get one free on the burgers.

records.title: On Arrival there were no tables…
records.text: On Arrival there were no tables available for our party size but a lovely member of staff Tyler put some tables together for us

records.title: Excellent quality  service
records.text: Booked family meal between Christmas and New year at The Crown & Arrows.  Lovely place staff very helpful and welcoming nothing to much trouble excellent service service excellent food great served very quickly all 13 of us piping hot . Great place for families.

records.title: The atmosphere is second to none,the…
records.text: The atmosphere is second to none,the staff are very helpful, the food is delicious, I would recomend The Super Mare ,the staff are excellent, Will eat there again

records.title: We drove here from Bristol for a meal
records.text: We drove here from Bristol for a meal. Angela and all Staff were very friendly and polite and made sure everything was ok with our food. Food was amazing. Cooked to perfection and very flavourful. Would definitely recommend and will be back.

records.title: Halcyon Peterborough
records.text: Had a lovely meal at the Halcyon today. Jules was brilliant very attentive and friendly and happy

records.title: On behalf of PWS (people we support…
records.text: On behalf of PWS (people we support (CB) appear to enjoy visiting the crown and arrows on the weekend with staff and award to enjoy the hospitality, family orientated friendly environment, warm and social accommodating  atmosphere from staff such as Kimmy, polly and much more and the delicious food. (CB) loves visiting and at this time of year love the Christmas tree and the decorations.(CB) will be visiting soon and look forward to every visit with fun and anticipation.

records.title: amazing
records.text: can’t complain i felt like number 1 she made me feel wanted hope she can cook then christmas wish list completed but all honestly she makes everyone feel special

records.title: Last minute lunch arrangement with my…
records.text: Last minute lunch arrangement with my Dad and family. Whilst the surroundings are tired, the staff were very friendly and welcoming. The food was excellent value for money, hot and we were served quickly.

records.title: Staff friendly, nice food,
records.text: Came for a kids birthday meal, staff friendly and efficient, kids really enjoyed it, especially the soft play, thank you to Courtney who served us

records.title: Halloween party…
records.text: Came for the children’s Halloween party today. Such good value for them food, drink, disco, soft play and a surprise visit from Mickey Mouse himself. The children had a fabulous time lots of games with the disco and interaction and a balloon for them too. Our granddaughter had a lovely afternoon with her friends.

records.title: Much better on this occasion !
records.text: After a bad experience a month or so with our food ! I thought I would say that on this occasion the food was much improved! Hot and served quickly a the sausage on mixed grill was fresh too. Thank you on the improvement. This is at Milton arms Cambridge x we eat a lot here when we visiting our son at uni! Thank you  for this much much better!!

records.title: The waitress who served us Megan was…
records.text: The waitress who served us Megan was polite and made sure everything with our breakfast was lovely, she served us with a smile and checked in to make sure everything was fine. Thanks.

records.title: Went to The Vine in Ower for the Wacky…
records.text: Went to The Vine in Ower for the Wacky Warehouse Halloween Party. Helpful staff, my burger was disgusting but they happily replaced it with another one. Kids had a good time, decent sided meals for them and they loved the entertainment

records.title: The halcyon Peterborough
records.text: Visited ‘the Halcyon’ for a meal for 5 of us- very polite staff and although busy our food was served in good time. Our waitress (Shannon) was very polite and helpful. Food was great as per previous visits (I had Sunday roast which I wasn’t keen on although it was popular with other customers there) definitely will be returning-good price good food friendly helpful staff 👍

records.title: We visited the Folly Andover
records.text: We visited the Folly Andover. Adult meals were fantastic no problems but the kids meals were a bit poor, we had 2 chicken nuggets with chips, salad and veg sticks the salad had way too much dressing on for a child's meal and the nuggets were overcooked, the other had veg sticks and were obviously left out for hours on end they were dry and warm

records.title: Good service and excellent value will come again
records.text: Welcomed and accommodated by Curtis and was well served on busy Bank Holiday Monday afternoon. Food was good quality well prepared better than most pub chains.Won a free drink on spin to win national Hungry Horse competition and bar staff were aware of redeemed no problem. Both bar and table staff were genuine in attention to customersOne observation the internal window sill looking out the old mill wheel urgently needs attention. Only negative of the visit.

records.title: Team Effort Working Well.
records.text: The great plus when visiting the Hardy Pick is the  enthusiastic and hard working staff who are all a credit to Hungry Horse.In comparison to other chain pubs there is never a negative mood when staff make no effort with the customer.The staff here just keep going even at the busiest times.Some of the furnishings and carpets could do with replacing but otherwise always a good experience with well cooked generous food portions.

records.title: Great service, big portions
records.text: Great service, food was nice, Jerk chicken was a bit of a let down (not authentic). Great portions.Sophia is the brightest & most helpful waitress ever, she left such an impact.Needs a raise or promotion lol.

records.title: Enjoyed breakfast with family
records.text: Enjoyed breakfast with family, well cooked and good value for money.Special mention to our server Diana, appeared to be the only member of staff front of house, she had to take orders and serve food. If I mention the pound coins and the grabber, she'll hopefully know who has written this. Certainly a testing moment and she dealt with swiftly and professionally whilst still smiling and apologising for the wait, a credit to your pub.

records.title: Hungry Horse Corby, thanks
records.text: My partner and I have been before and disappointed,,today the service was great by Rhys, Cara and Rebecca at Corby Hungry Horse, the food prepared by Callum was tasty, well presented. Will return.

records.title: Been coming here a long time
records.text: Been coming here a long time. Service and attitude was not great for a while, food took forever to arrive and often something was wrong! But since a change of management more recently service is with a smile and a positive attitude, food wait is not bad and the atmosphere seems lighter and friendlier. Nice to see some of the staff members back.

records.title: Served by Linda she was friendly and…
records.text: Served by Linda she was friendly and helpful but insisted that we give her a good review which I didn't mind as she was pleasant and had a good sense of humour

records.title: Had an excellent meal tonight which…
records.text: Had an excellent meal tonight which included the Christmas special steak which was first class. Staff had limited knowledge of the wine (didn’t know what Malbec was) and bill settlement took some time as the system did not appear to be set up correctly. In summary, food excellent, admin could be better

records.title: Courtney the waitress is always…
records.text: Courtney the waitress is always welcoming will sort any issues and concerns out Tonight we visited food was not the best , undercooked, Courtney took good back asked what good I'd like in replacement.  Nothing was too much trouble for Courtney she is an access to the pub Good needs improvement

records.title: Good service.
records.text: Good service at the bar. The food was well presented and tasted very nice. Very efficient and polite waitress, who checked later to see if the meal was to our satisfaction. Enjoyable dining experience, I would recommend the Hungry Horse (Rowden Arms Chippenham) for good value drinks and food. We will be visiting again soon.

records.title: Food amazing as always
records.text: Food amazing as always, although wait can be a little bit long even when restaurant is quiet. Staff always helpful and friendly. Men’s toilets desperately in need of a revamp, really letting the place down - if toilets had more attention I would always give Four Eagles five stars.

records.title: Becki and all the staff are brilliant…
records.text: Becki and all the staff are brilliant and bend over backwards to help and give excellent service. We were disappointed that the food we had is never very hot and has to be sent back to the kitchen to warm up. We also had a steak that was more gristle than meat,which was very disappointing.

records.title: Woollen mill Darlington
records.text: Used the Woollen mill Darlington on Sunday. Ordered a full English breakfast x2 and to lattes. Staff were great polite helpfully and friendly. However the breakfast was poor, hash browns good bacon ok the rest were cold and the sausage was like rubber as it had been reheated or sat on a hotplate for a longtime. So while the place and staff were great we won't be eating there again.

records.title: Get what you pay for!
records.text: Get what you pay for. Starter was great. We didn’t check the receipt after ordering but the order was taken incorrectly at the bar and therefore one of the mains was wrong. John was extremely helpful, rectifying this quickly and getting a new meal out to myself. Was a busy Friday night and food could have been better however the service we receive was great.

records.title: Pleasantly surprised
records.text: Pleasantly surprised. Slight improvement since last visit when we swore we would never return. But after a long day and no handy alternative we conceded. Was surprised all food was hot on this visit and the place had just a few other customers the wait was quite long. Give it another year and might try it again. Shame both male and female toilets were such a mess and the place needs redecorating.

records.title: Food was nice
records.text: Food was nice, we were served by a lovely young lady called Lacy, who was so happy and gave good customer service. However the other staff weren't so smiley, dirty looks, and just didn’t look happy.

records.title: Review
records.text: Whilst ordering my meal the cutlery & condiments were being put on table. Food arrived quickly but only after seeing another diner get their food I realised I hadn’t been given any onion rings on my order.* added infoI didn’t find out the onion rings should’ve been on my plate until after I’d finished eating & saw the other diners plate as it went past my table. So no, not rectified.

records.title: Attended the Netherton in Sefton
records.text: Attended the Netherton in Sefton. Food and service was great as always but when I went to pay and use my blue light card with photo ID as I have done for over year they wanted to see the app on my phone, unfortunately I have a Nokia that doesn’t do apps, surely that the card and photo ID should be enough.Regards

records.title: Hit and miss…
records.text: Hit and miss…We went to the Hungry Horse in Bedford for a birthday meal, there were 10 of us,  some of the meals were great and others were really poor and had to be sent back, including the birthday persons meal as it was not edible and cold. It’s a shame as it the potential at times to produce great food.

records.title: Good food awful service!!
records.text: Good food awful service!!Our waiter Tori was rude and obtrusive towards me and my family. We were casually enjoying our meals and she barked at me "have you finished with the ketchup?" And when I said yes she reached over my plate whilst I was eating and grabbed the bottle. As well as this the person taking our order at the bar was disengaged whilst we were ordering and after triple checking the order with him the food still came out wrong!

records.title: Please improve the ladies toilet
records.text: The ladies toilet at the Hungry Horse at Barnaby Road in Rugby is awful. They have invested in a beautiful digital frame that displays cool pictures but the money could be better spend in improving the toilets as in my view this is one the things that easily put me off eating at a restaurant. I have been visiting this particular HH quite regularly and I think that the level of service is becoming quite poor. Staff used to be much more attentive. Please bring your ‘A’ game Steam Turbine.

records.title: Shoemakers Norwich , lakenham
records.text: Shoemakers Norwich , lakenham member of staffs partner  ( the man sitting at bar drinking , and talking to staff like he owned the place)  was very foul mouthed and loud , even went outside for cigarette and came in with it lit to get his drink . THE FOOD was very nice ( breakfast ) and waiting staff were very polite and efficient.

records.title: Don’t expect too much and you won’t be quite so disappointed!
records.text: Hungry Horse is our local ‘go to’ when we have been rushed off our feet and don’t wish to be bothered preparing a meal.It is great value albeit not fine dining or even close!!Tonight was a disappointment, the wait to just order was just over 19 minutes due to poor management of staff. A long queue with just one person taking orders and serving the drinks whilst other staff appeared to be doing nothing.One taking orders and others preparing drinks would have cut the queue and time dramatically!!The order took some time to arrive but without cutlery, then the waitress forgot to bring it so by the time we had discovered the cutlery OUTSIDE near the car park the food was only Luke warm. Come on Hungry Horse, it’s the little things that make such a difference!!

records.title: Let down by the loos 👎
records.text: We had quite a lot long wait for the food but we did enjoy our meals. The quality was very good.The criticism that I do have is that the pub could do with a makeover and the toilets were disgusting. They were so small that you could not close the toilet doors without your clothes touching the toilet. Considering the amount of customers they have including many children, it would pay to improve the facilities and hygiene.I would be put off going again because because of the above problems.

records.title: Table staff were top notch (Abi &…
records.text: Table staff were top notch (Abi & Tyler). Was disappointed with the lack of offerings on the light bites menu and offers on it. 3 choices. We opted for chicken and bacon baguettes- the baguettes were under cooked so became soggy quickly and contents falling out. Additionally could have been filled, cut and presented better. Coffee and soft drinks perfect. Toilets clean. Warm environment to eat, tye area where we sat needs looking at ( table 18) table itself clean but very very worn, the seat was not of a standard I’d expect to used for customers. Can’t be very hygienic…. Taking it all into consideration 3/5 stars, would have given lower but the staff are clearly what make the place what it is! So Thankyou ladies 💜

records.title: Too long waiting for food
records.text: We waited 45 mns for the main and 50 for the pudding at which point we cancelled the pudding.  The guy in the bar apologised saying they were busy, half the tables were empty and no queues. He got the manager who just asked cash or card! No apology or anything! No thanks or goodbye! We go into The Hungry Horse regularly in Chippenham and never had this happen even when full! This was our regular when we lived in Bradford on Avon and always felt welcome food served within half hour at most. Puts us off going back. Also the ladies had 2 toilets, only one had a lock.

records.title: Went there on 17th took 3 friends…
records.text: Went there on 17th took 3 friends wasn't busy.but our food took quote a while,after finished 25 mins before someone came to take our plates. In end we m9ved them to another table,went and ordered our desserts they took 20 mins to arrive...friends weren't impressed .so servise was awful. The food was good when we did recieve it..I could understand if busy but staff where sitting drinking and chatting..

records.title: Visited The Milton Arms
records.text: Visited The Milton Arms, Cambridge yesterday. This is a place we use regularly because it is convenient. The meal was satisfactory and the service by Lee was first class as she is always cheerful and does her best to provide what you want. I have to say the decor is looking pretty tired and the toilets disgusting. We went for a Christmas meal at this establishment and a meal on Valentine's day. Both of which were disappointing, especially on Valentine's day but these will be the subject of a separate email as my review was ignored.Steve

records.title: Sat 24th of Feb me and My wife had…
records.text: Sat 24th of Feb me and My wife had lunch at the flying legend pub york, we had fish and chips along with steak and ale pie which came with peas , chips separate gravey jug and mashed potatoe,  the mash was dry and not very warm and also the gravey was only just warm. However the rest of the food was excellent,  the pie was one of the best I've had as a pub meal.Very large pie bursting with flavour and meat really enjoyable my wife had the fish and again said it was delicious both meals excellent value at £24 include a soft drink and half of larger.The staff where very busy but handled it really well, very polite an d attentive. The bar staff while taking orders and preparing drinks did a great job as did our server who asked us twice if everything was okay with the meals and did we need anything. For us this was a great pop in lunch while out and about but be warned its not the quietest of place with alot of family groups with small children so if looking for a place for a quiet lunch this might not be the best for u .

records.title: Just went to The Dog and Phesant in…
records.text: Just went to The Dog and Phesant in Colchester. Waited an hour for our food. I complained to waitress in which her response was that we had only waited 33 minutes as one of us had a starter not being funny but my mum and I hadn't eaten yet so we had waited an hour with no apology. I then decided to go to another lady which was a manager who said we cannot have a discount only a free dessert. My mum and her partner had already ordered desserts so I complained to another manager as the previous one avoided our table. She also stated we can only have a free dessert next time. Why is it that they cannot provide discount only give out desserts? We normally come this pub a lot but this has put us off so don't think we will be going for a while considering the attitude of the first manager and the member of staff concerned.

records.title: Worn out, a bit shabby
records.text: The place could do with a makeover, seats were badly worn out. Everything a bit sticky including the menus!One person working the bar so service was slow. Asked for 3 fish and chips to be told no fish and chips available. Alternative food order arrived quickly and was fine. Asked by bar staff if glass was Ok for the drink ordered, no problem, do people complain ? Yes apparently but corporate doesn't allow for new glasses. Looks like a business that was great when launched but heading downhill now. Won't be going back.

records.title: Wednesday offer not honoured
records.text: Went to Hussey Arms Brownhills today our 8th visit in the last 5 weeks. Food and staff excellent as usual but very disappointed that their Wednesday offer a bottle of wine for £7.99 wasn’t available because they had no stock of the wine included in the offer so had to pay another £5 for an alternative. I think they should have honoured the offer by offering an alternative at the offer pice very disappointing!

records.title: went to the fairnhurst
records.text: went to the fairnhurst, ewood, blackburn for santa breakfast as we do every year establishment in need of a revamp, wall dirty, roof leaking in small tvs not working and frame work missing.  Staff nice and polite but look fed up, atmosphere very low on the past years. Food below par and order wrong after giving special instruction on ordering. Unfortunatley we think that we will be going else where from now on.

records.title: Next Vegetarian tart
records.text: Had to wait a long time for meal.  Both had Sunday roasts, one turkey, one vegetarian.  Unfortunately only 2 small pieces of turkey, that were cold.  Only 3 roast potatoes.Vegetarian tart was nice.  Not asked about any sauces, didn't know where cutlery was.  Again not asked if everything was ok.  Unfortunately won't now be coming again.

records.title: As usual- Cold
records.text: As usual, breakfast beans stone cold, butter frozen and hot drinks should be renamed " serves with Luke warm tap water".Used to be a regular but would appreciate HOT FOOD and a HOT DRINK.

records.title: We recently had breakfast here
records.text: We recently had breakfast here, and while most of it was okay, the sausages were a real disappointment. They were tough, lacked flavor, and tasted like they had been cooked the night before and reheated in a microwave. Unfortunately, they were inedible. The rest of the meal was fine, but the poor quality of the sausages really stood out. We hope this was a one-off issue, as it detracted from an otherwise decent breakfast.

records.title: Long wait poor value…
records.text: Had to wait nearly an hour for food to arrive at The Pommel House in Hemel Hempstead Had tesco voucher for meal doesn't give any discount meals now when using them so won't be using them again as not good value anymore. Been using them for the last 5 years. Received  apology from Hungry Horse. Little  consolation  to us as this was a celebration  meal for our grandson's  birthday. Can't  recapture that moment & would have been a nice gesture  to receive some sort of compensation  rather than just a sorry

records.title: Lunch
records.text: Arrived today and asked for a g/free menu. One staff member said he would get one. Another staff member, think he was manager, said the menu had changed last week and gave me a tablet to use. (Not PC me), so never used it. His attitude was awful. I was supporting a young lady with Austim and changes in where she goes have a knock on effect on her day. The table service has now gone and you have to pay them get your own things. If I leave the table she runs to follow me, which is not safe. They were uninterested and we won't be back. The food was mediocre too and the service was appalling

records.title: Shocking standard!
records.text: Usually a nice meal! I had a mini mixed grill. The chicken and gammon was cold! The sausage was shrivelled like it had been reheated from a breakfast serving . The chip portion on our other meals was very sad. The burger bun on my son’s quadzilla burger was drowned in grease ! I reckon our dinner was made at same time as our starters and left on the hot plate!  The standard was shocking to be honest! Service was pleasant but food not !Milton Cambridge

records.title: Customer service ordering food hen at the counter…
records.text: Customer service when at the counter ordering food. The assistant obviously didn't want to be there. Very rude and when I asked if drinks were refillable she replied... Erm no.. Yes.. Ooh OK. More training required or change of career maybe.

records.title: Poor meal experience
records.text: Poor welcome on arrival,no acknowledgement of birthday for son despite putting it on special requests. JAY who served us outstanding customer service throughout our time there, a great asset to the pub.thank you Jay for your wonderful service and caring nature.Meal very poor, children's meal not as described and inedible.Pie cold, took a long time to bring back,Unable to eat as a family. Sadly not a great meal.

records.title: We had a table booked for 1.30pm…lack of supplies and horrible sausages
records.text: We had a table booked for 1.30pm 21.7.24 we started to order food at 1.40pm and they did not  have any gammon 5 of our orders were the full  monty the sausages were vile infact they made my husband gag it was that bad yet my family normally eat sausages I made my comment known to the girl collecting the plates told her you need to get a new supplier for the sausages they were that bad i didnt dare bring them home for my dogs this meal was for our 34yrs anniversary and feel it was ruined by this

description: The Pantry Basket where unbeatable prices meet personalised service. Our curated selection offers the most competitive prices, backed by a commitment to exceptional customer care.

records.title: Good price, fast delivery
records.text: Good price, fast delivery. The item was well packaged to protect from damage. I'll use them again and would recommend to others.

records.title: Delivery was on time
records.text: I had confidence I would get my parcel in time as I had  ordered previously and all went smoothly

records.title: Would highly recommend ordering from…
records.text: Would highly recommend ordering from The Pantry basket. Free delivery over £30. Ordered and dispatched the same day. Delivered next day. Not had to use customer service so could not comment on that. But why would you need to when you get your order supper quick with no issues.  Thanks guys.

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: I placed my order, received the confirmation and the product has just been delivered. 48 hours from start to finish. Wonderful! I would definitely use them again.

records.title: Perfect Service & Great Product
records.text: I love this product and they stock them....  they're in my, relatively local, area and not a large national.In addition to this, the service was excellent... arrived very quickly and in good condition.... delicate product...crispbreads, so expected might get broken.... but nothing. Absolutely perfect.  They're an authentic crispbread and nobody stocks them really, so am so grateful as i take them to work every shift. Didnt want to be back on gloopy sandwiches, or just a box of salad, and these are so tasty.Very grateful customer 😊

records.title: A relatively cheap purchase (biscuits)
records.text: A relatively cheap purchase (biscuits), yet a prompt dispatch and very well packed.  Items perfectly described on their site, and what arrived matched what had been described.  Cannot fault The Pantry Basket.  First time I have used them, and will more than likely return for other items.

records.title: Very Fast Delivery & Well Packed Items
records.text: I ordered online on Saturday (28th), and the parcel turned up on Sunday (29th), with astonishing fast delivery. I didn't know Roysl Mail worked Sundays!!

records.title: Good service and will continue ordering from here
records.text: Have had several orders now and all items delivered each time with good dates on them. One of my orders lost some items by the courier and through no fault of Pantry Basket. Pantry Basket were quick to dispatch additional items to replace these.Very happy with their service.

records.title: Easy ordering & excellent service!
records.text: The whole order experience was easy. I received my order in 2 days & it was tracked from start to finish so I knew exactly when I would receive it. It was the second time I ordered from The Pantry Basket & I’m sure I will order from them again. Excellent service.

records.title: Excellent fabric
records.text: Excellent fabric. Quick and easy. Would definitely buy again. Thanks so much!

records.title: Ordered on the 26/07/24 sent out of date biscuits 23/03/2024
records.text: Ordered on the 26th July 2024 was sent 4 packets of out of date biscuits they ran out of date on the 23/04/2024 I am absolutely appalled by this! I have contact customer service and received no response, I have also contacted the seller through PayPal with no response. Within the same order I purchased 8 boxes of Tunnoks teacakes 4 boxes of milk chocolate and 4 boxes of dark chocolate, the chocolate looked awful they tasted disgusting and the marshmallow inside was firm. In my opinion these were very old stock and potentially not stored well. I am awaiting any form of communication back from the company/seller in regards to a refund of my out of date items and also the teacakes which were inedible. Quick delivery, quite expensive for some products, good website design and ease of use. Other products purchased were satisfactory. I am very disappointed in being sent very out of date items and the lack of communication from customer service/seller. I have now received communication from the company and we are working through the issue so I have changed my review rating slightly in accordance to this.

description:

Parsley Box offers revolutionary and tasty meals delivered direct to your door!  With a wide selection of over 60 different meals, sides, desserts and drinks, there is something for everyone. 
 Our innovative cooking method keeps the freshness and nutrients locked in, which means you can store our meals in the cupboard for up to 6 months.
 No need for a fridge or freezer, just pop them in the microwave and your delicious meal will be ready in minutes.
   Plus, there is no subscription or commitment  - order what you want, when you want. 

We take pride in our service and the quality of care we provide to our growing number of customers across the UK.

records.title: I am always delighted with the ease to…

records.title: First Time Order

records.title: A friend's recommendation!

records.title: Service from your agent on the phone…

I had been trying to order online however when I got to the validation of my order on my credit card account and returned to your website you had wiped all my order from your website so I was unable to validate the order I made four attempts over 3days with the same failure on each occasion

records.title: Good all round experience
records.text: Good all round experience - wide choice of meals, delivered very promptly.

records.title: Efficient  and prompt delivery
records.text: Efficient  and prompt delivery. A good sturdy box but not sufficiently protectively packed. One of the base meals was dented presumably by rough handling by delivery men.

records.title: easy to use website good product and…

records.title: It was easy to place an order but I was…

records.title: Ordered on behalf of my father
records.text: Ordered on behalf of my father who is 87 as your phone lines were constantly busy!Easy to set up, order and pay.Good communication after ordering to delivery 👍😁

records.title: Food is good delivery fast only thing…

records.title: Parsley Box 10 Delivery company 3
records.text: Parsley box website was easy to use and order arrived really quickly. Delivery company not so great said left in porch but I do not have a porch when arrived home just sitting on door step🙁

records.title: The ordering process is good
records.text: The ordering process is good, but I was disappointed that one of the products I wanted to buy, was unavailable

records.title: Let down by delivery.
records.text: The delivery driver did not ring the door bell, the box was left on the doorstep for all to see.

records.title: Easy to follow menu selection
records.text: Easy to follow menu selection. Good choice of meals, unfortunately the offer I received 13/11/24 was already out of date.

records.title: Very prompt and efficient delivery
records.text: Very prompt and efficient delivery.   However, the delivery person didn't ring the doorbell or knock.   The box was left outside the front door without checking that I was at home - which I was!

records.title: Recent purchase
records.text: Easy to order but didn't go through 1st time so had to redoit

records.title: Received a leaflet with Office in the…
records.text: Received a leaflet with Office in the post, but when I looked on the website, there weren’t available

records.title: Site problem.…
records.text: I dont know why but I always have a problem completing my order,.????

records.title: Parsley Box Ready Meals
records.text: Already a Parsley Box customer and find the convenience of being able to store in cupboard really great...not taking space in freezer.

records.title: Parsley Box were good, be aware of the courier.
records.text: Parsley Box provided excellent service. However, they were badly let down by the courier, DHL. After a week of non delivery I spoke to Parsley Box who offered to resend the order using the Royal Mail. I got my order within 3 days. I would have given 5 stars except for being let down by DHL.

records.title: Ease of ordering.
records.text: Ease of ordering.On the negative side your courier DHL  continues to leave the parcel  in the porch without attempting to alert the owner even though it's obvious someone is at home. some elderly customers find it difficult to lift it safely from the floor.

records.title: Empower Me with Food Selection…
records.text: I have been awarded carers to make meals for me and yours are perfect for such an arrangement. They do not peel and slice raw ingredients and cook - neither do I since becoming visually impaired!! The meals (first box of my selection) has worked out perfectly. Especially, that I haven't needed to buy a spare freezer to house them in. If I could make suggestions which would help me so, possibly others. Having a separate vegetable selection would assist. Advancing years means bodies need help absorbing nutrients. Vegetables would do this. I'm particularly addicted to your Potato Dauphenoise. When selecting meals  a continuous view of the running total would greatly assist. Many order to a budget. This would enable more control. Knowing how much more we have to spend is rather exciting!

records.title: Meals delivered to the house. 👆
records.text: Very much appreciated my 2 meals but my son's meal didn't impress him much also my wife said one of her meals was not very nice the problem being is she has been a vegetarian for 30 years so probably very hard to get that one right but i will always use your services again. Thank you.

records.title: Web site review
records.text: By and large using the web site was ok.  However several times I had to jump back and forward when.making my selections.

records.title: A Costly Coincidence!
records.text: I'm afraid I deducted a star because, an hour after placing my order, a card came in the post from you giving me a £5 discount if I quoted GOLDENS.  A costly coincidence!!I am looking forward to getting my order no 2628822!

records.title: Hit and miss
records.text: Have placed several orders over the last few years. The meals are very tasty although small. You do need lots of extra veg to make a decent meal, which is fine for me. My latest order, of 7 dishes, included steak hotpot (melt in the mouth!) - the few pieces of chuck steak were tough, and I mean tough although I followed the cooking instructions to the ‘t’. Ended up with bits of stringy meat between my teeth. Hoping the other meals are better. Shame as this is a good company providing tasty, microwaveable small meals for the elderly and people living alone.PS: PB is kindly going to reimburse me for the one meal I found unsatisfactory.

records.title: I had trouble finding Shepherds pie…
records.text: I had trouble finding Shepherds pie even though I had spelt it right. Also it stated on my profile that I hadn’t left delivery instructions-which I did when I originally put in my 1st order

records.title: NOT SATISFIED!
records.text: Everything was ok, apart from missing out on 2 free dishes.  My offer stated end date 12/12.  Your rep stated the end date was 11/12. Obviously I disagreed and said you should honour this because it was offered to me in an advert.  I then asked to speak to a Manager.I was not offered this.  You stuck to your word, so I ended up getting another offer with 1 free dish.  I was told to send a picture of my offer, I don't know how to do this.

records.title: I find ordering by email al bit…
records.text: I find ordering by email a bit confusing. But that could be my connection. However I find it helpful to know when order will be delivered.

records.title: Codes hard to read due t the colours they are
records.text: Finding things would have been easier if the numbers in the bak could be read better. The colours they are in Mae reading them hard f9r people like with having t wear gasses. You need to make the codes stand out better. I struggled to read the codes.

records.title: Petty rules will never help sales.
records.text: I recently ordered a fresh supply of Parsley Box meals and, as per the message I received, I qualified for two free meals. About the same time I received your Christmas card which promised a Free Gift of a 2025 calendar. However, the lady who took my order told me that, as per the small print, I could only receive one gift. Sadly there was no small print in the Christrmas card but she insisted she could not send me the calendar as well as the extra meals. I will not be in a position to re-order before 12th January next as this is the cut-off point for the calendar. I feel somewhat let down by the beaurocracy and you will hopefully let other purchasers know how petty this rule appears. Thank you.

records.title: Paying…
records.text: The main problem occurred when paying I tried twice and gave up and then returned the next day and finally was able to make payment. Also when putting things in the basket the total kept changing so upsetting the free postage

records.title: Charged £6 delivery, should be free with code Flavours4
records.text: A lady called Erin was very good in sorting out a problem with my order of today 18/10/24, whereby instead of getting free delivery, as per code Flavour4 offer, I was charged and ended up paying £6 delivery.Erin said she has arranged a £6 refund as a credit to my card and she will ask that this error be looked into. So three stars for the experience but five stars to Erin

records.title: Delivery service
records.text: The contents were good and well packaged.im trying to pass on a complaint about the delivery I got a message to say  that the delivery has been passed to me.   I was out so didn't understand .I was actually inside main communal door but other side of 2nd locked door which wasfine ..what I expected but why repire that theyd delivered to me.p

records.title: returning to PB after a long time,I was…
records.text: returning to PB after a long time,I was hoping to try the tester box to assess if PB now met my needs. However I find that (presumably as a former customer) I was charged at normal rate.  OK . I will still assess against my current needs, but the process was confusing.

records.title: Very  disappointing
records.text: Well forgot  to add offer on order for elderly relative. Emailed immediately as an on line order, next day response.But told their system did not allow for an alterations. WHAT? How old school. Plenty of other sites would. Used parsley box often so very disappointing. Had a quick response to trust pilot comments. But not good enough comment as a returning customer. May as well buy from Amazon

records.title: Usually good
records.text: Usually good. Not this time. Your phone line didn't work. The final check-out on-line was confusing unless you 'joined'.

records.title: We found your site quite easy to use
records.text: We found your site quite easy to use, however couldn't find one of the meals that was in the brochure we recently received. Also disappointed that we can't order nearly half of your meals because they have alcohol in them and one of us won't have alcohol in anything.

records.title: I had the steak hotpot tonight …
records.text: I had the steak hotpot tonight was verry disappointed it only had 4 oxo sized pieces of steak in it, there was more meat on the cover photo.

records.title: Ordering was clear except for Sides…
records.text: Ordering was clear except for Sides where it was necessary to have no spelling mistakes as one had to type in the items as the Sides section did not pop up.Also I could not see my order list to check it until I had placed the order.

records.title: Recipe changed to lower price
records.text: Sausage, mash and onion gravy, used to be my favourite. Price recently reduced, but recipe has been changed. Onion gravy now thin and tastless. Won't be buying again, unless you go back to old recipe. Customer relations insist recipe hasn't been changed. If this is the case, then something was definitely wrong with the batch I received. I could make better gravy myself and I'm an useless cook. Would prefer to pay more for better quality meals. New chicken wing meals nice, but portion small.

records.title: Can’t fault the service itself
records.text: Can’t fault the service itself, very good, easy to use and fast delivery.The problem is with some of the meals. I’ve used a few other well known home delivery meals, but unfortunately a couple of the parsley box dinners are truly rank! Especially the chicken and tomato with rice, the chicken tastes very funky and is squished up in a ‘meat ball’ with a horrible consistency, it almost tastes like a bad liver flavour 🤢 a couple others are meh and the only nice is one was the beef stew. I don’t think I will be a regular customer unless the recipes/ingredients are improved.

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: My call was answered promptly and my order was taken calmly and efficiently.Any questions that I asked were answered with obvious knowledge of the products and any specific offers were pointed out to me without any pressure to order.I was treated with respect and courtesy throughout the process.

records.title: Ok with the food but explicet…
records.text: Ok with the food but explicet directions given 2x on order important as old and unable to get to the place delivered. I had directions to white door ring and wait a few seconds  if take long leave on shelf marked parcel. Came to wrong door a blue one left parcel on public towpath did not wait knock and drop I beleive. Had to get someone else to search parcel in rain 81 yrs old wet slippery muddy path used by many dogwalkers this is not where I asked or where anyone else delivers they use postcode and read instuction.

records.title: Delivery was great but an item was…
records.text: Delivery was great but an item was missing from the order and you had to credit my account, a shame

records.title: The delivery was very poor
records.text: The delivery was very poor. Item just left in front of the front door with barely any notification of delivery from driver. He hardly made a  knock and left immediately without waiting. Disabled household and this proved very difficult.

records.title: Delivery was due yesterday
records.text: Delivery was due yesterday, waited in for it to arrive, no notification but did not arrive. No delivery today so I called and was told it was at the depot but they could not tell me when it would be delivered. Told they would contact me, still waiting. Not Parsley Box's fault, currier is DHL.

records.title: Fast delivery
records.text: Fast deliveryProducts don’t look at all appealing Mash potatoes on products look brown and dry

records.title: I found payment difficult--could not…
records.text: I found payment difficult--could not always see CONTINUE and had to fill in some areas 20 or 30 times, don't know why.

records.title: I thought they were complete ready…
records.text: I thought they were complete ready meals, I can’t be doing with cooking my vegetables to be added to the meal and having to pierce the seal before cooking  also the mash with the sausages and cottage pie was an awful colour brownish so off putting,I won’t be buying from you again

records.title: My first and last order
records.text: My first and last order £46 spent, the portions are small and are all mush and potato topping brown, what  I  have tried so far need to be eaten with a spoon as the meals seem to just turn into a near liquid, no body to the food at all, very poor and I would like my money back. Ron Evans

records.title: Disappointed as first time customer
records.text: Under impression these meals had a decent shelf life but 4 puddings I ordered as a first time customer had only 6 weeks and another 4  only 10 weeks. Told by Customer Service at Parsley Box that there are no guarantees all items have a 6 month shelf life. No incentive to reorder again I'm afraid as matter was not corrected to my satisfaction.UpdateNo reply from Parsley Box to my review despite their reply. Puddings should have had 3 - 4 month shelf life (not older stock unless given prior notice of short life.) Considering I gave over a £120 first order I feel let down and guess my future custom didn't mean too much. Puddings have better shelf life in supermarkets (or sold as reduced.)

records.title: Food tastes not bad but nothing like the sleeve photo
records.text: I am sorry that I have to give only two stars. My main complaint is that many of the dishes are swimming in an excess of liquid gravy or sauce. The latest example was when we tried the Hearty Lasagne. It turned out to be nothing like the photo on the sleeve and looked like an unappetising loose mess and had to be eaten with a spoon. The taste was not bad but this could not be presented to guests as lasagne. Unfortunately this has been the case with a number of the Parsley Box items. We like the taste of most of what we have ordered but now know to use larger deeper plates because of the excessive amount of liquid in many of the dishes

records.title: Food is brown ( for mashed potatoes??) Likewise lasagne
records.text: Food is brown ( for mashed potatoes??) - likewise lasagne.  Flavour was terrible - I shan't be buying from you again.

records.title: Parsley Box admin.
records.text: This is for Parsley Box admin really as I have texted STOP several times (first one on 6th June) hit “unsubscribe” to emails but am still receiving communication and even got another catalogue in the post last week 🙈I really would like to opt out of Parsley Box please. Thank you

description: We are the UK’s fruit & veg box that fights food waste. We work closely with farmers & growers from all across the UK (& abroad), to rescue & fill up our boxes full of fresh, seasonal fruit & veg which are at risk of going to waste. The reason for this? They're simply seen as "too oddly shaped", "too oddly sized", or even just - "too many". Delivering all across London & the South-East. Proud B Corp.

records.title: Great service, great produce
records.text: Lovely fresh fruit & vegetables delivered weekly. The produce seems to stay fresh much longer than store bought items. Definitely got the family eating more fresh fruit & veg.I have the biggest mixed box and love that I can swap out items that we won't use for items that we will.When I did have 1 little niggle the customer service team got back to me straight away and all was sorted.I look forward to my oddbox delivery every week!

records.title: We have more vegetables in our diet
records.text: We have more vegetables in our diet, we are saving waste food (what's wrong with small carrots?) and are enjoying being creative with our finds in our OddBox on  Monday evening ... what's not to like?

records.title: Good quality produce
records.text: Very impressed with oddbox , I really like the thought of reducing food waste and packaging. It’s a good way to increase your variety of veg and fruit intake too . There has been no bad produce at all , very good quality. I added what the same quantity would be if bought from Tesco and it came out about £1 cheaper. The swapping options are really good too . The only issue is it’s quite a large quantity, I may consider getting a medium box ! If that’s my only concern that there’s too much then odd box are doing very well !

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent delivery service. Varied choice of produce with easy swaps so reducing waste. Good shelf life of produce.

records.title: Oddbox
records.text: Oddbox is a great way of changing what you eat throughout the week by using the variety of fruit and veg you get in your box.The cost of the box and any additional additional on's is very reasonable.The delivery and communication is second to none. You are kept updated on what is in your box that week, the add on's you can add, the choice of taking things out of your box if you don't like them. You get notified when your delivery has taken place and you get recipe ideas for what is in your box, or you can view recipes in the section on the website for ideas with other ingredients.The helping control food waste with produce that is perfectly edible and not prepacked is a big plus.Give oddbox a try, you might surprise yourself.

records.title: I love oddbox
records.text: I love oddbox. You can swap and add to your box which makes it very versatile.There is great variety and sometimes a gult of fruit which makes a nice pudding

records.title: Great experience especially for elderly…
records.text: Great experience especially for elderly people taking part in cancer treatment. Very easy to swap ingredients and to add some extras for the holidays.

records.title: Fab veg & fruit
records.text: Great choice of veg & fruit delivered every 2 weeks to the front door. Feels like a Christmas hamper arriving each time.Lovely tittle touches like a menu idea & why the veg is in your box & place of origin.

records.title: Oddbox is a great Company
records.text: Oddbox is a great Company, the produce is highly recommended & they are very competitive price wise! It is also a great delivery service & I wouldn’t change!

records.title: We are really pleased we found oddbox
records.text: We are really pleased we found oddbox. Since we joined they have changed the service so we can choose from a range of fruit and veg that need rescuing.Delivery is always on time - and they actually read the delivery instructions - and everything is so fresh, lasting much longer than stuff from the supermarket.We have had to change our food planning habits, but are eating more vegetables than before.

records.title: The excitement of what is in the box…
records.text: The excitement of what is in the box has made me change my cooking habits for the better. We are eating more healthier and the children are eating more fruit.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Delivery is very reliable, very easy to use system and swap out (and ban up to three specific veg. you dislike)  however not so sure that the small box really works for one.   i have to actively skip to a three weekly -as it gives me more than i can absorb as cooking for one, out a lot during day and freezer space limited.  I think fortnighly might be easier for small boxes or-. Tailoring quantities specifically for one person but understand delivery economies might be hard.  Currently my neighbours are getting a very good deal!

records.title: I was on the point of cancelling
records.text: I was on the point of cancelling my order.  But the opportunity to make unlimited swaps means that i will now get the goodies i really want.

records.title: Voyage of discovery!
records.text: I love receiving my Oddbox and discovering what is inside each week.  Mainly the quality is excellent (if somewhat misshapen, which is fine!) and when I did have a problem with an item the matter was resolved quickly and satisfactorily.  Also I enjoy browsing the many recipes.

records.title: Very reliable company
records.text: The box is always delivered on time. You can easily swap your items or cancel your box. Perfect size box for us.It feels good to be  recycling food that would otherwise go to waste.

records.title: Great idea and reasonably priced.
records.text: Great idea, bought odd veg from supermarket but this is better and more varied, Sometimes I get more than I chose/swapped so make veggie soup to give to family. I've had some fruit n veg I haven't had before, e.g. kiwi berries, long stem broccoli and a few more, good to save fruit and veg also have the boxes recycled too, keep up the good work I love it.

records.title: Enjoying variety of fruits and veg
records.text: I started Oddbox as an experiment and I haven't been disappointed. I haven't eaten every bit, I've given some away, like a big head of cauliflower (not one of my favourites) and lots of small potatoes (I tend to throw away more potatoes than I eat.) I'd like it better if I could have more options to pass on. I like being able to swap some of what's in the upcoming box and wish that option was available for extra small boxes. I'm excited to have cooked butternut squash for the first time yesterday. I just roasted it in cubes, but was amazed at how tasty it was! And I roasted sliced aubergine which I put in the freezer for future Spanish Chicken meals. I'm looking forward to my next box on Wednesday! I'd recommend Oddbox to anyone who likes to cook and isn't afraid to try new fruits and vegetables.

records.title: Love that there is a leaflet explaining…
records.text: Love that there is a leaflet explaining what the veg is and veg is good quality…..would have given 5 stars if there was more potatoes, only getting three in a family size box is not much use

records.title: Veg box with items I would not normally buy.
records.text: Enjoyed receiving veg box with certain items which I would not normally purchase. I did not think that the items were "wonky" or strange shapes, I guess just mainly surplus to requirements.  The smallest box was probably too much for one person and therefore I cancelled my subscription as it was going to be counter productive to preventing waste!

records.title: Great box
records.text: Great box, but only downside were the parsnips.Very small and dry.

records.title: Oddbox review
records.text: I appreciate the fact that OddBox offers different size boxes and I believe I've picked the right one for us.  I've very much appreciated the variety and freshness of the contents.  I've just put a stop to one week's delivery which was acknowledged without any fuss and I'm very happy about that because I have some build up at the moment and don't want to waste what has been thoughtfully rescued.  So, on the basis of my short experience (4 weeks to date), very satisfied.

records.title: Great produce drop off could be better
records.text: I love the variety and the ethics behind it. However on the last drop off they left the box in the rain not the tub we had placed and did not take back to old box.

records.title: Great box
records.text: Great box, with very good produce,except for the bag of rocket which was a bit mushy.I love not knowing what's going to be in the box, as I have several exclusions.It makes meal planning more interesting.I have even pickled some baby cucumbers, and made my own oven roasted tomatoes.

records.title: Vegetables always of good quality
records.text: Vegetables always of good quality. Come with a free recipe. Nice surprise in the morning to find the delivery by the gate

records.title: SO the great things are the quality
records.text: SO the great things are the quality, the variety and of course the saving of odd veg from feeling sad and not being used.  It lasts well, even things like bagged spinach is lasting a good 4 or 5 days, other things lasting 10 days (assuming we don't eat them). Especially if you pop a damp tea towel in the fridge drawer with it ;)   The only downside is the deciding what you want, almost a week before you get it.  Makes meal planning a bit harder as it feels so far away.  But I've been using about 4 weeks and I think I will continue.

records.title: A worthy cause here saving odd veg happy customer…
records.text: A worthy cause here saving odd veg from another fate maybe. I quite enjoy the unpredictability of what I'm going to get, it gives me a challenge sometimes to come up with a new recipe for a new vegetable rather than churning out the old repetoire

records.title: The boxes make me feel in touch with the season
records.text: The boxes make me feel in touch with the season, and they encourage me to try new recipes. I appreciate being able to swap out some items as needed so we get things we will use while they are fresh.

records.title: Flexible options
records.text: The flexibility is very good:  I can add items, prevent my personal dislikes appearing, suspend delivery if I am on holiday.  It is always interesting to see what is in the box, and find ways to use it.  There are recipe ideas, as well as useful information on how to store.  Yes, the fruit and veg may be odd sizes, or shapes, but they all taste fine!

records.title: Helping save the producers
records.text: Farmers work hard to produce our food and they are not truly supported by big supermarket chains who demand 'good looking' produce rather than 'good tasting' produce.Oddbox rescues the excess and distributes it to people who are keen to help 'save the planet' and support the growers.It can be funcoming up with new recipe ideas to put the produce to good use.

records.title: Great service and produce
records.text: Overnight delivery is really helpful and the produce is always really fresh. It's great to be able to swap items that we don't like / won't use or try things we wouldn't normally buy. I see it as a mini challenge to plan a week's meals around what we get and be a bit creative with the ingredients!We're a 2 person household, one vegetarian, and the medium fruit and veg box is just right for us.There have been a couple of occasions where an item was missing or has got damaged but the response when I've raised these were great and credit issued.

records.title: Obviously the fruit and vegetables are…
records.text: Obviously the fruit and vegetables are less than perfect but sometimes the vegetables aren't fresh and can be withered which I don't think that's very good especially as the cost isn't that cheap.

records.title: It's a lot of money for less.
records.text: It's a lot of money for less produce than you can buy in your local market. The good side is that the box is delivered, at an extra cost, so you don't need to carry heavy bags.

records.title: Palming off poor food at a premium
records.text: Branding and marketed to make you feel like you're a good person but all you're getting is subpar quality ingredients which aren't even necessarily from UK farmers. I got a butternut squash the size of a cooking apple all the way from Spain? My carrots (which were about 8cm long) went black before our second box arrived, which also had the same variety of carrots. We've cancelled it now. It's cheaper to buy what you want from a grocer.

records.title: My oddbox experience for the last 8 months I have really enjoyed revceiving my…
records.text: I have really enjoyed revceiving my boxes but it would be nice to choose whats in the box, i know i can exclude 3 items but you dont know what they will be replaced with & 9 times out of 10 its things we dont like or need.  Other than that great produce & idea, ive had to skip quite a few boxes just because there are more than 3 things we dont like or need as I buy the largest box . Shame really claire

records.title: Price is ok
records.text: Not bad however they give you a wonky stuff, not edible fruits or vegetables but they don’t refund. They also have incompetent drivers who plays loud music when they turn up and wake all street up during the delivery. I told them about it but nothing happened ! Response is so slow too

records.title: Really great concept
records.text: Really lovely concept however the price for what you get sadly isn't worth it. Happy to pay for the 'good' they do, however the value for the fruit box we get is around 4x the price you'd get from the supermarket. I understand these are more sustainable being a B Corp, however the cost isn't justifiable for the wonky fruit, especially when you can buy 'perfect' fruit elsewhere for less.Extra note: I love how the delivery driver collects the old box to re-use, nice touch!

records.title: Still under review
records.text: Last delivery not left in usual place so old box not collected for recycling.Some food not as fresh as expected. Last delivery tomatoes squashed in bottom of box so some had tobe discarded. Not sure how much longer I will continue as am struggling to use everything, maybe it'll take time to adjust and reduce other veg bought separately

records.title: The veg is great, fruit not so much
records.text: The vegetables are really great but some of the fruit doesn’t last very long at all.Had a delivery on Sunday morning (great delivery service as didn’t hear them come in the early hours). I had strawberries and a honeydew melon and both were thrown away by Tuesday morning as they’d gone bad quickly

records.title: The idea and ethos is great. Produce not so great
records.text: I like the idea of rescuing food from going to waste. But I have a few things that could balance the positive points backwards.1- Things are a bit more expensive than buying at the supermarket. You acknowledge you pay extra for delivery, but you also pay extra for the produce. Prices should be equal to normal supermarket prices. Delivery btw is great!2- The quality is OK, obviously you are saving stuff from being thrown away, but still, some produce is just meh... carrots smaller than my falange are less than ideal... asparagus had some pest eggs on them. Again, in the supermarket or market wouldn't choose them...

records.title: Some of the produce is great and it is…
records.text: Some of the produce is great and it is a good variety. However some of the quality has been poor - rotten potatoes and tasteless carrots.It is also difficult to cancel

records.title: I like the delivery system and your…
records.text: I like the delivery system and your packaging. Generally the variety is good. The shelf life is not always so great and I have received some vegetables where the quality has been poor and I have had to discard produce, which rather defeats the objective of saving on waste. I do like being able to order add-ons.

records.title: A great concept
records.text: A great concept, however, the reality does not live up to the hype. I have just cancelled my subscription, not because of the company or deliveries, but because I can visit my local farmers' market and buy wonky veg and fruits, in the quantities I want, at some 50% of Oddbox prices. In today's economic state, savings on essential foodstuffs is a paramount concern.

records.title: Quality
records.text: Update - whilst the quality was disappointing, Oddbox have dealt with my feedback promptly and provided a satisfactory outcome.  I was disappointed with some of the quality of produce in most recent box.  The easy peelers are very dry and one had to be thrown away as going bad.  The lemons that i added are also going bad very quickly- have had to throw 2 away so far.

records.title: Expensive for what you get
records.text: Can't fault them on customer service, but I've tried Oddbox a few times and I found the boxes were mainly full of dull basics, so I'd wind up with loads of carrots and potatoes every week. And quality is variable - soft onions and green potatoes in my last box before I cancelled. Ugly veg is fine. Poor quality or inedible is not.If you don't mind paying a significant premium for ok veg to reduce food wastage (it's at least double the cost of supermarket equivalent) then this might be for you. I'll spend the money at my local Sunday market instead.

records.title: Oddbox are still great....not so their…
records.text: Oddbox are still great....not so their new delivery partner. Have suspended our account because we were in despair at the inflexibility of the 'Modern Milkman' deliveries. Would like to return, but not while MM are the delivery partner. Oddbox's own deliveries were faultless.

records.title: I was dissapointed with today's small…
records.text: I was dissapointed with today's small veg box. 2 small cucumbers, 2 small courgettes and normal amount of other products plus my 2 add ons. I enjoyed receiving my last box as the veg lasted a week because it had a good amount of vegetables in it. This week it won't last a few days. Good job I put extra mushrooms in, I can get an extra days worth.

records.title: OddBox Veg
records.text: I like the root veg. sent as well as fruits such as tomatoes and avocados, also squash,courgettes etc. But salad veg. such as baby spinach  ,salad mixes etc are too much and soon go off!

records.title: I am sorry I  have cancelled my…
records.text: I am sorry I  have cancelled my subscription after three deliveries.  The freshness of the vegetables where not up to my standards. The first box contained a squash which was dry in the center when cut. The second an extremely large potato which was also discoloured when cut and tomatoes which needed using immediately. and in two of the boxes a stem of broccoli which I had to discard by the Tuesday following delivery.

records.title: Do you know where your fruit and veg comes from?
records.text: I liked the concept but my last order consisted of 7 items included 4 imported products. Cancelled order in order to use local Greengrocer who I can visit on foot and carry veg &fruit home. Also purchase local eggs and flowers. However, I would recommend to others and providing you select wisely bearing mind you can end up with 4 curly cucumbers etc the fact that you don’t know the source when ordering is not ideal. Grateful for Oddbox for making me think more about food

records.title: Could be better
records.text: The X-small box almost always had carrots, cabbage and kale. Fruit would be oranges or apples most boxes. The rest of the items in the box did not offer value for money, unlike the bigger boxes. If you don’t cancel within a small window of time they will charge you for another box before subscription ends. Update- the customer service is decent and I admire this company’s attempts to decrease plastic and food waste.

records.title: Pretty disappointed
