records.text: Pretty disappointed. I was all for reducing food waste but it’s £17 with delivery and the value just isn’t there. This week two large potato’s 4 peppers some leeks I think some carrots and 1 small butternut squash. Had to cancel the subscription just can’t afford to have to still go and buy additional veg when it’s already quite expensive.

records.title: Absolutely great until last delivery…
records.text: Absolutely great until last delivery didn’t show up. Had to email and just got told it was an operation problem. Shame because up until then it’s been brilliant. Had done my weekly shop around my box. Now a bit nervous about making that mistake again

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: I really wanted to love this and I am all for reducing produce waste, so the idea seemed great. Execution however leave a lot to be desired. The veg is not organic, nor does it claim to be, this however does mean compromising on quality: some things go off super fast, faster than those bought in a supermarket (think Aldi-fast), a few items arrive damaged/already rotten, so have to be sent to the bin. Some items seem to travel a long way from abroad, which makes little sense, especially when there are UK alternatives (don’t we want to help UK farmers? Think apples arriving from France, when uk apples were in season). Overall disappointing, so after giving it a good go of two months I will be cancelling.

records.title: Poor quality
records.text: While I get their ethos. The quality of the items delivered is so disappointing. IDon’t mind odd shapes, I got  tiniest of carrots and potatoes. It was not worth it at all.

records.title: Never deliver to my door
records.text: Never deliver to my door, quarter of a mile away. We are both disabled, car journey. Box left outside of site shop all night.poor contents..£10 at supermarket.Next one is last chance!

records.title: Not great
records.text: Not great. The last box they were supposed to substitute 3 but they only sent 2 substitutes. They gave me 2 oranges as a fruit on a medium size box. Both were rotten. I did contact customer service and they have me a £5 credit. I would have preferred a £5 refund. I might not buy another box. Also the quality of the vegetables is not always great. In the last box I got a butternut that was so small it would only be enough for a single person. I am not sure there is quality control in your company.

records.title: The second time I have tried oddbox
records.text: The second time I have tried oddboxThe veg arrived on time but things like aubergines were wrinkly and the salad leaves went off after 2 days.the weight seemed to be made up of numerous yellow peppers.6 in a small vegbox.the chantennay carrots were just small bits.sorry but no thanks

records.title: Loved it at first
records.text: Loved it at first. Then started to get broken off half carrots, bruised apples, wilted lettuce ... consistently. I was offered credit on our account, but it just became an unworthy way to shop. Love the concept, but they didn't deliver nice enough food for me to pay.

records.title: Very disappointed with my small box at…
records.text: Very disappointed with my small box at total price with delivery of £13.49.Included 1 squash, 1 aubergine, 1 lettuce, 4 tomatoes, 1 beetroot, 4 small potatoes and a bunch of spring onions. Could have got it all in the supermarket for £6.Was expecting bigger quantities of veg not suitable in shape for the supermarket. Might be good for the environment but not the pocket. I cancelled my subscription.

records.title: Cancelled our subscription last week
records.text: Cancelled our subscription last week, due to getting rotten or near gone off food, three times in a row. At first We enjoyed getting the box and seeing what goodies we had, but when you open the box and get 1 grape, half a swede, a melon that your thumb sinks into as you pick it up.  And half the items missing, we've given up.

description:
We believe home cooking is important. So we made it simple. When life gets busy, cooking’s often the first thing to go. With a Gousto recipe box, you choose recipes you’d like to cook, and we deliver the perfectly measured ingredients plus foolproof recipe cards. Create delicious, wholesome meals to share with those you love.

Visit www.gousto.co.uk

records.title: New to Guosto but very impressed
records.text: Have just started using Guosto and can't recommend them enough.... the meals are great and so easy to cook and eating healthier has never been so easy to choose or as tasty to eat, plus they have some excellent offers just now.The meals are genuinely restaurant quality and the selection is so good....As a veggie they really have a great depth of options and am totally on board with them and can't wait to see what next week will bring.... 👍

records.title: Love Gousto but the app keeps logging…
records.text: Love Gousto but the app keeps logging me out and then when I try to log back in it says technical problem please try again later. I’ve not been able to log in for 2 days. When logging into my account via the browser it just doesn’t load any of my upcoming meals etc.

records.title: Very good service
records.text: Very good service, I've never had any issues. My only feedback would be more choices for the vegan menu.

records.title: Best food service on the market.
records.text: Since my last review I have to say the delivery service has improved significantly. I now receive my Gusto recipes within the time slot emailed and text to me. As always the ingredients are tasty, fresh and well-proportioned. It would be fantastic if you switch one of the recipes for an extra plate. So if you have a guest that week over for dinner you get just a little more ingredients to make up an extra plate. Plan forward for when your entering for an extra 1or 2 people with your favourite Gusto dish, without having to change your subscription package (just a thought)Other than that I’ve continued to order consecutively since lockdown 2020 and had family and friends convert. Thank you Gusto, Yours Sincerely A valued customer

records.title: Had a gorg night with my friend
records.text: Had a gorg night with my friend, Luke was 10/10 he made us feel so welcome and was the most perfect waiter! Thank you gusto and especially Luke xx

records.title: Love Gusto - 5 STARS all the way!
records.text: Love Gusto! Made my life so much easier.We have been using Gusto for two years now and still love them!  The pricing is incredible, the deliveries always on time and the food choice is now so large we never run out of different options.  When we started with Gusto they have about 80 options per week, they now have over 200 a week! We cannot recommend this company enough.  This has saved me so much time, money and food waste.

records.title: I would like to take back my previous…
records.text: I would like to take back my previous review. I complained about the portion size of the one pot haddock and leek risotto. Not only was it enough for 2 but it was bloody beautiful. From now on I'll wait to cook it before I review it.

records.title: We love it
records.text: Joined few weeks back and we get 3 meals for 2 people and the portions are enough for 3 people. My 5 year old son loves helping cook them with me and he is finally eating other foods his favourite is the pepperoni pasta. My partner also loves the meals and he can be quite fussy I've finally got my son and partner trying diffrent meals they wouldn't eat before. I have also noticed a difference in my health I don't get upset stomach as much and my skin feels much better. I like you can pause your subscription which helps for last week of the month when our budget is tight.

records.title: Amazing
records.text: I love this company as it has revolutionised our eating and shopping habits.  Every other week my family (4 adults) choose our own recipe then make our meal choice.  The recipes are delicious and meal times are delightful, social affairs with us all enjoying the flavours and variety.  I love the way everything is included and any issues are dealt with quickly and efficiently using the app.

records.title: Absolutely love Gousto!
records.text: Absolutely love Gousto and so pleased they decided to launch in Northern Ireland! All the meals are so delicious and the portions are adult sized unlike other recipe boxes I’ve tried. Gousto has taken the stress away from meal planning for my family and I look forward to receiving my five dinners every Monday. Great job and highly recommended ☺️

records.title: Convenient, occasionally fresh produce not so good
records.text: Mostly the food is fresh, however sometimes vegetables and herbs can be very short dated and also haven’t travelled very well, can be crushed. The recipes are great and having everything prepared and easy to follow recipes make my life much easier, I enjoy looking through the recipes and choosing them.

records.title: No Keto/diabetic option
records.text: I like the variety of dishes but my husband is diabetic and we struggled to find dishes without carbs. We will be stopping Gousto next week because of this. I think there should be a diabetic/ keto option as the vast majority of dishes are rice or pasta based. Also the only fish available without having to pay more is basa fish. If you want a tiny strip of Salmon you have to pay anything extra £3 per portion or so.

records.title: 3 very tasty dishes however
records.text: 3 very tasty dishes. However, it’s starting to feel a little over-priced. The curry was good and there was enough chicken without the extra packet - why was this included? Methinks it’s because you know it’s over-priced so you think you need the customer to feel they are getting good value. I’m not fooled.

records.title: Love Gousto delivery is fast
records.text: Love Gousto delivery is fast. So many food options but I don’t like how food/meat options are really small

records.title: I enjoyed the experience of varied…
records.text: I enjoyed the experience of varied cooking food was fresh However I think thr packaging could improve. A competitor bags each meal up in a brown paper bag rather than all thrown in together.The reason a cancelled was because of the use of the app, I was fortnightly but to change a date you had to change your subscription authentication back again It would be good to just pick and choose when you want it, and not be sent deals when you don't

records.title: A great idea but not quite right for me
records.text: I enjoyed trying new recipes and the step by step guidance helped me to organise myself better.  Most of the dishes I enjoyed. The issue for me was 2-fold.  The quantities of some ingredients were suitable for 2, not 1. For example, the packs of pasta (not a problem as it was dried), the sachets of creme fraiche, cream etc. (was a problem as they don't keep more than a day or 2). My other issue is with the amount of plastic and non-returnable packaging - every herb and sauce in plastic and the delivery box and ice packs not collected with the next delivery. I think the idea is great and, at some point I may try more recipes.

records.title: I signed up a few weeks ago... Love it!
records.text: I signed up a few weeks ago, after being really disappointed with one of the main competitors. I like that gousto does not use so much plastic. They have really great customer service that sorted out any issues straight away. My only issue is trying to use the referring discount it never goes through and says an account has already been created!

records.title: High quality meals
records.text: All meals so far have been of a very high quality as always with generous portion size.Just a shame that during the packing/delivery process a sachet of sauce got split open and sauce got over several other ingredients

records.title: Perfect apart from peas
records.text: Perfect apart from peas. The contents had been pushed into box resulting in peas popping open and being all over the box

records.title: Great quality food and takes the stress out of meal planning
records.text: Great quality food and gorgeous recipes. The recipes are easy to follow and all have a time guide so you can plan ahead. My husband and I thoroughly enjoy the meals, we haven't had a takeaway in two months as the food is delicious, we feel like we've already had our treat. Gousto takes the stress out of meal planning and there is zero waste.

records.title: Amazing
records.text: Really good portions, tastes amazing only complaint is that one or 2 ingredients were missing from a meal or 2 but will carry on using gusto because we love it and price is good 👍

records.title: Really enjoying the different recipes
records.text: Really enjoying the different recipes, some are more fiddley than others but you get the hang of it.  Easy to follow instructions.  Only issue we have is with the delivery. Yodel keep leaving the box outside in full view in all weathers.  They never ring the doorbell or put the box in our porch as requested. Food lovely though

records.title: A mostly enjoyable experience
records.text: I'm really enjoying Gousto because it has rekindled my love affair with cooking. Gousto has also brought my out of my comfort zone and I'm eating new and interesting things. The app can be a little buggy at times. And I wish I was told in more advance and had a tighter window of when I can expect my order.

records.title: Great! Only fault one missing sweet potato.
records.text: All recipes have been lovely so far. Just one order was missing a sweet potato and we got a block of cheese instead!

records.title: Supper time
records.text: We really enjoyed the variety of the meals. The recipes are easy to follow. The food is so tasty although we feel sometimes there is not enough protein!

records.title: Great recipes
records.text: Great recipes. Wide range of choice. I enjoyed all recipes, but I would like more options for free range chicken if possible as I tend to have to substitute chicken that's not free range (I find it quite smelly) and I never choose recipes that I want if they have chicken thigh as I have found that to be quite smelly and generally not nice. Other than that I enjoy gousto range!

records.title: The recipes are so easy to follow …
records.text: The recipes are so easy to follow most of the ingredients are fresh and help make delicious meals.If there is a problem the Gusto team are so quick to respond and rectify any lost or poor quality ingredients although this is rare as nearly all the ingredients are finest quality

records.title: Enjoyed Gusto and new recipes
records.text: Enjoyed Gusto and new recipes. Had some delicious stuff. Well organised and perfect quantities. The current one however, is flavourless. Mince and noodles. Only sauce is a bit of honey and soy sauce. I had half then added swert chilli to the other half

records.title: My latest bix
records.text: Simple to follow instructions. Very taste meals. Could do with more sauce on most recipes.

records.title: Really good choice
records.text: I love Gousto and not have to think about what healthy meals we can have each day the only negative I’ve got is sometimes the dates on the meat is a bit short would be good if a bit longer

records.title: Awful phone line if you get through to…
records.text: Awful phone line if you get through to customer service - agent blamed his 'data line' and called my landline back but it was no better, very hard to understand the agent due to strong accent and background noise, and he struggled to assist with the problem with the order as a consequence.

records.title: I ordered 2 meal choices
records.text: I ordered 2 meal choices , I received green potato and rotten pepper Customer services credited my account . This is not useful as I won’t be buying again , it’s replacement food I need I think these meals are well over priced . Packaging far too excessive . I am going to return to simply cook , far better value and some appealing offers

records.title: Poor quality and very small portions.
records.text: Poor quality and very small portions.I’m all for health conscious meals but for two active adults, the portions are very small.I’ve even taken to using smaller plates so they’re fuller!Today’s recipe is the last straw. Pan fried haddock is shown on the recipe and website as a fillet of Haddock. However what you receive is a 200gm pack of Haddock ‘bites’, basically 3 small pieces.How does that resemble a fillet?I actually moved over to Gousto from Hello Fresh as their quality was not as it used to be either, but once the discounted menus stop, I can’t see how it’s worth the money.Nice recipes and pretty good choices but I feel that the consumer is once again suffering from shrinkflation.

records.title: Big drop in quality
records.text: Have been with Gousto for a few years but recently the quality has really dropped. Last week we had mould growing inside the pack of fresh pasta and this week we had a mouldy apple rolling around in the box getting all the ingredients sticky and gross even though none of our recipes needed an apple! They also now use yodel who are just awful and the boxes are battered, turn up late and the drivers never knock/ring so the box just sits outside until we notice it.

records.title: Beware of scanning the 25% off QR code…
records.text: Beware of scanning the 25% off QR code that you get through the post! I was in the middle of choosing my recipes when I remembered I had a code for 25% off. I scanned it but it took me to the website rather than the app, and rather than taking 25% off my regular box, it ordered me an extra one! So this week, I had 2 boxes delivered in 2 days and they are refusing to refund one of the boxes, even though we can't eat everything in time before it will go off. Just cancelled my account which is a shame as I was quite a loyal customer before and enjoyed the recipes.

records.title: Great delivery/promo value.  Very little enjoyment
records.text: We usually go with the other big player in the field but thought we’d try these guys as the the other menus changed very little - particularly vegetarian fayre.  Promo deal was quite good value - that said we’re 3/5 meals down and it’s been… underwhelming.  Can’t say I enjoyed eating anything so far.  The flavours just don’t work and the dishes look less than appetising.  I’m aware most of it is down to us and our cooking but usually we manage to make something enjoyable with the other company.  No so much here sorry

records.title: Non UK Ingredients
records.text: I was disappointed to find that ingredients that were in season in the UK were not used.Examples:Tomatoes from MoroccoHerbs from other countries not the UK etcOur Farmers deserve better

records.title: Lovely food - not so good packaging
records.text: Lovely food - not so good packaging It's a shame that when you order 3 x meals, they just put all the ingredients in together - rather than keep each meal separate. There is quite a lot of unnecessary plastic packing too.The free desserts are nice, of course they are, they are chocolate (in single use plastic pots) - but why no choice and why not a lower sugar/calorie option?

records.title: Good Food. Terrible Customer Service and Delivery
records.text: I have had some great food from Gousto and I am still a customer. I am a bit of a picky eater and vegetarian so do have to skip some weeks. The recipes are great and it makes it really easy to add some lovely flavours.However, the customer service is terrible and delivery is abysmal. They will use Yodel and they often are late. Have had customer service lie about the time it arrived despite emails from a previous agent confirming the truth. If you have issues with Gousto, then don't expect them to be resolved. They will charge for delivery and they will not refund the delivery charge if the time is missed.

records.title: Food is good, delivery isn't!
records.text: I've been using Gousto for a while now & the food is good, although I'm now finding a lot of the recipes are rice & pasta dishes & there's no choice of white or wholemeal which would be good for dietary needs. Delivery used to be DPD who were really good but it's now Yodel who are completely rubbish! The delivery is always really late in the evening & although Gousto states delivery will be between 8am & 7pm I regularly get emails on the day from Gousto saying the box is delayed & should be with me by 10pm. You'd think if they're having to regularly send these emails they'd change the delivery company but obviously not. I'm waiting for Yodel to deliver today hopefully I won't be in bed when they do eventually turn up!!

records.title: Great for people who don't like cooking!
records.text: I really like the idea of these boxes, and how quick and easy the meals are to make.However, I wish it was possible to remove ingredients when ordering. For example, I can't eat onion, so every time I select a meal which uses onion, I'm left with one that will just go to waste. And if I already have an ingredient in, it seems a waste of plastic to have a little portion come with my order when I could use my own.The other issue I have is that I wish orders could be fully reviewed before being placed - meal selection and total cost. It would allow people to make adjustments before placing the order, rather than trying to change it after.

records.title: Sometimes there is limited meals
records.text: Sometimes there is limited variety in meal choices - especially for those with dietary restrictions. Last order had one unusable veg and one almost pre chopped. They did put a credit on my account once I submitted a photo of the said items.  Whilst it takes the thinking out of meal planning it can be quite time consuming to make so check you are choosing the quick cook options if short on time. That said have had some tasty meals from them.

records.title: Not great
records.text: Not that easy, definitely took more than the stipulated 10 minutes, and one recipe required flour, which not everyone has in the house. The noodle dish with pak choi was impossible to mix and quite dry.

records.title: Would be best if moved back to DPD rather than Yodel
records.text: I think Gousto is great in what they do and we really like meals and pricing seems to be pretty good. However, it seems that they moved away from DPD to Yodel delivery and we are cancelling it.. Two latest deliveries are delivered late with damaged boxes. One was at 9pm while delivery window is until 7pm, another delivery was just before 7pm while estimated was between 6 and 8pm. So they basically just made it on time.

records.title: Not Bad for Newbies
records.text: If you don't often cook and want to get into it, then Gousto is a decent start. Everything delivered and easy-to-follow instructions (mostly).I'd say I'm an 'advanced' cook, and only tried this because I got 70% off. It was good the first few times. But there are various issues:- The portions are too small for a male adult- There's so much plastic waste; everything in small sachets etc- One time I didn't choose my selections, and 4 out of 5 of what arrived were bass fish dishes! (tbf they gave me a part refund)- The recipes are all a bit same-y. As I said: it's a good way to get into cooking if you're a rookie.

records.title: Recent changes
records.text: I have been with Gousto for about 4 years now. I have always been a major fan of the massive variety of options and new things to try- it makes cooking so much easier and exciting. However Gousto has recently been skimping on the little bits that make a meal so enjoyable. They are using the same amount of spices and lemons/limes and herbs for a 2 person meal and a four person meal. It really does affect the flavor and is just a bit unfair for those of us paying for the big box but getting the same amount of extras as the small box. If it continues I may thinking of switching boxes.

records.title: Red Thai curry last night carbanara…
records.text: Red Thai curry last night carbanara tonight.  One bit of criticism is the fresh tomatoes area bit manky/ripe for me otherwise it would have been 5*........... What a super fast response from Ryan at Gousto.  If you need photos just send me a contact email.

records.title: Too much packaging for me
records.text: I quite like the recipes, I like how the cards are easy to follow. It’s a bit repetitive though, feel like everything is either curry or mince.  The quality of the food is good.  I find it fiddly sorting through all the mini packages and my biggest dislike is the astronomical amount of packaging waste.

records.title: Gousto is good quality and convenient
records.text: I like the gousto box, it’s easy for me to cook and having everything portioned out is fab.  However the delivery service/courier hasn’t been great.  One box missed then others delivered so late on my delivery day meant I had to ensure I had an alternative meal on standby.  I think Yodel haven’t been particularly good which has made me reconsider if gousto is really that convenient after all.

records.title: I didn’t really like Gousto
records.text: I didn’t really like Gousto I didn’t like that it wasn’t tailored sufficiently for single adult and sometimes the recipes were complicated. Had to install the app and use that and that was annoying given recipe cards in boxes - The whole point of menu boxes was to simplify and improve my diet but it didn’t work. It’s also expensive. Often times things were missing or items were required that I just hadn’t known about. The app has poor functionality and it’s not worth taking the time to feedback Two recipes were delicious and simple (out of 3 boxes)  Moroccan style shepherd pie and sumac carrots, oven baked biryani,  ( the moussaka would have been great but it needed milk and I don’t drink it) incidentally this is the easiest part of the app - choosing and “hearting” recipes. So I have abandoned Gousto as a bad idea - it might work better for some people who’ve got faff about time. I expect it’s better experience  for families / house shares etc

records.title: Holding Payments
records.text: The food is fine , apart from the odd damaged item , however customer service and payment system is the worst system ever, they hold your payment 2/3 days before  , no problem , but change you delivery date that when the system goes wrong , they hold the payment again!! Example thos week box due Sunday,  today  changed to Tuesday  £66.04 payment held again.its not the money its the principal and the hold isn't taken off for days , come on Guosto sort yourselves out or your going to loose a customer to Hello ......

records.title: Bovaer - about to cancel the service.
records.text: About to cancel the service as they keep sending Arla's dairy products. Probably also beef contaminated with Bill Gates new experiment - Bovaer... Refuse to be a guinea pig on a lunatics experiment.

records.title: Poor Ingredients/Missed Delivery
records.text: We were using Gousto for 2 years but recently they completely failed to delivery our box leaving us without food for the week. I get that problems occur but they didn't communicate that the box wouldn't be delivered until the evening of the delivery date. If we had known we could have made other arrangements. To make matters worse they did not offer to redeliver the box the next day instead only offering us the refund credited to our Gousto account. No thanks, we won't be using that so have requested a refund to our bank account and we are now going to try Hello Fresh.Constant price increases, unreliable deliveries and missing/poor quality ingredients mean we will use another service now.

records.title: Gousto is losing its USP drastically
records.text: So fed up of the warehouse staff not packaging correctly;There’s always a series of missing ingredients that you have to go out and buy yourself (which defeats the point and purpose and convenience of Gousto)Then you live-chat to raise it with the staff and they give you a £2 coupon; every time. Of which doesn’t cover the price of the missing ingredients usually. Plus it doesn’t account for the time taken to report or the time spent going to get the groceries.Unfortunately this is a common occurrence with Gousto; they clearly don’t actually care about customer service or retention. They just hope they have enough rolling customers at any time who are willing to put up with small, bashed up fresh produce, meat that stinks after a couple of days, and a weekly game of ‘what will we have to go out and buy ourselves?’When you actually rally up the cost of the ingredients, you realise how much of a premium you’re paying for warehouse staff who can’t fulfill your order and live chat support that don’t actually care

records.title: They use Yodel for delivery
records.text: I was enjoying getting back into cooking. But sadly they use Yodel and yesterdays order just didn't arrive. Have to wait for a refund, so beans on toast for the next 5 days I guess. Cancelled my subscription until they use a decent delivery company

records.title: Halloumi cheese 3 months out of date
records.text: Halloumi cheese was 3 months out of date which comes from poor quality control. Pitta bread date says see meal date? Can this be believed if products are sent out of date?. Poor communication regards problem when reported via website/ appUPDATE...A week after replying to Gousto as they requested I've still not heard back, very poor customer service continues!!UPDATE #2... Same auto reply from Gousto, guess they're not really interested.

records.title: Our delivery didn't turn up yesterday…
records.text: Our delivery didn't turn up yesterday so had to go to shops to get dinner and was late eating. Not much help from customer service couldn't tell me why no delivery and was told to make other plans for evening meal. Have cancelled subscription and asked for refund, will go back to Hello Fresh.

records.title: Poor quality ingredients, tiny portions and poor customer service
records.text: I’ve have been a Guesto customer for a while now but recently the quality of ingredients is poor, the size of ingredients are tiny for example three potatoes provided to make chips for two adults were no bigger than three new potatoes. Short expiry dates, often items missing. Can only report one issue a day in the last few boxes always more than one issue. Have now cancelled as contacted their customer services to highlight the issue and given £5 refund. £5? For boxes that continually have missing items, poor quality ingredients and tiny portions. No thanks, customer service for being a customer for years very poor. Have now cancelled after a few years of being a customer.

records.title: If it ain't broke, don't fix it...
records.text: ...just offer discounts or credits for poor quality ingredients.Bendy carrots, squidgy potatoes, bloody and gristly chicken. The list goes on. It's easy enough to report the bad ingredients and get a credit, but that doesn't make up for being short of ingredients when you're about to cook or for having to make a trip to the supermarket to replace stuff.Everything also seems to have very short dates. We received an egg dated to go off two weeks before the eggs we bought from the supermarket the previous week.It seems the business model is buy short shelf life food and give a discount if someone grumbles. The recipes are great, but when backed up by poor produce, it makes for a frustrating service.Someone will be along to comment 'it's not the service we expect you to receive', but it is what I've come to expect.

records.title: Put some effort in Gousto.
records.text: Thought I'd give it a try because they're one of the few companies that have an option for 1 person boxes. First problem, the recipe cards are designed for 2,3,4 people. You have to use the app for single instructions so why did you even bother sending the cards!? I'm also not faffing around with an app while I'm trying to cook.Second, some of the ingredients were an absolute joke. The smallest red pepper I have ever seen and spring onions that could be mistaken for a blade of grass.Honestly annoyed me so much I literally rage quit and took EVERY SINGLE THING they sent me and chucked it.

description:
At SimplyCook we want to get Britain cooking! Despite our nation’s love of food, recipe programs and celebrity chefs, most of us only have 6 meals or less in our repertoire. We aim to change that by making cooking a simple and hassle free process so you can expand your repertoire with ease!

😋 We love flavour – we want your dinners to taste amazing.
💷 We want to save you money – our short shopping lists mean you don’t have to buy 20 ingredients to cook a tasty new recipe and our meals work out between £2 and £6 per person in total.
⏱Ultimate convenience – you can use our kits when you want, cooking takes around 20 minutes, and the items you have to add are easily accessible.

👋 We're a small company and really care about our customers. If you have an issue, we want to put it right straight away. Everyone from the team reads and replies to reviews and we take all your feedback and suggestions on board.

records.title: The Best
records.text: I have been a customer for about 3 years. A quietly efficient Company who respond to queries on-line virtually by return. Their menu of around 150 meals is excellent, none,that I have made, takes more than 25 mins. Even the wipe-able menu cards are arranged with a counterfoil (to be separated as a shopping list). Nothing beats a trial, go ahead, it's free! Chicken Makhani, Goan fish curry, Butternut squash hot pot are high on my list.

records.title: I tried the 7 days free trial and…
records.text: I tried the 7 days free trial and received my first box for £1. In the beginning, I was a really mad because I was charged £10 Instead of one, but after reaching the customer service, everything was resolved and I was refunded my £9. So very good nice and efficient customer service.Well, I didn’t try the box yet however I am glad they respected their engagement. The box looks nice and well assorted. I hope the stuffs inside taste as good as they look😋

records.title: Great products, they are amazing.
records.text: Their product is amazing. I adore the little pots of loveliness, so much concentrated flavour. Easy to follow, quick to make, aswell as the recipe card having the tear off shopping list is a clever idea. If you go on self-catering or camping holiday a great way to have gorgeous dinners. Well done Simply Cook. Also customer care is friendly and  professional.

records.title: Fantastic range of tastes...
records.text: Fantastic range of tastes and culinary choice from all over the world. You can try out different flavours & foods without having to buy lots of ingredients. When stuck for 'What to cook?" I find inspiration from the pages. I always cook from scratch. So I love the fact that it is only the recipe & spices given, leaving you free to use either the ingredients suggested or substitute your own. I find the packs are really useful to take on holiday, self catering!, meaning you don't have to buy lots of spices etc to cook delicious meals with. I also love the flexibility in being able to change the delivery dates & communication is good too. I really recommend giving Simply cook a go!

records.title: Outstanding Customer Service I have only communicated with this…
records.text: I have only communicated with this company in order to buy gifts for my family but have been really impressed with the prompt and friendly replies even when I’d made an error which necessitated extra work. If the products match this level of service I’ll certainly be using them again and recommending them to others.Thank you

records.title: Responses always quick and friendly
records.text: Simply Cook are always quick to respond to emails, and so friendly, too. Yesterday I asked if they could send me an old version of a recipe, since I preferred it to the new version and I had it by lunchtime today - New Year's day by the way!

records.title: It’s exactly as it says. Simply cook
records.text: It’s is exactly as it says Simply cook. You have to have some ingredients already in ( chicken and the like) but you get all the sauces in little tubs so there is no wastage. Easy to read and follow instructions and really tasty meals.

records.title: First class servicerder…
records.text: Had problems initially placing an order as I do not wish to receive monthly supplies with simply cook help have successfully placed my order thank you simply cook cannot wait to receive it thanks again Jeff

records.title: Great customer service
records.text: With huge thanks to Mandy and David who between them demonstrated great customer service helping me to restart my membership when my computer said ‘no’ and sorted out a finance issue too.  I’m pleased to restart my membership after a short break - the kits are great and there’s always someone to help out when things go awry (even if it’s due to pilot error!).

records.title: Excellent,prompt customer service-on…
records.text: Excellent,prompt customer service-on New Years Day no less! Always personal and friendly help from Simply Cook,and if course the recipe packs are delicious!

records.title: Perfect Curry Every Time          I found Simply cook was efficient and…
records.text: I found Simply cook was efficient and prompt in sending the spices for the meals they advertised. After cooking the first meal I was very happy with the result even though chilly and curry are not my favourite ingredients.  I enjoyed the adventure but no longer have a large enough household to purchase their spices on a regular basis.

records.title: Natural Spices
records.text: I love the interest put into the spices. I can instantly relate to them. I can use them in my cooking confidently when not following their recipe and the aroma teases the palate that you want to eat

records.title: Not bad
records.text: Not bad, work ok if you follow instructions, a interesting method of cooking real food....

records.title: I unwittingly signed up to 'SimplyCook'…
records.text: I unwittingly signed up to 'SimplyCook' by ticking a box when purchasing another item. I was caught out by not reading the accompanying 'Terms and Conditions'. It has take me a couple of months to realise this. However, once I realised my error and notified the company they were quick to respond and cancelled the subscription immediately which was very much appreciated.

records.title: I paid for a set of 4 spices
records.text: I paid for a set of 4 spices, however after some time they had not been delivered, therefore I contacted their customer service. Within 24 hours I received 2 emails, one from Hannah and one from David, to say sorry and the following day received a replacement pack. Can't fault their customer service commitment. The pack contained the 4 chosen meal spices plus recipe cards and shopping lists so even a 'non' cook should be safe!

records.title: Great tastes for such a hassle free…
records.text: Great tastes for such a hassle free creation of food. Flavours that are layered and varied;  using store cupboard ingredients with the pots of paste/spices/sauce it just lifts off once combined. It’s relatively quick too, I find that I have cooked a wonderful meal without labouring in the kitchen for hours. My only criticism is with the little tubs; unfortunately they are plastic tubs with a soft plastic seal and they prove difficult to peel open (so I resort to using a knife) .

records.title: Really happy with the recipe pots!
records.text: Really happy with the recipes and customer services. Recipe pots have made me much more adventurous when cooking from scratch; just wish they were easier to open, often have to resort to a sharp knife...Only real complaint I have: I wish we were sent an email when a new box is on its way - giving us a chance to change the recipes if we need to. I've been caught out a couple of times just too busy to log on and see when a box is due, a quick email would really help. Thank you :)

records.title: I had a lot of problems with my order…
records.text: I had a lot of problems with my order but the team is fast and efficient, reliable and communicate clearly not leaving the buyer clueless about anything like their packages, returns or etc for example. Great customer experience just bad circumstances (that's why it's a 4 and not 5) but I'll highly recommend regardless ❤️

records.title: Great recipes
records.text: I have used Simply Cook for over 4 years and love the measured pots of spices that makes cooking interesting and different dishes so easy.I would have given 5 stars but just lately the pots have been really difficult to open.  On the whole I would highly recommend the products.

records.title: Worth Trying as you may like them
records.text: I was recommended this by a friend so thought I'd give it a go.It was easy to order & there were plenty of choices to choose from & was allowed to order 4.They arrived very quickly & are small enough to go through your letter box so you don't have to worry about being in.The seasoning pots are very small but they come with instructions on how to cook the recipe, but be careful when taking the kids off.The meal wasn't quite my cup of tea but probably because I do make my own meals from scratch.It's good for new ideas on cooking food.It wasn't particularly easy to find where you cancel but I managed.

records.title: Delicious recipes, friendly staff
records.text: The recipes are delicious! The cancellation process was simple and easy. The staff are friendly too.

records.title: Great food and customer service. Limited recipe options for particular needs.
records.text: Great delivery. Recipes are pretty good. I do find the selection a bit limited if you dont want something spicy or if you need more gluten free options. I would encourage SimplyCook to improve the range if possible. Excellent customer service if you have any issues.

records.title: Really Tasty Easy-to-Make Meals
records.text: Using Simply Cook has been a great decision. We have really enjoyed all the recipes we’ve tried so far (we’re on the fifth box I think), the flavours are wonderful. I’m not a great cook so the simplicity of the recipes suits me and also has led me to try new foods and new techniques. The company are very pleasant to deal with, genuinely nice people. Would have given 5 stars but the lids don’t always peel off the pots of pastes and spices so that be a bit fiddly.

records.title: Complicated website,good company though
records.text: Complicated website led me to make a mistake with an order,got to give them credit though cos they gave me a refund very quickly

records.title: If you love cooking...
records.text: If you love cooking, you probably have all the ingredients in your cupboards already (although they are careful to not give you the recipe of what's in each sauce or spice blend). The variations/substitutions are clever if not essential, because let's face it the ingredients they send will be on the bland side.

records.title: I have been doing this subscription for…
records.text: I have been doing this subscription for many years now. The only disappointment I have had so far is the apparent reduction in the number of curry dishes as those are my absolute fav!

records.title: The kits are fab, the website not so easy
records.text: The kits that Simply Cook provide are excellent ! They turn the ordinary makings of a meal into a very special meal without having to do all the work. I thoroughly recommend them. However, I can only give them 4 stars because I find the website and phone app difficult to use. It looks like it’s user friendly but it isn’t. Hopefully this will be improved over time.

records.title: Test it and then decide if it's really for you!
records.text: I recently signed up but have now cancelled. I had 3 deliveries and I'm pleased with what I got but tried to put into my basket, for the next month's delivery, 4 of the same dish, as we liked it, but it wouldn't allow me four of the same. I've now received and been charged, without notification to pick my own, their choice for that month's delivery, that I didn't want. Also, the pots are not the easiest to open, so you end up opening them with a knife which I think is a bit dangerous.

records.title: Great flavours and very easy recipes
records.text: Great flavours and very easy recipes - they had a big thumbs up in my household but were just a little expensive for a family of 4 on top of the ingredients………2 sets were needed for some recipes (not all) and this made the cost for flavouring too much for me. Some recipes were enough for 2-4 so I will buy those again in the future. The little ingredient list Simply Cook provide for your purse is a fantastic idea and made the shopping so easy. Great product, just a little costly when feeding a family with teenagers (big portions).

records.title: The service is excellent and a speedy…
records.text: The service is excellent and a speedy delivery The recipes are clear snd easy to use I bought these for my son to try as he is moving.  I thought all the dry ingredients were included and would only have to buy the meat. There was too much flavour for him. I didn’t realise that I had to order regularly; and when I didn’t order a box with a random selection arrived Cancelling my ‘subscription’ was easy; but I think it would be easier if 1st box was free then no card details to worry about and followed up with a customer care/marketing phone call would be good like other companies do, this would also save any confusion

records.title: Food is quite tasty delivery rather…
records.text: Food is quite tasty delivery rather fast, plenty to choose from, instructions comprehensive.There is however no information how much does it cost and how much is shipping (£10 for four plus £1.78 if you are wondering), it doesn't show anyway when reordering. Probably buried somewhere in the T&C. Also I have had a problem where rather replacing or refunding for damaged pot I was offered a discount on my next order. Not exactly what Customer Rights Act says...

records.title: Very good product but execution a bit poor
records.text: Hi, the Simply Cook Food boxes are absolutely delicious, the meal is super tasty and you can control the Food size and protein easily (we go for organic). The foile on the 3 containers/box though is very fiddly and in 90% of the cases the fingers get dirty and swamped with sauces. The other piece of criticism is that it is impossible to order 20+ boxes in one go - unless you pay 5x delivery fees (as each come in a box of 4) which i find ridiculous. There must be a better solution for an overall good product. For me its annoying enough though to think about continuing using Simply Cook going forward.

records.title: Simply Cookg…
records.text: You don't make it obvious that along with the free samples I registered for regular  monthly payments. I emailed  the company to cancel free gift and payments and have been assured no payments will be taken

records.title: Love it, but…
records.text: I’ve been using Simply Cook for years now and really love the recipes and ease of cooking them. However, recently I’ve noticed that the pots are impossible to get into unless you use a knife to cut them open which is really inconvenient and leads to a potential loss of ingredient. Please sort this out!

records.title: Yummy but expensive
records.text: We love the recipes ... beautiful meals are created from them. Simply Cook is expensive-I feel for what it is,and at times, has very limited choice for your 'favourite' dishes.

records.title: Where's the protein?
records.text: It's fun learning new recipes to cook, but the instructions aren't as clear as gusto or hello fresh. The veggie/vegan recipes taste great. The ingredients lists are all a bit disappointing, we've been adding protein and more veg to the meals to make it a whole meal. I tried to leave and got some half price boxes, but I'll likely cancel after that due to the limited number of vegan options and rubbish ingredient lists.

records.title: Products are great, ordering process rubbish
records.text: Products are great, but I absolutely hate the fact that I get no notifications for my upcoming order and often end up with a box of options I didn’t choose. I also don’t like that we now have to pay extra for shipping.

records.title: Slightly confused when just tiny pots…
records.text: Slightly confused when just tiny pots of ingredients arrived rather than the fresh food needed to complete the meal.  This was good value at the very special intro price but is expensive at the monthly subscription cost.  I made the Thai green chicken not bad flavour but nothing like an authentic Thai curry - might as well make your own from fresh ingredients if you want an authentic flavour but this was tasty none the less.

records.title: Charged me for a complimentary box
records.text: Offered me a complimentary box to restart my subscription and then charged me for the box. In fairness as soon as I raised this with them they agreed it was a mistake and offered to refund the cost. Disappointed in the decision to stop one off boxes. Definitely a retrograde step although this would not stop me maybe rejoining in the future. In the mean time I have cancelled my membership and will look for alternatives

records.title: I agree with the review that the little…
records.text: I agree with the review that the little pots are fiddly to open - a knife was always needed. Nice recipes and spices, although the Thai Prawn Curry was rather bland. I had mistakenly thought this was a full meal kit, and think it is rather expensive for a recipe card and spices - I have hundreds of recipes and an overflowing spice rack, so have cancelled.

records.title: I received 1 weeks for free through…
records.text: I received 1 weeks for free through purchasing something from footasylum, the pots was ok but wasn't anything I couldn't but from a supermarket also for soke reason this automatically signed me up for a subscription which I didn't ask for.I did contact customer service who dealt with it pretty quick and refunded me the subscription fee

records.title: Prefer this to other full-meal boxed… but hate the pots!
records.text: Prefer this to other full-meal boxed sets I've used, because you can flex the ingredients and have a longer time to make them.   Also better value for that reason.  BUT, I just find the pots so frustrating to use... liquid/sauces tend to stick to the pots, so you have to spend time getting out all the ingredient.  Most of the time the pots are difficult to open/peel back.  Given the pots themselves are such a critical part of the proposition I would have though they'd been designed better.

records.title: Drop in Service
records.text: We have been customers for over a year and are beginning to see a drop in Simply Cook's quality of service.  Over recent months we have ordered recipes that have been accepted as available only to find that different recipes arrive.  We haven't been asked or warned so cannot amend the order to suit us.  To add insult to injury there is no enclosed note to recognise or apologise for the change. We certainly would not recommend the service any more.

records.title: Quite good recipes but...
records.text: Quite good recipes, but not too many to choose from. Some of them use exactly the same spice pots, just vary in ingredients we need to add. I noticed that they do not add or change recipes every month, as other companies do. Almost all recipes use chicken, and the majority of them come from Asian cuisine. For me, it is a bit boring - I am missing French and Italian dishes. Terrible app.

records.title: Need new recipes!
records.text: Me and my little family have enjoyed some of these recipes. However, they don't seem to offer many new ones which is very disappointing and has now put me off using them again. I also see a lot of recipes have chicken in pretty much every dish. They need to change it up more as it's getting repetitive seeing the same recipes.

records.title: A little disappointed
records.text: A little disappointed. I ordered my free trial box and the recipes and spaces I have used so far have been lovely. However, before my first month is up I receive another box of spices through the post, ones I didn't choose. I have a dairy intolerance which I put on the form when I chose my first box. However, the second box I was sent includes recipes that include cream, cheese and creme fraiche. I questioned this with Simply Cook and their response was the spices are dairy free. I wanted convenience not the stress of having to shop around for dairy free ingredients.

records.title: Signed up for the £1 Free box
records.text: Signed up for the £1 Free box. Was charged £9.99 on top of that.*edit since resolution*Was told I was refunded which is good but what caused the issue in the first place, was that once logged into the site it stated I had no orders coming to me. Upgraded to 3 stars as the website is not very clear regarding your £1 box order as it doesn't show up in my order history, nor does the confirmation email outline my order.

records.title: I tried to sign up as a new customer…
records.text: I tried to sign up as a new customer with the introductory offer but something their end told me there was a problem. After e mails with no response I tried again but came up I had already used my introductory offer, which I had not and so even changing login details still said I couldnt as it was same address. Finally got an e mail back telling me to order and they would refund the difference but trying that just gave error messages saying something went wrong . So I give up and would not reccomend the company. Not even a phone number to speak to anyone and the online chat keeps cutting you off. Usless.However I have finally managed to get through on e mail to someone who has sorted my issues out so hoping to receive my first box soon.

records.title: I didn't like the fact I had signed up…
records.text: I didn't like the fact I had signed up to a subscription. Nothing was mentioned in the introduction offering a freebie pay postage cost only. I decided to cancel that same day.

records.title: I was given 4 Simply Cook packets last…
records.text: I was given 4 Simply Cook packets last Xmas that I really enjoyed but had problems ordering for myself, then found the company does not accept Paypal and didn't answer if they'd take a cheque so sadly there will be no further order from me. They did answer my query quickly but not completely, and reading some other reviews I'd rather shop with them through PayPal.

records.title: I was just about to sign up for their…
records.text: I was just about to sign up for their £1 offer, then thought to look her first. Glad I did......It's a subscription service.....only found that out by looking in their Terms & Conditions.........couldn't see it anywhere else..........No Thanks....

records.title: Made changes without speaking to me
records.text: Changed the recipe selections I had made without asking me so I ended up with stuff I dont like - so frustrating

records.title: You should listen to the customers requirements.
records.text: So I enjoyed the trial box which had recipes which I ticked when I was looking at the trial then on the charged boxes I received rubbish that I wouldn't eat. It doesn't matter what you initially identify as liking you get sent utter rubbish that you have to give away if you don't like curries.

records.title: Keeping bank details
records.text: I’m normally more than happy with Simply cook and pay an annual fee. When my subscription for that year came to an end I would have thought SimplyCook would have contacted me and asked if I would like to renew my subscription!! No they didn’t they just went into my bank and stole £11.98 without my permission, by using my bank details that I gave a year ago. I thought the Data protection act stopped company’s keeping their customers personal bank details unless you ticked a box allowing them to. I never ticked such a box nor did I see one. I’ve since contacted SimplyCook and they said they would reimburse me which they did.I have since cancelled my subscription because they were very naughty.

records.title: Was great…now not so.
records.text: I’ve used Simply Cook for a number of years. Sadly, I’ve cancelled today (to be fair they cancelled for me) as I was not notified about the hike in delivery charges, lots of things are out of stock, pots are now a pain to get into, and I can buy them direct from Tesco or Asda (for 2.50).

records.title: Got food, I didn’t knowingly order
records.text: The signup process managed to fool me, and I got food that I did not want or knowingly order.The UK website then routed me to the US customer services via messenger… Who were less than helpful and didn’t bother to respond to my (polite) but obviously cross message to them.Had to actually call somebody in order to delete my account which felt a bit 1980s. Please could the UK marketing team look at customer journey for unhappy customers. I actually thought the food that I didn’t order was tasty… But there is no way that I am coming back with such a substandard contact process.

records.title: Subscription service built to catch you…
records.text: Subscription service built to catch you out! I have cancelled my subscription yet still get charged and sent a box. You are unable to cancel your subscription in the app and they make it difficult to find the option, giving you multiple windows to pause or restart your subscription instead. Other delivery services are much more transparent and easier to manage

records.title: Do not recommend not useful or convenient…
records.text: I think this is the dumbest business idea. I ordered it to see what it is like, and u get 3 spices/herbs in a box to put in ur food with the recipes. I don’t see the point in it when everyone could go to the supermarket/order online. I recommend using other companies if you need help with recipes or convenience because you still need to the ingredients for the meals.

records.title: You ARE signing up to regular deliveries
records.text: Offered a free trial via another company, completed form, paid £1 for postage, suddenly my 'regular box' is scheduled at £10. I'm pretty sure that this is not mentioned at all - all I provided was my name, address and the all important payment details. Not sure about content as I have loads of spices and cookbooks so could probably do this bit myself, but thought it might be worth a go. I'll update when the box arrives. In the meantime I have to remember to cancel in 7 days.Mandy - I'm saying that it wasn't made clear that I was signing up for a regular service until AFTER I had supplied my payment details. This is MISLEADING.

records.title: £1? More like £10
records.text: I recently discovered their website and purchased an offer that was advertised as £1. However, upon checking my bank account, I noticed that £10 had been taken out instead!!! I have requested that they refund the £10 and cancel any purchases that may have been made.Update: They just got back to me and told me they would issue a 50% refund as the order was already shipped. Seems fair enough but I am disappointed that it wasn’t full as I have no need for what I ordered.

description:
Welcome to ChefOnline, your gateway to takeaways!
Our online food ordering platform is the finest choice for ordering food. You can find a wide range of restaurants and takeaways from YOUR own neighbourhood with ChefOnline. Get exclusive discounts and deals on your first order, browse through mouth-watering menus, make instant table reservations, and get takeaways brought right to your doorstep — only with ChefOnline!


Order Online

records.title: Delivered on time and an excellent…
records.text: Delivered on time and an excellent biriahni and roti. Extra spice as requested. Will definitely order from here again

records.title: Quick and Easy
records.text: First time I have ordered on here . It was easy and the process went very smoothly ! The food hadn’t arrived yet but the ordering process and communication seems excellent!

records.title: Easy to order and great food
records.text: Easy to order acknowledgement gave a helpful eta and arrived within 5 minutes of the time.The food was great

records.title: Indian food was great and very tasty full of great spices.
records.text: Food was great and very tasty full of the right spices. Will definitely use this website again when ordering another Indian dish.

records.title: Very easy to order
records.text: Very easy to order, clear discounts and time when order will be ready

records.title: Once I set up the site it was ok
records.text: Once I set up the site it was ok. Couldn’t process the online payment via c/c but was able to order & pay at the restaurant when I collected. And the advantage of that was the food was ready & I could pay either card or cash.

records.title: Really nice
records.text: Really nice , on time . Polite delivery driver . 👍👍

records.title: Very easy to navigate
records.text: Very easy to navigate

records.title: Good choice and great taste
records.text: Good choice and great taste. Delivery was sooner than advised. Would recommend

records.title: Great food quick delivery time
records.text: Great food quick delivery time

records.title: Great food, but delayed
records.text: Food was perfect, all items as ordered but 45 minute delay compared to requested time. Suspect too many phone orders taken competing with on-line orders.

records.title: Platform user-friendly
records.text: Platform user-friendly. Need to increase the Limited restaurant selection. App seems safe.

records.title: Easy to use and the food came when on…
records.text: Easy to use and the food came when on the time said

records.title: Good experience
records.text: Everything went well - the correct food arrived in a reasonable time. But the app could be better - there's no obvious indication that the order has been received by the restaurant or what the status of the order is, which leaves you wondering whether and when the food will turn up.

records.title: Upgraded from one star following improvement
records.text: After my first use which was disappointing, I had to wait for my order to be prepared, I've had no problems and whatever the difficulties my favourite takeaway and the ChefOnline had with its interface have been solved and I now use the app full time. Well done everyone.

records.title: Recommended
records.text: Generous portions. Very tasty. Fair wait time. I wish the dishes could be a tad bit hotter, but still to an exceptable standard. I have been using this particular Indian for years and I would definiately recommend to others.

records.title: Transaction was smooth and efficient
records.text: Transaction was smooth and efficient. Whilst I don't really like having to have a plethora of online accounts just to order take away, this process was easy and worked well. Also, I got a nice 10% discount, which was a welcome surprise

records.title: The food was real tasty …
records.text: The food was real tasty and authentic... tasted freshly cooked and still hot when we arrived home. Can't fault my experience of this restaurant/takeaway food.

records.title: POB Watford take away
records.text: Very easy service, signed up answer logged in.Only downside was that I was told my food would be ready after 45 mins, but when I went to the restaurant I was told that the food had been sitting in the bag for around 10 mins. Who decided the length of cook and wait time. As I had colder food than expected.

records.title: Great deal if you order online
records.text: Easy to use online great offer for 25% off if spend over £15. Great food that's why I always come back, the only downside from this experience was I couldn't find onion bhaji on the list otherwise would have been 5/5

records.title: Lucky to have this on our doorstep
records.text: They are friendly and conscientious, I have always liked their food .. I think it’s interesting how they have so many menus and I think it’s always the same guys cooking - they now introduced a Korean menu too 😯The passanda was spicier than I anticipated/expected but it was nice - the lamb was lovely!My daughter said her korma was watery but it looked thick and creamy to me and she’d eaten it within minutes..I like a saag paneer but on the online menu it has the pea one twice and no saag so I think it’s an error because they made it when I asked and apologised because ‘it’s a third party website’They were quicker than I expected and so called as I hadn’t arrived yet but it was kept hot and was perfect even when I got home

records.title: Wheres my nan and free delivery?
records.text: Food is always spot on, delivery was on time, however mixed kebab was supposed to include a nan bread, there was none and delivery is supposed to be free within 3 miles, i live less than 2, but was charged £2 for delivery. I wont be complaining as ive always found Spice Junction to be the best in the area.

records.title: Food was lovely and staff at Paneer too.…
records.text: Food was lovely and staff at Paneer very helpful, but ordering was exasperating. Payment didn't go through and I had to re-order from memory as I'd gone to Asda by the time I realised. Got there in the end and will use again but pay cash.

records.title: The food is very good
records.text: The food is very good, tasty, but the main portions were a little small, but this was rectified immediately. Was not to keen on the Bombay Potatoes, these was more like boiled potatoes no real flavor. Love the Dall Makhni. Will order again was very happy with the customer service received.

records.title: The ordering system online is clunky…
records.text: The ordering system online is clunky and frustrating, but the food turned up on time and the delivery driver was polite and friendly. The food unfortunately wasn’t good, but that’s not ChefOnline’s fault.

records.title: Easy to order and reasonably priced
records.text: Easy to order and reasonably priced. Food arrived a little later than expected, as the delivery driver had trouble finding the address. This however is not unusual as we live in an unlit road.

records.title: Clear and simple ordering

Unfortunately the food had been rushed and was not the usual very high standard we have come to expect which was extremely disappointing as we were really looking forward to it.

records.title: The food was very nice and well presented, but!!
records.text: The food was very nice and well presented.  I had Chicken Satay, 3 small skewers for £7.50 seemed rather expensive to me compared to other restaurants that I eat at.  I noticed a Gluten Free menu and as I have an intolerance to wheat gluten I looked at  it.  I was very surprised to see how much more expensive GF items were than on the normal menu.  I know that rice doesn't have any gluten in it so it seems a bit much to add over £4 per portion on for GF, same with coconut and sticky rice.  I have eaten there many times in the past and eat Pad Thai, Green and Red Curry, Panang Curry and more with no ill effect but GF Pad Thai and currys are over £8 more expensive.  I think this is preying on those of us who, through no fault of their own, have to be careful what we eat.  In my case a small amount of wheat gluten brings on Irritable Bowel Syndrome that lasts for 5 to 7 days and is not only very uncomfortable but restricts my movements as I have to be near a toilet at all times.  There are many restaurants that can handle food for those of us with intolerances with no extra charge and I shall continue to support them.  The service was very good, but considering it was Saturday evening we were very surprised to see so few dining at 8pm.

records.title: Delivery was within specified times
records.text: Delivery was within specified times, food was very nice. However we received a paneer dish instead of a chicken jalfrezi. Left it that night and emailed the restaurant the following day but did not receive a reply.

records.title: It has been a bit disappointing
records.text: It has been a bit disappointing, the samosas were cold and looked as if one of them wasn't even fried! The butter chicken wasn't butter chicken, it was korma. I expected more from Bangla.

records.title: Early arrival
records.text: No problem with the food and usually a complaint would be about late delivery. Mine is that it arrived 30 minutes before expected so had to keep it warm in the oven until everyone ready.

Maybe you do well on the other dishes.A good Biriyani is not greasy. The saffron should also be the main ingredient for smell and taste and these are the qualities I am looking for.

description:
Smakolyki, meaning "tasty food" in Ukrainian, is a family-run business, established by a family who fled from the war in Ukraine. We specialise in healthy, fresh, and never processed food, prepared according to traditional Ukrainian and Polish cuisines with a modern twist. Our dishes are adorned with natural, colorful ingredients that promote healthy eating. Our menu includes national favorites like Vareniki (Polish Pierogi), which are handmade daily in our kitchen, delicious Pelmeni dumplings, as well as Nalystnyki (Spring Rolls) and Borscht soup. For those feeling more adventurous, we recommend trying our traditional Chicken Kiev. 
We also have a special vegetarian menu with a few vegan options. 
Smakolyki takeaway provides food delivery services to Bolton, Manchester, Wigan, Bury, Leigh, Chorley, and Horwich

records.title: The food is always fresh and warm

records.title: Good
