description: Plant-based meal kits from award-winning vegan chef Alexis Gauthier, delivered nationwide direct from Soho, London

records.title: Absolutely amazing!
records.text: I'm not normally one to write reviews, but after sampling the Gauthier Home "Brazil" box this weekend I felt compelled to tell the world just how brilliant this food is.Out of this world flavours, clever dishes and easy to follow instructions made this experience something we want to repeat again and again.Can't recommend this highly enough!Thank you to Alexis and the team.

records.title: I had a great experience
records.text: I had a great experience, very good vegan foods and nice staff. Tnak you

records.title: The food was exceptional
records.text: The food was exceptional  We ordered for my husband's 50th birthday meal. We couldn't stop raving about each dish.The instructions are really clear and simple. The delivery was straightforward and all packaged really well.We have ordered another box already even though we have no occasion.  There's enough food for two nights so we figure it's an alternative to the same boring takeaway we've had throughout lockdown.

records.title: This was such a treat
records.text: This was such a treat. Tasty food prepared so minimal effort is needed to serve it. And, all vegan! The tasting menu approach made it different from menus even experienced cooks might prepare at home. Please, Gauthier, continue with these boxes even though we are looking forward to coming to the restaurant soon.

records.title: Excellent box
records.text: Excellent box! We've been fans of Gauthier restaurant for many years and were thrilled when Alexis pved in his new vegan direction. We finally ordered a box last week and it was so lovely. Big selection of dishes, enough for two evenings (we are 2). Highly recommended. See you all soon at the restaurant we hope!

records.title: Best experience
records.text: We went to Gauthier soho for the first time this year and it was simply amazing. We had the classic home box and it is also succulent. Gauthier and his team are so exceptional! Thank you so much for your work

records.title: Dining in in style
records.text: Gauthier have been offering 7/8 course vegan tasting menus for home preparation and serving since the autumn. We have treated ourselves to one on a monthly basis and treat is the right word.They have been a joy to eat, imaginative, and have encouraged us to broaden our vegan horizon. They are designed for four people and that has given us, as a couple, two generous dinners each. There is no problem with keeping them for a couple of days.The presentation and preparation instructions are accurate and clear, but you do need to run through the timings in advance. The boxes are very good value at under £20 per head for high end restaurant quality food.

records.title: Mega Vegan experiance.
records.text: Mega Vegan experiance.Myself and my partner had the absolute delight of experiacing Gauthier @ homes Korean box. The box is neatly presented and easy to prepare, with absolutely minimal effort to achieve restaurant standard dishes!Packaging is almost entirely recyclable but still managed to endure its journey to us in scotland. The dishes are well prepared, balanced and easily preppared, even for a novice cook like myself. Its great to see a restaurant providing a regulary changing menu in these rather stagnant times.I would urge everybody to try this @home box, vegan or not. I swear its delicious!

records.title: Restaurant experience at your door
records.text: Every meal should be as good and entertaining as what Mr Gauthier and his team has delivered to my door.I've ordered the Marrakech Box and from start to end the journey was a delight.Everything arrived on time and in a nice ecological packaging, and the food was meeting high quality standards. Special mention for the Couscous, Harira and Brioutat, the preparation was as easy as it could be and my basic skills were more than enough.I will definitely recommend it to some of my family and friends and looking forward for the next ones.

records.title: Amazing food for a very reasonable…
records.text: Amazing food for a very reasonable price. We have eaten at the Gauthier restaurant in person and this certainly lived up to the very high standards they set there. From now on a monthly treat. To put things in perspective we had a very average Thai meal from a local restaurant that was only £5 less and this is in a different league

records.title: Bangkok at home!
records.text: Well presented with outer box and inclusion of menu and instructions. Food was protected well for transit and maintained integrity. It wasn’t clear whether all the (plastic?) containers were recyclable so maybe a good idea to note that. Overall we really enjoyed the taste adventure. We didn’t make it to the second bottle of wine yet!!!

records.title: Excellent food and overall experience
records.text: Great food and really enjoyed the whole experience. Some of the instructions weren’t clear so that slowed some of the prep but on the whole thought the food was delicious and the different boxes for different cuisines give a brilliant choice of options

records.title: Inspired, delicious and memorable!
records.text: The meal was absolutely delicious! My only comments would be that the faux gras should have come with toasted bread Or crackers instead of having to provide them yourself and the pudding needed a creamy element. Otherwise gorgeous and do much appreciated during these extraordinary times. The madras was divine. Well done team, great way to keep your business alive and get incredible vegan food to the masses. Thank you 💚💚💚

records.title: Almost everything was perfect
records.text: Almost everything was perfect. The order arrived on time, as advertised.  We are new to veganism, so still getting our heads round some of the flavours/textures, and the cauliflower veloute was a step too far for us.  However, the rest was delicious.

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: The box arrived without instructions which turned the meal into a bit of a joke. One sachet appeared to be missing. Some interesting tastes, but could not recommend. Disappointing.

records.title: Just OK
records.text: It was just OK so I wouldn’t have the experience again. We found the veloute very unpalatable and couldn’t eat it and for the price I would expect a bit more than stewed apples with a bit of calvados for dessert.

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: I tried the Bangkok box, it may have just been an unfortunate mistake on my part but the mention of pineapple rice and a pudding that isn’t chocolate then for me that’s a winner.  How wrong I was. Box arrived on time and everything is well labelled. Heating instructions are very clear and easy to follow. My first thought was, not a lot of food for four people. I know it’s a seven course menu but...four bits of tofu in one of the main courses, come on.Two courses went in the bin just couldn’t eat it. Another two courses my mouth was on fire and I couldn’t taste anything.  One course could have been anything as it had no flavour. The pineapple rice at least tasted nice even if it didn’t look too appetising. The puddings were eaten but had a strange texture and were just ok. I had been looking at these boxes for a long time and was really looking forward to the food but was really underwhelmed by it. As I said above, it could be that I choose the wrong box to try and the food just wasn’t for me. Would I try another box, probably not Disappointing.

records.title: I was very disappointed
records.text: I was very disappointed , after been in your restaurant many time .. the food is just ok sorry

records.title: Arrived smashed, no compensation
records.text: I paid £100 for a Gauthier Home valentine’s box (£100 for food only, no wine).  It was a large amount of money for me and I was really looking forward to receiving the delivery.On arrival, the first course (pastry appetisers) were smashed, as was the mousse dessert.  Furthermore the glass ramekin containing pate was smashed with small shards of glass inside the pate - inedible.There were also no instructions in the box and I had to ask for them.I emailed Gauthier and all I received was the offer of a discount against a future purchase. Not at all inclined to purchase again and put off by the customer service as well as the state of order on arrival - I’m sure I was unlucky, but for me a waste of money and feel really stupid for having spent so much.  Food and meal was okay - but not amazing.  Quite disappointing.I wouldn’t recommend at all.

records.title: Not an enjoyable experience
records.text: I was really looking forward to trying Gauthier at Home, but nearly everything in the box was a great disappointment and I would say it ruined my weekend having to eat this food over 2 days when I can cook something much better myself.Four of the dishes had the same flavour, which I think is rosemary. As a long time vegetarian I’ve not tried foie gras so I don’t know if faux gras is trying to be similar but it had no complexity, only rosemary. Kohlrabi carpaccio tasted of rosemary, carrot veloute tasted of rosemary, harissa cauliflower even tasted of rosemary. The only dish that was remotely enjoyable was the potato Boulangere but it was very oily. Tarte tatin looked and tasted cheap. Alexis Gauthier should taste this food before dispatching it. On the basis of what I tasted I certainly wouldn’t go to his restaurant. Two of the dishes actually made me feel nauseous afterwards, probably because they were so oily.

records.title: Truly disappointing Valentine's box
records.text: I ordered the Gauthier Valentine's Day box 2022 and ate the meal on the evening after the arrival of the box. The meal was overall bad, comically bad, and very different from how it was advertised on the website (or even on the menu in the box). The quality of the food reminded me that of a school canteen. While one doesn't need to do many things with the ingredients provided in the box, I would have appreciated clearer instructions on obtaining a good presentation for the plates. I would have also appreciated larger pictures of what the plates should have looked like. The only pictures provided were tiny pictures on the printed menu (or one had to look at the pictures on the website). And many of those pictures were of different plates from those provided in the box. Other pictures could not be recreated (for reasons provided below).The Valentine's box consisted of eight courses. So I'll go through them:1) Canapés: The canapés are substantially different from those shown on the picture in the website. However, this was probably the best part of the meal. The faux gras is good. Though the pieces of bread on which to serve it are minuscule. Also, the herbs sauce is quite tasty. 2) Bread Apart: quite disappointingly, there is only one piece of heart-shaped bread for the two of us. It was good. But I feel that here there was a bit of a play on expectations. Now, we start getting into the bad:3) Dressed Coco “Like a Crab”: A ball of shredded coconut with a red sauce, herbs and capers. The herbs and capers come together, so it is impossible to separate them recreating the picture provided. The sauce is also very liquid, so it is quite impossible to get the clean presentation of the picture. Anyways, the taste is kind of okish. The coconut flavour gets boring very quickly and isn't too interesting. And overall, the sweetness of the coconut doesn't mix too well with the other flavours. The capers are tasty though. I think this was at least a quite original idea, though it failed in execution.4) Black Truffle lasagna: Not too different in flavour from a supermarket mushroom lasagna (with a bit of truffle). Quite disappointed in the quality. I don't think the fact this was vegan is a good excuse. 5) Celeriac Tournedos: We are given two celeriacs and a sauce. The sauce is really bad and smelled like dog food. Worse than many store Quorn sauces. We both only had a small taste of this plate since the sauce was too bad to eat it. We made one of my girlfriend's housemates try it and he spit it immediately. Furthermore, the final result looks NOTHING like the picture on the website (which clearly is a different dish), and the sauce was a completely different colour from that of the tiny picture on the menu we were provided (on that picture the sauce was quite red, while our sauce was brown). 6) Crunchy Radicchio Leaves: These are just radicchio leaves with a dressing. I think there are some extra things in the picture, which overall cannot be recreated. The leaves are not crunchy and many of them browned. Not sure why who made the box expected the radicchio leaves to stay crunchy...7) Red Love Velvet: This actually has a nice gold leaf on top which is not on the picture. Overall a nice flavour. Not terribly interesting. But not comically bad as the previous dishes. 8) Chocolates (4): These are ok. Two chocolates are heart-shaped, which is nice.In theory there was also some granola, but much of it was pulverised, and since the meal was so bad we didn't really want to try it the next day. There were also some tiny heart-shaped candles and some fake rose leaves.I think this was a terrible waste of money (£100). Especially considering that for roughly the same price one can go to a good restaurant to eat, while the quality of the main dishes of this box was comparable to that of Tesco food. Except for the Tournedos, which were too bad for that standard. I am sure this box ruined many Valentine's day dinners. Ours would have been ruined if not for the fact that by the end we were having a laugh at how much we were feeling scammed. I had very high expectations on this meal given the fame of Gauthier, how great the pictures of the plates looked, and the price. The meal I had was terribly disappointing in all of the main dishes. PS: The box was delivered to the wrong address (with the wrong address written on the box), in spite of Gauthierhome having the correct address (as confirmed by their emails). I am not sure whether this is a mistake of the company or of the shipping service they used.

records.title: I bought a voucher for a three course…
records.text: I bought a voucher for a three course meal champagne and wine when they were not plant based.  I now want my money back because I am not a huge vegetable fan and my husband dislikes vegetables.  They are ignoring my request.

records.title: Expensive mistake not to be repeated
records.text: Ordered the Marrakesh menu for a special occasion. Most of it went in the bin as unpalatable. All very wet with very little texture or flavour. Definitely not the flavours of Marrakesh I am familiar with. I emailed Alexis outlining my disappointment and commenting on several of the dishes.  He was clearly not open to customer criticism.  His lengthy response outlined how he himself had enjoyed the dishes, summing up with "I absolutely loved our take on Moroccan cuisine and I hope you will accept my view to differ on our criticisms." He also seems to have missed the irony of his statement that he had "never been to a vegan Moroccan restaurant"This wasn't just a bad cheap take-out, it was a very expensive box of largely tasteless vegetable soups.  I was offered a £30 voucher off my next box, which I would normally have considered by way of giving him the benefit of the doubt, however in light of the self-righteous response I have turned the offer down.   I did, however, outline a couple of good vegan restaurants he might like to try.

records.title: How shall I put it? 'COULD DO BETTER'
records.text: I bought one of their box meals during lockdown to try and was really looking forward to it. I had already had a box from The Brook Restaurant and had been delighted with it. Being a Michelin chef I expected really interesting things to try with good taste combinations from Gauthier. My husband and I have been vegan for some 30 years and love trying new things. The Gauthier box arrived on time as promised and it was well packed. I loaded it into the fridge ready for the following evening. All the instructions were fine. Well, to say we were disappointed would be an understatement. The flavours by and large were underwhelming and some of it  - a risotto - was so vile we put it in the compost bin after one mouthful - it was fatty tasteless slop and neither of us could stomach it. It left a dreadful coating on the teeth as if you'd bitten into a block of lard or a wax candle. Yuk.Asked to review the meal by the restaurant I responded by giving marks out of 10 for the different elements and saying why we hadn't thought much of many of them. Despite saying they wanted our thoughts - good or bad - we have never had the courtesy of a response so I can only conclude that they only want glowing reviews. I hate giving a vegan restaurant a poor review - and I said that to them - but being ignored has led me to put one on here as I expect that for the money I should get something that is not just a cut-above the average, but is at least some way enjoyable and edible. In this they failed miserably. And they demonstrated that they have a bad attitude problem to customer complaints. And to think that I wanted to try some of the other boxes listed on their website. Oh dear.

description: YO! Sushi brings you tasty Japanese food in a fun environment and on your own doorstep. So bring your friends and family and join the growing YO! Family! Give YO! a go!

records.title: My daughter and I ate there this…
records.text: My daughter and I ate there this evening. Milton Keynes. Great food. Very relaxed atmosphere. We looked after by Georgina who made the experience really welcoming and provided us with some great recommendations to what foods to try. Definitely will be going back. Davie

records.title: Excellent experience!!
records.text: Had been here for ages, Had difficulty ordering as to everything’s were changed!! Lexie was a really amazing lad who helped us with a wonderful service throughout!! Very genuine guy with a great personality and helpful. Would definitely recommend coming here again!!

records.title: Superb service from Emma
records.text: Superb service from Emma. Smiles and very helpful. So welcoming and knowledgeable. Made our visit amazing Food was delicious too. Try the popcorn prawns

records.title: This was the branch off Bond Street
records.text: This was the branch off Bond StreetI should have written this months ago but my son mentioned it today.The server was phenomenal - she made the experience for my newly 13 year old for his birthday meal.She made such an effort - noticed when we needed help, kind, excited to be there, just so positive.I'm sorry I didn't get her name - she went on a break before we left, but honestly best server for ages.

records.title: superb customer service
records.text: I received superb customer service last night at the Cribbs Causeway, Bristol restaurant.  I made error when ordering via Just Eat collection service. When I arrived to collect the order it had not gone through. This was entirely my fault. But even thought the restaurant had just closed, the front of house staff were very accommodating. He made up the order anyway. Happy customer. Thanks!

records.title: Absolutely wonderful
records.text: Absolutely wonderful! Went to yo sushi in nottingham!! Service was outstanding! Staff were super!! Jordan such a top guy! Loving the soup! Thanks so much! Super chilled environment and nice and cool especially with this hot weather we are having! Will definitely be back soon!

records.title: Bathgate super service
records.text: I visited Yo Sushi Bathgate in the Tesco store. The young lady serving the counter, despite working on her own, provided me quick efficient service and a really tasty meal. I watched a few minutes as she served a few customers with the same politeness and efficiency. I was amazed she could do this all on her own - well done whoever you are, I will come back again to your store.

records.title: Amazing!!!!went with my late grandma…
records.text: Amazing!!!!went with my late grandma last week to celebrate our anniversary together. was pleasantly surprised when i saw human faeces in my katsu curry. tried to complain to the manager but was met with a handful of sperm which had obviously been especially prepared just for me.

records.title: Sushi school
records.text: We have just had a lovely evening at the York City branch doing yo sushi school. Joel and Barnaby were amazing, very friendly and welcoming. Everything was well prepared and explained. I brought my little boy for his 11th birthday and he thoroughly enjoyed it. Highly recommend this class and will def pass this onto friends and family. Thank you York City branch for such a great evening.

records.title: I thought it was amazing
records.text: I thought it was amazing, the people who worked there checked up on you and made it such a warm experience, they where lovely. The food (especially the salmon hand roll) was the best sushi I’ve ever gotten, overall amazing, the only downside is that it is quite expensive but for how it tastes, it’s fresh and for what it is aswell it’s definitely worth it x

records.title: First time
records.text: This was our first time but we were honestly impressed by the service, the workers were kind and asissting us whenever we needed it, super amazing but i highly recommend the Yo! sushi, Bluewater in the UK as its ones. Still questioning why its a 2.0 star ig

records.title: Really good
records.text: I had a nice meal today at the Ashford Outlet restaurant.The only thing that was disappointing was the lack of tofu nigiri on the conveyor belt, which I definitely would have chosen if I saw it. Everything else was really good though and I would go again.The staff let you eat in peace — it’s one of my biggest pet peeves when I’m asked every two minutes if I’m enjoying my meal, but this didn’t happen here and it made the experience a lot better.

records.title: Booked a table to Yo sushi in…
records.text: Booked a table to Yo sushi in Manchester (Arndale centre with my nephew. Booked for the kids Bento box (kids eat free) on the website, mentioned it once we were sat down. 50 minutes later box had not arrived. I do understand that we should be grateful that places are doing this but he would have been left waiting for 50 minutes whilst hungry if i hadnt said to grab stuff off the conveyor belt. But was given £15 off the bill as compensation. Service slow, waiters hiding round the corner.

records.title: We visited the swindon outlet Yo Sushi…
records.text: We visited the swindon outlet Yo Sushi and although the dishes seemed to differ from other Yo our attendant Alex was great. Hands on, accommodating and very friendly!

records.title: Delicious food, good experience -Liverpool
records.text: Delicious food. Enjoyed the atmosphere and service. Bathroom could have been kept on top more but it would busy. Chef's work relentlessly. Very happy X

records.title: Great Food
records.text: Great Food, Great Staff.Something’s are expensive others not so much.I would recommend this place.

records.title: The Yo Sushi counter in Tesco Reading
records.text: The Yo Sushi counter in Tesco Reading, Kings Meadow is great.Friendly, kind staff who are keen to advise.Food freshly made and delicious for a take away.

records.title: Would of been five star
records.text: I would have given this five star but the lack of service was terrible. Asked for help twice and no one came over, the food was also cold.

records.title: Love Sushi, however could do with a little more attention to customers
records.text: I love coming here for lunch on a weekly basis, however the service of waters and waitress' could be adjusted a little. Having to wait around for service even when you press the buzzer 3 times is a little annoying, however all in all very nice food and the chefs are lovely too :)

records.title: YoSushi in Newcastle town centre good service
records.text: Had YoSushi in Newcastle town centre yesterday and although they removed their NHS discounts the service was still great, and friendly. Would go there again. Not the best sushi I’ve had but still a lovely experience.

records.title: the food is quite nice but could be…
records.text: the food is quite nice but could be better

records.title: The average meal is spot on
records.text: The average meal is well worth the money however portion sizes are really small. There is a good variety also

records.title: Impressive
records.text: Impressive! Very convenient to order food either for pick up or delivery.

records.title: love the food here
records.text: love the food here , a little expensive though :/

records.title: Pumpkin Katsu bought from St Pancras
records.text: Pumpkin Katsu bought from St Pancras. Lots of rice, good flavour to the sauce, with chopped spring onion and pickled garlic. Breaded pumpkin, just one piece cut in two. £8.25!

records.title: From good to bad
records.text: We have always loved YO Sushi but this time it did not live up to how we remembered. Food was good as always but the service is where I had an issue, to get cutlery, order food and get the bill, I had to get the waiters attention because they were too busy chatting amongst themselves, I even saw one of them pretend to bum another one of the colleagues from behind which I understand can be work banter but not in front of the customers, it was disgusting to see. Also after not being asked if I wanted cutlery and unable to get the attention of the staff, I got up and got some myself which was met by a comment of “next time let me know and I will get it for you” which was not in a nice way but a snarky comment at the least. Also, the food on the conveyor belt is disgusting, it sits there for far too long before it’s eaten and tastes horrible compared to it being made fresh. Lastly, where have the QR codes gone?

records.title: Usually buy a Seafood Soup
records.text: Usually buy a Seafood Soup & Chicken Katsu Curry but tried a chicken teriyaki today.Disappointed with the chicken content. Feels as if I paid £12 for a bowl of Rice. Not impressed at all

records.title: A long view of the decline of Yo!
records.text: I’ve been going to Yo! in Selfridges about once a month for years, and sometimes go to the one near Bond Street instead. Over all this time I’ve remained faithful to its central proposition but I have to say that it is getting increasingly tired and very understaffed. I find myself going less often. The food remains more or less the same though the range of options going past on the conveyor belt has really dropped off meaning that I personally (and I suspect many others) have to order what used to just go past and be grabbed. That would be fine but may people (me included) have struggled with their app and they don’t have enough staff to make ordering via a waitperson either quick or efficient. Feels like the tail end of a good idea…

records.title: Aberdeen branch
records.text: Visit the Aberdeen branch this afternoon, the food was lovely - however the large lady with the pony tail who took us to the table was quite grumpy.  I had already scanned the QR code using the poster at the door, so when she told me to scan the QR code inside the door I showed her I had already scanned just a minute before.  She didn't like this, let out a huge sigh and rolled her eyes at me.  She then took us to the booth and got quite angry when she had to explain the new ordering system.  She also gave us chopsticks that were so dirty that it was obvious she had done something to them.

records.title: When did YoSushi lose its atmosphere
records.text: When did YoSushi lose its atmosphere? It used to be fun and entertaining, now is on an app, sat in a booth, not being served.The food quality was ok but I found that it was very expensive for what we had. This never used to be the case so it’s disappointing to see how downhill it’s gone, it used to be one of my favourite places to eat.

records.title: Will Yo Sushi ever revert to its previous belt charm?
records.text: Will Yo Sushi ever work as it used to? The whole charm of the place was being able to pick whatever you saw on the belt, on the spot. I understand that it had to change temporarily because of the pandemic… but it will surely go back to its previous charm when things settle a bit more? The whole app thing is just annoying. Hope this is just temporary.

records.title: Bone in the Salmon sushi
records.text: I went to Yo Sushi at Westfield Stratfford today with my husband for a quickly and nice meal. Took more than 15 min for our food to arrive, the staff look a bit lost on the space without knowledge for the menu. When the food arrived I found 2 pieces of fish bone in my salmon. So glad my daughter wasn’t with us as Salmon is her favourite fish.

records.title: Used to love Yo Sushi but todays visit…
records.text: Used to love Yo Sushi but todays visit was very disappointing with lots of 'little' things that have changed for the worse.The didgital ordering app was erratic and confusing so we used a paper menu; several thing we wanted on the paper menu were 'no longer available'. Miso soup had no seaweed in it (unlike the description and picture), the crispy squid wasn't crispy and didn't have its dipping sauce with it, the salmon and avocado hand roll was folded, not rolled and fell apart, the plain rice is now steamed instead of sushi rice, so it's impossible to pick it up and dip in some soy sauce and wasabi (which we had to ask for). They now use the conveyor belt for delivering your specific order to your table, where it stops; this was the only thing I enjoyed about our visit today.

records.title: All the "covid measures" destroyed the experience
records.text: First time returning since the fabricated bogus pandemic.Visited the High Wycombe store to eat.First of all staff got my back up by insisting it was regulation to swipe track & trace. I said my phone didn't have data so they allowed us in but watched me whilst I filled out the track and trace when I signed into WiFi stating it's government regulation. I didn't know regulation was law ? After all that we where then told scan barcode and order on our phone. This is absolutely mad that they again insisting to log in via phone. Fortunately table didn't have bar code so they took our order face to face and allowed us to pay also. What yo sushi are doing is over kill. Pure and simple madness. I want to speak to a human not order on phone.TRI the waitress that served us was excellent and went out her way to look after us. The tall guy managing or supervising store looked cold and only interested in this track and trace. Food was nice but not happy with reduced menu especially as we where a vegan party. The kitchen staff on point but really dissapointed Alot of the dishes we used to enjoy off menu gone such as Yakisoba noodles, fire cracker rice & soups some of our staple meals.Why they have stopped conveyor belt I don't know as all dishes where covered anyway. It's really taken the fun out of going with all these bogus safety measures put in place for a made up virus. Hope things change or we won't be back. We've been coming to Yo sushi for over a decade but with what we experienced today I'm not sure when we will return.Bring back the colored plates too and food on belt please.

records.title: Yo! Sushi.  Swindon designer Outlet
records.text: The food was OK, but the service was absolutely shocking. Couldn't of been more disinterested if they tried!!

records.title: Good service
records.text: Good service on our visit today but not hugely impressed with the mains we had which is a shame

records.title: First time at you sushi in silver burn…
records.text: First time at you sushi in silver burn Glasgow. The service was fine tbh but the food wasn’t great. Sushi on the belt was mediocre and a simple all veg dish you could tell wasn’t very fresh. I ordered 1 hot dish which was absolutely aweful! I would have given 2 stars but the service was okay so that’s why it’s 3. Won’t be going back :(

records.title: I can not remember a time when yo sushi…
records.text: I can not remember a time when yo sushi was not part of my lunchtime routine. Where Great atmosphere met great food and great people. However, unfortunately those days are not the same. The quality of produce, price and atmosphere has really been lost - and has stopped me from visiting yo sushi during my lunch breaks.

records.title: Watford
records.text: Arrived I hr before closing so carousel was quite empty. Our first waitress Cherise was lovely  and explained how things worked.I know it was busy and two staff went AWOL. But we did have to ask a couple of times for a fork as it seemed staff had forgotten. Apart from that overall it was good.

records.title: It's difficult to review a chain
records.text: It's difficult to review a chain. Some restaurants, the food and the services is just perfection...then you visit a new place expecting the same and...huge disappointment... just want them to create clones

records.title: I like Sushi and the food at Yo Sushi…
records.text: I like Sushi and the food at Yo Sushi is nice, however it is quite expensive for what you get so we don't often eat there

records.title: Pitiful portions for premium prices
records.text: If the barely there overpriced servings weren’t bad enough, the disingenuous menu deliberately shows large portions while failing to mention the ‘discretionary 10% service charge’ added to the bill. Is that even legal?

records.title: Warm sushi
records.text: I am a regular customer and the fridges at the St Pancras branch were not working two weeks ago and today. When we bought the sushi today it was warm because it is not refrigerated. Moreover, the packets of sushi now have times of when they should be consumed. I am concerned that this food is safe to eat. While the hard working staff are very reassuring, this feel like a health and safety issue, whoever heard of keeping fish warm and being safe to eat? Yo sushi, when are the new fridges coming?

records.title: Not so keen on the Ashford Outlet…
records.text: Not so keen on the Ashford Outlet Restaurant due to its layout.  However, this was our third visit in recent months, Portsmouth, Cambridge and here.  The issue once again is the small bowl options moving around the track, these are very limited and just a duplication of about 5/6 dishes.  Hot food options are good but it’s the small plates which are the company’s trade mark, you need to improve.

records.title: New Ordering System Creates Poor Service
records.text: Just been to Yo in Cambridge for first post COVID meal. Agree with the other reviewers that the new system is poor. No water or way to order extra drinks. Wrong food arrived - two of one thing and another part missed. And we had to wait so long between deliveries. The woman next to me had finished her meal before any of her husband’s arrived - they are not treating the orders as a ‘table’ but just as individual dishes. Very disappointing. We won’t be going back if they stay like this.

records.title: Went to the new one in Bluewater today
records.text: Went to the new one in Bluewater today. Never been before. Felt ripped off! And they tried to charge me an extra £5 service charge for crap service ! ..There wasn't enough food on the dishes and I wish I had thought about the cost a bit more ..but then you want to sit and enjoy food so you don't really...then £70 later you wish you'd gone to Wasabi ! ... my daughter just wanted to go for the novelty. But I feel the extortionate cost ruins the experience! ( £3.75 for a small bottle of lemonade too! )

records.title: Swindon branch, poor service, sub par food. Over priced.
records.text: Quite a poor experience, food was all very salty, even the meals for the children. The beef teriyaki was inedible due to the amount of salt.Poor customer service, asked a member of staff for some wasabi and was met with an abrupt "did you order it?", being a sushi restaurant I thought it would be included it I ordered sushi?? Asked another member of staff still didn't arrive after asking her twice. It only came after waiting and asking three times.All in all over priced sub par sushi with rude/poor customer service. Other better alternatives avaliable would not return.

records.title: Fair enough Product, Obliterated by Onion
records.text: Store bought stuff is fine but holy c*** do they carpet bomb the poor thingts with fried onion. .. i dont care for onion at all and so i only ever buy this brand if its on offer/throw out counter as even though i can put up with onion on stuff....i'd like to be able to see the Sushi beneath before i eat it. All other store bought brands offer the additions in small container/sachet so you can choose. i Wonder how many other folk who dislike strong onion taste avoid this brand like the plague due to the mess on top of the product.

records.title: The sushi was of bad quality...
records.text: The sushi was of bad quality.... I have been to other yo sushis and this has probably been my worse experience at any Japanese food related restaurants... ever....

records.title: Today for the first time went to YO in…
records.text: Today for the first time went to YO in Tesco in Bidston on the Wirral and bought sushi plus Korean Chicken noodles. The sushi rice was awful , so dense and glutenous and totally tasteless, just awful. The Korean Chicken was SOOO sweet I had to stop eating it. The staff were awful, did not even ask if I needed any help choosing, more interested in bi…ching about another staff member in the Heswall branch. WHERE WAS THE SASHIMI.. too much sweet badly cooked rubbish.

records.title: The sushi was of bad quality...
records.text: The sushi was of bad quality.... I have been to other yo sushis and this has probably been my worse experience at any Japanese food related restaurants... ever.... Service was ok... the restaurant was half empty and still they forgot my miso soup and messed up an order... Moreover, the miso soup had to be redone as mine was transparent and in fact was only hot water! Food on the conveyor belt was bad to be honest, the rice was tasteless and the seafood was even worse. Food is frozen and of bad quality. I ordered a couple of dishes from the menu and the seaweed tasted like cardboard. My boyfriend had a duck Bao and ended up puking once we got home.

description:
Healthy meal prep delivery in London, prepared fresh daily & delivered to 
  your home or office! Weekly changing menu bespoke to your personal health 
  goals.

records.title: Time saver
records.text: Healthy and yummy meals. I didn't lose weight but it certainly helped me to eat more healthy and save time cooking. If i wasn't moving abroad i'd keep the service.

records.title: A friend suggested the company to me so…
records.text: A friend suggested the company to me so I started with a one week trial - OMG the food was so tasty and well presented( I like food that looks good to eat) Working long hours meant I got into the habit of grabbing quick meals on the go like fast food and supermarket ready meals....Now I have good wholesome home cooked food without the prep! Perfect for me and now I'm a committed monthly meal planner, I cannot recommend highly enough

records.title: Ticks all my boxes
records.text: It's great for when you don't have this extra time on your hands but still want to keep an eye on what you eat. I like it for great flavours, quality, fantastic variety, freshness, frequent deliveries and flexibility. There is even a flexitarian option which works perfectly for me. And once I got apple pie / raspberry overnight oats to die for. Still trying to recreate them myself but not getting close.

records.title: Best food delivery in London!
records.text: Amazing food!  I’ve had so many food delivery services in London and this is by far the tastiest.  Just want I needed after baby number four.  Honestly, I would look forward to meals everyday as they were so tasty and alway felt satisfied after.  Also, I’ve always been told its healthy to have a rainbow on the plate, but have never managed it until key to food.  Such great variety of veg and colors.

records.title: I was extremely impressed by my week of food
records.text: I was extremely impressed by my week of meals from key to food Very tasty nutritious and look so good .I eat with my eyes and they look so good Yes I’ll definitely be ordering againSo much easier than cooking from scratch after a busy day

records.title: Couldn’t be better!
records.text: The key to food have been nothing but delicious, efficient and effective! This service has saved me time to work on my business. Provided me with consistent energy to perform and have delivered the goods straight to my door without a day or meal missed.I would whole heartedly recommend the key to food to anyone looking to conquer there nutrition from every angle!

records.title: Best In Class!
records.text: I’ve tried a few different meal delivery services and Key To Good Food is head and shoulders above the rest. The service is fast and friendly, they’re happy to personalise their plans, delivery is exactly as promised and most importantly of course, the food is absolutely delicious! Healthy, fresh, filling, varied - brilliant. And great value for money.

records.title: Amazing variation and quality
records.text: I have tried about fives different food delivery services over the past three years and Key To Food is, without doubt, the best quality. freshest-tasting and most varied I've encountered. I originally joined for a quick-fix two months but am still getting my meals, six months on! And their customer service is great and super-friendly. Brilliant!

records.title: Key to Food has changed my life for the…
records.text: Key to Food has changed my life for the better!I love the variety and the fact that I don’t have to worry about preparing breakfast, lunch or a snack. I also don’t have to worry about eating healthy because all of their meals are rich in natural ingredients, fruits and vegetables. I particularly love their outnight oats and smoothies.

records.title: Would give 6 stars if I could
records.text: Would give 6 stars if I could! Amazing food and amazing quality. Would recommend to everyone! Thank you Key To Food!! :)

records.title: Lovely food
records.text: Lovely food - can be repetitive at times for a vegetarian diet. Tends to repeat specific ingredients e.g. lentils, chickpeas. Always on time with delivery.

records.title: Pretty good
records.text: Pretty good, had the keto box for a couple of weeks. Only wish that you get told of what the meals a little bit in advance so you could potentially veto them.

records.title: Great quality and taste
records.text: Great quality, fresh and balanced food which is good for you (and no compromises on taste!). Everything we tried was delicious. It can be quite pricey but that’s what you pay for getting weekly supply of ready to eat varied food straight to your door - less hassle. The only problem we had is the mistake with delivery of our taster packages, on the delivery day we only got food for 1 person (instead of 2) that caused some inconvenience and we had to share. The support team was helpful though and they sorted everything out by sending the rest of the food (for 2nd person) the next day.

records.title: Food is healthy and delicious
records.text: Food is healthy and delicious. Saves a lot of time and worth the cost. Deliveries sometimes can be late, given the traffic in London. I personally don't like smoothies, so I opted out from snacks. But everything else is very good.

records.title: Good quality, tasty and well balanced meals.
records.text: I have my meals delivered Monday to Friday so that whilst working and exercising during the week it’s easy to eat healthy, high quality meals. I used to often skip meals and end up over hungry and tired, having three quality meals plus a snack has been excellent. Works out no more expensive than buying food to cook along with a sandwich or something bought out at lunch time. I have saved myself at least an hour every evening not having to shop and cook dinner too. Would be great if they had an app to daily meal feedback on taste/favourites etc.

records.title: Really great varied food
records.text: Really great varied food! Sustainable packaging and great delivery. Excellent at creating recipes for all dietary needs.

records.title: Great good for a packaged service and…
records.text: Great good for a packaged service and reactive customer service!

records.title: Healthy but tasteless
records.text: If you are looking for healthy food, this ticks the box. Its is however bland and tastless. The worst part was i received my first portion of my order and didnt like it, so i tried to cancel the reat of my order. Customer service would not cancel it for me.

records.title: Unfortunately there were three days of…
records.text: Unfortunately there were three days of meals that contained gluten, I have coeliac so this was a real shame as I couldn’t eat them at all. This wasn’t supplemented which again was disappointing. The food was tasty however the vegan menu got repetitive with tempeh. I didn’t feel that I lost any weight as the portions didn’t correlate with my macro requirements.

records.title: repetitive meals, meat mixup in vegan meals
records.text: Generally good albeit repetitive meals but delivered meat when I'm strictly vegan (unlabelled as well), food often lacking labels and meal containers often arrived broken and leaking

records.title: Not as great as it would first appear
records.text: This is a subscription service as stated and not priced per meal. Note they don't deliver on bank holidays. When you consider not all the food is delivered fresh daily, They delivery two meals on Monday and Wednesday and one on Friday. Then consider that £10-£27.50 per day you're paying and most bank holidays fall on a monday (5 in 2021). You are gifting between £100-£275 per annum to the company. The vegan meals while healthy(ish) began to all taste the same. Note they used white rice in preference over wholegrain. On check out you're offered a prefered delivery time which they don't stick to. The FAQ's for the site state times between 08:00-13:00. I often found myself in a situation of waiting for food to be delivered from 09:30 and it arrive at 13:30.

records.title: I had a good experience first time…
records.text: I had a good experience first time round, second time round confusion around seafood over fish order and they gave me tofu as a substitute. There was no offer to replace or change and i was disappointed.

records.title: Good food but never delivered on time
records.text: It's been few months now, food is healthy and useful during lockdown but delivery are consistently late despite having flagged timing requirement in the appropriate section when ordering

records.title: Avoid Queens Kebab Ramsgate
records.text: Queens Kebab RamsgateI've been a long standing customer through many of the owners over the years.Today though the food wasn't just bad it was so bad that it was un-eatable. The meat was so overly cooked you couldn't even eat it they got my salad order wrong and whatever that sauce was it really wasn't chilli. I got a lamb shish for my aunt and that too was horrible, cold and chewy the only saving grace was the chips were nice. But we've just had to cook something to eat. I would never recommend this place again.

records.title: Poor service
records.text: Poor service - have been requesting a refund for over three months but just never get any feedback. I was told I would be refunded for unused meals due to travel but nothing has been done

records.title: Horrible food, exceptionally poor, stubborn service.
records.text: Wish I’d seen some of the other reviews before committing to a month subscription!Totally agree with bland and tasteless. Also had same experience where they literally refuse to cancel it for me. Poor quality of ingredients, not very nice textures or flavours. some have been inedible. I messaged and emailed asking to cancel my subscription - twice - pointing out the terms and conditions, and they won’t let me. Really poor service and really upsetting, as I hate food waste- but am now faced with another three weeks of either eating horrible food, or putting it to the compost- which would obviously be a complete waste of money - not worth it at all.

records.title: Careless company that doesn’t take proper care of people with coeliac, but promises to do so!
records.text: I signed up to their trial plan for one week after exchanging emails where they promised their food is safe for coeliacs. I was ensured that they have a procedure to eliminate gluten from their food and they have many coeliac clients. They sent a meal with Guinness beer (was disclosed to me after the accident). I ended up in the emergency with severe bloating and pain that made it hard to breathe. Luckily, I stopped all the meals and avoided another one with rye bread that was delivered by mistake the day I returned from NHS!!! When I informed them, I just received an apology email, an explanation of which two meals contained gluten and a reimbursement for two meals!!! This cost me a lot as I was at the hospital for months after because of the pain, bloating and the impact on my immunity.Their products are not labeled properly (label is on the edge and you can’t read the ingredients). Their apology and reimbursement is not the proper way to deal with someone that had medical problems and could lose their life!

records.title: Avoid at all costs

description:
Pastan is a family-owned plant-based pasta restaurant. 

We serve a range of delicious handmade pasta dishes and delicacies; all made with the finest ingredients. At Pastan, we believe you shouldn't have to compromise on flavour or enjoyment when it comes to eating food that respects the planet. 

Carbon Free Dining partner.

records.title: Delicious
records.text: We visited from Newcastle on Friday and had the most amazing lunch. The restaurant is small and beautifully decorated and the staff were very friendly and attentive. We shared Pan con tomate to start and I had the Green Velvet Ravioli, which is one of the best dishes I've ever eaten. My other half had the Mac and Cheese, followed by the biscoff doughnuts which are served hot, these are a must! I enjoyed an Affogato and a delicious chocolate orange espresso martini. We thoroughly enjoyed everything we had and will definitely be back when we are next in London. Highly recommend this place to all.

records.title: What a gem!
records.text: Fantastic food! Delicious and a tantalising choice of all vegan food, all looking equally as delicious. The drinks menu too spoiled us for choice.  Staff were lovely .. friendly and efficient,  and the ambiance was relaxing and warm. Excellent value for money. Can’t recommend enough. Would definitely go back! Good luck pastan for a bright future!

records.title: This has quickly become our favourite…
records.text: This has quickly become our favourite restaurant in London. The food is incredible - particular highlights are the loaded gnocchi and the speculoos doughnut balls! We've eaten our way through most of the menu now and it's all amazing. The staff are great too - incredibley welcoming and warm. Highly reccommend a visit!

records.title: Excellent customer service. Delicious food!

records.title: Lovely birthday celebrations

records.title: My new favourite place in Manchester!
records.text: Went to the manchester branch and had an absolutely lovely experience. Everyone working there were just wonderful to speak to and the food was incredible. I had the Caspian Sea; the dill worked so well with the shrimp! We also treated ourselves to the donut balls for desert and these are essential for your order - biscoff filled and now one of my favourite deserts.Please give this place a chance, I read about this place ages ago but kept putting it off as was unsure if it was worth the price for pasta. It definitely was, there's dishes I haven't tried before (which tasted fantastic) and the restaurant was a relaxed environment, which just made for an incredible night with my friends. One of my new favourite spots to go to in Manchester and can't wait to go back.

records.title: Great food (especially the gnocchi…

description:
The Sushi Co – Responsible box fresh sushi. 

At The Sushi Co. we follow the path less trodden to seek out the highest quality ingredients for our live sushi kitchens, without compromising the environment that they come from. 

Our dedicated team works with a small hand-picked and highly accredited group of suppliers who deliver vibrant, eye-catching and flavoursome ingredients to our kitchens daily.

Once our team takes hold of these fresh ingredients, we follow authentic Japanese processes to prepare our handmade Minutes Fresh Sushi. From the size of slices taken from our Scottish sashimi grade salmon, to our slightly soured specialist sushi rice being the perfect bed for our fish or vegetables. We’re proud to take all the necessary extra steps to provide great quality sushi whilst doing our bit to be responsible in how we go about it. 


We don’t use any rice; we use sushi rice.

Rice is sushi, that’s why we use the same rice you’ll find in the UKs top sushi restaurants. Carefully milled in the Po Valley, Northern Italy. Mother nature’s rich Mediterranean sun melts the snow sitting high on the Alps giving the rice fields we source from everything they need to grow.  Our premium grade short grain rice is designed specifically for sushi – its texture and natural stickiness is perfect for sushi. 

 
Fresh fish daily from award-winning fisheries.  

We have the highest standards when sourcing our fresh fish suppliers. Whether it’s our 50-year-old Scottish Salmon farm or our cutting-edge 100% sustainable Dutch Yellowtail supplier, both are proud to have been accredited by the Aquaculture Stewardship Council (ASC) for making every step of their processes as sustainable as possible. 

Our Dutch Yellowtail are organically fed with the highest-grade antibiotic free feed, resulting in high levels of Omega 3. Our Scottish Salmon are nurtured in hatcheries on the banks of Loch Creran and use RAS technology to ensure the best growing conditions are provided.

records.text: I went to the one in Ealing Broadway, and the service was fantastic: very friendly and fast.The food was delicious and fresh. They have a very diverse menu of hot and cold foods. My only request to the restaurant is to please have gluten-free soy sauce. And make sure that the allergens on the menu are updated. As I didn't see any gluten allergen marked, there was only seafood and sesame allergens marked.

We ordered 4 particulars, we started 9pm its 10:30 now and we’re still waiting for one more dish. Hahaha its funny actually. We might sleep here hahaha

records.title: Went to the place in South Kensington
records.text: Went to the place in South Kensington. Certainly not to be recommended as a dine-in place, zero atmosphere, grey basement, disposable plates (boxes) and cutlery. Quality of food - below mediocre. Staff very friendly but it doesn’t compensate for the lack of quality.

records.title: Late and average
records.text: Ordered for pick up at the set time as on a tight time frame. Didn’t start preparing until I arrived which meant food was not ready until 30 minutes after original time. Food was very average and not great value should have gone to sticks and sushi next door.

records.title: I ordered via the website
records.text: I ordered via the website, and when I arrived to pick up my order 15-20 min later, I was informed that they didn't receive the order as the website booking platform didn't work. I had to wait another 15 min to get my order. Rice wasn't light and fluffy; it felt heavy.

description: Reishi Plant Based Kitchen resides upstairs in the popular public house "The Lamb and Flag" on the Tything, offering an innovative plant based dining experience. You will find our friendly team eagerly awaiting to invite you into the intimate restaurant where our experienced, well travelled kitchen team are busy creating an ethical menu featuring delicious global vegan cuisine to suit all dietary requirements. Our food where possible is local, organic, and above all else delicious.

records.title: Our Christmas lunch was delicious
records.text: Our Christmas lunch was delicious. Party of 6 and we all thought it was excellent. Only one very small criticism: there was no non-alcoholic mulled wine available but we were given soft drinks as a replacement. So no harm done!! Everything was fresh. The atmosphere is always great and the servers are really lovely and approachable.

records.title: Amazing vegan food
records.text: Friendly staff, nice atmosphere, not overcrowded with tables. Food was delicious. Both my friend and I had the 'fillet steak' which was the closest tasting thing to a steak I've had since becoming vegetarian five years ago. Neither of us are vegan but it's a great option for those with certain dietary considerations. Will definitely eat here again.

records.title: Fantastic food
records.text: Fantastic food. Friendly Staff

records.title: Good variety of food on offer for the…
records.text: Good variety of food on offer for the Xmas meal deal. Drinks alsoImaginative

records.title: Well what a surprise
records.text: Well what a surprise. We loved every minute and every mouthful of our wonderful meal from Reishi Plant Kitchen. Three course of incredibly tasty, beautifully presented food that arrived well timed and with exemplary service. Great drinks too of course. So many restaurants don't get their ambience quite right but Reishi have created a warm, cozy space full of natural rustic charm. Perfect lighting, bravo. We booked through the fab 'Taste Worcester' scheme. We're planning on taking vegan friends there too now :D Our meal was on a Wednesday so it was quiet – we hope more local people treat themselves to offerings from this dedicated plant kitchen of delight.

records.title: Fab food, super evening
records.text: Fab food and a lovely setting. Nestled above a friendly pub, serving delicious food. The staff are super friendly and we had a delicious meal- we left feeling very full and happy. Thank you to the excellent team for bringing vegan food alive in Worcester. I definitely recommend if you're visiting. 🤩

records.title: SPOT ON
records.text: We were bought a voucher by our meat eating family and they came along with us. Fantastic experience, the food was amazing, by far the best Vegan restaurant around. The Meaties were blown away by the food. I will certainly be back. The service was great.

records.title: Delicious vegan food in wonderful…
records.text: Delicious vegan food in wonderful surroundings with great service too! We'll be back.

records.title: A gem in central Worcester
records.text: Lovely environment, especially if you’re under the trellis area, makes you feel like you could be abroad, near a sandy beach. The food was delicious, enjoyed very much by myself (vegan) and my partner (non vegan) the tapas menus was really good, even had baked vegan feta which was delicious! Good prices, really friendly staff, and a definite gem in Worcester. I’ve recommended them to pretty much everyone I know and will hopefully be back very soon!

records.title: Finding Reishi was a delight
records.text: Finding Reishi was a delight! On arrival, I spotted a special o; the chalkboard, of Rose Matcha. It was outstanding and looked exquisite too, a swirl of rose pink and matcha green.The menu had great ideas, with several intriguing dishes to choose from, so we shared everything and got to try each dish on every course.The great ideas turned out to be superbly executed, skilful cooking at its vegan best!Attentive, highly professional staff and delicious food, in a lovely setting filled with natural light. I can’t recommend it highly enough.We had travelled for 90 minutes to get there, after seeing the website and our expectations were surpassed, it was well worth our journey.

records.title: Great Vegan Eatery
records.text: It is great to have an all vegan eatery in Worcester, & the food is always good. As a vegan, I enjoy the fact that I can have anything from the menu, & they always have a great choice. I had the burger from the bar menu, which was well presented & tasted great. For dessert I had a rose flavoured creme brulé, which was delicious. Keep up the good work team Reishi.

records.title: Beautiful food and excellent staff
records.text: Beautiful food and excellent staffThe food is excellent and a lot of time and effort clearly goes into it. I'm torn between 4 stars and 5 because I did find it a little expensive.  It was a treat but not somewhere I'd just nip into. Not that you could just nip in, they're popular, you need to book and understandably so.

records.title: Staff very friendly
records.text: Staff very friendly. Service efficient.Food delicious- one star deducted as I would have liked another mushroom or two ! (I had the portobello mushrooms instead of steak poivre)

records.text: Oh my gosh ! The food was lush!!! The steak here is the best meal I’ve ever had. Only downside is the location above the pub. The smoking area is below it and the smoke fills the restaurant. Very sad , if the ever move locations I would eat here ever week!
